shing rta'o/ /da sha ra tha la bu brgyud kyi rkyen i nya ster/ da sha ra tha i nya nya yal/dang por 'phel ba da ring por song / tha'i a phyis/ i la drangs/ dā sha ra thi ste/shing rta bcu pa'i bu zhes pa'o/ /rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'i bu ni bzhi ste/ lha rā ma dang / sha tru gha na dang / bha ra tha dang / lda ṇa rnams so/ /de rnams las su snyam na rā ma ste/ dā sha ra thi si bzhag /si rnam bcad/ dā sha ra thiXrā ma rā mthong bas rnam bod ru ru song / ra la ru dbyi/ dbyangs snga ma ring po'o/ /dā sha ra shrī rā maXbyung ngo / /rna ba can ni/ sngon 'thab dka'i sgo srungs rnams nub re bzhin srin po gcig gis bsad nas zos/ nub gcig rna ba can sgo srungs la yod pa/ srin po dang gyad stobs bkye bas rna ba can rgyal lo/ /da mi la gnod pa ma byed cig byas pas/ 'o na nyid re bzhin gser bhā ra gcig bzhi char bcas pa ster dgos zer ba ltar rtag tu byin skad/ se ba brgyad la ma sa gcigam sa bcu gnyis la to la gcig to la stong phrag la bhā ra yin/ ma sha ka ni ma sa'i ming ngo / /sa bā bhā ra/ zhes pa bzhi cha dang bcas pa'i bhā ra la zer/gzhan yang rang gi pags pa byin pa dang / 'chi ba'i tshe yang bram ze la sog ser gyi rang bzhin byin pa sogs slong mo bas blangs tshad ster ba'o/ /g.yul ngor brtan pa ni 'thab sar mi 'bros pa dang nam yang rdzun mi smra ba'o/ /'jigs pa ni 'jig sde ste glang po che stong phrag bcu'i stobs yod skad de/ phul byung tsam yin par mngon yang / pha bong khru bcu gnyis pa gru bzhi pa lag gis 'phangs nges pa'o/ /de dag go ba skye ba'i phyir 'phros don tsam mo/ rnam bcad kyi mtshams sbyor rdzogs so/ / —85—

༈ /da ni 'phros don gzhan cung zad bshad de/ 'grel bar ji skad du/ya du k+ta lo ki kā ye ha ta dī de ba hu laX bha be tra/ se māX bhu myu da de so khri mi t+yā dī nā ma du rtse tā/ bod skad du/ 'jig rten pas gang bshad pa 'di dag dang / /rig byed las ni de 'dra mang po 'byung / /sa gzhi ma byin blangs dang bur shing ma/ /de de 'di zhes la sogs nyes pa med/ /ces te/ gang 'jig rten 'di na mkhas pas bshad pa dang / nges tshig dang / rig byed las dmigs gsal dang / gsang tshig gi sgrub pa gzhan yang de 'dra ba mang du yod pa rnams brda sprod rang gzhung dang ma mthun yang nyes pa med de legs pa'i yan lag go se māX bhu myu da de/saX.i māX bhā mi a ā da de/ saX ni de i māX 'di/ dh+wa mi sa gzhi/ a dgag pa/ā da de dun nas sbyin pa/ de gnyis sdoms/ ma byi ni pa kho nar blangs pa'o/ /de'i tshe sa'i rnam bcad phyis rjes slar mtshams sbyar ba'o/ a i e/ semāX/ de 'di'o/ a dang ā mtshungs pa sbyar ma'i nga ro phyis/ i yu ā dang bsres/ bhā myu da de grub/ de zhes pa lha mi'u thung ste/ lha min stobs ldan gyi sa gzhi phro rges pa'o/ kha cig bhā mi ud de/ kho na yin zer nas phar sa gzhi byin pa'i bshad pa byed de mi 'thad do/ /so khri mi t+ya di/ zhes pa ni/ de bur shing ma zhes pa sogs zhes par bsgyur ro/ saX u khriX i ti ā di zhes pa la/ saXni de/ gi hāX ni bu raX shing mo ste/ lha kridzi'i bu a ni dra dha'i chung ma'i ming yin/ de ni srin po ba nā su ra'i bu mo'o/ /i ti zhes pa dang / ā di sogs pa'o/ /sa'i rnam bcad phyis kyang slar/ u la o byas pas/ so lgaX nga ro i la drangs/ mi ti la i bro kyi/ de ā la drangs pa'o/ /de si māX zhes dang / so khro ma zhes rnam bcad phyis pa'i rjes su —86—

mtshams sbyar kyang nyes pa med pa'i dper brjod do/ ༈yang brjod pa/ kwa tsi spro brin+tiXkwa tsi da pra khro skyuX/ kwatsi di bhā ṣa kwatsi da n+ya de ba/ /bi khyu rli khyu naX ba khu khyu sa sī k+ṣu tsa turbi ṅgāX bā hu la kaX ba da rnyi/ la lar 'jug dang la lar mi 'jug pa/ la lar gdam nga la lar gzhan du bsgyur/ /cho ga'i rim pa mang po legs 'dod de/ /sgrub tshul bzhi po mang du bshad pa'o/ skabs la la 'ga' zhig tu ste/ phal cher la mdo'i don spyir btang dmigs gsal tshig zin 'jug pa dang / la lar nges tshig gi sgrub pa dang / man ngag gsang tshig gis/ mdo'i dngos bstan la spyir btangs dang / dmigs gsal gnyis shugs bstan te gsum ka spangs bas mdo'i don mi 'jug pa dang / yang la lar bu bhā ṣa gnyis su smra ba gang mang ste/mdo don dang mdo don ma yin pa 'dam kar byed pa dang / la lar mdo tshig gis zin pa'am ma zin pa gang yin yang rung / gong gi bhā mi gi nga ro dbyi ba lta bu/ rgyu mtshan bshad du med pa dang / ā de sha byed pa so gos gzhan du bsgyur ba ste cho ga bzhi po dag go/cho ga'i bya ba mi 'dra ba'i grub tshul mang po dag yod pa mi 'gog ste 'dod pa yin kyang / sgrub tshul bzhi po de mang po de dag 'dus par zugad do/ /brje ga mo brna bi pad+ma ya : dwo tsā pa ro brna bi kā ra nā sho/ dh+wa tosta da shrī ti sha ye na yo ga sta du tsu te pañtsa bi dhaX bi ruk+taX/ yi ge glo bur yi ge bsnol ba dang / nyams dang yi ge rnam 'gyur gnyis ni gzhan/ /byings de'i don la phul byung sbyor ba ste/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga lnga po nges par bshad/ ces te gzhan yang rnam 'gyur rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi'am lnga yod de/ yi ge glo bur ba ste/ sngar rgyun med pa'i yi ge gsar pa bsnan pa ā ga ma dang bar rkyen rnams yin la/ spyir —87—

rkyen thams cad sngar med glo bur du byung ba ltar snang yang / tshig dang rkyen/ ming dang rkyen/ byings dang rkyen rnams snga phyir sbyor rgyu'i dngos po rnams khyad gzhi yin pas yi ge glo bur ba ma yin no/ /yi ge bsnol pa ni/ snga ma'i gsal byed phyi mar spos/ phyi ma'i gsal byed snga mar spos pa yin la/ yi ge nyams pa ni dbyi ba ste/ lo pa/ lo pa sha/ lu ka ste gsum mo/ /yi ge rnam par 'gyur ba ni/ā de sha la sogs pa'o/ /de yang mtha' 'gyur ba dang / ngo bo 'gyur ba 'brel ba can dang / 'brel ba med ba sogs sna tsho gis pa'o/ gnyis ni gzhan zhes pa/nyams dang rnam 'gyur gnyis ni glo bur ba dang bsnol ba las rnam par 'gyur tshul gzhan yin no zhes so/ /byings kyi don de la phul byung du sbyor ba ni/ bzhi po de'i nang na ci rigs pa'ang yod pas logs su mi 'dren pa'am/ de dag tu ma 'dus pa yang yod pas lnga par yang bgrang ngo / /byings de'i dang po'i don gang yin pa de ka ches phul du byung bar 'gro ba'i don gyi rkyen gyi cho ga la/ byings kyi don de la phul du byung ba'i sbyor ba zer ro/ brta ga mo ga be sgru do sidhe brte bi pad+ma yaX/ kho ḍa shā do bi kāraXsgyu ñtsa nā shaXbṛ sho da re/ yi ge glo bur ba lang dbang po sogs/ /yi ge rab tu bsnol ba seng ge'o/ /bcu drug sogs ni rnam par 'gyur ba yin/ /yi ge nyams pa rgyas pa'i lto ba zhes/ /zhes so/ /ā ga ma la ā ga mo/ /zhes pa'i rna ru ni rnam bcad u'i shul lo/ ༈ go/ in+t+ra ba theg bar du a yig ā ga ma byin/ go a mthong bas tse( ab/ ga ab a in+d+ra a ni i la e/so sor drangs pas/ ga ben+t+ra/ ba lang gi dbang bo ste khyu mchog go /ga be rgyu ā do mtshams sbyar bas/ ga ben+da do byung / de yang ā di di ba theg de au bsgyur/ de ḍi —88—

tra yin pas ṭi da'i i phyis/ dra au la drangs pas/ ā do byung ba'o/ /'di phul du byung ba'i don can no/ ༈yi ge bsnol ba ni hi das/ zhes pa la/ dbyangs so sor phral/ ha id sa a byung / dbyangs gnyis gong 'og ma bsgyur bar/ ha sa'i gnas su bskyal/ sa yig he'i gnas su bskyal nas so sor drangs bas sidha grub/ gzhung las/ da he ni/ snye ha la ngi byin pa'o/ ༈ yi ge rnam 'gyur ni/ṣa ṣa da sha bzhug khri dbyangs med u/ dra ṇa ru song / u la o/ kho byung /sho ḍa sha grub/ khu u ru 'gro ba 'brel ba med kyang bsgyur ba yin/ da ḍa ru 'gyur ba 'brel bas 'gyur ba'o/ /yi ge nyams pa ni/ bṛ ṣa tra u da ra bzhag /tra yig rgyu mtshan 'brel med par phyis pa'o/ /u la o/ /kho ru song / bṛ kho da ra/grub/ bṛ ṣa tra chen por rgyas pa dang ri dwags la 'jug /u da ra lto ba'o/ /des na rgyas pa'i lto ba'am/ ri dwags lto ba'o/ /de nas yi ge glo bur ba'i dper brjod/ ga ben+t+ra yi ge bsnol ba'i dper brjod/ si dra ha/ yi ge rnam par 'gyur ba'i dper brjod/ kho ḍa sha /yi ge nyams pa'i dper brjod/ mṛ sho da ra'o/ ༈ /brje bi kā ra nā shā bhāX dh+wa to ra ti sha ye na yaX/ yo gaXs u tsu te pra lha mi yu ra bh+ra ma rā di sgyu yi ge rnam par 'gyur dang nyams dag gis/ byings la phul du byung ba 'dren pa gang / /rma bya dang ni bung ba la sogs su/ khres rab can gyis sbyor ba de smras so/ /yi ge rnam par 'gyur ba'i rigs las byings la phul byung gi dper brjod ni/ rma bya ste/ ma yu ra zhes pa lta bu yin la/ yi ge nyams pa'i phul byung sbyor ba'i dper brjod ni/ bung ba'i skad dod / bh+ra ma ra lta bu'o/de yang ru sgra la lo/ zhes sam/ ri sgra la'o/ gang rigs ba6ga rkyen ḍa sbyin/—89—

ḍā yal/ a ba theg ti ta la ṭi dbyi bas/ ru yin na u dang / ri yin na i yal/ drangs bas ra byung / de la si rnam bcad/ raXgrub/ sgra 'byin pa'i don yin/ yang na rkyen a yig spyin/ ra'i srog u dang / i brjod don/ drangs/ si rnam bcad byas kyang 'ong ngo / ༈ ma hi gong du bzhag ste sa gzhi'i ming yin/ ma hi raX zhes pa bzhag phul du byung ba'i yi ge rnam par bsgyur te/ hi zhes pa'i hu dang dbyangs sī ring po sdoms pa de/ ྅ ring por bsgyur ba/ ma pū ra grub/ sa steng du skad phul du byung bar sgrog ba'i don te rma bya'i skad dod do/ /rma bya'i mjug sgro mdongs can la/ dh+wa dza ste rgyal mtshan zer/ rma bya sgro mdongs can la/ka lā ya ra zer/ de med pa la la rtor zer/ sgro mdongs kyi dbus kyi thig le la/tsan+d+ra ka zer/ rgyud las/ bod skad la/ /zla ba chu shel nor bu 'od/ /zhes pa las ma byung yang / rgya gar gyi skad tsan+di ka la/ rgya 'grel 'ga' na nag po'i bshad pa byed pa mi 'gal ba der gda'/ rma bya pho gar byed cing mchi ma 'bab pa la/ ri shu zer/ de rma bya mos 'thungs pa las/ mdongs kyi thig le 'byung bar grags so/ /phyis byung rgya gar gyi cha rgyus med par/ rgya gar gyi bshad pa ka byed mkhan tsho ya cha'o/ ༈ yang bha ma ta raXbazhag /yi ge nyams pa ste/ tra yig dbyi/ 'di yang phul du byung ba'i don yin/ bha ma ta/ 'khor ba/ raXsgra 'byin pa'o/ /ma'i mtha' rten tra yig phyis pas phul byung du song bas/ sgra chen po dang bcas te 'phur lding byed pa'i don te/ bh+ra ma ri ha byung ba yin no/ /rnam 'gyur gyi dbye ba bshad pa 'di rnams mtshon byed de/ gzhung phyi ༷༷bung ba'o/ /seng ge yang hid sa ste 'che pa phul du byung ba'i don la/ sim rnams su —90—

rgyas par rtogs par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir cung zad bshad pa ni/ slar 'chad 'gyur ba rnams la/ slob sla ba'i phyir dang po nyid nas 'jug sgo cung zad bshad pas 'dris su 'jug pa yin la/ mtshams sbyor tsam kho na las gzhan mi slob pa rnams la ni/ blo gros rgyas par byed pa'i gal chen yin no/ /'dir sa dang e ṣa las ha sa la'o/ /zhes pa yan chad kyis rnam bcad kyi mtshams sbyor rdzogs chi kyang / de man chad 'grel par 'phros don cung zad tshigs bcad du mdzad 'dug pas de dag gi don zur tsam smros pa'o/ swa ra swa sti byā ka ra ṇa'i gzhung las mtshams sbyor gyi gzhung legs par bshad pa'o/ gcig zhus/ /bibha kun+taX pa daX/ rnam dbye'i mtha' can ni tshig go /rnam dbye gnyis las 'dir si sogs so/ a bibha sti nā ma/ rnam dbye med pa ni ming ngo / /byings kyi mtshan nyid bor ba zhes bya ba/ krita mtha'i rkyen sogs byin pas byings las 'gyur grub pa si sogs ti sogs kyi rnam dbye ma byin pa ni ming ngam rtags sam/ shag zhes bya'o/ ta grwa ta/ de yang / si au dzas/ da au shas/ ṭā smya mu nyis/ nge khyu ma byas/ /nga si sgyu mu khyo su/ nges os u mu/ ngi os sus/ ༈dang por a thung mtha' can spyir btang la/ de ba'i sgra la dper brjod du bya ste/ de ba'i ming ngam rtags la/ rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig si byin/ de ba si/ si'i srog gi i ni brjod don yin pas phyis/ sa srog med/ sro bis rga/ sa ru dag gi rnam bcad do/ /byings kyi mtha' ma yin pa ste/ ming mtha' 'am tshig mtha' la rkyen gyi sa yig ru yig srog med rnams rnam bcad du 'gyur zhes bya ste/ de yang tshig mtha' yin na/ pha rol du yi ge gzhan med kyang der 'gyur ba yin la/—91—

tshig mtha' min par ming tsam yin pa sogs la/ ra sa'i so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge sum cu po gang rung pha rol du yod pa'ang dgos pa las/ 'dir tshig mtha' yang yin pas/ si'i su srog med rnam bcad du song bas/ de ba ༷༷lha grub bo/ de ba la rnam dbye dang po'i gnyis tshig au byin/ o dang au la e'o/ /zhes pas rtags mtha'i a au ru bsgyur/ de po lha dag zhes pa grub/ de ba la rnam dbye dang po'i mang tshig dzas byin/ de ba dza sa dza yig ni/ dzas zhi'o zhes pa'i mdo lha'i bya ba'i dgos pa can yin cing / rtags don yin pas phyis/ de ba as 'dra ba'i yi ge la ring la ring bo'o/ /pha rol dbyi ba'i a ring por song sa rnam bcad du bya'o/ de lha rnams bāX༈ mdo gzhan las ni a yig gi dzas la/a su ka res 'ga'o zhes bshad pas / de ba dza sa/ a su kra byin ba/ de ba'i srog gi a ring song / de bā su a su ka kra rjes 'brel yin pas phyis/ su'i u brjod don yin pas phyis/ de bā sa as/ lha rnams / sa dbyangs med pha rol tu drangs/ sra phyi ma rnam bcad/ de bā saX'adi sdeb sbyor dang rig byed lugs te yang na ba'o/ ༈/ de ba la rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig da byin/ de ba da/a sna sor su/ da shas dag gi a'o/ tshu rol rtags mtha' mtshungs pa'i yi ge yod la/ pha rol ri dang shas kyi a dag ming mtha' la dbyi ste/'on kyang byings kyi mthar byin pa yin na mi dbyi'o/ /'dir ming mtha' yin pas dbyi ste/ de ba mu/ mu rjes su nga ro/ de baX lha la zhes pa grub bo/ /de ba la gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig au ster te/ dang po'i gnyis tshig dang tsha ga 'dra'o/ /de bo grub/ de ba la gnyis pa'i mang tshig shas byin/ de ba shas/ sha yig ni/ shas —92—

la'o zhes sogs mdo bya ba la dgos mod/ /brda chad tha snyad kyi don yin pas phyis/ lha la/ de ba as/ sonaXpuXsaX skyes pa las sa'i na'o/ /skyes pa 'i rtags kyi mtshungs pa'i yi ge yod pa'i mtha' can gyi pha rol du bzhag pa'i shas kyi sa yig ni na srog med du 'gyur ro/ sha si/ shas la'o/ shas kyi sha yig phyis zin kyang nus pa as la yod pas/ /rtags mtha'i a ring por 'gyur ro/ /as de thog ma shas yin pas/ shas la'o zhes shas kyi ming btags pa'o/ /as kyi a ni/ da shas dag gi a'o/ /zhes pas dbyi'o/ de bā na lha rnams zhes pa grub/ ༈ gsum pa'i gcig tshig gi rkyen ṭā yin te/ de ba la ṭā byin/ de ba ṭā/ ṭa ni ṭā i na'o sogs kyi rtags don nam/ rjes 'brel yin pas phyis/ṭa na/ ṭā i na'o/ ṭa'i a i na zhes par bsgyur/ a i la e'o/ /zhes pas rtags mtha'i a er song / de ben lha yis grub/ gnyis tshig ni/a rnyi/ bha la a'o/ de ba sgyu mu/ de ba'i rtags mtha'i a yig ni/ rnam dbye bha yig mthong bas ā yig tu 'gyur ro/ mu ni kun la 'dra ste nga ror bsgyur kyang rung ma bskyur kyang rung ngo / de bā bhāX/ lha dag gi grub po/ mang tshig ni / dzoXbha'i bha a'o/ /de ba rtsis/ a thung mtha' can las pha rol rkyen rnam dbye'i dhis kyi bha yig ni a ru bsgyur te/ ā de sha bya'o/ /de yang da kyi gong du 'bri'o/ /der ā de sha'i a de/ da kyi i mthong bas a i bhangs tsa a si tsa/tsa gsum tshig sdud kyis phyis/ da gnyis mi zad pa las 'jig si rnam bcad/ bha bhi aX ri ru song / dzha sa tshu rol dzha bha pha rol la dza ba ru —93—

'gyur bas/ bha ba ru song / phar drangs/ bhūXl e'o/ /deb e sa/ rtags mtha'i a pha rol e mthong / 'phel ba i ru song / sa rnam bcad/ de be+eXlha rnams kyis grub/ ༈ sdeb sbyor las/ bhi rang sor ba6ga rtags mtha'i a er bsgyur dgos te/ ji skad du/ a yig bhi sa la e yig yang na'o/ /sa rnam bcad/ de be bhiXkuṇ+ḍa stiX/ ༈ rnam dbye bzhi pa'i gcig tshig de ste/ de ba de dra'i dra ni di ta kyi bya ba'i don yin pas dbyi ste/ 'dir ma zad nga ldan bzhi car gying yig rnam pa kun tu dbyi'o/nge raka nge yi akra'o/ /de la a ka ā ga ma ster te 'di ka tra ā ga ma yin pas rnam dbye'i mthar bzhag kra rjes 'brel/ e a yu'o/ /zhes pas/ de e a yu ru song / de ba a yu a/ mtshungs pa'i yi ge la ring lnga'o/ /de bā ru song / dbyangs med pha rol a la yu drangs/ de bā ya lha'i ched du/ grub bo/gnyis tshig de ba sgyu mu/ de bā bhāX du 'grub ste/ lha dag gi ched du gong rnam dbye gsum pa dang 'dra mang tshig gi rkyen byas yin te/e sdi ba hu tī/ sa bha mang po nyid la e'o/ /de bsnus/ bhi sda ma gtogs pa'i rnam dbye sa yig bha yig gang yin la yang / 'dra ste/ mang tshig gi rkyen yin na/ de mthong bas a thung mtha' na e ru 'gyur ro/ /de las 'di mang tshig gi bha yig ste/ de be sdus/ su rnam bcad/ de be khyoXgrub po/ lha rnams kyi ched du/༈ rnam dbye lnga pa'i dbang du byas te gcig tshig sing ste/ de ba nga si ri dbyi/ nga si ra tra/ nga si a ta do/ /a thung mtha' can la/ nga si a tra du bsgyur ba'i ā de sha bya la/ de yang nga dang i phyis nas a ta du bsgyur ba blo la bzhag —94—

go /'dra ba ring po/ de ba ta grub/ lha las/ gnyis tshig de ba sgyu mu/ lha dag las de bā bhāX du bskyur ba dang / mang tshig de ba smyas/ de be khyuXlha rnams las / zhes par bsgyur ba ni/ gong bzhi pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/༈ rnam dbye drug pa'i dbang du byas nas gcig tshig ngas yin te/ nga sgru/ngas su'o/ de ba ngas/ a thung mtha' can la rkyen ngas ni/ nga yig phyis/ a sa gya ru bsgyur/ de ba phya/ lha yi grub/ gnyis tshig ni/ o si/ os la'o/ de ba os/ de ba'i rtags mtha' a ni rnam dbye o sa mthong bas e yig tu 'gyur la/ e da/ dbyangs med pha rol sa rnam bcad/ de ba yoXgrub/ lha dag gi mang tshig ni/ de ba u mu/ nu ṭa maX nu ṭa u mu la'o/ rnam dbye u mu la nus ā ga ma sbyin te/ 'di ṭi tra ā ga ma yin pas/ rnam dbye'i sngon du bzhag dgos so/ /ṭa rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ 'dir u mu la nu tra ster ba ni/ rtags mtha' mtshungs pa'i yi ge yod na yin no/ /dbyangs med pha rol/ nā mi/ nā mu la'o/ pha rol nā mu las tshu rol rtags mtha' ring bor 'gyur bas/ de bā lha rnams kyi grub nā/༈ rnam dbye bdun pa'i dbang du byas nas gcig tshig ngi'o/ /de ba ngi nga dbyi/ a i la e'o/ /lha la de be/ grub/ gnyis tshig de ba os/ de ba yoXlha dag la zhes par 'gyur ba drug pa'i skabs bzhin no/ /mang tshig gi dbang du byas te/ de ba su pu bzhag ri rjes 'brel/ki 'u chu khaXsaXkṛ ta su/ ku i la las ṣa ru byed de sa'o/ /sa dang bha mang po nyid la ni e'o/ zhes pas su pra kyi sa yig ni mang tshig yin pas/ rtags —95—

mtha'i a e ru bya'o/ ka sde dang i la so sor bsdu ba ste/ i u ṛ kla e e o au ha ya ba ra la bcu gsum po'i rtags mtha' can gyi pha rol kyi/ rnam dbye sa yig ni ṣa yig tu 'gyur te/ 'gyur ba de yang brjod pa bde ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis sgra mdo rnams su de ltar byed pa yin gyi rgyu mtshan gzhan ni med do/ de bas na mdo'i byed pas bsgyur na/ de be khu grub/ lha rnams la/༈ bod pa'i don la gcig gnyis mang tshig gsum las/ dang po ni/ ā man+t+ra ṇi sirnyiX bod pa la si dhi 'o/ /mngon du mthong ba la smra ba'i ming 'bod byed pa na bod pa ste/ mgron du 'bod pa lta bu ni ma yin no/ /bod pa'i don du sbyin pa'i rnam dbye si la dhi zhes brda chad bya'o/ /de ba si bzhag /sa mā na rnyeslo bo3dha toXbyings ma yin pa'i mtshungs pa la dhi dbyi'o/ /byings yin na mtshungs pa yin kyang dhi mi 'phyid la/ byings kyi mtha' ma yin pa'i tshu rol ming mtha' la mtshungs pa'i yi ge bcu po gang rung zhig yod pa la/ pha rol du bod si byung ba rnams dbyi'o/ /de ba/ mngon du smras pa'i bod tshig gi rnam dbye byin pa'i rtags su ming gi thog mar he yig bzhag par bya'o/ /he ni mtshon pa ste/ bho la sogs pa yang ngo / de ba/ grub/ he/ kyi lha gnyis pa gnyis tshig ni/de ba au/ de bo/ rnam dbye dang po'i skabs dang 'dra/ he/ de bo/ grub/ kyai lha dag gsum na pa mang tshig ni/ de ba dzas/ de bāX/ gong rnam dbye dang po'i skabs dang 'dra/ he de bāXgrub/ kye lha rnams zhes so/ /'dis mtshon te 'og ma rnams la'ang so so'i skabs thob dang sbyar te shes par bya'o de ltar na/ si au dzas rnams/ don tsam ston pa dang / bod pa'i don te dgos pa'i dbang gis lan —96—

gnyis ldabs pas/ rnam dbye nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ /de ba'i sgra la byed pa ltar/ gha ṭa/bum pa pa/ gos ṭa ma ṭa/ gnas staX bha/ ka ba ku nga bum pa be pra/ bram ze brik+ṣa shing la sogs pa ches mang po rnams la cho ga 'di kho na sbyor te/ spyir btang a thung mtha' can pho rtags rnams la'o/ /a thung mtha' can yin yang / sarba la sogs pa rnams la ni cho ga cung zad mi 'dra ba yod de/ de la sarba la sogs pa ni/ sarba thams cad/ bi shwa sna tshogs/ u bha gnyis u bha ya gnyis min/ a n+ya/g.yin a n+ya ta ra/ /gzhan dang gzhan i ta ra/ rang las tha dad ḍa ta ra dang ḍa ta ma dang ni/ ka ta ra ji tsam dang ka ta ma ji tsam dang yang / sa ma ra mnyam pa si mar sa cha 'am mnga' zhabs ne ma ra khrims/ e ka gcig dang / pū rbur shar par pha rol dang ni a ba ra dak+ṣi ṇa gzhan/ lho dang de bzhin ut+ta ra/ byang a pa ra gzhan zhig dang / a dha ra dma' ba dang mchu dang swa rang / /an+ta ra/ bar mtshams tu du tad yang dang gang ces e tad lkog 'gyur dang / i dmu/ a das 'di gsum mngon gyur dī/ gnyis/ ci/ 'di dang ba dang smad pa gnyis yod/yurmi khyed/ a smad bdag/ bha bta yod min byung gyur zhes bya so lnga'o/ rtags gsum cho ga thams cad 'jug rung yin/ de la re zhig pho rtags kyi dbang du byas te/ rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig la/ sarba si/ sa spruX ces par 'gyur/gnyis tshig la/ sa sgro au/ sa khro/ zhes par 'gyur te/ de gnyis de ba'i rtags dang 'dra'o/ /mang tshig la/ sarba dzas/ dza sī/ dzas zhi'o/ /sarba sogs kyi nang nas a thung gi mtha' la pha rol dzas ril gyis yī ru bsgyur/ sarba dzas/ sarba yī/ a i la e'o/ sa rbe/ grub/ ༈rnam dbye gnyis pa la/ gcig tshig sarba —97—

da/ sarbaX/ gnyis tshig sarba au/ sa khro/ mang tshig sarba shas/ sa grwan rnams grub ste/ de ba'i rtags dang 'dra'o/༈ rnam dbye gsum pa'i dang po ni/ sarba ṭu/ spru in 'o/ sarba i na/ a i la e'o/ /sa rben/ zhes so/ /khrerno rko ྅ naX ti/ ṣa ra ṛ las mtha' min pa'i ṇa na'o/ /tshu rol du ṣa yig dang re pha dang ṛ yig yod la/ yi ge gas gyis bar ma chod na/ pha rol na yig mtha' ma yin pa ste srog can yod pa rnams ṇa yig 'gyur la/ mtha' ste srog med yin na ṇa ru mi 'gyur te/ sa sgro la gnyis pa'i mang tshig shas byin pa'i rjes ni/ sa rgyun zhes na yig bya yi/ sa zhwa ṇa zhes ṇa yig mi bya ba bzhin no/ /a ba ku pa ban+ta re ྅ pi/ a ba ku pu bar na yod kyang ngo / /a ba so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge a i u ṛ '-i e i o au ha ya ba/ zhes pa rnams dang / ku ni ka sde/ pu ni pa sde/ yi ge de rnams tshu rol ṣa ra ri dang / pha rol na yi ge bar na yod kyang na yig ṇa yig tu 'gro la/ lhag ma yi ge rnams yod na mi 'gyur ro/ /snga ma'i dmigs gsal lo/ /de ltar na/ sarba zhes pa las/ da zhes pa'i ru mthong bas/ pha rol a na'i na yig srog can ṇa ru 'gro ste/ bar na ba dang e yod kyang e yig ni a ba so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yin/ ba yig ba sde yin pa de yod kyang / na de ṇa yig tu song ngo / /sa rbe ṇa/ grub gnyis tshig /sarba sgyu mu/ sa rgyu bhāX/ mang tshig sarba rtsis/ sa r+bheX rnams de ba dang 'dra/ ༈rnam dbye bzhi pa'i gcig tshig la/ sa sgro de nga phyis/ sa spru sogs la sma ṭa 'o/ rnam dbye la sma ṭa ā ga ma ster/ 'di krita yin rnam dbye'i gong du 'bri/ṭa rjes 'brel/ sa sgro sma e/ a e la e'o/ sme/ sarba smi/ grub/ gnyis tshig—98—

sa spru khyum/ sa shrī bhā/ mang tshig/ sa spru sdus/ sa r+bhe khyuX gong ma rnams dang 'dra/ ༈lnga pa'i gcig tshig sa sgro nga si/ dra dang i phyis/ as bzhag a taX.a tra la'o/ /ngas kyi as a ta du bsnyur/ sma ṭa ā ga ma byin te gong bzhin la/ sa spru sma a ta/ sma'i a dang pha rol a ta mtshungs pa 'dra ba byas pas/ sa spru smutra/grub/ gnyis tshig sarba snum sa sgro bhāX/ mang tshig sarba bha sra/ sa rbe bh+yaX ༈drug pa'i dang po/ sa sgro ngas/ ngas phya'o/ /zhes pas/ sa spru gya/ gnyis tshig sar+bha.os/ sa rgyu yoX/ gong bzhin/ mang tshig ni/ sa spru u mu/ su ḍā maX su ṭa u mu la'o/ /gong du nus ster ba'i don du/ sus ā ga ma ster/ ṭa rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ sa sgros ā mu/ bha sa mang po nid la e'o/ /rtags mtha' er bsgyur/ sa r+bhe ku i la las ṣa ru byed de sa'o/ /sa ṣa ru bsgyur/ dbyangs med/sa rje khriX/༈ bdun pa'i dang po la/ sa spru/ ngi tri phyis/ ngi smin/ ngi smin 'o/ /ngi'i i smin du bsgyur te/ sa spru smin/ gnyis tshig sa spru os/ sarba yoX/ mang tshigs spru su pra/ sa r+bhe khu rnams kyang de ba'i skabs bzhin no/ ༈ bod pa la yang / he sa spru/ he sa khro/ sa spru dzas/ dzas ril gyis yī ru 'gyur bas/ he sa r+bhe/ de dang 'dra bar bi shwa la sogs pa'i sa spru nā ma'i sgra a yig mtha' can kun spyir btangs su/ sa spru dang sgrub tshul 'dra'o/ ༈ ḍa tar dang ḍa tam ni rkyen yin gyi ming ma yin mod/ ming gzhan gyi mthar sbyar te 'byung bas/ de'i tshe bya ba byed tshul sa spru dang 'dra'o/ ༈ pu zla la sogs pa dgu ste/ gu za/ ba ra/ a ba ra/ dak+ṣi ṇa/ at+ta ra/ a pa ra/ a dha ra/ su arnya ru rnams so/ de ltar dgu po rnams la —99—

dzas yī ru bsgyur nas/ pur+bhe/ pa re sogs su byed pa dang / de ba'i sgra bzhin mtshungs 'dra byas pas/ phi khruX ba rāX/ zhes sogs su byed pa 'dam ka yin no/ /nga dang ngi la yang / sa spru dang de ba'i bya ba gang rung 'dam ka can byed pas/puṇ+ḍa da si/ puṇ+ḍa smutra/ pu ble di/ ga rbu smin/ zhes pa sa sgro'i lugs dang / puṇ+ḍa nga si/puṇ+ḍa tra/ puṇ+ḍa ngi / gar+bhe/ zhes pa de ba'i lugs yang na bar bya'o/ /lhag ma rnams sarba kho na bzhin bsgrub bo/ ༈ yang pra tha ma/ dang po tsa ra ma/ pags pa ta ya ṭa/yin rkyen a ya ṭā/ a lpa/ chung ngu a byed rta/ ka ti ji tsam byung pa ya la sogs pa la yang de dang 'dra'o/ /dza srib/ dzas sī yang na'o/ dper na/ pra tha ma/ dzas/ dzas yī/ pra tha me/ pra tha ma/ dzas/ pra tha ma/ as/ 'dra ba ring po/ pra tha māX/ zhes te/ pra tha ma sogs la rnam dbye lhag ma thams can spyir btang de ba'i skabs dang 'dra'o/༈ /ta ya ṭa dang a ya ṭa ni rkyen yin yang / de dang de'i mtha' can ni rkyen mtha' can gyi ming yin pas sgra ste ming gi nang du bzung par bya'o/ ༈ /tī ya zhes pa'ang rkyen yin mod/ sarba sogs dang gzugs 'dra bar bya ste/ ngi tra te dra ldan rnams/sa spru la sogs pa dang / de ba la sogs pa gang rung gi bya ba gdam nga yin no/ ༈ming gzhan gyi mthar tī ya 'jug tshul ni/ sa sgro sogs kyi nang tshan/ dī zhes pa'i mthar tī ya sbyar ba/ dī tī ya la sarba sogs kyi rang lugs ltar/ de la dī tī ya smi/ nga si la dī tī ya smu tra/ ngi la dī tī ya smin/ zhes pa dang / de ba shabha ltar na/de la dī tī yā ya/ nga si la di tī rdza tra/ ngi la dī tī ye/ zhes pa'o/ ༈sa sgro sogs min yang / tri tī ya la yang de bzhin no/ ༈sa spru'i nang tshan/ u bha la ni/ si —100—

sogs gcig tshig bdun dang / dzas sogs mang tshig bdun mi 'jugaganyis tshig bdun po kho na 'jug pas/ /de dag kyang / ༈dang po la/ u bha au/u lho|gnyis pa la/ u bha au/ u bho/ ༈gsum pa la/ u bha/ byas/ gi khyu khyuX/ ༈bzhi pa la/ u bha smya mu/ u bhā bhāX/ ༈lnga pa la/ u bha bya mu/ gi khyu bhāX/ ༈drug pa la/ u bha/ os/ u bha yoX/ ༈bdun pa la/ u bha/ os/ u bha yoX/zhes pa'o/ ༈u bha ya la ni/ au la sogs pa gnyis tshig bdun po med de/gcig tshig bdun dang mang tshig bdun no/ /de yang / ༈dang po'i gcig tshiga.u bha ya si/ u bha yaXmang tshig u bha ya/ dzas/ u bha ye/ ༈ gnyis pa'i gcig tshig u bha ya ri/ u bha yaX/ mang tshig /u bha ya shas/ u bha yun/ ༈gsum pa'i gcis/ tshig u bha ya ṭā/ u bha ye na/ mang tshig u bha ya rtsis/ u bha yiX/ ༈bzhi pa'i gcig tshig u bha ya nge / u bha ya sme/ mang tshiga.u bha ya byas/ u bha ye bh+yaX༈ lnga pa'i gcig tshig u bha ya sing/ u bha ya smutra/mang tshig /u bha ya sdus/ u bha ye khyuX ༈ drug pa'i gcig tshig u bha ya ngas/ u bha ya gya/ mang tshig u bha ya/ u mu/ u bha ye lgaX ༈ bdun pa'i gcig tshig u bha ya ngi / u bha ya smin/ mang tshig /u bha ya su pra/u bha ye skyu zhes bya ste/ sa spru la sogs pa rang gi bya ba nyid do/ /'o na sa r+bhe ṇa zhes pa ltar 'dir mi 'byung ba ci zhe na/ de ni sa ṇ+ḍa'i sde tshan de la rnam dbye 'jug tshul gyi bya ba ma yin/ sa spru'i rtags rang nyid la ra yig yod pa'i nus pa kho na yin pas mi 'gal lo/ /de dag ni a ta mtha' can gyi sa rlu nā ma'i skor ro/༈ /da ni pho rtags mā sa'i sgra'i dbang du byas te/ mā sa phya lo po bā/ mā sa'i dbyi —101—

ba yang na'o/ /mā sa'i sgra la pha rol du rnam dbye gang byung kyang / rtags mtha'i dbyangs nyid dbyi ba dang / a thung mtha' can pho rtags spyir btangs de ba'i sgra la bshad pa lta bu'i bya ba gnyis po 'dam ka yin la/ mā sa'i zhes drug sgra 'byung ba'i don/ dbyi rgyu'i yi ge de mā sa'i rtags rang nyid kyi nang tshan du gtogs pa'i yi ge gcig yin pa'i don no/ de la de ba'i sgra dang mthun pa'i tshul ni/ tshu rol mā sa la/ pha rol rnam dbye nyer gcig rim can du bzhag nas/ gong de ba'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas/ ༈ mā saX/ mā oṃ(/ mā swāX༈ mā saX/ mā so/ mā sun/ mā se na/ mā swā bhāX/ mā baiX/ ༈ mā swā ya/ mā swā khyoX/ mā swā zlaX/ ༈ mā swa ta/ mā swā smoX/mā se khyuX/ ༈ mā sa phya/ mā sa sku1༷༷/ mā swā nāX/ ༈mā se/ mā sa sku1༷༷/ mā se khri/ ༈he mā sa/ he mā so/ ha mā swāX/ zhes pa rnams yin no/ ༈ gnyis pa rtags mtha'i a yig dbyi ba'i phyogs ni/ mā sa'i rtags nyid kyi bya ba dngos yin la/ thams cad la yang dbyangs med pha rol du 'dren/su srog med rnam bcad du 'gyur ba las/ a phyis pa'i pha rol rnam dbye'i bha yig gi tshu rol rnam bcad rnams dbyi'o/ zhes nges par byas nas/ mā sa si/sa'i srog gi i phyis/ mā sa su/ mā sa'i dbyi ba yang na'o/ /rtags mtha'i a phyis/ ha se baXse rlobaX ha sa zhwa pu la si dbyi'o/ /ha sa'i mtha' ste rtags mtha' gsal byed mtha' can dang snyi pu la pha rol si dbyi'o/ zhes pas 'dir gsal byed mtha' la si phyis/ ru sa dag gi rnam bcad/ māXgrub/ mā sa au/rtags mtha'i a phyis/ dbyangs med/ mā so/ mā sa dzas/ hro phyis/ mtha'i a phyis/ dbyangs med/ ru sa rnam bcad/ mā saX༈ mā sa da/ mtha'i a phyis/—102—

dbyangs med pha rol/ mā saX/ mā sa au/ rtags mtha'i a phyis/ dbyangs med/mā so/ mā sa/ sha phyis/ mtha'i a phyis/ dbyangs med/ ru sa rnam bcad/ mā saXmā sa ṭā/ ṭa phyis/ mtha'i a phyis/ dbyangs med/ mā sā/ mā sa khyu mu/ bha'i nus pas a phyis/ mā sa'i sa srog med dang / sa rnam bcad du song bar ma zad/a ta pi lo pa sha/ zhes pas/ rnam bcad phyis/ mā bhāX/ mā sa rtsis/ pha rol bha mthong bas sa srog gi a phyis/ su rnam bcad/ rnam bcad phyis/ bhas kyi sa rnam bcad/ mā bhiX/ ༈ mā sa nge / nga dbyi/ a phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol/ mā se/mā sa khyus/ a phyis/ sa rnam bcad/ de yang phyis/ mā bhāX/ mā sa smyas/ a phyis/sa rnam bcad/ de yang phyis/ smyas kyi sa rnam bcad/ mā khyuX/ ༈mā sa nga si/ dra dang i rjes 'brel/ mus da/ a phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol/ sa rnam bcad/mā saX/ ༈mā sa sgyu mu/ mā bhāX/ mā sa smyas/ mā khyuX/ ru bsgyur sa gong bzhin no/ mā sa ngas/ dra phyis/ mtha'i a phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol/ sa rnam bcad/ mā saX/mā sa os/ a phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol/ sa rnam bcad/ mā soX/ mus u mu/a phyis dbyangs med pha rol/ mā swāX/ ༈ mā sa ngi nga dbyi a phyis mā si/ mā sa os/ mā soX/ gong bzhin/ mā sa su pu/ pra rjes 'brel/ a phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol/ mā spu/ ༈ mā sa si/ a phyis/ i 'jig sa rnam bcad/ he māX/ mā sa au a phyis/ dbyangs med drangs/ he mā so/ mus dzas/ dza song / a phyis/dbyangs med pha rol/ he mā saX/ des a thung mtha' can pho rtags kyi sde tshan rags pa rnams kyi bya ba rdzogs so/༈ /da ni skyes pa'i rtags ā ring mtha' can gyi dbang du byas te/ so ma —103—

pā sha sdi sgrub pa la/ so ma pā si/ i phyis/ su rnam bcad/ so ma pāX/ so ma pā au/o dang au la e'o/ /so ma po/ so ma pā dzas/ dzu song / 'dra ba'i yi ge pha rol dzas kyi a phyis/ so ma pāX ༈bod pa'i si 'dir mi dbyi ste/ de dbyi ba ni byings ma yin pa'i dbang du byas la/ 'di ni byings mtha' yin pas so/ /so ma pā si/ i brjod don/ snga rnam bcad/ he so ma pāX/ he so ma po/ he so ma pāX/gnyis tshig mang tshig gi bod pa'ang rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra'o/ /so ma pā/da/ da gyi a phyis/ so ma pāX/ so ma pā au/ o au ru bsgyur/ so ma po/ so ma pā shas/ ā to dh+wa to rlo paX.uta kyi byings kyi dbyi'o/ /de yang rtags mātha' ā yig byings dang 'brel ba ni pha rol shas la sogs pa'i dbyings kyi rang bzhin rnam dbye gang mthong yang / rtags mtha'i dbyangs phyi bar bya ste/ so ma pā/ shas/ sha sngong /rtags mtha'i ā phyis/ pha rol drangs pas/ so ma paXgrub/ shas la sogs pa zhes so/ au gnyis dang da dang / dzas kyi as rnams ma yin pa'i don no/ ༈so ma pā ṭā ṭa song / so ma pā ā/ rtags mtha'i ā phyis/ drangs pas/ so ma pā/so ma pā sgyu mu/ gzhan bya ba med/ som pā ra/ so ma pā rtsis/ gzhan med/ so ma pā bhiX/ ༈so ma pā nge / tro phyis/ rtags mtha'i ā phyis pha rol drangs/ sa ma pe/so ma pā bha mu/ so ma pā bhāX/ so ma pā byas/ /gzhan med/ so ma pā khyuX/ ༈so ma pā nga si/ dra dang i song / rtags mtha'i ā phyis/ dbyangs med drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ so ma paX so ma pā sgyu mu/ so ma pā khyuX/ so ma pā sdus/ so ma pā khyoX/so ma pā ngas/ as ba theg rtags mtha'i ā phyis/ drangs/ so ma paX so —104—

ma poX.os/ rtags mtha'i ā phyis/ dbyangs med/ sa rnam bcad/ so ma poXso ma pā u mu/ rtags mtha'i ā phyis pha rol drangs so ma pāX/ ༈so ma pā ngi / da phyis/ rtags mtha' dbyangs med/ so ma pi/ so ma pā os/ ā phyis/ dbyangs med/ so ma poXste drug pa dang 'dra/ so ma pā su pu/ pra rjes 'brel/ gzhan bya ba med/ so ma pā su/ zhes pa grub po/ /de bzhin du/ ki lwa la pā/ chu 'thung shaX kha spyi dung bzo ba/ ma dhu 'thung pā/ sbrang rtsi la sogs pa mang po dag kyang so ma pā dang bya ba 'dra'o/༈ da ni i thung mtha' can gyi dbang du byas na/ ha ri si/ i brjod don/sa rnam bcad/ ha riX/ ha ri au/ au yu/ rnam dbye au mtshams spyor bas yu byung au ni i u dag go /i thung mtha' can dang / u thung mtha' can pho rtags la/ dang po'i gnyis tshig au dang / gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig au dag rtags mtha'i dbyangs dang mtshungs par 'gyur te/ rtags mtha'i i la au dag i thung du 'gyur ba dang / rtags mtha' u la au gnyis po u thung du 'gyur ro/'dir rtags mtha' i thung yin pas/ au i thung du bsgyur/ 'dra ba la ring pho/ ha rī/ ha ri dzas/ dzu 'gro/e o dza si/ e o dzas la'o/ /i thung mtha' can pha rol dzas la rtags mtha' e ru 'gyur/ /u thung mtha' can pha rol dzas la rtags mtha' o ru 'gyur/ 'dir i thung yin pas/ he re/ zhes par 'gyur/ e da/ dbyangs med/ sa rnam bcad/ ha ra yaX/ 'dir sa spru rnyi ste bod pa'i rnam dbye la/ hi ri si/ i song / byings ma yin pa'i mtshungs pa la dhi dbyi'o/ /zhes pas/ /dhi ni —105—

shod si yin pas/ rnam dbye'i si'i sa phyis/ ha re/ zhes byung ba la/ dho/ dhi la'o/sgyu rol dhi mthong —bas rtags mtha'i i thung e dang / /u thung o ru 'gyur ba las/ 'dir ha ri las ri'i srog gi i e ru bsgyur/ he sngon du bzhug he ha re/grub/ si ni song zin ci'i phyir rtags mtha' 'gyur 'gro snyam na/ 'grel bar dhi'i yul las/ zhes 'byung bas/ sngar dhi byung pa'i nus pa'am/ shul gyis kyang 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa ste 'di lta bu gzhan yang mang ngo / /gnyis tshig ha ri au/ he ha rī/ mang tshig ha ri dzas/ ha ra yaXzhes pa rnam dbye dang po'i skabs dang 'dra ba las he sngon du ba theg go /he ha ra yaX/ grub po/ ༈ ha ri ri/ da shas dag gi a'o/ /zhes pas ri gyi a song / ha ri/ ha ri au/ dang po'i gnyis pa dang 'dra/ hoshrī/ ha ri shas sha song / skyes pa la sa'i na'o/ zhes pas/ as kyi sa na ru byas pas a na/ shas la'o zhes pas rtags mtha' ring por bsgyur/da shas dag gi a'o/ /zhes shas kyi a phyis/ ha nin/ ༈ha ri ṭā bzhagaṭa 'gro/ṭā nā s+t+ri yāX/ bud med min pa la ṭā nā 'o/ /i ta mtha' dang utu mtha' bud med min pa zhes pas/ pho rtags dang ma ning rtags la/ pha rol ṭā zhes pa'i ā ni nā ru bsgyur/ ṣa ra ṛ las mtha' min pa'i na ṇa 'o/ /zhes i bar na yod kyang sngon du ra mthong bas pha rol na ṇa ru 'gro bas/ ha ri ṇa/ grub bo/ /ha ri bha mu/ ha ri bhāX/ ha ri lhas/ ha ri bhiX/ ༈ ha ri nge bzhag dra 'jig ngi ti/ ngi ta la'o/ /ngi ta te nga ldan gyi rnam dbye bzhi po pha rol tu gang byung na yang rtags mtha' i ta e ta dang / u ta o tu du 'gyur ba las/ skabs 'dir/ ha ri —106—

ha re ru 'gyur/ e da ru bsgyur/ dbyangs med gnyis drangs pas/ ha ra ye/ha ri sgyum/ ha ra bhāX/ ha ri smyas/ ha ri khyuX/ ༈ha ri nga si/ dra dang i phyis/ a sa bzhag ngi ta la'o zhes pas rtags mtha'i i ni e dra kyu/ra/nga si nga so ra phya/ nga si ngas dag gi a'o/ /ha re as zhes pa la rtags mtha' e ta dang o tu kyi pha rol/ nga si dang ngas kyi as zhes pa'i a yig dbyi'o/ /'dir nga si'i rkyen gyi khong na yod pa'i a yig phyis/ sa rnam bcad/ ha reX/ ha ri sgyu mu/ ha ri bhāX/ ha ri smyas/ ha ri khyuX/ ༈ha ri ngas/ dra dbyi/ ngi ta la'o/ /ha re/ nga si da dag gi a'o/ /rkyen gyi a song / rnam bcad/ ha reXchu gong nga si dang gzugs 'dra'o/ /ha ri da bzhag rtags mtha'i da ru bsgyur/ ra las yu yang gnyis so/ zhes pas/ ha ra zhes pa nyid kyai ru srog med de'i nus pas srog gi da ru song ba de/ gcig las gnyis su 'gyur te/ yu snga ma'i sngon du yu gcig 'phel lo/ /o la yu drangs/ yu cig shos kyang de'o steng du drangs/ ru yang de'i steng du sbyar te/ sa rnam bcad du byas pas/ te snoX/ ha ri u mu/ nus ā ga ma/ u dang ṭa song / dbyangs med/ nā mu la'o/ /zhes pas ring por 'gyur bas/ ha ri ha rī ru bsgyur/ ha rī nā mu/ ṣa ra ṛ las mtha' min pa'i na ṇa 'o/ /ha rī ṇaX/ ༈ ha ri ngi bzhag dmigs gsal yin pas/ ngi ta la'o/zhes pa 'dir mi 'jug gonge ro/ nga'i e'o/ /i tra mtha' dang utu mtha'i pha rol du phyin pa'i ngi ni au ru bsgyur/ sa tsa ḍi tra/ de ni ḍi tra/ /ngi au ru bsgyur ba'i au de la ḍi tra kyi ming 'dogs so/—107—

ḍi ti ṭiX/ ḍi tra la zhi'o/ ṭi ni rtags mtha'i dbyangs kyi ming yin/ pha rol ḍi tra mthong bas/ tshu rol zhi'i ming can rtags mtha'i dbyangs de dbyi'o/dbyangs med pha rol/ ha ro/ ha ri da/ ha ri'i ri/ yu gnyis/ dbyangs med drangs pa drug pa'i gnyis pa bzhin te/ he sgroX/ ha ri su pra/ pā song / ku i la las ṣa ru byed de sa'o/ /zhes pas/ su'i sa ṣa ru bsgyur te/ he re khu zhes so/ ༈ de bzhin du/ a sni/ me ri gi ri/ ra bi/ nyi ma ka bi snyan ngag mkhan pra pri ti yal sogs pa'o/ ༈ /u thung mtha' can gyi rtags kyi dbang du byas/ bhā nu 'od zer la sogs pa'o/ /de yang bshad ma thag pa ha ri'i sgra la byas pa'i cho ga rnams 'dir yang sbyor ba ste/ dbyangs mi 'dra ba'i 'gyur khyad 'phran bu mgatogs khyad par med do/ bhā nu si/ sa rnam bcad/ bhā nuX/ bhā nu au/ rkyen au ni ur 'gyur 'dra ba ring po'o/ /bhā nā/ bhā nu dzas/ nu no ru song / o ab/rnam bcad/ bhā na baX/ ༈ bhā nu da/ lo phyis/ bhā nuX/ bhā nu au/ au ur song /bhā nā/ bhā nu/ shas/ a phyis/ sa nar 'gyur/ nu ring po/ bhā nā na/ ༈bhā nu ṭā/ṭā nā ru song / bhā nu nā/ bhā nu bhāX/ bha nu bhiX/ gong ma rnams dang 'dra/ ༈ bhā nu nge /tro phyis/ nu no ru song / o ab/ bhā na be/ bhā nu bhāX/ bhā nu khyuX/ ༈ bhā nu/ sing/bhā nu as/ a phyis nu no/ bhā noX/ bhā nu raX/ bhā nu bh+yaX/ ༈ bhā nu ngas/ bhā nu as/a 'jig /nu noX bhā noX bha nu os/ u ru song / bhā na bu os la drangs pas/ two/ bhā twoX/ bhā nu u mu/ nus byin/ nu ring por song / na ṇa ru mi 'gro /bha nu nāX/ ༈bhā nu ngi/ ngi au ru bsgyur/ ḍi tra la rtags mtha'i dbyangs song / bhā no/ bhā nu os/ gong du drug pa'i os dang 'dra/ bhā twoX/ bhā nu su pra/—108—

sa ṣa ru bsgyur/ bhā nu rngo ༈bod pa'i don la/ bhā ni si/ si rnam bcad/ he bzhagahe bhā nuX/ bhā nu au/ au ni u ru bsgyur/ mū nā/ bhā nu dzas/ nu no ru song / o ab/ drangs pas/ he bhā na/ kyai nyi ma rnams baX/ zhes grub/ gzhan yang / biṣ+ṭha khyab 'jug dang / bā yul rlung sogs pa mang po dag ste/ 'dir i ta mtha' dang utu mtha' 'am/ i thung mtha' can dang u thung mtha' can zhes 'byung / gzhung gzhan las asni'i rtags zhes ming btags so/༈ /sa khri sha sdi la/ se ḍā khyuX dhi ni bod si'i ming yin la/ a dhiXni dhi min pa'o/ /tsheg drag ni si'i rjes so/ dhi ma yin pa la si ḍa 'o/ sa khi si/grogs po rnam dbye dang po sbyin/ si'i i brjod don/ sa ni ḍar song / ni ta las zhi'o/ zhes rtags mtha'i dbyangs la ṭi zer bas/ ḍa mthong bas rtags mtha'i i phyis/ ḍa yang khyad don yin phyis/ ā bzhag dbyangs med pho rol sbyar te/ kha ā la drangs/ sa 'a grub bo/ ༈ yang sa khi la bod si byin/ bod si 'jigadhi'i yul las rtags mtha'i i e/ he sa khe/ dhi ma yin pa zhes pas/ bod sri 'jig si gzhan mi 'jig pa'i khyad bar bshad pa'o/e sa khyuX/ ༈sa khri'i e'o/ sa khi au/ 'grel bar si sogs lnga la zhes 'byung yang / au sogs bzhi la rtags mtha'i i er bsnyur/ e u yu/dbyangs med gnyis po pha rol so sor drangs/ sa ji yo grub/ sa khri'i zhes drug sgra'i don/ rtags mtha'i yi ge yongs rdzogs min/ de'i nang gi mtha' ma dbyangs kho na bskyur ro/ /zhes pa ste/ mi'i dbyug pa longs shig byas pa/ dbyug ba kho na yin gyi/ mi dang bcas pa min pa bzhin no/ /'grel par gnyis tshig —109—

ces pa las med kyang / g.yin ma yin/ dang po'i gnyis tshig dang gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig au la sdeb sbyor dang rig byed las/ sa khi'i rtags mtha' e dang /au ā ru bsgyur/ e u yu/ so sor drangs/ sa ji yā/ grub/ sa khri dzas/ dzu khyad don/ rtags mtha' i/ i ā yu/ so sor drangs/ ra sa dag gi rnam bcad do/sa ji yaX/ grub/ ༈ sa khri a mu/ rtags mtha' e/ e ā yu/ so sor drangs/mu nga ro/ sa sku yaX/ grub/ sa ji la/ gnyis pa'i au gong dang 'dra/ sa ji yo/rig byed las/ sa mā yā/ lnga po song ngo / /de nas sa khi shas mtshungs pa'i pha rol shas kyi san ra song / a phyis/ rtags mtha' ring po/ sa khri na/ grub po/༈ sa khi pa khyo ri ka/ sa khi pa ti dag la zhwa ka'o/ sa khi dang pa ti bdag po la pha rol du ṭā dang nge dang ngi gang yod kyang / sa khri dang pa ti'i rtags mthar/zhi ka ā ga ma ster te/ lo khri ṭā/ ṭā phyis ā/ zhi ka kra rjes 'brel/ mtshungs 'dra ring po/ 'dir ring por gyur pa yin pas/ ṭā nā 'o zhes pa mi thob/ ri dbyangs la'o/ /da ru song / dbyangs med pha rol/ sa khyu grub/ ā ga ma glo bur ba ste/ rtag par mi yong bas/ snyika ma byin na/ mtshungs 'dra med pa sa ring po med/ ṭā nā ra 'gyur bas/ sa khi nā grub/ sa khi sgyu mu/ sa kha bhāX du bya ba kho na yin/ sa khirtsis/ sa khi bhiXru bsgyur/ ༈sa khi nge/ dra phyis e/ ri dbyangs la'o/ /dbyangs med pha rol/ sa khye/ grub/ zhi kra ā ga ma byin na/ mtshungs 'dra/sa khri/ gzhan 'dra/ yang na ngi tra la'o zhes zhi ka mi ster ha ri dang 'dra'o/ /sa khri lha mu/ gong dang 'dra/ sa khi smyas/ sa khri khyoXru bsgyur/༈ ṛ ngeng / re ka nga la'o/ sa khi dang pa ti'i pha rol tu nga yig gi rkyen —110—

gnyis te nga si dang ngas gnyis gang yin kyang / rtags mthar dka ā ga ma ster ro/ sa khri nga si/ dra dang i phyis/ as/ raka byin/ sa khi re kra as/ ri dbyangs la'o/ /dbyangs med pha rol lan gnyis/ sa khyer as/ṛ to nga uX re ta las nga'i u'o/ rtags mtha'i ṛ yig pha rol/ nga si dang / ngas kyi a yig kur ( ur ) 'gyur bas/ as/ de ni us ru song / de yang ḍi tra do/ zhes nga si dang / ngas kyi a yig ur song ba de ḍi ta zhes brda chad sbyar nas/ zhi ta pha rol du byung bas/ rtags mtha'i dbyangs phyis te/ dbyangs med pha rol/ sa rnam bcad/ sa khyuXgrub/ sa khi bha mu/ sa khi bhāX/ sa khi smyas/ sa khi khyuX/ gong dang 'dra/ ༈ sa khi ngas ba theg nge phyis re ka/ nga la'o/rtags mthar re ka byin/ da dbyangs la'o/ /dbyangs med pha rol/ re tu las nga'i u'o/ /rnam dbye'i a yig ur song / ni tra las rtags mtha'i dbyangs phyis/pha rol du drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ sa khyuXgrub ste nga si sgra ji bzhin no/ sa khi os/da dbyang la'o/ /dbyangs med pha rol/ su rnam bcad/ sa khyoXgrub/ sa khri u mra/ nus byin/ ṭa rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ rtags mtha' ring po/dbyangs med pha rol/ sa khri nāX/ grub/ ༈sa khi ngi/ dra phyis/ au ru bsgyur/ ni ṭa la zhi'o zhes pas rtags mtha'i i phyis/ /rtags mthar zhi ka ā ga ma byin/ kra rjes 'brel/ nga phyis pa'i i glur bsgyur ba de ni ṭa yin no/ /ri dbyangs la'o/ zhwa ka gi sī yu ru song / dbyangs med pha rol/ sa khyo/ sa khi os/ gong dang 'dra/ sa khyoX/ sa khi sus/ pu phyis/ ku dang i la las sa khri'o/ rkyen gyi sa yig ṣa yig tu bsgyur/ sa khi khu grub po/ ༈pa ti la ni/ rkyang pa dang tshig bsdud —111—

can gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni/ pa ti zhes pa lta bu'o/ /phyi ma ni/ pra dzā pa ti/ skyed dgu'i bdag po zhes pa lta bu'o/ /tshig de yang pa ti nyid dang 'brel pa la yin gyi/ ming tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod kyang / gong du ming gzhan ma 'brel pa yod pa la mi rtsi'o/ /de gnyis las/ pa ti'i sgra rkyang pa la/ si o dzas/ri au shas rnams ha ri skabs te i thung mtha' can spyir btang dang 'dra bar bsgrub la/ ṭa nas su pu kyi bar sa khi dang 'dra bar bsgrub ste/ ༈pa ti si/ pa tiXpa ti au/ au yī/ pa tī/ pa ti dzas/ pa ta yaX/ ༈pa ti bod pa'i si/ si zhig shul gyi rtags mtha' e/ he pa te/ he pa tī/ he pa ta yaX/ rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra'o/ ༈pa ti da/ pa ti/ pa ti au/ pa tī/ pa ti shas/ pa tī na/ ༈pa ti spru/zhi ka ster/ pa t+yā/ yang na ha ri'i sgra ltar/ pa ti nā/ pa ti khyu mu/ pa ti dhīX/ pa ti rtsis/ pa hi bhiX/ ༈pa ti nge / pa rkye/ pa ti bhāX/ pa ti khyuX/ ༈pa ti nga si/ re ka byin/i yu/ re ka las a'i u'o/ rkyen gyi a u/ de yang ni ta do/ pa kyuX/ pa ti bhāX pa ti khyuX/ ༈ pa ti da/ gong ngas dang 'dra/ pa rkyuX/ pa ti os/ pa khyoX/ pa ti zhwas/nus byin/ pa tī nāX/ ༈ pa ti ngi/ au ru bsgyur/ ti'i srog phyis/ zhi ka byin/ pa rkyo/pa ti da/ pa skyoX/ pa ti su pra/ pa ti ju zhes pa'o/༈ gnyis pa pa ti'i sgra tshig sdud dang 'brel ba la ni/ spyir btang ha ri dang 'dra ba kho na ste/ dang po drug gong bzhin dang / ṭā sogs la/ pra dzā pa ti nā/pra dzā pa ti bhāX/ pra dza pa ti bhiX/ ༈pra dzā pa ta ye/ pra dzā pa ti bhāX/ pra dzā pa ti khyuX/pra dzā pa ti bhāX/ pra dzā pa ti khyuX ༈pra dzā pa teX/ pra dzu pa khroX/ pra dzā pa tī nāX/ ༈pra dzā pa to/ pra dzā pa khroX/ pra dzā pa ti sgyu zhes pa ste/ i thung mtha' can spyir —112—

btang nyid kyis bsgrubs pas go sla'o/ ༈dī ces pa sa spru sogs kyi nang tshan yin/de'i nang gi kyi tra sogs bcu'i nang tshan te/ bcu po ni/ tu dra ta tra ya ta e ta tra i dmu/ a das/ di/ kim pu khyu dra/ asmad/ zhes pa'o/ de rnams la i thung mtha' can ni/ dī gcig pu yin pas skabs 'dir/ dri'i sgra la di gnyis kyi skad dod yin cing / grangs bgrong ba'i skabs dang 'brel ba'i di'i sgra la gcig dang mang tshig gi rkyen mi 'jug ste gnyis tshig kho na sbyor ro/ 'o na 'dir si med pa la si sogs zhes pa ci snyam na/ grangs bgrong ba'i skabs la med kyang spyir yod pa dang / de las khyad par du 'di ltar go dgos te/ si sogs zhes pa rnam dbye bdun gsum nyer gcig gi spyi ming du btags pa yin pas 'grel par si sogs zhes so/ gya dā pre sna raXbyā do/ kyi ta sogs kyi zhi'i si sogs a'o/ /zhes so/ /si sogs la tu ta sogs kyi ṭi 'o/ /tshu rol t+ya tra sogs bcu la/ pha rol si sogs gang byung yang / rtags mtha'i dbyangs zhi'i ming can de a yig tu 'gro ste/ 'dir di au/ dwa au ru 'gro /o au la e'o/ zhes pas/ dwo/ gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig kyang de dang 'dra/ de bzhin du/ di bhā mu/ dwa bhāX/ gsum pa/bzhi pa/ lnga pa kun 'dra ste/ dwa khyuX/ dī os/ drug pa bdun pa 'dra ste rtags mtha'i a de slar yang er bsgyur/ e ri/ dwa yoXdwa yoX/ ༈ tri ni gsum gyi skad dod yin grangs bgrong ba'i skabs su/ trore sgra la mang tshig kho na sbyor ba/tri dzas/ tri as/ e o dzas la'o/ tra yaX/ khri shas/ hi na/ shā nyis/tri bhiX/khri smyas/ tri khyuX/ khaṃ sdus/ tri bh+yaX zhes dzas/ shas/ nyis/ byas/ rnams spyir btang ha ti'i skabs dang 'dra'o/

༈tre ra ri/ tri yi a ri/ /tri la u mu/ tri u mu/ nus ā ga ma byin/ṭa rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ dbyangs med pha rol/ tri nā mu/ tri sgra de/ pha rol nā mu mthong bas rtags mtha'i i a yung bsgyur/ tra a yad/ nā mu/ dra phyis/dbyangs med pha rol tu drangs/ trore ra btags kyi nus pas/ nā ṇa ra song / tra yā ṇaX/ lugs gcig la/ a ri lta bu yi ge mang por 'gyur ba la/ bsgyur bya trore tra ru i gsum kra bsgyur ba'ang 'dod skad la/ 'on kyang ri ni dra'i brdas i kho na bsgyur ba nyid 'thad do/ khri su pra/ tri khu ru byed pa'ang ha ri dang 'dra'o/ ༈ ka ti'i sgra la yang mang tshig kho na sbyor te/ ka ti dzas/ dzas yongs rdzogs 'jig ka ti/ ༈ ka ti shas/ shas yongs rdzogs 'jig /ka ti/ka ti'i sgra las dzas shas 'jig go /ces bshad pas so/ ༈ka ti bhas/ ji tsam ka ti bhiX/ ༈ka ti byas/ ka ti khyuX/ ༈ka ti khyu saX/ ka ti khyuX ༈ka ti su pu/ ka ti khu zhes pa'o/ /ka ti ni rtags gsum pa can te/ /ka ti pu ru lga pho rtags/ ka ti s+t+ri ya/ mo rtags/ ka ti pa t+yā ne/ ma ning yin pa lta bu'o/ de yan chad kyis i ta mtha' can gyi sde tshan spyir btang dang dmigs gsal rnams bshad zin to/ ༈ /da ni zhwa tra mtha' ste yī ring po'i mtha' can bshad pa ni/ su shrī sha sdi/gzugs mdzes sam/ dpal phun sum tshogs pa su shrī si rnam bcad/ su shrīX/sbyorte to ri yu bo swa ro/ byings kyi yī ྅ da ub dag dbyangs la'o/ming dang byings gzhi mthun pa'i rtags mtha' byings kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sī ring po de/ pha rol dbyangs dang rnam dbye'i gzhi mthun can mthong ba na/ da ru —114—

'gyur ba las/ shrī ni yī ring bo dang byings mtha'i gzhi mthun yin la/ de bzhin du de 'dra'i mū de/ rnam dbye dbyangs la u ba ru 'gyur ro/ /'dir yī da ru 'gyur te/ si gong du bshad zin/ slar bha ldan rnams dang sus ma gtogs pa rnam dbye thams cad dbyangs yin pas de ltar go bar byas te/ su shrī au bzhagayī phral/ shra yī/ byings rtags kyi mtha'i yī da ru bsgyur/ shra da o zhes so/dbyangs med/ su shri yo/ su shrī dzas/ dzu song / yī i yu/ drangs/ rnam 4da/su shri yaX/ ༈ sa skru rnyo gsum po yang de gsum dag 'dra la he ba theg pa nyid do/he su shrīX/ he su shri yo/ he su shri yaX/ zhes pa'o/ ༈su shi a mu/ rtags mtha'i zhi tra/ da drangs pas/ su gri yaX/ bha mu/ nyis/ sgyu mu/ smyas/ khyu mu/ smyas/ zhes pa drug dang sus ma gtogs/ kun la zhwa ta da ru bsgyur/ dbyangs med pha rol 'dren pa go bar byas te/ su shrī au/ da/ su shri yo/ su shrī shas/ 'di la san bsgyur ba sogs dmigs gsal la bkag ste/ su shri yaX/ ༈ su shrī ṭā/ ṭā song /da/ su shri yā/ su shrī sgyu mu/ su shī khyuX/ su shrī nyis/ su shrī bhiX/ ༈su shrī nge/ tro dbyi/ da/ su shri ye/ su shrī sgyu mu/ su shrī khyuX/ su shrī byas/ su shrī khyoX/ ༈su shrī nga si/ dra dang i song / /da/ su shri yaX/ su shrī sgyu mu/ su shrī khyoX/ su shi byas/ su shri khyoX/ ༈su shrī ngas/ su shri yaX/ su shrī os/ su shri yoX/ su shrī u mu/ su shri yāX/su shi ji/ dra phyis/ ri/ su shri yi/ ༈su shrī ri/ su shri yoX/ ༈su shrī su/ pra rjes 'brel/ i la las sa ṣa ste/ gra kyi ha raX su shrī khu ༈de bzhin du/ su dhī la yang ste/ su dhī si/ bzhiX/ su dhi au/ su dhī yo/ su dhi dzas/ sdo zhi yaX/ zhes pa la sogs pa thams cad snga ma bzhin no/ ༈/mū yig mtha' can la/ swa yaX bhū la —115—

sogs pa ste/ su shri gzugs mdzes sam bde bar 'byor ba klu tra ri ru byed pa'i dod du/ rtags mtha'i uta ub ru bsgyur ba ma gtogs cho ga thams cad 'dra ste/ swā yaX bhu si/ su yaX dh+waX/ swa yaX bhā 6(/ /swa yaX bhu bo/ su yaX bhā dzas/ swa yaX bhu baX/ ༈swa yaX bhu da su yaX ༄bhā waX/ su ya bhā au/ swa yaX bhu bo/ swa yo bhā shas/ swa yaX bhu waX/ ༈su yaX spre/ sla yo bhu bā/ su ma bhū sgyu mu/ swā yaX bhū bhāX su yeX bhū nyis/swa yaX bhū bhiX/ ༈swa yaX bhu nge / su yaX bhu be/ swā yaX bhū sgyu mu/ swa yaX bhū bhāX/ swa yaXsgru smyas/ sriX yaX bhu khyuX/ ༈swaX yaXsgrungs si/ swaX yaX bhu baX swaX yaX bhū sgyu mu/ swaXtsho yaX bhā bhā/ swa ya bhū sdus/ swa ya bhū khyuX/ ༈swā ya bhu ngas/ swa ya bhu baX/ swa dzi/ bhu 6(sa/ su yaX bhu boX/ swa yaX bhā u mu/ su yaX bhā bāX/ ༈ swa yaX bhā ngi/ swa yaX bhu bi/ swa yaX bhu os/ su yaX bhu boX/ rko lha su yaX dh+wa sub/ swe yaX bhā khu zhe se pa rnams so/ se na ni zhes pa la/ su shrī las mi 'dra bzhi khyad par yo do de/ sbo bā/spra ba dag yang na'o/ /byings dang ming gi lus sbyar ba la rtags mtha'i zhi tra yu kho na dang / ub kho nar byed de/ de yang mtha'i dbyangs de'i snga rol tu yi ge brtsegs ma med pa dang / sngon du yi ge gnyis sam gsum sogs yod pa dgos so/ /bha ṣa ri/ lo dus su 'byung pu rte/ slar yang 'byung ba/ gnyis 'dir bzung la/ gzhan 'ju' sgra dang dhī sgra spangs pa'i pho rtags zhi tra lha ta yu rkyang pa dang da rkyang par bsgyur pra yin te/ rnam dbye dbyangs yin pa rnams la de ltar go bar bya'o/ ༈se na nī sde'i 'dren a ste dmag dpon no/ si/ se na nīX/ sen nī au/ ni yī phral/ na srog med/ yī zhes pa yu ru bsgyur/ senā nas mo/ dbyangs med pha rol pas drangs pas/ se na rmyo/ se nā sgo ni dzas/ hro phyis/ zhwa lnga ru bsgyur/—116—

drangs/ se nā rgyu/ se nā nī da/ yī ni yu ru song / drangs/ se nā n+yaX/ se nā nī au/gong bzhin/ se nā rmyo/ se nā nī shas/ sha song / yī ni yu/ drangs/ se nā n+yaX/ se nā nī ṭā/ klu yu/ drangs/ senā rgyu/ se nī nā sgyu mu/ se nā nī bhāX/ se nā nī dhis/ se nā nī bhiX/ se nā nī nge/ ri dbyi/ zhwa yu/ drangs/ se nā rkye/ senā nī sgyu mu/ senā nī khyuX/se nā ni byas/ se nā ni khyuX/ gong dang 'dra/ ༈se nā nī nga si/ dra dang i phyis/ yī yu/ drangs/ senā rkye/ se nā nī sgyu mu/ se nā nī khyuX/ se nā nī khyoX ༈se nā nī ngas/nga si dang 'dra/ se nā n+yaX/ se nā ni os/ senā rgyoX/ se nā ni u mu/ se nā nī la sogs pa rnams las u mu la nu yang na'o/ /zhes gzhan las bshad pas/ se nā nīX nus u mu/ u dang ṭā phyis/ senā nī nāX/ se nā nī u mu/ zhi yu ru bsgyur/ se nā rte//༈ u mengaX ngi u mu'o/ nī tshig sdud can la rnam dbye ngi ni u mu du 'gyur te/ se nā nī ngi/ ngi las dra phyis/ i u mu du bsgyur/ ḍi tra la zhi'o/ zhes pa thob pa ltar snang yang 'dir mi sbyor te/ se nā nī u mu/ zhi yu/ se nā rgyuX/ se nā nī os/ se nā rgyoX/ se nā nī su pu/ se nā ni khu ༈he se nā no/ he se nā n+yaX/ yang na'o zhes/ se nā nī kho na la yang na ston pa min/ zhwa ta mtha' uta mtha' spyi la yang na ba ston no gsung ste/ se nā nī sogs rag la/ su shrī'i bya ba dang / rang gi bya ba gdam ka yin nam dpyad do/ /tshig sdud med pa'i nī rkyang pa la ni/ /yī ring po i yur 'gro ste/ si au dzas/ da sogs la/ nīXni yo/ ni yaXni yaX sogs su bsgyur te/ su shrī skabs dang 'dra'o/ ༈pū zhing rnga ba rkyang pa la ni da ru byed pa'i dod/ ub ru bsgyur ba nyid ma gtogs/ su shrī dang 'dra ste/ swa yaX —117—

gri'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin yin pas/ pūX lu bo/ lu baXl sogs pa'o/rko sna tshig sdud can ni/ se nā nī dang 'dra ste/ dper nas rnga ba yab ྅ si/ ya ba ྅༷༷/ ya ba lu tse(/ ya ba swo/ ya ba lha dzas/ ya ba lwaX/ he ya ba ྅༷༷/ sogs/snunā bhū dang / pu na / yang de dang 'dra ste/ bharnya bhūXbharnya bho/ bharnya bhāX sogs dang / pu na rduX/ pu ne rto/ pu na bhāXsogs so/ ༈/bā da pra sī/ ri dwags kṛ sna zhes pa yang phal cher de dang 'dra ste/ bā da pra sīX/ bā da pra rmyo/ bā da pra myaXsogs/'on kyang rnam dbye'i rkyen gsum la mi 'dra ste/ da dag shas dang ngi gsum mo/bā da pra sī da ri gyi a yig phyis/ bā da pra māX/ ༈bā da pri sī shas/ da shas dag gi/ a'o/ shas gyi a phyis/ bā da pra sīX/ ༈ bā da pra sī ngi / nga dbyi/ 'dra ba la pha rol dbyi/ bā da pra sī/ zhes so/ /yī ring mū ring gi mtha' can bshad zin to/༈ /da ni ṛ tra mtha'i rnam dbye 'jug tshul la/ /dang po pi trore sgra la maḥrngun na/se ra/ si u'o/ ri tra mtha' can rnam dbye dang po'i si ā ru 'gyur te/pi tri si/ i brjod don/ su ā ru bsgyur/ de ni ḍi tra yin pas/ ḍi tra la zhi'o zhes pas rtags mtha'i ṛ phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol/ pi smya/ piṇ+ḍa o/da baX tsa pu/ lnga la ri/ lnga la zhes pa rnam dbye dang po lnga yin la/da lta na/ si'i bya ba la da mi 'byung bas/ gnyis pa sogs bzhi la zer dgos so snyam na/ tshig sdud kyi khyad par las mi 'gal te/ ba lang dkar po can 'dir shog byas na rdzi bo 'ong gi ba lang mi 'ong ba bzhin no/ /dngos su na rkyen —118—

dbyangs bzhi ste/ pa tra au/ dza as drangs/ pi ta ro/ pi tri dzas/ rdza asadrangs pi ta raX/༈ khyeraX dhi da/ re ta mtha' la bod si byin na/ dhi ste bod si nyid da du 'gyur/ de ni ni ta yin pas to ta zhi'o/ /zhes mtha'i ṛ dbyi dgos so/ ༈pi tri si/ i brjod don/ sa da ṛ dbyi/ dbyangs med drangs/ ru rnam bcad/he pi taX/ he pi ta ro/ he pi ta raXgong dang 'dra/ ༈pi tri da/ ro ri/ drangs/pi ta raX/ pi tri au/ bi ta ro/ pi tri shas/ sha song / sa na/ ṛ grwa ru song / a phyis/ pi tshwa dra/ ༈ pi ༷ ṭā/ ṛ ru ru song / drangs/ pi hā/ pi ltu bhāX/ pi ༷ bhiX/ pi tri nge/ ṛ ru drangs/ pi tre/ pi tri bhāX/ bi tri khyuX/ ༈ pi tri nga si/ pi tri as/ ri tra las nga'i u'o/ /as us ru song / ṭi phyis/ drangs/ pi rnyaX/ pi tri bhāX/ pi tri khyuX/ ༈pi tri ngas/ pa ltu as/ re tra la nga yi u'o/ /ṛ phyis/ pu khyuX/ pi tri os/rar / sa rna gru/ bcad/ pi hroX/ pi ltu u mu/ tsho/ ṛ ring po/ na ṇa ru song / pi hro ṇaX/ ༈ ngo/ ngi la'o/ /pi tri ngi / ṛ ri du bsgyur/ tra a dang / ru i la drangs/pi ta ri/ pi tri os/ pi twoX/ pi tri su pra/ pi ltu skyu ༈de bzhin du/ dzā mā tri la mag pa sogs pa'ang de kho na 'dra ba las/ rnam dbye drug pa'i mang tshig gi skabs/ nu ṭa ster yang / rtags mtha' ring por byed pa dang mi byed pa gdam nga ste/ dzā mā tri nus u mu/ dzā mā hṝ ṇi/ dzā mā tri ṇaX/ zhes so/ ༈ ka rto gyi sgra la/gzhan rnams pi rta'i sgra dang 'dra/ dang po lnga khyad yod de/stu rwa ru/ sa tro dag gi uru 'o/ sa tri rkyen can te tri rkyen dang 'brel pa'am 'dus pa'i sa yig re ta mtha' kan+t+ra lta bu de ni rnam dbye lnga la uru du —119—

'gyur ro/ /'dir ka ltu gyi ༷ yig rkyen yin mod sa yig med pa la ji lhar 'dus shing 'brel snyam na/ da lta med kyang sngon 'dus pa ste/ byings kṛ la rkyen khyu byin/sa khyad don/ ka'i srog gi ṛ ri/ drangs pas/ po tsho byung tri sngon dang po ga yin pas so/ /ka dṛ si bzhug i brjod don/ rtags mtha' uru du bsgyur/ si u'o/ /kan+t+ra'i rtags kyi pha rol tu rnam dbye dang po'i si'i sa srog med ā ru 'gro ste/ ā 'di ni ta yin pas 'dra ba'i bya ba mi byed de/ rtags mtha'i dbyangs te/uru gyi ā phyis/ rta srog med ā la drangs/ ka rta/ pi tā dang / ka rta rkyen gzugs gcig du byung kyang bya ba mi 'dra ste/ 'dir ni rkyen ā ru song / rtags mtha' uru ring por song ba'i ā dbyi ba yin/ pi two'i skabs rtags mtha'i ro uru du mi bsgyur ba khyad par ro/ /au sogs gzhan bzhi la yang / pi tri skabs su/rtags mtha'i da thung ngu dang / 'dir uru ring por bsgyur ba'i khyad kho na ste/yo au/ ṛ uru/ ka rta ro/ spu rto dzas/ da/ ṛ uru/ ka rtaraX/ ༈ rta da/ṛ uru/ ka rta raX/ ka tri au/ ṛ uru/ ka rta ro/ lhag ma shas sogs bcu drug dang / saX bo dha na gsum po rnams/ pi ༷ dang khyad med do/ /de bzhin du/ na tsha bo lha/ pe tra shwa sto/ tshad ma'i mtshon cha can ho ༷ / sho ༷ / thos pa can gwa ༷ smra ba can la sogs pa yang ka rto dang 'dra'o/༈ u thung mtha' can gyi rtags kyi nang tshan/ kro ni 'i ci spyang sgra la yang /si au dzas/ a mu au ste/ rkyen lnga po 'jug tshul/ kan+t+ra dang mtshungs te/ tri rkyen can zhes pa kun la'o/ ye ku ni si/ rnam dbye mthong bas rtags mtha'i u ṛ du gyur/gro snis/ si ā ru song / tshe ta las ṭi phyis/ gro spre grub/ u ṛ du bsgyur/ ṛ uru/—120—

dbyangs med pha rol/ krog ro/ kra zhu dzas/ dzu song / u ṛ/ ṛ uru/ drangs/kro gu raX/ ku gu si/ ༈ bod si phyis/ sa'i nus pas rtags mtha'i u otra du gyur/he bzhag he kro sno/ he kro ni ro/ he kroṣ+ṭha raX/ si sogs rkyen lnga dang / bod si bya ba mi 'dra bas/ bod pa'i don gyi si ni lnga po la mi the bar tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa'o/kro gu da/ u ṛ/ ṛ uru/ krog raX/ tshwa o/ krog ro/ spro ni/ shas/ sa na/rtags mtha' ring pa/ shas kyi a dbyi/ kra dzin/ zhes spu rto dang / pi tri dang yang mthun/ sngar bha nu'i skabs dang yang mthun no/ /'grel par/ shas kyi skabs na/tri'i sgra dang mi mthun zhes gsungs pa ni/ /rtags mtha'i u ṛ ru mi 'gyur ba'i don te/ gzhan 'dra'o/ ༈ ṭā nas brtsams te/ dbyangs kyi rkyen la chu dang /bhā nu'i lugs 'dam ka yin par mdo gzhan las 'byung ba ltar sbyor te/ kre skye ṭā/ kroṣ+ṭha 'am/ sgo skya// kro rnu bhāX/ pas rto bhiX/ ༈ kro ni nge/ sgom dang / kro ni be/ lho rto dhīX/ kre skye khyuX/ ༈kro skye nga dang / ngas kyi a phyis/ sa rnam bcad/ ye kra niX/ yang na a phyis/ u or gyur/ grosaXrde/ kre khye bhāX/ /shes ni khyuX/ ༈kra gungs/ nga si dang 'dra/kro zhuX'am/ kro rgoX/ nga si dang ri kyi a phyis pas ṛ ru mi thob po/ kre skye os/ ṛ ru/ klo snoXrde/ yang na u ba ru bsgyur/ kre ྅ 0 ༷ gang yang bcos ma bcos min gyi/rab sbyor cho ga de la ni/ /rtag dang mi rtag gang de la/ /rtag pa'i cho ga stobs ldan nyid/ /kro ni utu mtha' yin pas/ /bhā nu'i lugs ni uta mtha' rang lugs yin pas bcos ma min pa dang gtan du ba'am rtag pa'i cho ga yin la/tri rkyen la sogs pa re ta mtha'i lugs sbyor ba ni/ gzhan las blangs pa yin pa'i phyir/ bcos ma dang mi rtag pa glo bur ba yin pas/ /gtan du ba'i cho ga —121—

dbang btsan pa'i brdar/ drug pa'i mang tshig la re ta mtha'i lugs mi byed do/kha cig um dbyangs yin/ kyang nu ṭa byin nas dbyangs pha rol tu mi 'gyur/nus byin pa'i gong du dbyangs pha rol yin kyang / nā mu ma yin pas ṛ ring por mi 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no zer ba mi 'thad de/ ṛ mtha' thams cad la yang thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ kre khye yan bzhug /nus byin/ rku nāX/'di skabs gsal byed kyi sngon du byung bas/ tri sgra bzhin du mi byed ces ṛ ar ra mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gsal byed pha rol yin zhes pa'i don du 'grel ba'i dpe gcig na'ang 'dug ste/ gcig 'gas blo bzo bcug pa 'dra'o/ ༈kre khye ngi/ u ṛ da/ kro ni ri/ yang na ngi au/ ṭi phyis/ drangs/ kro sno/ kro ni/ os/ gong bzhin/kro r+shaX/ rdziXkre skye su pra/ kre skye khu skabs 'dir grwa tra le tra dang zhwa tra e tra rnams kyi mtha' can med par grags so/ /pho rtags i mtha' la/ su ri sgra ste/ ri sa snyi/ ris dang bha la'o/ /e ta mtha' can la rnam dbye sa yig can si dang su pra gnyis/ bha yig can dhīX nyis sgyu mu sdus sgyu mu smyas te brgyad po de la/ rtags mtha' i ā ru 'gyur la/dbyangs kyi rang bzhin rnam dbye rnams la/ rtags mtha' u yu ru bsgyur dgos te/ su ri si i song / ra'i srog i ā ru 'gyur/ su rnam bcad/ su rāX su ri au/ ra'i i yig ā yu ru bsgyur/ drangs pa/ su rā yo/ 'di gnyis kyis phyi ma kun la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ su ri dzas/ su rā yaX/ ༈ bod pa la yang de kho na te/he su rāX he su rā yo/ he su rā yaX/ zhes pa'o/ 'grel par thog ma bod si kho na las ma bshad de lhag ma gnyis phal cher du rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra bas

dogs pa med la/ si la mi 'dra ba re yod pa mang ba la 'dir mi 'dra ba med pa la kha gsal byas ba'o/ /'di'i rigs 'og tu'ang mang ngo / /༈su ri da/ su rā yaX/ su ri au/ su rā yo/ su ri shas/ su rā yaX/ ༈su ri ṭā/ su rā yā/ su ri sgyu mu/su rā khyuX/ su ri rnyis/ su rā bhiX/ ༈ su ri nge / su rā ye/ su rā dhīX/ su rā khyuX /༈ su ri nga si/ su rā ya/ su rā bhūX/ su rā khyuX/ ༈ su ri ngas/ su rā yaX/su ri os/ su rā yoX/ su ri u mu/ su rā yāX/ ༈su ri ngi / su rā yi/ su ri os/su rā yoX/ su re su pu/ su rā su/ ༈ otra mtha' can la go'i sgras mtshon na/ o ro/ o ni o'o/ rnam dbye thog ma lnga po las gcig pha rol du mthong bas/ rtags mtha'i o yig au yig tu 'gyur ro/ /go si/ o ri rnam 4da/ goX go au/ o au ru song / au ub/ drangs/ gā bo/ go dzas/ o au/ ub/ drangs/ gā baX/ ༈bod pa'i don la'ang bya ba gzhan med de/ he goX he gwa bo/ he gā baX/༈ a sgo si/ ā da shas la'o/ /'dir rnam dbye thog ma lnga zhes gong du bshad kyang / da la dmigs gsal du/ rtags mtha'i o ni ā ru bsgyur ba ste/ 'on kyang o dang ā 'dam kar bya zer ro/ /'grel pa'i dkyus la gdam nga med kyang / ri ni lnga po'i cho ga dang / da shas gnyis rang gi cho ga ste bya ba gnyis 'dzin dgos/ gzhung gzhan las kyang bshad/ 'di'i 'grel bshad 'ga' las kyang yod ces/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'chad do/ go ri zhes bzhag ga'i srog gi o ni ā ru bsgyur te/ 'dra ba'i yi ge gāX/ go au/ gong dang 'dra/ ga bo/ go shas/ o ā ru bsgyur/ 'dra ba'i yi ge/ gāX/ ༈go ṭā/ tre song / o ab/—123sgro

drangs/ gā bā/ go bhāX/ go bhiX/ ༈go nge/ dra phyis/ o ab/ ga be/ go bhāX/ go khyuX/༈ go nga si/ dra i gnyis phyis/ as bzhag nga si da kyi a'o/ /zhes pas/a mi snang bar song / goX/ go bhāX/ go khyuX/ ༈go nga sa/ nga si dang 'dra/ goX/ go as/ o ab rnam bcad/ ga boX/ go u mu/ o ab/ ga bāX/ sdeb sbyor las nug ster ba'ang yod pas/ go nāX/ 'greng bu dang na ro la rtags mtha' ring por 'gro rgyu med/ 'greng bu na ro nyid rtag tu ring po yin pas so/ ༈go ngi / o ab/ga bi/ go os/ ga boX/ go su pra/ go khu de bzhin du/ su byo rab tu snang zhes pa'i sgra la'ang go sgra ji bzhin no/ ༈ au yig mtha' can la 'dir/ glo zhes pa'i sgra ste/ de yang rkyen ha sa ste gsal byed dang po can brgyad ma gtogs pa thams cad la/ rtags mtha'i au yig ub ru bsgyur ba kho na yin la/ bod pa gsum yang rnam dbye dang po gsum dang 'dra'o/ glo si/ rnam bcad/ gloX/ glo au/au ub/ glu bo/ glo dzas/ au ub/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ glu baX/ ༈he gloX/ he glu bo/ he glu baX/ glo ra/ glu baX/ glo/ au/ glu bo/ glo shas/ glu ba༈ glo ṭā/ tre song / glu bā/ glo bhāX/ glo bhiX/ ༈ glo nge / dra dbyi/ glu be/ glo bhāX/ glo khyuX/ ༈ glo nga si/ tro i phyis/ glu baX/ glo dhīX/ glo khyoX/ ༈ glo ngas/ glu baX/ glo os/ glu boX/glo u mu/ glu bāX/ ༈ glo ngi / gla bi/ glo os/ glu boX/ glo su pu/ glo khu zhes pa rnams 'grub bo/ dbyangs mtha'i rtags las pho rtags can gyi bya ba rnams rdzogs so/༈ da ni dbyangs kyi mtha' can mo rtags kyi bya ba rnams brjod par bya ste/ dang por ā yig mtha' can nam/ u pra mtha' zhes pa'i sde las/ spyir —124—

btang gaX ga'i sgra la/ dang por gaX ga zhes pa la/ ā pa taXs+t+ri yāX/ bud med la a la ā pra'o/ /ga ṅga us/ pra rjes 'brel/ 'dra ba'i yi ge las ring po zhes pas/gī ring po song / gaṅgā zhes pa grub ste mo rtags so/ a yig mtha' can mo rtags su sgrub pa thams cad des 'gre'o/ /de la rnam dbye rnams ster ba las/ gaṅgā si/ā paX/ u pra las so/ /ā mtha' la rnam dbye dang po'i su dbyi'o/ /gaX gāgrub bo/ /au rī/ au zhi'o/ /gaṅgā au/ mo rtags u pra la au zhes pa dang po dang gnyis pa'i rnam dbye gnyis pa yī ru bsgyur/ a i la e'o/ /gaX ge /gaX gādzas/ 'dra ba/ rnam bcad/ gaX gāX/༈ dhi riX/ dhi i ru sno/ /ru spyo pa'i skad dod med kyang mi nor ba'i don no/ /zhwas la dhi byin na/ dhi nyid i thung ngu 'gyur/ gaṅgā i/ zhes so/ /a i la e'o/ /he gaX ge/ he gaX ge/ he gaX gā/ de gnyis rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra/ ༈ ā ra/ na ga ra ko ṭa'i lha mo a klu/ 'bigs byed lha mo a lbā nor rgyun ma zer rnams la'ang / dhi i thung du 'gyur/ he armā/ he a slo/ he a k+ki/ 'di gsum ka u mi'i ming ngo zer lha mo thams cad rgyud gcig zer ba'i lugs so/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈gaX gā da/ mtshungs 'dra/ gaX gāX /gaṅgā au/ gaX ge/ gong bzhin/ gaX gāshas/ dzas dang 'dra/ gaṅgāX/ ༈ ṭo sor/ṭā os dag la e/ gsum pa'i gcig tshig ṭā dang / drug pa dang bdun pa'i gnyis tshig os la rtags mtha' e dang e da ru 'gro'o/ /gaX gā khyu/ ṭā song / rtags mtha' e/ e da/ drangs/ gaX ga yā/ ga ṅga bhāX gaṅgā bhiX/ ༈ ngi tāX ya ṭa/ ngi ta rnams kyi yan+t+ra 'o/ /nge dang / nga si dang / ngas dang / ngi rnams la —125—

skabs 'dir/ yas ā ga ma ster te/ gaṅgā nge / de la yas ster ni dgos na/'di zhi ta yin pas rnam dbye'i sngon du ste/ gaṅgā yan+t+ra e gro rjes 'brel/ a ni/e la e/ drangs/ gaX gā yi/ gaṅgā bhāX/ gaṅgā khyuX/ ༈gaṅgā nga si/ yas byin/ gaX gā ya as/ mtshungs pa/ rnam bcad/ gaX gā yāX/ gaX gā bhāX/ gaX gwa khyoX/ ༈ gaṅgā da/ nga si dang 'dra/ gaṅgā yāX/ gi gā os/ ṭā os dag la e/ zhes pas rtags mtha' e/ e da/ rnam bcad/ ga ṅga yoX/ gad gā u mu/ nus/gaṅgā nāX/ ༈gaṅgā ngi / dra phyis/ ya gro byin/ ngi u mu'o/ zhes pas/ i u mu du bsgyur/ gaX gā ya u mu/ gaX ga yāX/ gad gwa /os/ gaX ga yoX/ gaX gā sdos/da rjes 'brel/ gaṅgā su/ ༈de bzhin du/ tha snyi/ dad pa me khyu/ blo gros shā lā/khang pa mā lā/ 'phreng ba he lā/ smad ra do lā/ khyogs zhes sogs mang po zhig 'di dang 'dra'o/༈ sa spru rang nyid gong du bshad pa ltar pho rtags yin rung/ zhwas byin mor bsgrubs pas so/ /sa rgyu ces pa mo rtags te/ skyes pa'am skye bo thams cad ces pa lta bu la pho rtags 'jug dngos po la mo yin pa dang / sa gzhi la sogs pa blos btags pa'i mo mang po 'dus pa la yang / sa rmā mo rtags 'jug go /sa rgyu la rnam dbye 'jug tshul gzhan rnams spyir btang ga spyi'i skabs dang 'dra/ ngi ta rnams la khyad par yod de/ya ṭa nyam ya gro kyi a tra yang ngo / /yan+t+ra kyi a ta yang ngo / /yan+t+ra ā ga ma byin pas rtags mtha' a thung du 'gyur la/ yang zhes pas ya gro la sngon du sdoskyu ā ga ma ster ro/ /de bas na/ sa rmā la si sogs sbyin/ sa rgyu/ su r+bhe/ sa sbyiX/ ༈he —126—

sa r+bhe/ he sa r+bhe/ he sa dzoX/ ༈sa shrīX/ sa bye/ sa rgyuX/ ༈ṭā os dag la e dang / e ri/ zhes/ pas/ sa spru yā/ sa shrī bhāX/ sa rgyu bhiX/ ༈sa sgro nge / ngi tra rnams kyi yas/zhes pas/ yan+t+ra/ ya gro kyi a ta yang ngo / /zhes pas/ /rtags mtha' a thung dang /ya gro kyi gong du sdoskyu sbyin/ /khyu gnyis dang su'i u rjes 'brel/ sa spru sa ya e/e i/ yi drangs/ phye/ sa spru phye/ sa shrī bhāX/ sa spru khyuX/ ༈sa spru nga si/ dra i phyis/yan+t+ra/ sdo khrig/ rtags mtha' thung ngu / e e/ sa spru phywaX/ sa rgyu bhāX/ sa shrī khyoX/ ༈sa rgyu ngas/ dra phyis gzhan nga si dang 'dra/ sa spru byāX/ sa r+sā os/ ṭā os dag la e dang / e da/ sa rnam bcad ces pas/ sa spru yoX/ sa rgyu u mu/ nus kyi dod /sdoskyu byin/ sa shrī swāX/ ༈sa shrī ngi / ngi u mu du bsgyur/ yan+t+ra/ sdoskyu sbyin/ rtags mtha' a thung / sa sprus ya u mu/ sa spru sgyuX/ sa spru yoX/ drug pa dang 'dra/ sa rgyu su/༈dza rā rgan po zhes pa'i sgra la/ ga d+ma'i bya ba sgra ji bzhin pa byed pa dang /dbyangs thog ma can gyi rnam dbye gang byin kyang / dza rā nyid dza da ru bsgyur ba 'dam kha ste/ dza rā si/ si dbyi/ dza rā/ dza re/ dza rāX/ ༈he dza re/ he dza rāX/ ༈dza rāX/ dza re/ dza rāX/ ༈ dza ra yā/ dza rā bhāX/ dza rā bhiX/ ༈dza rā yi/ dza rā bhāX/ dza rā khyuX/ ༈dza rā yāX/ dza rā khyoX/ dza rā khyoX/ ༈dza rā yāX/ dza ra yoX/ dza rā ṇaX/ ༈dza rā yāX/dza rā yo/ dza ra su/ zhes pa rnams ni ā ring mtha' can mo rtags spyir btangs kyi lugs yin la/ ༈yang dza ras zhes par bsgyur ba ni/ si dang bha ldan rnams dang su pu rnams bor ba ste/ dza rā au/ dza ra so/ dza rā dzas/ dza ras/ as/ dza ra saX/ ༈dza rā ra/ dza ras/ da/ dza ra saX/ dza rā au/ dza ra so/ dza rā shas/dza ra saX/ dza ra ṭā/ dza ra swa/ ༈dza rā nge / dza rā nga si/ dza ra saX/ ༈dza rā ngas/ dza —127—

ra saX/ dza rā da/ dza ra soX/ dza rā u mu/ dza ra swāX/ ༈dza rā ngi / ༈dza rā si/ dza rā os/ dza ra soX/ zhes pa rnams so/ /mo rtags ā ring mtha' can gyi cho ga bstan zin to/༈ da ni mo rtags i thung mtha' can las bud+dhā sgra la/ rnam dbye dang po gsum dang / gnyis pa gsum pho rtags i thung mtha' can spyir btangs dang 'dra ste/ bu rnyi si/ rnam bcad/ brnyiX/ brnyi au/ au ni yī mū dag go /zhes bas/ au/ yī ru song / bu rnyi/ tshu rje dzas/ e o dzas la'o/ /zhes pas/ budhe ru song / e da/ budha yaX/ ༈bod pa'i don la/ brnyi si/ byings ma yin pa'i mtshungs pa la/ dhi dbyi/ zhes pas phyis/ dhi la'o zhes pas/ rtags mtha' e ru bsgyur/ he budhe/ au dang dzas la he bzhug ba las gzhan dbye ba med/ ༈ bu rnyi da/ ri shas dag gi a'o/ /a dbyi/ tshurnyi/ brnyi au/ gong bzhin/ brnyi/bu rnyi shas/ 'di ha ri dang cung mi 'dra ste/ su'i na mi byed/ shas la'o zhes pas/rtags mtha' ring po/ bu rnyi/ a phyis/ brnyiX/ ༈ bu rnyi ṭā/ bud+dhā/ bhāX rtsis 'dra/i du rgyuX/ i tra utu dag las so/ bud med kyi rtags i ta mtha' dang /utu mtha'i pha rol du/ ngi tra byung na/ ngi tra la a khu ā ga ma ster/ brnyi nge / dra dbyi/ an+t+ra byin/ ba dhi a e ba theg a yig e mthong e ru song / brnyi'i da drangs brje/ de yang 'grel bar gdam gar bshad de/ a sgra mi sbyin na/bu rnyi e/ rtags e/ e no/ bzhi ye/ bhāX byas 'dra'o/ ༈bu rnyi nga si/ brnyi as/i ta utu1 dag las so/ /zhes/ pas/ an+t+ra sbyin/ brnyi a as/ 'dra ba'i yi geri/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ ba khyuX/ yang na/ an+t+ra spangs pas/ brnyi as/—128—

rtags mtha' e/ budhe as/ nga ngas kyi a phyis/ rnam bcad/ brnyeX/ bhāX khyuX'adra'o/ ༈bu ju ngas bzhag sing dang 'dra bar bsgrubs bud+dhāX/ yang na budheX/ brnyi os/ da/ rnam bcad/ brtsaX/ bu rnyi u mu/ nus/ brnyi nāX/༈s+t+ri yāX yoX/ i u las bud med la'o/ /i ring thung u ring thung gi mtha' can mo rtags kyi pha rol gyi ngi ni yang na u mu du 'gyur ro/ /bud dhi ngi /dra phyis/ i au ru bsgyur/ de ni tra yin pas/ ṭi phyis/ burnyo/ bu rnyi i/ i ta utu dag la'o/ /zhes/ a ta byin/ ja ji a gro i/ i u mu/ da/ drangs/ bud+dhāX/ brnyi os/ bro smyoXrde/ brnyi sus/ ku i la las sa ṣa zhes pas sa ṣa ru bsgyur/ brdzi khu'adi kho na ltar/ ma ti/ blo gros bhu ti/ 'byor ba dha ti/ 'dzin 'cha ru tsi mdzes pa la sogs pa rnams kyang rnam dbye 'jug tshul 'dra'o/ ༈ /khyu ba 'jom ste kā ma khyu nu/ 'dod 'jo nu'i sgra la/ khyo nu si/ rnam bcad/ khyu nuX/ khyo nu au/ au ni snga ma dang 'dra ba mū ru song / 'dra ba/ khyu nā/ khyu dzas/ u o/ o ab/ rnam bcad/khyu na baX/ ༈bod pa'i don la/ khyu nu si byings min pa la dhi phyis/ rtags mtha' o/ he khyu no/ he khyu ni/ he khyo na baX/ ༈khyu nu da/ a phyis/ stu nuX/ khyo nu au/ khyu nu/ sbo nu shas/ rtags mtha' ring / rkyen gyi a phyis/ khyo nāX/ ༈khyu nu ṭā ub/ stu nā/ bhāX bhiX'adra/ ༈khyu nu nge / /an+t+ra ster/ stu nu a e bzhag/ a ni i/ khyu nu'i ub/ dhi nai/ khyu nu nge o a wa/ khyo na be/ /stu nu bhāX/ khyo nu khyoX/ ༈khyo nu sing/an+t+ra/ mtshungs pa/ u wa/ khyu nāX/ khyu nu nga si a phyis/ rtags mtha' o/ khyu noX/sgyuX/ khyoX'adra/ ༈de nu ngas/ nga si dang 'dra/ khyu twoX/ khyu noX/ khyu nu os/ khyu twoX/khyu nu u mu/ nus/ rtags mtha' ring / khyu ni nāX/ ༈khyo nu ngi / ngi au/ rtags mtha'i —129—

u phyis/ drangs/ khyo no/ yang khyo nu ji / a gro/ i sdis/ 'dra ba ring ub/ khyu nāX/khyu nu da/ khyu nīX/ rnye du su pra/ khyu nu khu de bzhin du/ ra dzha thag pa la sogs pa'ang 'dra'o/ ༈na di'i rgyun can te chu bo'o sgra/ha sepaXse rlopa/ ha sa zhi pra la si dbyi'o/ /ne di si/ si dbyi/ zhi ta kyi mtha' kun la rnam dbye dang po'i si dbyi ba kho na yin/ na dī/ na dī au/ klu yu ru bsgyur/ na khyo/ na dī dzas/ na byiX/༈dho hra swā/ dhi la thung du'o/ /mo rtags yī mtha' dang mū mtha' la/ bod si byin na/ rtags mtha' thung ngur 'gyur/ bod si 'jig go /he na di/ he na khyo/ he na duX/ ༈na dī da/ a phyis/ na sdu/ na dī au/ na sdu/ na dī shas/ a phyis/ rnam bcad/ na hiX/ ༈na di khyu yī/ zhi yu/ na phywa/ na dī bhāX/ na dī bhiX/ na dī nge/ ngi tā man+t+ra/ngi ta la an+t+ra 'o/ /mo rtags yī dngu u'i mtha' las/ ngi tra yod pa rnams la a gro ā ga ma ster te/ na dī nge/ a gro/ na dī a e/ /a i ru bsgyur/ yī spra/drangs/ na bye/ dz+nyā khyoX'adra/ ༈na dī nga si/ an+t+ra/ na dī a as/ mtshungs pa/ na dī gis/ yī yu/ drangs/ na khyuX/ dhīX khyoX'adra/ ༈na dī ngas/ nga si dang 'dra/ na sdiX/na dī os/ yī yu/ rnam bcad/ na droX/ na dī u mu/ nus/ na dī nāX/ ༈na dī ngi/an+t+ra/ ngi u mu/ zhi yu/ drangs/ na byāX/ na dī os/ na droX/ na dī su pu/ na dī skyun dī dang 'dra bar/ go rī/ u ma'am lo brgyad ma su ra su tī dbyangs can ma bru smi ṇi/ bram ze mo ku mā rī/ gzhon nu ma ki sho rī/ lo brgyad ma ka —la bhā/mdzes ma bu mo chung du rang la'ang zer la sogs pa mang ngo / /de dag ni zhwa pu —130—

mtha' yin te/ dper na/ na da la bud med kyi rkyen zhis byin/ pra rjes 'brel/de'i srog a phyis/ drangs pas/ na dī zhes pa lta bu yin no/ ༈lam+bhi ni zhwa pra mtha' ni min/ mo rtags yī ring mtha' can yin pas phal cher dang 'dra ba dang /yang na pa yod pa la/ /dang po'i si mi dbyi ste rnam bcad du byed pa'ang yin/bod si la rtags mtha' thung ngu rang du byed/ g.yin lhag ma rnams na dī ji lta ba'o/ ༈ sdi zhes pa'i sgra la/ si dbyi ba kho na yin/s+t+ri bhū boX/ sbyi bhu yi'ang ngo / sdi dang byu'i sgra la/ pha rol rkyen rnam dbye dbyangs thog ma can la/ rtags mtha' da dang ub ru bsgyur/ zhes te/ sdi'i srog gi yī ring po de/ i thung spra srog med dang bcas par 'gro ba dang / zla'i srog gi mū ring po de/ u thung nywa srog med dang bcas par 'gro bas/ sdi sdi yu/bhu la/ byub ru 'gyur te/ de yang sdi si/ si dbyi/ sdi/ sdi au/ rtags mtha'i zhi/i yu ru bsgyur/ s+t+ri yo/ sdi dzas/ ri/ s+t+ri yaX/ ༈bod si la rtags mtha' thung si phyis/ he s+t+ri/ he s+t+ri yo/ he s+t+ri yaX/ ༈bā sna si/ da shas la yang na'o/ sdi da/ yī ri du bsgyur/ sti yaX/yang na da gyi a phyis/ lti/ snri au/ da/ s+t+ri yo/ sdi shas/ da/ s+t+ri yaX/tshig phrad kyi sgrub ba yin na ma gtogs/ /mo rtags la shas kyi sa nar ru mi bsgyur ro/ /yang na sti shas/ shas kyi a phyis/ sa rnam bcad/ s+t+riX/ ༈lji ṭā/da/ s+t+ri yā/ bhāX bhiX/ ༈snri nge / an+t+ra/ ra/ a e ru song / drangs/ s+t+ri yi/ bhāX khyuX/ ༈snri nga si/ an+t+ra/ s+t+ri da/ a as bzhag mtshungs 'dra drangs/ rnam bcad/ s+t+ri yā/ bhāX khyuX/ ༈sdi ngas/ nga si dang 'dra/ s+t+ri yāX/ sdi os/ da/ s+t+ri —131—

yoX/ snri u mu/ nus/ ṣa ra ra sogs/ rtags mtha' ring po sngar nas grub/ sdi nāX/ ༈sdi ngi / sdi i/ i u mu du gyur/ ri/ s+t+ri yāX/ sdi os/ s+t+ri yoX/ sdi sub/sdi khu ༈shrī'i sgra la/ si rnam bcad/ shrīX/ gzhan/ shri yo/ shri yaX/ ༈ shi yaX/ shri yo/ shri yāX/ ༈shri yā/ shrī stuX/ shrī bhiX/ rnams na dī dang 'dra/ ༈be yu boX/ yang na da ub la'o/ /mo rtags byings mtha' i ta dang uta ri dang u bar song ba la/ pha rol ji ta bzhi bo rnams byung na/ as ā ga ma ster ba dang mi ster ba yang na bar bya'o/ yī nge / dra phyis/ rtags mtha' da/ an+t+ra byin/ ṭā song / a de e mthong bas i ru song / drangs/ shri yi/ yang na shrī e da/ shri ye/ bhāX khyuX/༈shrī nga si/ aṭa/ mtshungs pa/ da/ shri yāX/ yang na an+t+ra ma byin pas/ shri yaX/bhāX khyuX/ ༈shrī ngas/ nga si dang 'dra/ shri yāX/ shri yaX/ shrī os/ shri yoX/ mdo gzhan las/ shrī la sogs pa rnams kyi u mu la nu yang na'o/ /zhes bshad pas/shrī u mu/ nus/ shrī ṇaX/ yang na da shri yāX/ ༈ shrī ngi / an+t+ra byin/ ngi u mu/ da/shri yāX/ 'di an+t+ra mi ster na u mu du yang mi bsgyur te/ da/ drangs pas/ shri yi/shrī os/ shri yoX/ shrī su pu/ shrī khu ༈de bzhi du/ dhī blo/ khyo/ngo tsha bhā/ bhū la sogs pa la yang bsgyub tshul shrī kho na dang 'dra'o/ ༈ ba dhu bu mo dang /༄dzam+bu la shing gi rigs sogs pa ni/ na dī sgra dang 'dra ste/ bcwa si/ riX/ ga au/ub/ ba tho/ de bzhin du/ ba'iX/ ༈he ba dhu/ he brjo/ he ༄bsdiX/ |badhūX/ be+e rjo/shas kyi skabs 'dir sa'i na mi byed/ a dbyi/ rtags mtha' ring po'i /pa dh+waX/༈badhū/ ba dhū bhāX/ ba dhu bhiX/༷༈ba lha/༷badhū bhāX/ bsgru khyoX/ ༈badhūX/ ba dhū dz+nyāX/ ba hūṃ khyuX/—༈ba dhūX/ bzloX/ ba dha nā/ ༈badhū/ bo zloX/ bskyo skyu—132—

༈ /ṛ yig mtha' can mo rtags la/ mu ༷ la sogs pa ste/ de yang gong du pho rtags su gtogs pa'i pi rta'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /mu tā/ mā ta ro/ muta raX/༈he mā taX/ he mā ta ro/ he mā ta raX/ 7/mā ta raX/ mā ta ro/ mu tshwaX shas kyi na mi byed a phyis rtags mtha' ring po'o/ ༈ mā tri ṭ+wā/ ṛ ni ru ru song / wo/ bhāX sbyiX/ ༈mā tre/ bhāX khyuX/ ༈mā tri nga si/ nga yi u'o/ nga u ru bsgyur/ ṭi phyis/ nā khungaX/khriX khyuX/ ༈mā 6༷/ snye jiX/ mā hṝ ṇaX/ ༈mu ta ri/ mā khroX/ mā tri skyu zhes pa'o/ ༈ su hre'i sgra ni/ po gyi skabs dang 'dra ste/ swa swā/ swa swā ro/ swā rā raX/ ༈he swa swāX/he swa swā ro/ he swa sā raX/ ༈ swa swā raX/ su swā ro/ su hṝX ༈ su sru/ bhāX bhiX/༈su sre/ dhīX khyuX/ ༈dra u/ ṭi phyis/ swā suX/ bhāX khyuX/ ༈su suX/ swa sroX/ su tshwa ṇaX/7/ swas ri/ swa sroX/ swa mṛ skyu zhes so/ ༈ e yig mtha' can mo rtags las re zhes pa'i sgra ni/ su ri/ zhes pa'i skabs dang khyad med de/ rāX/ rā yo/ rā yaX/༈he rāX/ he rā yo/ he rāX/ ༈rā yaX/ rā yo/ rā yaX/ ༈rā yā/ rā bhāX/ rā bhiX/ 7/rā ye/ rā bhāX/ rā khyuX/ ༈rā yaX/ rā bhāX/ rā khyuX/ ༈rā yaX/ rā yoX/ rā yāX ༈rā yi/ rā yoX/ rā su/ ༈go zhes pa la/ pho rtags mo rtags gnyis ka yod pa las/ mo rtags kyi go sgra la'ang / rnam dbye 'jug tshul pho rtags dang khyad par med de/goX/ gā bo/ gā baX/ ༈he goX/ he gā po/ he gā baX/ ༈gāX /gā bo/ gāX/ ga bā/ go dhīX/ go bhiX/ 7/ga be/ /go dhīXgo khyuX/ ༈goX/ go bhāX/ go khyuX/ ༈goX/ ga boX/ ga ba/ yang na go nāX/ 7/ga bi/ ga boX/ go khyi ༈ mo rtags au yig mtha' can las/no zhes pa'i sgra ni/ pho rtags glo zhes pa'i sgra dang khyad par med de/ noX/ nā po/nā baX/ ༈he no/ he nā bo/ he nā bāX/ ༈nā baX/ nā bo/ nā ba/ nā bā/ no bhāX/ no bhiX/—133—

༈ nā be/ no bhāX/ no khyoX/ ༈ nā baX/ no bhāX/ no khyoX/ ༈nā baX/ nā boX/ nā bāX/ ༈nā bi/ nā boX/ no khu zhes pa rnams so/ /dbyangs mtha'i rtags las mo rtags rnams rdzogs so/༈ /da ni dbyangs mtha'i rtags las ma ning gi rtags bshad par bya ste/a to da/ a tra las ri/ /ma ning a thung gi mtha'i pha rol tu rnam dbye dang po'i si ste/ dhi min pa'i si dang / gnyis pa'i da ni/ nges par ri kho nar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di snyam du si ni ri du 'gyur pa bden du chug kyang /ri nyid phyis nas yang da du byed pa dgos pa med do/ /zhes dogs so/ /min te dgos pa gzhan yang yod mod/ lu ka zhes bya ba'i dbyi bas 'jig pa de min pa'i don du go byed de/ 'og tu ma ning la si da 'jig go /zhes pa la sogs gcod pa'o/ /'dir ku la'i sgra la mtshon na/ ku la si i phyis/ sa da du bsgyur/ rtags mtha'i a phyis/ drangs/ ku laX/ ༈bod si ni dbyi ste/ bya ba gzhan med/ he ku la/༈sī mo/ au zhi'o/ /ku la au/ au yī ru song / a i la e ku le/ ༈ ku la dzas/ zhes pa bzhag dza sh+ka bzhag dza sh+ka so shiX/ dzas shas dag gi shi'o/ kha yig ni thams cad pa'i don te/ dzu as gsum ka bsgyur gyi /a lta bu gcig kho na bsgyur ba min pa'i brda'o/ /g.yin las kyang / lci ba'i shi tra thams cad kyi'o/ /zhes bshad/ lci ba'i dzas shas lta bu yi ge du ma 'dus pa'i don no/ /nu ma ya maX ya ma min pa'i nus 'o/ /ya ma so sor bsdus ba'i yi ge —134—

dgu po rtags mtha' la med na ma ning skabs 'dir/ dzas shas la nus ā ga ma ster te/ pha rol sha yig dag la ster zhes 'grel bar 'byung ste/ sha yig ni shi la zer te/ dzas shas shi ru bsgyur ba'i ming ngo / /ku la dzas/ dzas shi zhes par bsgyur/ nus ā ga ma byin/ gzhan las/ mu i tra mtha' can dbyangs kyi pha rol lo/ /zhes 'byung bas/ i brjod don dang / mya gnas kyi don yin pas/ nus gyi u dang mu dbyi/ gnas ni skabs 'dir dbus su 'jog pa'o/ /ku la nu shi/no pa dha yuX/ na'i u pa dha'i 'o/ /na u pa bhā ni/ mtha' las snga ma u pa blu'o/ zhes 'byung na/ 'dir mtha' ni na gsar byung de yin pas/ de'i snga ma dang po'i rtags mtha' an u pa dha 'o/ /na mtha' ru byung pa'i nus pas de ring por 'gyur te/ na rkyang pas mi na pha rol tu rkyen gyi sha yig yod na yin no/ khra phyis/na i la drangs/ ku lā ni/ grub po/ ༈ku la da/ a song / ku laX/ ku la shas/dzas dang 'dra/ ku lwa ni/ ༈lhag ma ṭā la sogs pa rnams pho rtags de ba'i sgra dang sgrub tshu 9 / 'dra ste/ ku le na/ ku lā bhāX/ ku liX/ ༈ku lwa ya/ ku lā bhāX/ ku le khyoX/ ༈ku 'gron/ ku lā bhāX/ ku le khyuX/ ༈ku la phya/ ku la yoX/ ku lā nāX/ ༈ku le/ku la yoX/ ku le khu ༈he ku la/ he ku lo/ he ku lwaX zhes pa rnams so/ ༈de bzhin du/ mū la rtsa ba dang / pha la 'bras bu dang / pa tra lo ma dang / pu ṣ+ka me tog dang / kuṇ+ḍa snod dam dong dang / ku shu sba la nye du sogs pa dpag tu med pa yang de dang 'dra'o/༈ sha twa rgyu deX a n+ya la sogs pa la ༈'o/ /a n+ya la sogs pa 'phral du 'chad 'gyur rnams la/ si dang da ni ༈ zhes par bsgyur dgos te/ a rgya —135—

si/ i phyis/ sa ni shu zhes par bsgyur/ u brjod don/ sha gong bzhin thams cad pa'i don te dbyi/ a mya ta/ ༈ a n+ya da/ si dang 'dra ste/ a rgya ta/ gzhan ku la dang 'dra/ a nu tra/ a rkye/ a n+ya ni/ ༈ a rgya tra/ a rkye/ a rgya ni/ a rkye na/zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ de bzhin du/ i ta ra'i sgra la/ i ta ra ta/ i ta re/i ta rā ṇi/ la sogs pa dang / ༈ ka ta ra'i sgra la/ ka ta ra ta/ ka ta re/ ka ta rā ṇi la sogs dang / ༈ka ta ma'i sgra la/ ka ta ma ta/ ka ta me/ ke ta mā ni la sogs pa dang / ༈ a n+ya ta ra'i sgra la/ a n+ya ta re/ a n+ya ta rā ṇi/ la sogs pa ste/ rkyen ḍa ta ra ḍa ta ma la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /da ni i yig mtha' can la/ a snyi zhes ba'i sgra la/ na puX sa ka ta su mo rlu ku/ ma ning la si da dag 'jig gom ning i mtha' la si dang da ni lu ka zhes te 'jig 'jig ces brda chad dngos 'di dang / gzhan rnam grangs su bkod pa dag ma 'dres pa bya'o/ pas dbyi ste/ lu ka gi sgras phyis pa tsam ma gtogs bya ba gang yang med pa'o/ /a smi si/ si dbyi/ a snyi/ a snyi ri/ da dbyi/sbo ṇaX/ i u ṛ rnams kyi'o/ /ma ning skabs 'dir/ bod pa'i don la si byin na/ dhi de'i nus pas rtags mtha' yon to du 'gyur te/ i ni e dang / u ni o dang / ṛ ni da du 'gyur te/ a snyi si/ byin/ i e/ a snyi/ he bzhag /si dbyi/ he a ste/ 'grel par yang na bar bshad de/ yon tan ma byas na he a snyi/ skabs 'dir 'grel par/ saXbho dha na li na gzugs gsum sa mtha' u sha nas dang / /de bzhin na mtha' u shan de nas a mtha' u sha na pa sangs la/ /i ka mtha'i yon tan stag rkang rus gcig ming nang nas mchog —136—
