'phags pa/ /lhag min drang srong nyin mo 'dod de ma ning rtags la'o/ /zhes 'byung ngo / u sha nas dang / u shan/ u na/ zhes pa gza' pa sangs kyi ming yin la/ ma ning gi bod pa/ sa mtha'/ na mtha'/ dbyangs mtha' gsum ga la rtags mtha'i yon to 'byung bar drang srong ma dh+ya di nas bshad do/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /nā mi naXswa re/ nā mi dbyangs la nu'o/ /ma ning nā mi'i rtags mtha' can/ pha rol rnam dbye'i rigs dbyangs kho na ba'am/ dbyangs dang po can la/nus ā ga ma ster te/ a snyi/ au nus/ u mu dbyi/ au zhi'o/ drangs/ a smi nī/a sbi dzas/ shi ru bsgyur/ nus/ u mu phyis/ a snyin shi/ shra song / a smin/ i byung / drangs/ a snyi ni/ u ba dh+wa ring po'o/ /asnri ni/ ri/ o shas kyang de dang 'dra ste/ a snyi/ a snyi nī/ a sbyi ni/ zhes pa'o/ ༈adz+nyā s+thaXnā sha swā do/ a snyi rnams kyi na a tra shas la sogs pa la'o/ /a snyi la sogs pa rnams la/ pha rol tu shas la sogs pa ste/ shas kyi rting ma ṭā la sogs pa'i skabs 'dir 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i nang tshan rigs gcig la/ dngos su smon pa de mi bsdud pas/'dir yang shas mi sdud/ ṭā man thad sdud de/ ṭā byin gyi dbyangs kyi rnam dbye rnams gang byung yang / rtags mtha'i i a ru 'gro zhing / nus ā ga ma ster ro/ /a slo paXsra re ྅sba yuk+ta smo swā do/ ma ba rab sbyor ma yin pa las shas sogs la a ta dbyi ste dbyangs la'o/ skabs 'dir ni nus byin pas gsar du na mthar song ba'ang yin la/ gdod ma ma ning i mtha' yang yin la/ ma yig gam ba yig yod pa'i rab sbyor te/ ma'am ba yod pa'i yi ge brtsegs ma min pa —137—

cig pha rol du shas kyi rjes ma nas byung ba'i dbyangs kyi rnam dbye yod par gyur na/ u pa khyu ste/ gdod ma'i rtags mtha' dngos su mtha' las snga ma ste/ na mtha'i gong gi a yig ni dbyi bar bya'o/ /ma yig dang ba yig yod pa'i rab sbyor la ni mi dbyi'o/ /a snyi ṭā/ nus/ i a ru bsgyur/ a phyis/ a sban ā/na ā la drangs/ s+tha srog med kyang na la drangs/ a sgra nā/ bhāX bhiX/ ༈ a snyi nge ྅sra/ a phyis drangs/ a sgran/ sgyuX khyuX/ ༈a smi nga nus/ i a/ a phyis drangs/ a sgra nāX/ bhāX khyuX/ ༈ a smi ngas/ sing dang 'dra/ a sbanaX/ isgri os/nus/ i a/ phyis drangs/ a sbonaX/ a snyi ā/ nu mu/ i a/ phyis drangs/a smraXn/ ༈be droX/ i ngi dag la yang na'o/ /i dang ngi pha rol la ni u pa dha'i a yig dbyi ba'am mi dbye ba yang na ba ste/ a snyi ngi nus/ i a/ a phyis drangs/a smin/ yang na a ma phyis pas/ a s+tha ni/ a snyi/ tse(sa/ drug pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ a snyonaX/ a snyi su pa/ a snyi khu zhes te/ 'dir a sbi sogs zhes pa'i sogs khongs nas/ da zho dhi/ sa mdung sna/ a mig ldan spu la sogs mang po ste sgrub tshul gcig pa'o/ ༈ de bzhin du/ bā ri chu/ bā ri ṇi/ bā rī ṇi/ da sogs la/ bā ri/ bā ri ṇi/ bā rī ṇi/ zhes pa rnams asbi'i sgra dang 'dra/ bā ri ṭā/ nā mi zhes pas/ nus/ ṣa ra ri las nā ṇa ru song / bā ri ṇa/ ༈des dbyangs kyi rnam dbye kun la rigs 'gre ste/ /bā ri nge / nu mu/ bā ri ṇi/ ༈ bā sdo nga si/nus/ bā ri ṇaX sgyuX gsum khyuXganyis bhiXrnams 'dra/ ༈ bā ri ngas/ nus/ bā ri ṇaX/ bā ri os/ nu mu/ bā ri khoX/ bā ri u mu/ nus/ bā ri ṇaX/ ༈bā ri ngi / nu mu/ bā ri ṇi/ bā ri os/ nus/ bā ri rjoX/ bā ri su pu/ bā ri khyi—138—

༈ na puX sa ka gya hra swaX/ ma ning gi thung du'o/ i mtha' sogs ma ning la rnam dbye byin na/ rtags mtha' thung ngur 'gro ba shas che ste/ grwa ma ṇi si/ i phyis/ sa 'jig rtags mtha' thung du'o/ grwa ma ṇi/ grong sde'i phra ma mkhan rnam dbye dbyangs rnams byung na/ nus ā ga ma ster te/ grwa ma ṇi au/ au yī ru bsgyur/ nu mu/ rtags mtha' thung du/ drangs/ grwa ma ṇi ni/ grwa ma ṇi dzas/ dzas shi ru bsgyur/ nus mtha' thung sa sha dang mu phyis/ grwa ma ṇa in/ i zhes pa las/mang tshig gi nus pas i gong ma slar ring por 'gro ༈ so sor drangs pas/grwa ma ṇi ni/ ༈bod pa gsum pa la yang 'di kho na dang 'dra ba las/ he bzhag go༈ grwa ma khyi a mu/ mtha' thung / da phyis/ grwa ma ṇi/ grwa ma ṇi au/ gong dang 'dra/grwa ma ṇi nī/ grwa ma ṇi shas/ /dzas dang 'dra/ grwa ma ṇi ni/༈ ṭā dā buk+ta puX skaX puX ba dwa/ ṭā sogs la skyes par bshad pa'i skyes pa bzhin yang na'o/ /dbyangs rkyen rnams la sngar bshad pa'i/ se na nī la sogs pa/ grwa ma ṇi pho rtags dang 'dra bar ma ning sgrub pa dang / ma ning rang nyid kyi lugs su bsgrub pa gnyis yod de/ skyes pa bzhin zhes pas skyes pa rang min pa'o/ /grwa ma ṇi ṭā/ da ru song / grwa ma t+yāX/ grwa ma ṇa nge/ da/ grwa ma rkye/ ༈des rigs 'gre ste/ grwa ma ṇi nga si/ grwa ma khyuX/ ༈ grwa mā ṇi ngas/ grwa ma khyoX grwa ma ṇi/ os/ grwa mā khyoX/ grwa ma ṇi u mu/ grwa ma t+yāX/ ༈ grwa ma ṇi ngi / rkyen gyi i u mu/ grwa ma t+yāX/ grwa ma ṇi os/ grwa ma rkyoX/ grwa ma ṇi nge / e yu/ grwa na ṇi su pa/grwa ma ṇi khri/ zhes pa pho rtags dang mtshungs par sgrub tshul yin no/ ༈yang na grwa ma ṇi smi nu mu/ /mtha' thung / grwa ma ṇi nā/ ༈grwa ma ṇi nge/ nus/ mtha' thung/ grwa ma ṇi —139—

ne/ ༈ grwa ma ṇi nga si/ da nus mtha' thung / grwa ma ṇi naX/ ༈grwa ma ṇi ngas nus mtha' 'thung / grwa ma ṇi naX grwa ma ṇi tse(sa num mtha' thung grwa ma ṇi noX/ grwa ma ṇi ri/ mtha' thung nus drangs mtha' slar yang ring po'o/ /grwa ma ṇi nā/ ༈grwa ma ṇi ngi / nus/ mtha' thung / grwa ma ṇi ni/ grwa ma ṇi os/ nus/ grwa ma ṇi noX/zhes pa rnams ma ning nyid kyi rtags kyi bsgrub tshul yin pas 'di gtso che'o/ /skabs 'dir bha ldan drug dang sub la pho rtags dang ma ning gi khyad par med do/༈ //so ma pā/ zhes pa'i sgra ma ning rtags la/ pha rol rnam dbye gang byung yang /rtags mtha' thung ngur 'gyur nges la/ dang po gsum dang gnyis pa gsum/ grwa ma ṇi sogs dang 'dra ste/ so ma pā si/ rtags mtha' thung / si ri du bsgyur/da gyi a phyis/ so ma paX/ so ma pā au/ thung/ au yī/ a i e/ so ma pe so ma pā dzas/ thung / dzas shi nus/ sha phyis/ so ma pan i byung / rtags mtha' slar ring po'o/ /drangs/ so ma pā ni/ ༈de bzhin du/ so ma pā da/ thung / a dbyi/ so ma paX/ so ma pā au/ yī/ thung / so ma pe/ so ma pā dzas/ thung kyi shi/nus/ sha phyis/ so ma pan i byung / rtags mtha' slar ring po'o/ /drangs/ so ma pā ni/ ༈ de bzhin du/ so ma pā ri/ thung / a dbyi/ so ma paX/ so ma pā au/yī/ thung / so ma pe/ so ma pā/ shas/ thung / shi/ nus/ slar ring po/ so ma pā ni/ ༈ṭā man chad/ pho rtags de ba'i skabs dang 'dra ste/ so ma be na/ so ma pā bhāX/rtsis kyi bha ri bsgyur/ a i la e/ a e la e/ so ma be+eX/ ༈ so ma pā de akra da/ mtshungs 'dra/ drangs/ so ma pā ya/ so ma pā sgyuX/ so ma pe khyuX/ ༈ so ma pā nga si/ so ma gra ta/ bhāX khyoX/ bzhi pa dag 'dra/ ༈ so ma pā ngas/ so ma pa gya/—140—

so ma pā os/ rtags mtha' e ru song / e da/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ so ma pa yoX/ so ma pā/ u mu nus/ thung ngu slar ring por log /so ma pā nāX/ ༈ so ma pu lnga/ so ma be+e/ so ma pā os/ drug pa dang 'dra/ so ma pa yoX/ so ma pā su pa/so ma pe sgyu ༈ u yig mtha' can ma dha'i sgra la/ ma dhu pho rtags ni dpyid ka la 'jug ma ning rtags ni sbrang rtsi'o/ /rnam dbye dbyangs thams cad la/ nus ster ba kho na yin no/ /ma dhu si/ si dbyi/ ma dhu/ ma dhu au sī/ nus/ ma dhu nī/ma dhu dzas/ shi/ shus/ ring po / ma ga ni/ ༈ ma dhu da/ a dbyi/ ma dhu/ ma dhu au/ ma dhu nī/ ma skyo shas/ dzas dang ja'adra/ ma ga ni/ ༈ ma dhu ṭā/ nus/ ma dhu nā/bhāX bhiX/ ༈mju nga / nus/ ma dhu ne/ bhāX khyuX/ | ma skyo nga/ nus/ ma dhu naX/ bhāX khyuX/ ༈ ma dha ngas/ nus/ ma dhu naX/ ma dhu os/ spes/ ma dhu noX/ ma dhu u mu nus/ ma dhu nāX/ ༈ma dhu ngi / nus/ ma dhu ni/ ma dhu os gong dang 'dra/ ma dhas pu/ma dhu khyi ༈ /i ma ning yig mtha' can las/ a ti ri zhes pa la/ ji skad du thung ngu ā de sha mtshams spyor gyi yi ge la i yig u yig dag kyang ngo / /zhes 'byung / /rtags mtha' e dang ske ni/ thung ngu i dang / o dang au ni thung du u ru 'gyur te/ a ti re/ si/ rtags mtha' i i ru bsgyur/ si dbyi/ a ti ri au/nus/ thung ngu / au yī/ a ti ri ṇi/ a ti ri dzas/ thung ngu / dzas shi/ nus/ thung ngu ring po/ a ti rī ṇi/ a ti ri da/ phyis/ a ti ri/ a ti ri au ā nus/ a ti ri ṇi/ a ti ri shas/ rtags mtha' thung / shi thung ngu ring por/ a ti rī ṇi/༈a ti re ṭā/ nus/ a ti ri ṇa/ a ti ri bhāX/ a ti ri bhiX/ ༈ des 'gre ste/ a ti ri ṇi/ dhīX khyoX/ ༈a ti ri ṇaX/ dhīX khyoX/ ༈a ti ri ṇaX/ a ti ri rtoX/ a ti rī —141—

ṇaX/ a ti ri ṇi/ a ti ri hoX/ a ti ri khu zhes te/ a ti ri zhes pa la/ ri nor can/ a ti 3 zhes pa shin du nor can no/ ༈ a ti no zhes pa la/ no ni gru yin/a ti no/ gru chus khengs la khang pa'i ming yin/ de la rnam dbye nyer gcig gang byin kyang o la ltos pa'i thung ngu u ru 'gyur bas/ a ti no si/ a ti nu si/ si dbyi/ a ti nu/ a ti no au/ a ti nu au/ nus/ au yī/ a ti nu nī/ ༈ a ti nu dzas/ shi/ nu ring po/ a ti nā ni/ ༈ de dang 'dra ba la/ a ti nu/ a ti nu ni/a ti nā ni/ ༈ de bzhin du/ bha ldan rnams la 'gyur ba med la/ sdas khu ༈dbyangs rkyen rnams la nus rtag par 'jug pas/ a ti nu nā/ ༈ a ti nu neX/༈ a ti nu na:/ a ti nu naX/ a ti nā noX/ a ti nu nāX/ ༈ a ti nu ni/ a ti nu noX/ a ti ri dang a ti no/ bod si ster/ si rkyang bzhin nam/ slar yang e dang au log 'gro ji ltar 'os pa 'dam kar bya'o/ ༈ yang kha la pū zhes pa la/ dang po drug bsha/da ma thag pa dang 'dra ste/ kha la pu/ kha la pu ni/ kha la pū ni/ ༈ kha la pu/ kha la pu ni/ kha la pu ni/ lhag ma ṭā sogs gong ya ba ྅ dang 'dra'o/ ༈ṛ yig mtha' la/ tshwa'i sgra ni/ dang po drug po de dang 'dra ba las/ ṣa ra ri las na ṇa ru 'gyur te/ ka ltu/ ka rto ṇi/ ka rto ṇi/ ༈ ka ltu/ kan+t+ra ṇi/ kadz+nyā ṇi/ ༈ṭu la sogs pa la gdam nga ste/ ma ning rang lugs ltar na/ dbyangs kyi rkyen rnams la nus ster/ na ṇa ra bsgyur/ su pra dang bha ldan la nus gyi bya ba mi dgos so/ /yo ṇa/ skyo bhāX/ skyo bhiX/ ༈rka tsho ṇi/ po tsho bhāX/ rka tsho khyuX/ ༈ ka khya ṇaX/kan+t+ra bhāX/ kan+t+ra khyoX/ kan+t+ra ṇaX/ kan+t+ra khoX/ u mu 'di la rtags mtha' ring / kadz+nyā ṇaX/༈ ka tsho ṇi/ ka khya rkoX/skyo khu༈pho rtags dag mtshungs par sgrubs na/ ṛ ru ru —142—

bsgyur bas/ ko n+t+ra shrī/ ṭa song / ṛ ru/ ru ā la drangs/ ta ya drangs pas/ ka rta/༈ kan+t+ra nge/ ka tre/ ༈ kan+t+ra nga si/ re tra la nga u'o/ /a u ru song / kartuX/ ༈ kan+t+ra ngas/ de dang 'dra/ kartuX/ ka tro os/ po rtoX kan+t+ra u mu ka tri ṇaX/ ༈ katswa ngi/ka rta ri/ ka rto os/ ka rto/ kan+t+ra su pu/ kan+t+ra sgyu de ltar na dbyangs mtha' ma ning gi rtags rnams bshad zin to/༈ da ni ha sa'i mtha' can te gsal byed mtha' can las dang por pho rtags rnams bshad par bya'o/ /ha sa so sor bsdu ba ni gsal byed kyi ming ste ha sa'i mtha' can ni gsal byed mtha' can no/ de la dang po/ ha mtha' can la/a glang gyu pa na ḍū ha zhes pa la/ sā ba na ḍū haX/ a na ḍū rwa'i si la'o/ /a na khu ha la dang po'i si byin na/ nus ā ga ma ster/ gzhan las/ a na khu ha yi u mu ā ga pa lnga po rnams la'o zhes 'byung ba/ si au dzas/ da au ste lnga lnga'o/ /'dir u mu dang nu mu gnyis ka ster dgos pa rnam dbye la mi ster bar ming la ster la/ ming gi yang gsal byed la mi ster/ dbyangs mtha' ma de la ster bas/skabs 'dir/ a na ḍū dang / mtha' rten hu srog med kyi bar du ster ro/ /a na ḍū hu si brjod don/ u mu de'i 'og tu nus/ mu gnyis phyis/ a na ḍū un 4ha sa/saX yo gan+ta su lo baX/ rab sbyor mtha' la dbyi'o/ rab sbyor ni gsal byed dbyangs med 'dus pa ste/ skabs 'dir/ na srog med dang / ha srog med do/ /de las tha ma ha phyis/ de yang pha rol ra sa so sor bsdu ba'i rkyen yod pa dgos pa las/ 'dir si byung la/ ngo bo tshig mtha' yin pa cig dgos na/ de —143—

yang si byin pas tshig tu grub ste/ de'i phyir hu dbyi/ ha se pa se lo pa/ ha sa zhwa pra la si dbyi'o/ /zhes pas si yang 'jig a na khu ā na zhes pa lus so/ /ub/ drangs pas/ a na ṭa lda ṭā na/ gru/ a na hu o/ um/ u lda/ a na ḍā bā ā hā/ au/ zhes 'byung / so sor drangs/ a na ḍā ho/ a na khu ha dzas/u mu/ ub/ a ḍa na haX/༈ dha wa mu/ dhi la 'i ri/ /bod si byin na/ rnam dbye dang po'i skabs dang gzhan 'dra ba la/ u mu ring po mi ster bar da ā ga ma thung ngu ster ro/ /de la/ a na ḍā na zhes pa 'byung / he a na ḍa na/ he a na ḍā ho/ he a na ḍā haX/ ༈a na khyu ha a mu/ ub/ drangs/ a na ḍā haX/ a na ḍā ho/ a na khu hu sha su/ sha song/ drangs/ a na ḍū rnyaX༈ de bzhin du/ a na khu ṭā ṭā/ drangs/ a na ḍū hā/ ༈ des rigs 'gre ste/ dbyangs rkyen lhag ma rnams la/ a na khukhya nge/ a na ḍū he/ ༈ a na khu ta nga a na ḍū rnyaX ༈ a na nus ngas/ a na ḍū rnyaX ༈ a na khukhya os/a na khu hoX/ a na khu hu u mu/ a na ḍū hāX/ ༈ a na nus ngi/ a na ḍū hi/ a na khu hu/ os/ a na ḍū hoX/ zhes so/ ༈ bha ldan dang su pu khyad par gzhan yod de/a na khu hu sgyu mu zhes pa bzhag ba sa rnams kyi ra sa ba swe ra se/ la'o//rnams kyi zhes mang tshig ni bas kyi sogs khongs na/ sraX sa/ mtshon snun dh+waX su/'joms pa bh+raXsu/ a na ḍū ha la sogs pa'o/ /ming gi pha rol du ra sa so sor bsdu ba'i rkyen yod pa'am/ tshig mtha' la yang 'gyur te/ 'dir bha dang sa —144—

gnyis ka ra sa'i khongs su gtogs pas/ ra sa pha rol can la ha ḍa ru song /drangs/ a na sdu rgyu/ an khu rnyiX/ ༈an khu rgyu/ an khu dhūX/ ༈a na khu rgyu༈ a na gu rgyuX/ ༈a na khu hu su pra/ ba sa rnams kyi ra sa la'o zhes pas/ hu da ru song / kha sa la tsa pa rnams dzha sa ru 'gyur zhes pas da tra ru 'gyur bas/ a na khu zlu/ yang ha srog med kyi mtha' can yin yang / de dang cung zad mi 'dra ba la/ ba 'jo ba go du ha zhes pa la ni/ go du hu si bzhag /dā de rgyuX/ da la sogs pa'i lha'o/ /da la sogs pa la/ tshu rol byings yin na/ pha rol dzha sa so sor bsdu ba rkyen la yod pa dang / tshu rol ming yin na pha rol ra sa byung / so sor bsdu ba yod pa'i rkyen nam/ tshig mthar song ba yin na/ hu srog med gha srog med du 'gyur ro/ /si dbyi ste/ skabs 'dir ming yin la/ si'i sa ma phyis gong du ra sa'i rkyen yin pas gha ru 'gyur la/ phyis zin na ni hu de tshig mthar song bas gha ru byed de/ gang ltar yang nges par gha ru bsgyur ro/ /go du gha bzhaga.ā di dza bā nāX dzha bhan+ta gya rnyes joX/ dza ba'i dang po rnams kyi dzha bha mtha'i dzha bha ste sa dh+wa rnams kyi'o/ /dzha bha so sor bsdu ba ni dzha khyu dha gha bha 'o/ /dza ba so sor bsdu ba ni/ dza ḍa da ga ba'o/ /skabs 'dir dzha bha'i bzhi pa gha yin/ de'i dang po ste sngon ma ni/ dra yin na/ da yig dza ba'i gsum pa yin la/ dha ni dzha bha'i gsum pa yin no/ /de la dha dang da gnyis sde pa gcig pas/ sde pa mtshungs pa'i yi ge yin la/ dzha bha'i gsum pa dang / dza ba'i gsum pa yin pas grangs mtshungs pa'i yi ge yang yin no/ /dzha bha'i gha srog med mtha' can gyi dang po na yod pa'i —145—

dza ba'i yi ge dra yig de gha yig mthong bas du dang mtshungs yig dha yig tu 'gyur ro/ /go dhu gha/ dra dang lha'i bar na srog u yod kyang / dha ru bu sgyur ba 'di gsalabyed kho na'i 'gyur ba yin pas mi sgrib bo/ /'dir de ltar yin la/spyir byings la dzha bha'i mtha' yod pa la/ mtha'i dang po'am sngon ma dza ba yod pa rnams dza ba de rang dag mtshungs pa'i dzha bha ru 'gyur ro/ /de la pha rol du rkyen sa yig dang dh+wa zhes pa'i sgra yod pa dgos la/ ming mtha' yin na/ de tshig mthar gyur pa'am/yang na ra sa so sor bsdu ba'i rkyen pha rol du yod na yang / rtags mtha'i gsal byed kyi gong ma gsal byed gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i gsal byed/ dza ba de/de yang dzha bha dang mtshungs pa'i yi ger 'gyur ro/ /go skye gha/bā ba sa ne/ gnas med pa la yang na'o/ /gnas med pa zhes pa ni/dbyangs med pas gzhan la ltos pa'i phyir/ gsal byed mtha'i ming yin la/ de la yang rkyen rnam dbye byin pa dgos la/ de yang dang po'i yi ge mtha'i sngon ma dza ba ru yod pa de/ dzha bha dang 'phrad pas/ yi ge sngon ma dzha bha sde grangs mtshungs par gyur pa de yod pa'i nus pas rtags 'gyur 'gro ste/ tshu rol dza ba ru ma zad/gzhan mtshan nyid de 'dra tshang ba'i dzha sa gang yod kyang / pha rol gsal byed mtha'i dzha bha de/ dzha bha kho rang dang sde grangs mtshungs pa dza ba ru 'gyur te/skabs 'dir sde ba mtshungs pa ka sde nang phan tshun yin pa dang / grangs mtshungs pa/ dzha bha'i bzhi pa gha de dza ba'i bzhi pa ga ru 'gyur la/ yang na'o zhes dzha bha de tsa pa ru bsgyur te/ de yang sde ba mtshungs pa ka sde/ grangs mtshungs pa dzha bha'i bzhi pa gha de/ tsa pa'i bzhi pa ka ru bsgyur ro/ /go jug go dhu kra zhes pa'o/—146—

/gzhan dbyangs kyi rkyen rnams sgrubs sla ste/ go du ha au/ pha rol/ go du hoX/go du ha dzas/ go du haX/ ༈go du ha da/ go du hāX/ ༈go du/ ha au/ go du ho/ go du ha/ shas/ go du haX/ ༈ go du hu ṭu/ go du hā/ ༈ go du ha ngi / go du hi/ go du/nga si/ go du rnyaX/ ༈ go du ha ngas/ go du rnyaX/ go du hu os/ go du ho/ go du ha/u mu/ go du hāX/ ༈ go du hu ngi / go du hi/ go du hu/ os/ go du hoX zhes pa'o/ /bod pa rnams kyang he thog mar sbyor ba ma gtogs rnam dbye dang po'i gsum po sgra ji bzhin pa'o/ ༈ bha ldan rnams la ni/ go du ha sgyu mu/ da la sogs pa'i lha'o/ /zhes pas/ hu gha ru bsgyur/ 'di la rtags mtha'i gong gi gsal byed la ltos pa'i mtha' ma de dza ba'i nang gi da yig yin pas gha yig de dzha bha'i nang gi dha yig tu bsgyur/ dzha pe dza ba/ zhes pa'i mdos/ dzha bha gha yig dza ba ga yig tu bsgyur/ na te bur ba'o/ drangs pas/ rga khye sbaXbhā/ go dhu sdiX/ ༈go dhu sbaXbhā/ go dhu sba phyaX/ ༈go dhu gyuX/ go dhu kraX/ ༈go du hā ha gha ru bskyur/ kha sa la tsa pa dzha sar 'gyur bas/ pha rol su ni kha sa yin pa de mthong bas tshu rol dzha sa gha de/ tsa pa lda las kra ru 'gyur/ ku i la las/ su'i su ṣa ru bsgyur/ drangs pas/kra ṣa rab tu 'dus pa las k+ṣa zhes pas/ go dhu khri/ ༈ yang ma dhu li hu sbrang rtsi len pa'i bung ba'o/ /zhes pa phal cher de dag dang 'dra yang khyad par cung zad yod de/ ma skyo li ha si bzhagaho rte/ ha yi rte'o/ byings mtha' la hu yod pa/ dzha sa pha rol la sbru ru 'gyur ba dang / ming mtha' la ra sa pha rol lam/ tshig mthar gyur ba'i gnyis ka yin pa las kyang ste/ rtags mtha'i hu yig ḍū yig tu 'gyur ro/ /'dir ming —147—

mtha'i hu/ ra sa pha rol si'i sa las sbru yig tu 'gyur tshe de nas si phyis/gnas med pa la yang na'o/ /zhes pas/ rtags mtha'i dzha sa khyu yig de/ yang na dza ba ḍa yig tu bsgyur ba'am/ yang na tsa pa ṭā yig tu bsgyur ro/ /ma dhu li ḍa/mju litre/ ma dha li ha au/ pha rol drangs/ ma dhu li hoX/ des dbyangs rnams rigs 'gre /ma dhu li haX/ ༈he ma dhu liṭa/ he mju li ḍa/ he ma dhu li ho/ he ma dhu li rnyaX/ ༈ma dhu li haX ma dhu li ho/ ma dhu lir+shaX/ ༈ma dhu li hā/ ༈mju li hai/ ༈ma dhu li tshiX/ ༈ ma dhu li rnyaX/ ma dhu li ho khyaX/ ma dhu li hāX/ ༈ ma dhu li hi/ ma dhu li hoX/ ༈ ma dhu li ha bya mu/he'i lha'o/ hu sbru ru song/ dzha pe dza ba/ zhes pas lha ḍa ru bsgyur/ drangs/ma dhu li ḍaXbyā/ ma dhu li rnyiX/ ༈ ma dhu li ḍaXbyā/ mju li ḍa gyu/ la sogs pa'o/ /madhu li hu sus/ hu yig sbru ru song / kha sa las dzha bha tsa par 'gyur bas ḍabya ru song / ma dhu li zlu/ dru hā dī nāX gha twa khyu tī bā/ dru ha la sogs pa'i gha nyid khyu nyid yang na'o/ /dru hu la sogs pa'i hu yig gha yig dang sbru yig tu bsgyur ba gdam ka yin la/ gha sbru gnyis po la so sor dza ba dang tsa pa gdam kha yin te/ de yang dang po'i si dang bod si de ltar bzhi yin la/ bha lngan rnams la dza ba kho na yin gyi /tsa pa ma yin pas gnyis gnyis so/ mi tra dru hi/ si/ hrore lha'o grogs bzhes la mkhu ba/ zhes pas/ ha khyu ru song ba'am/ bha nyid dang sbru nyid ces pas/ gha dha gang rung bya/ mi tra dru gha/ mi tra dru ḍā/ dza ba'i dang bo rnams kyi dzha bha mtha'i dzha bha te sa dh+wa rnams la'o/ /zhes pas/ dzha bha'i yi ge gha dang khyu gang mthong yang / gong ma dza ba'i yi ge dru'i da ni dha ru te/ mi tra ngh+rugha/ mi tra dhu skyu/ zhes —148—

pa'o/ /gnas med ba la yang na'o/ /zhes pas/ gha ru bsgyur ba'i phyogs la dza ba'i nang tshan ga dang / tsa pa'i yi ge kra'o/ /lha ru bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ tsa pa'i yi ge ṭa dang / dza ba yi ge ṇa ru 'gyur ro/ /mi tra dhu gra /mi tra byu kra/ mi tra dhu ṭa/mi tra rmyu bye/ zhes pa yin no/ /mi tra dru ho/ mi tra dru tshiX/ ༈he me tra rmyug he mi tra dhukrahe mi tra rgyu ṭa/ he mi tra byu ḍa he mi tra dru ho/ he mi tra dru haX/ ༈da sogs la/ mi tra dru haX/ mi tra dru ho/ mi tra dru haX/ ༈mi tra dru hā/ ༈mi tra dru he/ ༈ mi tra dru haX ༈mi tra dru haX/ mi tra dru hoX/ mi tra dru hāX/ ༈mi tra dru hi/ ༈mi tra dru hoX/ bha ldan/ ha lha'am dha ru bsgyur/ lha ḍa dang / gha ga ru 'gro ste/ dru dhu ru bsgyur/ drangs/ mi tra dhu bhūX/mi tra dhu sbaXbhā/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈mi tra dru ha su pra/ ha dha dang / dru dhu ru song / kha sa las dzha bha tsa par bsgyur te/ khyu ṭa'o/ /mi tra rmyu rgya/ zhes pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ ta twa mu ha de kho na nyid la rmongs pa la sogs pa rnams la yang ngo /༈bha ra bā/ khur bkyed de bong bu zhes pa la/ dang po lnga la khyad med/ shas sogs la khyad yod/ de yang bhā ra bā ta si/ ha yi bha 'o/ /ha khyu ru song / de yang gnas med pa zhes pas/ dza ba'i ḍa 'am tsa pa'i ṭā gang rung du byas/ bhā ra bā ṭa/bhā ra ba ḍa/ bhā ra bā ha/ au/ /bha ra bā hoX bhā ra bā ha/ ༈he bhā ra bāṭa/ he bhā ra dwaḍa/ he bhā ra bā ho/ he bhā ra bā haX/ ༈bhā ra bā haX/ bhā ra bā ho/bā ho po sha swā do su re/ bā he'i shas sogs dbyangs la bā'i e'o/ /bhā ra bā ha/ shas/ bā yongs rdzogs au ru bsnyur/ ra'i srog a dang mtshams sbyar te/drangs/ ro ru song / shas man chad ṭā sogs dbyangs kun la ro 'di rtag tu 'ong ngo / /bhā ro rnyaX/ ༈ḍā la/ bhā ro hā/ la sogs pa/ bdun pa'i os la bhā ro hoX/—149—

zhes pa'i bar gong ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre ste go sla/ ༈bha ldan rnams kyang /bhā ra bā ha/ sgyu mu/ ha'i bha 'o/ /zhe gnas med/ bha ḍa ru 'gyur/ bhā ra bā ḍaXbhā/ des 'gre/ ༈bhā ra bā ha su pu/ ha sbru/ sbru ṭa/ bhā ra bā rgya/ ༈yang / tu swā ha'i brgya byin gyi rta rā sgra la/swā heXkhaXswā khyi/ swā he'i lha la sa khri'o/ /swā he'i sgra la si dang bha ldan dang sub rnams byin pa na/ swa ha zhes pa'i sa yig ṣa yig tu 'gyur te/ si la tshig mtha' yin pa dang / gzhan la ming mtha' lha'i nus pa ste/ tu rā swā ha si/ bzhagagye'i lha'o/ /khyu/ swā he'i khyu la sa ṣa 'o/ /zhes pas/ sa ṣa ra song / tu rā khri lha si/zhes so/ /si dbyi/ zhe ni gnas med sogs kyi ḍa' ma ṭa ru bsgyur ro/ /tu rā tsho/ tu rā ṣaḍa/ tu rā su ha/ au/ pha rol drangs/ tu rā sā ho/ de bzhin du/ tu rā swā haX/ ༈tu rā swā haX/ tu rā swā ho/ tu rā swā rnyaX/ ༈tu rā sā hā/ zhes sogs/ bdun pa'i os/ tu rā swā hoX/ zhes pa'i bar go sla/ ༈bha ldan la/ tu rā swā ha bhāX/ ha lha/bha'i nus pas sa ṣa ru song / tu rā khyi lha sgyu mu/ dzha bha la dzab zhes pas ḍa ru bsgyur/tu rā ṣaḍaXbyā/ des gzhan la'ang 'gre/ ༈tu rā swa ha su pa/ ha khyu/ sa lga gnas med/ sbru ṭa ru song / tu rā khrig/ grub/ ༈ re pha'i mtha' las/ tsa tus gyi sgra dper brjod na/ tsa spyas grangs kyi don la rnam dbye bdun po'i mang tshig kho na 'jug gi gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig mi 'jug go /dngos po brjod pa'i don la ni gcig tshig sogs thams cad 'jug ste dbye ba shes par bya'o/༈ tsa tu rā sgo tsa/ tsa spyad gyi u mu shi la'o/ /tsa spyas bzhi gyi sgra la dngos po brjod pa'i skabs/ si au dzas/ ri au rnams te lnga po la/ u mu ā ga ma —150—

ster te/ shi zhes pa ni lnga po de rnams te/ rnam dbye lnga po de dag pha rol na yod pa la'o/ /grangs brjod pa la si sogs mi ster yang / /dzas ni lnga po'i nang sel yin pas lnga pha rol ces pa'i mi 'gal lo zer/ mu'i mtha' can 'di dbyangs kyi pha rol lo zhes bshad pas/ ming mtha'i gsal byed srog med kyi gong /dbyangs 'jug ma de'i 'og mtha' u mu ā ga ma ster ro/ /tsa tus si/ u mu byin/tsa tu u mu ru si/ si 'jig ub/ ru rnam bcad/ tsa tāX/ tsa tus mo/ u mu/ub/ drangs/ tsa tā ro/ tsa co dzas/ u mu/ u bya/ drangs/ tsa tā raX/ ༈tsa spyad da/ u mu ā ga ma/ u ba/ tsa tā raX/ tsa tud au/ tsa tā ro/ zhes pa'o/ g.yin dbyangs rnams la/ tso tu ru shas/ drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ tsa tu raX/ ༈des mtshon te/ tsa tu rā/ ༈tsa tu re/ tsa tu raX/ tsa tu raX/ tsa tu roX/ tsa tu rāX/ tsa tu ri/tsa tu roX/ zhes pa dang / ༈bha sa thog ma can la/ ra pha rol du drangs/ 'og ma bha rnams gnyis su byed pa'ang yin/ sa gnyis su mi byed do/ /tsa tu skyuX/ tsa tu rje bhaX/ zhes/ pa lta bu ste/ tsa tu rgyuX/ gsum/ tsa tu rgyuX/ gnyis/ tsa shu chu/ zhes/ pa'o/ ༈grangs kyi don ni/ tsa tā raX/ tsa tu raX/ tsa tu skyuX tsa tu rgyuX/ tsa tu khyuX/༈raXsaX khyu yāX/ ra yi grangs kyi'o/ /tsa tu ru gyi re pha'i mtha' nus ster/tsa tu ru na zhwa mu/ zhes 'byung / na drangs/ nā ru mthong / ṇaX du song / ṇa nyis brtsegs su 'gyur/ tsa tu ngaX/ ༈tsa tu chu/ zhes pa mang tshig bdun po kho na'o// ༈ //na mtha' las/ rā dza na rgyal po gyi sgra ni/ rā phan si/ na'i u pa dh+wa ring po'o zhes pas/ dzā ring po'o/ /nā sno no lo pa sha dho/ ming gi na'i dbyi ba dhi min pa la'o/ /zhes pas na —151—

dbyi ste/ de yang dhi ma yin pa rnam dbye dang po'i si ni na mtha' can gyi ming mthar byin na/ mtha'i na dbyi ste/ 'grel par ā ga ma min pa zhes 'byung ste/gdod ma'i ming mtha'i na yig dgos pa'i don no/ /pha rol du ra sa'i rkyen yod pa'am/ rang nyid tshig mthar song ba gang rung gcig dgos pa las/ 'dir si ma phyis gong du/ bsgyur na/ ra sa pha rol dang / sa phyis rjes su bsgyur na tshig mtha' 'o/ /si phyis/ rā dzā/ rā dza na/ au u pa bhā ring po/ drangs rā dzā no/ rā dzan/dzas/ ring po/ rā dzā naX/ ༈dhi ma yin pa zhes pa'i khyad par gyi tshig gis/ bod si ni kho rang dbyi ba kho na las/ u pa dh+wa ring po dang rtags mtha'i na dbyi ba gnyis ka med de/ he rā tha/ gzhan gnyis ni gong dang 'dra/ he rā dzā no/ he rā dzā naX/ ༈da la/ rā dzā naX/ au la rā dzā no/ rā phan shas bzhug /ma ba rab sbyor min pa las shas sogs la a ta dbyi ste dbyangs la'o/ /zhes gong du 'byung bas/ jo'i srog gi a phyis/ sa tu ni sha tsu rnams las sha tsu'o/ /zhes gong du 'byung bas/ ta sde'i na ni gong gi tsa sde'i dza mthong bas tsa sde nya yig tu song / rā dzu nya as/ dza nyo rnyiX/ dza nya dag gi stso/ /dzu dang nya dag sdoms pa dz+nya ste/ de as la drangs/ rnam bcad/ rā dz+nyaX/ ༈de ma gtogs 'og gi dbyangs rkyen rnams la 'di kho nas rigs 'gre/ gsal byed thog ma can rnams la gong si'i skabs kyi ming gi na'i dbyi ba'o thob/ ༈u pa dh+wa ring po mi thob ste/ ṭā man chad la/ rā dz+nyā/ rā dza bhāX/ rā dza bhiX/ ༈rā dzhai/ rā dza dz+nyāX/ rā dza khyuX/ ༈rā dz+nyaX/ rā dza bhāX/rā dza khyuX/ ༈rā dz+nyaX/ rā dzhaiX rā dz+nyāX/ ༈gong du e ngi dag yang na'o/ /zhes pas yang na ba la u pa dh+wa dbyi ba'i phyogs dkyus bzhin yin/ rā rnyi/ mi dbyi na/ na —152—

i la drangs/ rā dza ni/ rā dzhaiX/ ༈rā dza su/ zhes so/ ༈de bzhin du/ ya dzan lha mchod mkhan/ a khru na nga bdag/ su dha rmā na lug sa bzang / de la sogs pa na mtha' mang po phal cher/ rā phan dang mtshungs kyang / a smin dang / dha smin gyi ma dang / ya dzan gyi ba ste/ de rnams ma ba rab sbyor yin pas/ u pa dha'i a ta mi dbyi'o/ /des na ya phan si/ ring po byed/ si 'jig /na dbyi/ ya dzā/ ya dzā no/ ya dzā naX/ ༈bod pa'i na mi dbyi/ ring po med/ he ya dzan/ he ya cha do/ he ya dzā naX/ ༈ya dzā naX/ ya dzā no/ zhes pa rnams/ rā mun dang 'dra/ ༈de nas shas sogs mi mtshungs te/ u pa dha'i a ma phyis pas/ rtags mtha'i na srog med pha rol tu drangs pa kho nas chog ste/ ya dzanaX/ ༈ya dz+wa nā/ na min zhes pas na dbyi'o/ /ya dz+wa bhāX/ ya dza bhiX/ ༈ya dz+wa ne/ ya dz+wa bhāX/ ya dzo bh+yaX/ ya dzanaX/ ya dzo dz+nyāX/ya dza bh+yaX/ ༈ya dz+wa naX/ ya dz+wa noX ya dz+wa nāX/ ༈ya dzā ni/ ya dzā noX/ ya dz+wa su/zhes pa'o/ ༈shwa na khyi dang / yu ban lang tsho dang / ma gha ban brgya byin rnams la/si au dzas/ no au lnga rnams rā mu ni gyi skabs dang 'dra/ shā/ shā no/ shā naX/༈he hwan/ he shwa no/ he shwa naX/ ༈shā naX/ shwa no/ zhes pa'o/ ༈shas man chad dbyangs la mi 'dra ste/ shā de ga shwa sogs kyi yang ngo/ khwan sogs la shas sogs dbyangs kyi rnam dbye byin na rtags mtha'i gong gi ba yig u ru 'gyur ro/ khrin gyi skabs 'di dang / de phan dang / zhi pra dang / ā yig las kyang de 'dra mang ngo/ shwan shas/ ba u/ shu naX/ ༈de dang 'dra ba kho nar khyu sogs dbyangs la/ shu nā/ ༈shu ne/ ༈shu naX/ ༈shu neX/ shu noX/ shu nāX/ ༈shu ni/ shu naX/༈na mi na lo pa sha/ zhes na phyis pas/ shwa bhāX/ shwa bhiX/ shwa bhāX/ ༈shwa khyuX/ ༈ shwa khyuX/—153—

shwa khyuX/ ༈shwa su/ mtha'i na dbyi ba kho na'o/ ༈yu ban la ni dang po lnga 'dra/ yu bā/yu bā no/ yu bā naX/ ༈he yu ba na/ he yu bā no/ he yu bā naX/ ༈yu bā naX/ yu bā no/zhes pa'o/ ༈shas man chad dbyangs la/ ba dbyangs dang bcas pa u ru 'gyur te/ u ni yu'i u dang mtshungs 'dra sbyar/ na drangs/ ྅ naX/ ༈de bzhin du/ pū nā/ ༈྅ ne/ ༈྅ naX/ pū naX/ pū noX/ ྅ nāX/ ༈pū niX/ ྅ noX/ zhes pa'o/ ༈bha ldan dang sus la/ yu dang ba rang gnas dang mtha'i na dbyi ste/ yu ba sgyuX gsum dang / yu ba khyuXganyis dang / yu ba bhiX zhes pa dang / yu ba su/ zhes so/༈ma gha ban la yang / ba srog can u ru bsgyur/ u la e'o/ mtshams sbyar bas/ma ston zhes 'byung ba las/ dang por si sogs lnga rā dzan dang 'dra/ ma gha bā zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈shas sogs la yang / ma sto naX/ sogs dang / ༈ma gha ba bhāX/ sogs/ ma gha ba su/ zhes pa'i bar 'gre'o/ ༈na mtha' las thin lam gyi sgra la/i to tuñtsa su/ i tra kyi a ta lnga la'o/ /pa thin la sogs pa'i sgra rnams la/si sogs lnga byin pa na/ thi'i srog gi i lta bu u pa bhā i yig a ta du 'gyur te/de ltar lnga las si kho na'i bya ba la/ thā nu ṭa/tha'i nu ṭa'o/ parnyi sogs kyi pha rol/ si sogs lnga la tha yig sogs la nus ā ga ma ster ro/ /ā so/ ā si la'o/ /de'i rjes su bya ba la/ lnga'i nang nas si byin pa na/ṭi ā ru 'gyur/ si rnam bcad do/ de yang pa thin si i ta kyi a ta lnga la'o/ /zhes tha'i srog gi i a ru bsgyur/ pa thu an/ si tha la nus ster de/ ni ta yin —154—

pas tha'i gong du byin/ ṭā rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ ban thu an sa si byin pa'i dus/ 'dir ni ta ni tha na gyi srog an te/ de ā ru bsgyur/ si rnam bcad/ raXzhes pa grub/ pa thin au/ tha'i i a ta/ nu ṭa gong / na yi u pa dha 'o/ /zhes pas/ a paṅgā tha'i dbyangs ā ru song / na drangs/ za no/ pa thin dzas/ au 'dra par bsgrub pas/ pa rgyunaX/ ༈de kho na 'dra bar/ ri dang au ste/pa thin da/ za naX/ pa thin au/ za no/ zhes so/༈ zaX ṭi/ pa rgyu rnams kyi zhi'o/ khras sogs dbyangs la pa thin la sogs pa rnams kyi ṭi phyis te rnam dbye dang mtshams sbyor/ bha ldan dang su pra la mtha'i na dbyi ba kho na'o/ /pa thin shas/ pa thin/ as/ pan rnams kyi ṭi zhes pas/ thina'i in phyis/ thu dbyangs med drangs/ pa thaX/ ༈pa thin ṭā/ ṭi phyis/drangs/ pa thā/ pa thin bha mu/ pa thi khyuX de bzhin du/ pa thi bhiX/ ༈pa thin nge / pa the/ pa thi sgyuX/ pa thi khyuX/ ༈pa thin nga si/ pa thaX/ bhāX khyoX'adra/ ༈pa thin ngas/ pa thaX/ pa thin os/ pa thoX/ pa thin u mu/ pa thāX/ ༈pa thin ngi / pa thi/ pa thin/os/ pa thoX/ pa thin su pu/ na phyis/ ku i la sa lga pa thi sgyu ༈de bzhin du/ma thin srub pa dang / ṛ bha spyin brgya byin la sogs pa yang de kho na'o/ ༈da ni na 'i sgra la cung zad mi 'dra ba khrod de/i nāX sho so/ in rnams kyi shi dang si la'o/ /in mtha' dang / tī dang / pudzin dang / a rla man nyi ma sogs rnams la/ sha ste/ dza sa shas dang /si'i rnam dbye dhi ma yin pa pha rol du byung na/ u pa dh+wa ring por 'gyur te/ daX na si/ u pa/ bhā ḍa yi yī ring por gyur/ si phyis/ tshig mtha'i na srog med —155—

phyis te/ daX 'a/ daṇ+ḍi zhes pa grub po/ daX ḍa na au/ daX ḍi no/ daX ḍi na dzas/daX ḍi naX/ ༈de bzhin du gnyis pa gsum la/ daX ḍi rna/ daX ḍi no/ daX ḍi naX/ ༈daX ḍi na/ ༈bod pa'i si byin/ si phyis/ ring po dang na phyi ba med/ ༈he daX nin/ he daX ḍi no/ he daX ḍi naX/ ༈de bzhin du ṭu sogs la 'gre/ ༈bha dang sa la na dbyi/ daX ḍi nā/ daX ḍi dz+nyā/ bhiX'adra/ ༈daX ḍi ne/ bhāX khyoX/ ༈daX ḍi naX/ bhāX khyuX/ ༈daX ḍi naX/ daX ḍi noX/ daX ḍi naX/ ༈daX ḍi ni/ daX ḍi noX/ daX ḍi skyu ༈da rten kho na dang 'dra bar/ka lin cha shas can dang / ka pā lin thod pa can dang / mu sha lin gtun shing can dang / da rnyi na glang po dang / mā lin 'phreng ba can dang / dha ni nor can na la sogs pa yang ngo / ༈ han gyi dbang du byas na/ brarmi han tshangs pa gsod pa zhes pa lta bu la/ brarmi rtan la si/ si phyis/ ha ring po/ na yang dbyi/ brad+ma hā/zhes gong dang 'dra/ /de bzhin du/ au la sogs pa la/ ṣa ra ṛ na ṇa ru bsgyur ba dgos/ gzhan 'dra/ /brad+ma ha kho/ brarmi ha ṇaX/ brarmi ha ṇaX/ brad+ma ha kho/༈ha no sni/ hana'i gha na la'o/ han gyi mtha' can la/ shas sogs dbyangs kyi rkyen byung na/ ha yig de gha yig dbyangs med du 'gyur la/ na as la drangs/ de la gha drangs/ sa rnam bcad byas pas/ brarmi ghāX/ ༈de bzhin du/brarmi sni/ bha sa la na dbyi ste/ brarmi ha bhāX/ brad+ma ha bhiX/ ༈brad+ma sne/ bhāX khyuX/ ༈brad+ma ghāX/ dhīX khyuX/ ༈brad+ma ghāX/ brarmi khroX/ ༈brad+ma sni/ brarmi khroX/ brad+ma ha khu ༈pu dzin la dang po lnga brad+ma han dang 'dra ste/ pū lga pū ṣa no/ pū ṣa ṇaX/ ༈pū ṣa ṇaX/ pū ṣa kho/shas sogs kyang phal cher 'dra/ pu ṣa na shas/ ṣa yi a phyis/ ṣa dang na a sa la drangs/ sgi miX ༈pu gi sogs dang / puṣa bhāX sogs/ ༈pe'i skabs su/ pū —156—

wā gyi ngi la ṭi dbyi ste/ 'ga' zhig tu yang na'o/ zhes bshad pa/ pū ṣas na ngi /a phyis pa shas sogs dang 'dra bar byas na/ spun yang na na i la drangs/ ṣa ra ṛ las na ṇa/ pu ṣa ṇi/ yang na ṭi dbyi ste/ ṣa ṇa gyi an phyis/ ṣa i la drangs/ pu khri zhes pa gsum po gdam nga'o/ /pū snoX/ pu ṣa su/ ༈an+t+ra ma na gyi sgra la/ an+t+ra man si/ in rnams kyi shi dang si la'o/ /zhes/ u pa dh+wa man gyi ā ring por 'gyur/ si phyis/ tshig mtha'i na yang dbyi'o/ /a slo mā/ zhes so/ a slo ma rjo/ a slo ma ṇaX/ ༈a slo ma ṇaX/ an+t+ra ma kho/ ༈he an+t+ra man/ he an+t+ra ma kho/ he ar+sā ma ṇaX/ shas sogs dbyangs la u pa bhā phyis/ bha sa la mtha'i na phyis pas/yi/rngeX/ ༈a/rgyu hā// 65slo ma sgyuX/ phya5slo ma bhiX/ ༈65rnge/ 65slo ma bhāX/ 65rnyu ma khyuX/ yi/rngeX/ phya5slo ma bhāX/ yi/slo ma khyuX/ ༈ 65rngeX/ ca5slo ma rte 1 ༷༷/ 65slo ṭ+wāX/༈an+t+ra mi/ zhes/ sam/ an+t+ra sti/ a slo ma hoX/ a slo ma su/ ༈grangs kyi don du/pa nyan gyi sgra la/ mang tshig gi mtha' kho na te/ de yang paX tsa bhā ma yaX/ mo rtags kho na dang / paX tsa pu ru lga pho rtags dang / pañtsa ku laX/ mi ni nge gi rtags te/ ku la paX tsa kho na las rkyen gyis bsgyur ba med pas/ rang bzhin gyi rtags gsum pa zhes zer la/ de yang paX tsan dzas bzhagadza sha so rlu ka/ dzas shas dag dbyi 'jig go/ grangs kyi don ṣa mtha' dang na mtha' la/ dzas sha sa ni lu ga zhes pa 'jig pa ste/ skabs 'dir na mtha' la dzas dbyi 'jig ste/ de yang spyir rkyen dbyi ba la rkyen gyi bya ba yod la/'jig pa la ni bya ba med pa nyid do/ 'dir yang ste/ dzas phyis tshig mtha'i na yang phyis pas/ paX tsa zhes pa kho na'o/ /༈pañtsa na shas/ shas 'jig paX tsa/ ༈bha —157—

sa la na dbyi/ paX tsa na lhis/ pas nyiX ༈paX tsa khyoX/༈rwaX/ ṣa na'i 'o/ grangs kyi ṣa mtha' na mtha' la u mu gyi skabs su nus ster ba las/ 'dir na mtha' yin/ paX tsan/ na u mu/ no pa bhā ya/ zhes pas tsa ring po/ na mtha' phyis/ paX tsā nāX/ paX tsa su/ ༈de kho na ltar/ sa stan/ na ban/ da shan rnams de dang mtshungs par sgrub po/ ༈gyu la ni khyad par cung zad yod de/aṣ+ṭa no bā to/ a rdzo las to yang na'o/ /adzi la ni dza su dang shas byin na/ dzas shas nyid kho ru 'gyur ba yang na ba ste/ ḍa rjes 'brel la ṭi dbyi'o/ /aṣ+ṭa na dzas/ dzas to ru song / ḍa rjes 'brel/ ṭi an dbyi/ drangs/ asgo༈yang na paX tsan gyi skabs ltar dzas 'jig tshig mtha'i na phyis/ aṣ+ṭa/༈a ni na shas to an phyis/ drangs/ a sgo yang na shas 'jig na phyis/ alga༈bā su/ 'di rnams la ā yang na'o/ /bā ā yang na/ a sub 'di rnams la/ ba phyis gzhan rnams 'dra ba mtshams sbyor ba'o/ ༈aṣ+ṭa na rtsis/ na phyis/ aṣ+ṭa bhiX/a spyin nyis/ u pa dh+wa ring po/ na phyis/ aṣ+ṭa bhiX/ ༈des 'gre ste/ aṣ+ṭa khyuX.ag khyuX/ zhes dang / aṣ+ṭa khyuX/ ag khyuX zhes/ so/ ༈u mu la gdam ka mi byed de gzugs gcig nyid do zhes bshad/ de yang ring por bsgyur ba kho na te/a spyin u mu/ a ni nāX/ ༈yang kha cig gdam nga byed kyang / sngon ma ring por mi bsgyur ba'i phyogs la'ang / rtags mtha'i na phyis/ chus byin/ nā mu la ring por byas pas/ ag nāX/ zhes pa ka yod pas/ cho ga mi 'dra yang gzugs gcig go zer ro/ /sdo rdzo la gong bzhin/ aṣ+ṭa su/ adz+nyā su// ༈ //mu yig gi mtha' can —158—

i dmu gyi sgra la/ i dmu si/ i da mo3 yaX puX si/ skyes pa la i da mu gyi a yaX mo/ i dmu la pho rtags kyi sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir/ i dmu si dang bcas pa a ya mu du bsgyur/ a yaX/ i dmu au/ da gya maX/ da'i ma'o/ /da zhes pa khyad sogs kyi nang nas mtha' rten da yod pa'am/yang na 'dir i dmu gyi da kho na ma ru bsgyur ba'o/ /de la 'grel par/kyi du sogs la zhi'i mtha' dbyi ba'am a ru 'gyur bar zugad pas/ dmu gyi ri a ru bsgyur ba'am/ mu dbyangs med phyis/ i da au/ da'i ma'o zhes pas/i da'i da ma ru bsgyur/ i ma au/ drangs/ i mo/ i dmu dzas/ ṭi phyis/ da'i ma'o/ /sarba'i skabs su/ dzas zhi'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ yī ru bsgyur/ a i la e'o/ /i me/ ༈kyi du sogs la bod tshig mi 'byung ngo / /i dmu da/ ṭi phyis/da ma/ drangs/ i maX/ de bzhin du/ i mo/ i dmu/ shas/ skyes pa la sa na'o/shas kyi sa na ru bsgyur/ ṭi phyis/ da ma/ shas la'o/ zhes pas ma ring rnge'o/ /da sha sa dag gi a'o/ /zhes shas kyi a phyis/ i mun/༈ a na ṭo soX ṭā os dag la a na'o/ /i dmu la ṭā dang / drug pa dang bdun pa'i da byin na/ mgyogs par byed na/ i dmu nyid a nar bsgyur ba'am/ thob thang du byas na ṭi dbyi/ da ma byed dgos te gnyis po de si sogs su pra kyi bar thams cad la 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /des im/ /ā/ im/a na ru bsgyur/ a na'i na srog can no/ /ṭā yi ā i na ru byas/ mtshams sbyar bas/ a ne na/ ༈sba bh+yaX/ sa bh+ya la a'o/ sdo rdzo dang bha ldan gyi rkyen la/ im ni a ru 'gyur ro/ /i dmu sgyu mu/ ṭi a da a/ bha la a'o/ /zhes pas/ i —159—

dmu 'gyur ba'i thung waṃ a de ring po ā ru gyur/ ā bhāX/bhi sgyiX/ nyis rtsis so/ i dmu dang a das la/ dhis phyis nas yang rtsis nyid du byed do/ /'grel par lhas las mi 'gyur yang dhis snga ma phyis pa'i dgos pa ni/ rtsi'i bha a'o/ /zhes dang / a yig rtsis la e yig yang na'o/zhes pa'i don dgag pa'i phyir yin par bshad do/ /'on kyang bha sa mang po nyid la ni e'o/ /zhes pas e ru bsgyur te/ de yang i dmya lhis/ phyis/ his bcos/ zhi a i ma a ru a de yang e sa bsgyur/ e bhiX/ ༈i dmu nge/ i dmu/ a ru bsgyur ba'i bar gong bzhin/ sma ṭa byin/ a e la e/ a sme/ ā bhāX/gong dang 'dra/ i dmu byas/ i dmu/ a/ a e/ e khyuX/ ༈i dmu nga si bzhag a ru bsgyur ba gong bzhin/ nga si uta/ sma ṭa/ 'dra ba'i yi ge/a smutra/ ā bhāX/ e khyuX/ ༈i dmu ngas/ a gong bzhin/ da phya'o/ /a su/ i dmu os/ gong bzhin a na ru bsgyur/ os la'o zhes pas a na'i srog e ru bsgyur/ e a spra/ drangs/ a na yoX/ i dam/ zhwa mu/ i dmu a'i bar du bsgyur pa dang / a e ru byed/ su ṭa byin/ i sa ā ma zhes so/ ku i la las ṣa zhes pas sa ṣa ru song / drangs/ e gliX ༈id shī ngi / i dam a ngi smin du bsgyur/ a smin/ i dam os/ ṭā da la a na ru 'gro ste gong bzhin/ an yoX/ i dmu sdas/ i dmu a'i bar du bsgyur/ a de yang e song / ku i la las sag e khu ༈ ma'i mtha' can ki mu gyi sgra la/ tu du sogs rnams kyi si sogs la ṭi a ru byed de/ rnam dbye nyer gcig po kun la yin no/ /ki mu si/ka'i srog i yig mu srog med dang bcas pa a ru 'gyur te/ drangs pas ka srog —160—

can du song / si sa rnams bcad/ kaX/ ki mu au/ ki mu ka ru 'gyur/ ko kimudzas/ ki mu ka dzas yī/ a i e/ ke ༈ki mu da/ ༈ka da gyi a phyis/drangs༈ kaX ki mu au/ ka o au/ ko gis shas/ sa na ka shas la'o/ zhes pasakā ring po/ kwan/ ༈ki mu ṭā/ ka in/ ke na/ ki mu sgyu mu/ ka bha la a'o/ /zhes pas kā ring po/ kā bhāX/ ki mu rtsis/ ka bhi yi bha a'o/ /zhes pas/ ka a da/a i e/ e i/ drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ kaiX/ ༈ki mu nge / kasma ṭa/ e i/ ka smi/ sgyu mu gong dang 'dra/ kā dz+nyā/ byas la bhas mang po zhes pas rtags mtha' e/ke khyuX/ ༈ki mu nga si/ kasma ṭa/ a ta/ ka sma.a ta/ mtshams sbyar/ ka smutra/ khyiX/khyuX/ gong dang 'dra/ ༈ki mu ngas/ ka ngas phya/ ka su/ ki mu os/ ka os la'o/ /zhes pas ke/ e da/ ka yoX/ ki mu u mu/ ka sdoskyu kas u mu/ drangs/ka swa mu/ su mu gyi sa byung bas bha sa mang po la e/ ke ku i la la sa zhes pas sa ṣa ru song / ke khri ༈ka mu ngi / smin/ kasmin/ ki mu os/ ka ke da/ ka yoXki mu su pu/ ka bha sa mang po nyid la e/ ke ku i la sogs/ ke skyu de dag phal cher sarba'i skabs bzhin bsgrubs pa'o//༈ /dha yig mtha' la/ ta twa budha de kho na nyid de rtags pa/ zhes pa'i sgra la/ ta twa budha si/ dza ba'i dang po rnams kyi dzha bha'i mtha'i dzha bha ste/ sa dh+wa rnams kyi'o/ zhes pa/ dza ba'i nang tshan bu yig ni/ dbyangs med pa dzha bha'i nang tshan dh+ra mthong bas/ rang dang sde grangs mtshungs pa'i bhu yig 'gyur te/ ta twa : dha/ zhes pa'o/ de nas gnas med pa la yang na'o/ /zhes gong dza ba dzha bha ra song ba'i nus pas/ 'og ma dzha bha srog med de dza ba'am tsa pa ru 'gro ste/ dza ba ltar na sde —161—

grangs mtshungs pa'i ḍa ru 'gyur/ tsa pa ltar na sde grangs mtshungs pa'i ṭā ru 'gyur ro/ ta twa bhu ḍa/ /ta twa bhaṭa/ lhag ma dbyangs rkyen rnams la gsal byed pha rol la 'dren pa kho na te/ ta twa bu khyo/ ta twa bu dhaX/ ༈ta twa bu dhaX/ ta twa bu dho/ta twa bu dhaX ta twa bu khyu/ ta twa bu khru/ ༈ta twa bu dhaX/ ༈ta twa bu dhaX/ ta twa bu dhoX/ta twa bu bhāX/ ༈ta twa bu dhi/ ta twa bu rdoX/ he tatwa khyu ḍa/ he ta twa bhaṭa/ he ta twa bu dho/he ta twa bu dhaX/ ༈bha sa la/ dza ba dang po sogs kyi/ ba bha ru bsgyur/ dzha bha la dza ba rnams so/ /zhes dha yig dra yig tu song ste drangs gnas med sogs/ ta twa snu ḍaXbhā/ ta twa zuXzhes so/ /ta twa bu khyu sus/ dza ba dang po sogs/ bu bhu/ kha sa la tsa pa dzha sa zhes pas/ dha yig tra yig tu bsgyur bas/ ta twa blu phyi/ zhes pa ste phal cher go dhu hra zhes pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /dza mtha' can la/ sa grwa thu zhes pa dper brjod do/ /tsha sha ṣa rā dzā deXkhaX/ tsha sha ṣa rā dzu la sogs pa'i ṣa 'o/ /tshu mtha' dang shra mtha' dang ṣa mtha' dang rā dzu la sogs pa ste/ rā dzu// ya dzu lha mchod/ sri dza/badz+ra/ la sogs pa mang po dag ste/ de rnams la si byin na/ mtha'i tsha sha ṣa dzu rnams ṣa yig tu 'gyur la/ kho ṣa yi ḍa 'o/ khri yig de ḍa yig tu 'gyur te/ ṣa ru byed pa dang / ḍa ru byed pa gnyis ka byings rkyang pa'i mtha' yin pa dzha sa pha rol dang ming mtha' la ra sa pha rol can/ bha sa'i rkyen dang si phyis pa'i tshig mtha' la'o/ /ṣa nyid ṣa ru byed pa mi 'thad do snyam na/ ṣa mtha' ḍa yig bsgyur ba dgag pa'i don ni/ /thog ma nas ṣa yin na ḍa ru 'gro la/ phyis bsgyur ba'i ṣa yig la mi dgos pas so/ /dper na/ dī sa ṭi la/ dī khyi byas na ches mi bde —162—

bas/ stsorto zer dgos pa'i ched do/ /de yang sa grwa dz+ra si/ si phyis/ tsha sha ṣa tsha la sogs pa'i ṣa 'o/ /zhes dza yig ṣa yig tu bsgyur/ ṣa yi ḍa 'o zhes lta de yang ḍa yig go /gnas med sogs kyang 'jug pas/ yang na tsa pa ste ṭa ru byed do/ /sa sru ḍa/ sa grwa ṭa/ lhan ma dbyangs rnams la pha rol du 'dren/ bha sa la/ tsha sha ṣa rā dza la sogs pa'i ṣa 'o/ /zhes rtags mtha' ṣa dang / khyad par du bha ldan la ṣa'i ḍa 'o'am/ dzha bha las dza ba zhes pas/ yi de shā ru song 'dren/ su pra la khyad par du/ kha sa la tsa par bsgyur te/ ḍa ṭa ru bsgyur ba'o/ /sa mru dzo/ sa sru dzaX/༈he sa sru ḍa/ he sa grwa ṭa/ he sa mā dzo/ he sa mru dzaX/ ༈sa mru dzaX/ sa mā dzo/ sa mā dzaX/༈sa mā dzā/ sa grwa ḍaXbyāX/ sa sru d+dhiX/ ༈sa swā dze/ bhāX 'dra/ sa lha ḍa byaX/ ༈sa grwa dzaX/ bhāX khyoX'adra/ ༈sa sru dzaX/ sa srudzoX/ sa mā dz+wa/ sa mā dzi/ sa mā dzoX/ sa mā zlu/ zhes so/ /bi rā dzā la sogs pa'ang de kho na dang 'dra'o//༈ dra'i mtha' can ni/ gro yad ye to la sogs pa'o/ /'di dag sa spru sogs kyi nang tshan yin pa ltar spyir btang de'i sgrub tshul dang 'dra/ gsal byed mtha' can gyi bya ba cung zad mi 'dra ste/ khyad/ si/ kyid sogs rnams si sogs la ṭi a ru 'gyur bas da phyis t+ya zhes pa'o/ /si sogs zhes pa rnam dbye nyer gcig thams cad la ste/ 'dir ni/staX/ ta'i sa'o/ /kyid kyi t+ya si mthong na/ ya btags rang sor bsdad/ta ni sa ru 'gyur bas phya/ si rnam bcad/ phyaXgrub/ ta sa ru bsgyur ba ni/ si kho na la yin gyi/ dbyangs rkyen rnams lta ci smos/ bha sa la yang ma yin no/ /khyad tu ru song ba gzhir bzhag nas/ t+ya au/ rkyo/ t+ya dzas/ yī/ a i e/ tre/ ༈tu da/—163—

a dbyi/ tuX/ t+ya au/ rkyo/ kyi shas/ su na sa shas la'o/ /rtags mtha' ring po shas kyi a phyis/ khyun/ ༈kyi zhwa/ in/ rkye na/ t+ya sgyumu/ bha la a'o/ zhes/ t+yā bhāX/t+ya gis/ bhi yi a'o zhes/ s+t+yaX/ ༈tu nge / sma ṭa/ mya smi/ t+yā bhāX/ t+ya byas/ bha sa mang po zhes pas/ rkye khyuX/ ༈tu nga si/ uskyu/ sma ṭa/ tu sna khya/ t+yā sgyuX/ rkye khyuX/ ༈tu ngas/tu gya/ khya os/ /os la'o zhes pas/ rtags mtha' e/ e ri/ tu yoX/ t+ya u mu su ṭa/ bha sa mang po zhes rkye/ ku i las sa ṣa ste/ rkye lgaX ༈t+ya ngi/ rtso sten/t+ya os/ gong bzhin/ tu yoX/ tu su ri/ bha sa mang po zhes pas rtags mtha' e/ku i la sogs sa ṣa ru song ste/ rkye skyu zhes pa'o/ ༈tad kyi sgra la cho ga 'dra yang / gzugs 'gyur la the tshom mi 'jug pa'i phyir zur tsam smos na/ tad si/dra phyis/ ta sa ru bsgyur/ rnam bcad/ saX/ zhes pa grub/ gzhan yang tad ta ru song ba gzhir byas te/ des mtshon nas/ to/ te/ taX/ sogs kyid dang 'dra'o/༈yad si/ dra phyis/ ta yig ma yin pas na/ ya ni sa ru bsgyur mi dgos/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ rnam bcad/ yaXzhes so/ /de bzhin du/ yo/ ye sogs so// ༈e tad si/ dra phyis/ ta sa ru song / ku i la sogs sa ṣa ru song / rnam bcad/ e khaX/ e rto/ e te sogs 'dra ba las/ e tad kyi cho ga slar yang brjod pa/gnyis pa rnams dang / ṭā os rnams la e na yang na'o/ /zhes gzhan las bshad pas/ e tad kyi don/ 'di ni zhes pa yin pa la/ 'di ni khyed la bcol lo zhes smras na/ 'di su zhes pa la/ slar yang e na zhes pa'i don/ 'di zhes ngos sbyor ba'i tshig la/ e tad kyi sgra e na/ zhes bsgyur nas bya ba byed de/ de yang dbyangs rkyen la yin gyi/ bha sa la min te/ ༈e tad ri/ dra phyis/ e ta/—164—

e na ru bsgyur/ da gyi a phyis/ e naX/ e ta/ e na ru ma bsgyur na/ e taX/nyid do/ ༈de bzhin du/ e tā na/ e nā na/ la sogs pa dang / ༈e tā dhīX/ e taiX/ e te khyuX/ e te khu zhes pa'i bar kyid dang 'dra'o/ ༈ tsha mtha' las/ ta twa bru tshu de kho na nyid la dri ba/ zhes pa'i sgra la/ ta twa pru tshu si/ tsha sha ṣa rā dzu la sogs pa'i kho/ /zhes tsha ṣa ru song / 'a ḍa 'o/ zhes pas tha ru 'gyur/gnas med sogs kyi yang na tsa pa'i ṭa ru bsgyur/ tatwa pru ḍa/ tatwa pru ṭa/ tatwa prutshu.au/ ta twa pru tsho/ ta twa pru tshaX/ he ta twa pru ḍa/ he ta twa pru ṭa/ he ta twa pru tsho/ he ta twa pru tshaX/ ༈ta twa pru tsho/ ta twa krā tsho/ ta twa pru tshaX/ ༈ta twa pru tshwa/ tatwa pru tshu/ khyu mu/ tshu ṣa ru song / ṣa ḍa ru gyur/ ta twa pru ḍaXbhā/ ta twa pru ni bhaX/ ༈ta twa pru tshe/ ta twa pru ḍaXbhā/ ta twa bhā ḍaXbhāX/ ༈ta twa pru tshaX/ bhāX khyuX'adra/ ༈ta twa pru tshaX/ ta twa pru tsho/ ta twa pru tshwaX/ ༈ta twa pru tshi/ ta twa pru tshoX/ ta twa pru tshu su pra/ dz+nyāX dang 'dra ba las/ ḍa yig ṭa yig tu bsgyur/ ta twa pra zhu/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈ thu yig mtha' la/asni ma thu me srubs pa zhes pa ste/ i sni mthu si/ gnas med zhes pas/ thu dbyangs med dra'am trar song / si phyis/ asni ma tu/ asni mad/ asni ma thu au/asni ma tho/ asni ma thaX༈he asni ma ta/ he asni mad/ ༈asni ma thaX/ asni ma tho/asni ma thaX/ ༈'a ma thā/ asni ma ḍaXbhā asni mni bhaX/ ༈asni ma the/ bhāX khyuX/༈asni ma thaX/ dhīX smyaX/ ༈asni ma thaX/ asni ma thoX/ asni ma thāX/ ༈'a ma thi/asni ma thoX/ asni ma phyi/ ༈tsa yig mtha' la/ pra kyi dza zhes pa'i sgra'i dbang du byas na/ pra 6 9 )/ ri yi lnga po la nus ā ga ma'o zhes 'byung ba'o/ /dbyangs mthar nus ster dgos pas/ pra tu dang tsa'i bar du ste/ pra tu nus tsu si/ zhes —165

dang / pra tshoni sngos/ zhes pa'o/ /sa tu ni sha tsu rnams la sha tsusno/ /zhes ta sde na dbyangs med tsa sde tsu dang 'phrad pas/ tsa sde'i sde pa mtshungs pa nya yig tu lte song /rab sbyor gyi mtha' dbyi bas tsa phyis/tsoXkuX/ tsa yi ku'o/ /de yang tsa sde ka sder 'gyur te/ byings la dz+nya sa pha rol dang / ming la tshig mtha' 'am/ ra sa pha rol can yin na'o/ /tsa sde ka sder 'gro tshul/ grangs ji ltar ba bzhin te/ tsa sde'i dang po/ ka sde'i yang dang po dang /tsa sde'i lnga pa ka sde'i yang lnga par 'gyur ba'i bar ro/ /des na 'dir tsa sde'i lnga pa nya yig de ka sde'i lnga pa dra yig tu 'gyur/ si phyis pas/ pra kyi dra zhes pa grub bo/ /pra kyi sngo au nus/ pra tran tsu au/ sa tu ni sha tsu rnams la sha tsun/ /zhes na nya/pra kyi spyo sngo au/ rim pas drangs/ pra tu rnyu dzas la/ pra kyi ñtsa ༷༷/ as dang au khyad ma gtogs cho ga 'dra'o/ ༈si dang bod si 'dra/ /he pra tron au dzas kyi bod pa'ang 'dra/ ༈da la/ pra kyi smaX au la/ pra kyi khyo/a tse ra lo bo di sna sma no dbyi zhing ring po'o/ /pra tu tsu/ shas bzhug a tsa red pha rol du shas sogs dbyangs rkyen rnams dang / de phan dang snyi pra dang sī yig byung na/ ming gi mtha'i dbyangs a phyis la de'i gong ma rings por 'gyur ro/ /de yang pra ti ri zhes pa mtshams sbyar bas/ pra kyi sngo yin/ so sor phral na/pra ta i ri as zhes so/ /de nas ti'i i ni yu dbyangs med pa ru song /a tsa'i no a de ni yu la bcug pa yin pas so sor phral na/ pra tā sgo as zhes pa'o/ khas mthong bas mtha' ma'i dbyangs ri a phyis/ lugs can/ med pas lugs kyang med par 'gyur te/ dang po i yig de bar skabs su yu —166—

dbyangs med du bsgyur mkhan a med par song tsa na/ yu de yang yu la mi gnas par sngar lus i nyid du slar ldog ste/ pra tra ra ri/ zhes pa'o/ der a phyis shul gyi gong ma i de ring po yī ru 'gyur zhing / tsu as kyi a la drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ pra tī tsaX/ ༈des rigs 'gre ste/ ṭā sogs dbyangs la/ pra tī tsā/ ༈pra tī tse/ ༈pra tī tsaX/ ༈pra tī tsaX/ pra tī tsoX/ pra tī tsāX/ ༈pra tī tsi/ pra tī tsoX/ ༈bha ldan la/ pra kyi tsu zhes tsu ni bha rkyen mthong bas ka ru 'gro /kra ga ru gyur te/ pra t+ya ghaXyā/ zhes pa la sogs pa bha ldan drug 'dra/ ༈su pra/ tsu ka ru bsgyur/ ku i la sogs/ sus kyi sa ṣa ru bsgyur/ drangs/ kra ṣa sbyor ba k+ṣa ste/ pra tu ltu/ ༈de bzhin du/ tirla tsu zhes pa'i sgra la'ang / dang po lnga/ pra tu tho dang sgrub tshul gcig ste/ ti rlud/ tirla sme 'a tad+ma miX/ ༈bod pa gsum la yang he 'jog ༈ra dang e la/ tirla smaX tiṅgetwo༈ tir ༈ da yaX/ ti zi la sogs pa'o/ /sogs pa'o zhes pa ni/ 'og tu 'chad 'gyur/ mu da tsu la sogs pa mang po yod pa la dgongs pa'o/ /tirla tsu/ti rtu ru byed pa ni tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa ste/ de yang ta rlu tsu la shas sogs dbyangs rkyen byin na/ ti rdu ru bsgyur dgos la/ de phan dang zhis dang / yī yig las kyang 'gyur te/ ti ra: yi tsu de ni dang po nas srog med do/ /yang na sngon la dbyangs bcas su bsgyur/ phyis dbyangs phyis kyang rung ste/ tsu dbyangs med la bya ba byed kyi/ dbyangs bcas la min no/ /de yang tirla tsu shas/ sha phyis/ti ra: ru bsgyur/ ti 4na ri ri drangs/ rnam bcad/ ti rtuX/ ༈cho ga de kho nas lhag ma rnams kyang sgrub ste/ ti ra༈ ༈ti tho ༈ti rduX/ ༈ti rduX/ ༈ti —167—

ra nyoX/ ti ra ༈༷ ༈ti rngo ti ra stsoX/ zhes so/ ༈ti'i tsu sgyu mu/ sngo ka ru bsgyur/ka ga ste/ tirla ge byu yā/ tirla snyiX/ ༈ti〉 sba phyaX/ ༈ti'i sngo sus/ tsu kra sa ku i la sogs/ su khu ru song / drangs/ kra ṣa 'dus pa k+ṣa/ ti'i k+ṣu/ ka ṣa 'dus pa spu ru 'gyur zhes pa/ rgya yig la kra ṣa ma 'dres par brtsegs pa tsam dang / 'dres pa k+ṣa la gzugs dang brjod pa gnyis ka nas khyad chen po yod pas dmigs kyis bkar ba'o/ /des na kra ṣa 'dus pa nyid k+ṣa yin gyi/ sngon la 'dus nas rjes la k+ṣa ru 'gro rgyu rang gcig med dam snyam pa mi bya'o// ༈ //u da tsware sgra la/pra tu tsu dang / tirla mu bya ba dang phal cher 'dra ste/ dang po lnga dang bod pa gsum rnams la/ u dad / ud rnyu ud miX/ ༈u da smaX u da smo ༈he u dad / he u da snyu he u dmiX/ ༈kun la nus ster/ na nya sa si phyis/ de rjes tsu dbyi'o/༈shas sogs dbyangs la/ u da tsu ni/ u di tsu ru bsgyur te/ gzhan tirla mu skabs bzhin te/ u dī tsaX/ ༈u dī tsa:/ u dī tse/ ༈u di tsaX/ ༈u dī tsaX/ u dī tsoX/ ༈u di tsāX/ ༈u dī tsi/ u dī tsoX/ ༈u dwas sgyu mu/ tsu kra kra ga u da sbaXt+yā la sogs pa'o/ ༈u da tsu sus/ tsu kra sa lda drangs/ u dku/ ༈ /sa mya tsu yang de kho na ltar sbyor te/ u dī tsa yi tshab du/ sī tsu sa yang dag pa ru bsgyur pa'o/ /sa myad/ sa mya snyu| sa mya ñtsaX/ ༈sa mya smaX sa myos/ paṃ sī tsaX/ ༈sa sī tsā/ ༈sa sī ces/ ༈sa/ sī shunaX/ ༈sa sī tsa / ༷༷/ ༈rba/ sī thenaX/ bo/ sī shuX/ dra/ sī bhu/༷༷/ bro/ sī ce(༷༷/ ༈bha sa la/ sa mya sbaXt+yā sogs dang / sa mya ku/ /༈ta yig mtha' can gyi/ ma ru ta kyi sgra la/ ma ru sno se/ si ha sa'i mtha' la phyis/ tra de nyid du gnas pa'am/ da ru bsgyur te/ ma ru ta/ ma ru zhe/ ma ru to/ ma ru taX/ ༈ ma ru taX ma ru to/ ma ru taX/—168—

༈ma ru taX/ ma ru to/ ma ru taX/ ༈ma ru tā/ ma ru rwaX/ ma ru rnyiX/ ༈ma ru te/ bhāX khyoX/༈ma ru taX/ bhāX khyoX/ ༈ma ru traX/ ma ru toX/ ma ru tāX/ ༈ma ru ti/ ma ru toX/ ma ru h+phu/ zhes te/ sa mya tsu dang ma ru ta kyi bod pa'ang dang po dang 'dra'o/ ༈ma tu ta kyi sgra bzhin du/ asni tsita kyi la'ang 'dra'o/ ༈tra mtha' la/ u rjes 'brel/ ma ha tā zhes pa lta bu ste/ ma ha tu zhes hu ni mtha' yin/ de'i u rjes 'brel gyi rkyen yin/ bris ma thag tu dbyi bas ta srog med nyid mtha' yin no/ /braX to nus/ u dang ṛ dag gi nus 'o/ /rtags mtha' rkyen u yig ṛ yig rjes 'brel la/ si sogs lnga dhi dang bcas pa la/ ṭas ā ga ma ster/rgyu sma ha to dho di rgyuX3| tsa/ hri da ma ha tra kyi dhi min pa la ring po ste shi la'ang ngo / /'og tu 'chad pa'i nu'i mtha' dang / da kyi mtha' dang / 'dir ma ha tra te/ 'di rnams la dhi sbangs pa'i si sogs lnga byin pa na/ rtags kyi tha ma'i dbyangs ring por 'gyur la/ rab sbyor gyi mtha' ni dbyi'o/ /sa ni 'jig cing /gzhan bzhi la/ na tra phar drangs/ ma tshwa rto sogs dang / tra drangs/ na nga ro/ ma hāX to/ zhes sogs te/ na nga ror byed dam/ 'dren pa gang rung zhig bya'o/ /ma ha tra si/ u ṛ dag gi nus zhes/ nus/ dbyangs kyi mtha' ste/ ha dang ta yi bar du ster/ rgyu ri ma ha tra kyi ring po/ zhes ha ring por bsgyur/ mahā na tra sa/ si phyis tshig mtha'i tra yang phyis/ ma hwan/ ༈he ma han te bod si la ring por mi byed do/ /ma ha ta au nus ring po/ tra drangs/ na nga ro/ ma hāX to'i ma/ ma he rnyo 'dra/ des 'gre/ ma rnya niX/ ༈ma hāXrnya/ ma 6 1 / zhes so/ ༈shas sogs la/nus mi ster/ ring po med/ ma ha taX/ ༈ma ha tā/ ma ha ta sgyu mu/ dzha bha las dza —169—

ba'o zhes// tra dra'o/ ༈ma je/ ma ha dhiX/ ༈ma ha te/ ma ha stuX/ ma ha : ༷༷/ ༈ma ha taX/ ma ha jiX/ ma ha:/༷༷༈ ma ha taX/ ma ha ṇa rteX/ ma ha tāX/ ༈ma ha ti/ ma ha |ṣeX/ ma ha klu/ ༈u rjes 'brel tra mtha' bha ba tra la/ bha ba tu zhes pa'i rjes 'brel u phyis/ bha ba/ tra si/a twa soXso/ a tu dang si'i si la'o/ /pha rol du dhi min pa'i si byung na/a skye re mtha' dang / sa mtha' can gyi u pa bhā ring por 'gyur ro/ /u dang ṛ dag gi nu mu'o/ 'dir u pa dh+wa ni ba'i srog gi a ste de ring po ā ru 'gyur ro/ /si phyis/ rab sbyor yang dbyi/ bha bān/ bha bta au/ nus/ tra drangs/ na nga ro'am drangs/ bha baX to/ bha brnyo/ de dang 'dra bar/ bha ban+taX/ ༈bha ban+taX/ bha brnyo/ ༈he bha brnye 'di la u pa bhā ring por bsgyur ba med/ gzhan dang po'i si dang 'dra/ gnyis tshig mang tshig 'dra ༈shas sogs kyang gong dang 'dra ste/ bha ba taX/ ༈bha ba tā/ bha brgyuX/ bha brnyiX/ ༈bha ba te/ bha brgyuX/ bha bsgruX/ ༈bha ba taX/bhāX khyuX'adra/ ༈bha ba taX/ bha ba toX bha ba tāX/ ༈bha ba ti/ bha ba toX/ bha ba klu/༈ta mtha' ṛ yig rjes 'brel/ bha brta lta bu ste/ ṛ rjes 'brel dbyi/ bha bta 'di la si'i skabs u pa bhā ring po mi byed/ bha bta si nus/ si phyis/ tshig mtha' tra yang dbyi/ bha ban/ he bha ban/ bha brnyo/ bha ban+taX/ thams cad gong ma dang 'dra/ ༈yang ṛ rjes 'brel/ pa tsa tri la ṛ rjes 'brel/ ba tsa tra si nus/ring po med/ si phyis/ rtags mtha' yal/ pa tsan/ ༈he pa tsan/ gzhan rnams kyang rigs bha ba tra dang 'dra/ pa tsaX to/ pa lho sno/ gang byas kyang 'dra/ pa tsan+taX/༈pa tsan+taX la sogs pa bha bta dang 'dra/ ༈sha mtha' la/ pi shu'i sgra ni / bi sha si/—170—

tsha sha ṣa rā hro sogs kyis sha yig ṣa yig tu bsgyur/ si phyis/ kri'i ḍa 'o/ ṣa ḍa ru bsgyur/ gnas med ces pas/ yang na ḍa yang ṭa ru bsgyur/ biḍa/ biṭa/ bi shra au/ drangs/ bi sho/ bi sha/ dzas/ bi shaX/ ༈he bi ṭa/ gzhan rnams 'dra/ ༈bishubhāXmu/ shu yi / ṣa ḍa/ bi ḍaXsgyu/ bha gzhan des 'gre/ ༈bi sha sus/ sha lga ṣa ḍa/kha sa la tsa par 'gyur zhes pas/ ḍa ṭa ru song / bizlu/ ༈ṣa mtha' can/ ṣa yi la/grangs kyi don la mang tshig bdun po nyid do/ /dzas pawā gyi skabs dang 'dra bar rtags gsum ka la rnam 'gyur so so med do/ /dzas shas dag 'jig go /zhes pas/ dzas rtsa ba nas 'jig ṣa'i ḍa 'o/ ḍā ru bsgyur te/ gong du ṣa mtha' ṣa ru bsgyur nas ḍa ru mi byed pa na skabs 'gar yin gyi rtag tu min no/ /ṣa ḍa skabs 'gar gnas med ces/ ḍa yang ṭa'o/ dzis/ ṣaḍa/ ༈ṣa ṣa shas/ dzas dang 'dra/ khis/ ṣaskyu/ ༈dzin rtsis/ 9ḍa sa dza sgroX/ ༈byas gnyis 'dra/ ༈dzin u mu nus/ na mthong bas ṣa ḍa ru song / ṣa ḍa na u mu/ zhes so/ /na u myal drangs/nā mu zhes/ḍa ṇaX/ ḍa yi ṇa 'o/ /nāX mthong pas ḍa ṇa ru 'gyur/ ṣa ṇa nā mu/ tshu rol ṇa mthong bas pha rol na yang ṇa ru 'gyur ba'i don te/ khri gi ṇa mu/ drangs bas/ ṣaṇ+ḍaX/zhes pa'o/ ༈ṣa ṣa sdos/ ḍa ru song / khas la sogs ḍa ṭa// khu zhu// ༈'ga' zhig tu tshig mtha' min pa la yang tshig mtha'i bya ba'o/ /zhes 'grel par 'byung ba ni/su pra kyi mtha' gcod de/ ṣa ṭa ru byed pa sogs tshig mtha'i rnam 'gyur du bshad pa yod kyang / tshig mtha'i min pa la'ang bya ste/ don gyis thob pa'i phyir dang /grub pa'i mtha' ma yin pa'i phyir ro/—171—

༈ do khyiX raX/ don rnams kyi ra'o/ ṣa mtha'i nang tshan/ do ṣa lag pa la sogs pa rnams kyi pha rol si dang po dang / bod pa gang byung na'ang rtags mtha'i ṣa yig ra yig tu 'gyur ro/ /do ṣa si/ ṣa ru ru song / si phyis/ ru rnam bcad/doX/ ༈he doX/ ༈bha ldan dang sus la/ ṣa ru ru song pa phar 'dren/ khyu nyis rtseg dngos sam yid la bzhag /do rgyuX/ do rlu/ ༈dbyangs rkyen thog ma bzhi po la ṣa yig phar sbyor ba ste/ do lko do ṣaX/ lda lgaX do lko ༈shas sogs dbyangs rkyen la rkyen mthong bas/ na mthar 'gyur te ji ltar 'gro snyam na/ ṣa na ru mi 'gro bar/ na dbyangs med gcig rtags mthar gsar du skye'o/ /wa khye shas bzhagasha dbyi/ gzhan las shas sogs dbyangs pha rol la na mtha' nyid yang na'o/ /zhes bshad pa la/ ṣa ni dzin ru song / de ⑫nā da/ zhes 'byung / na 'dir sbyor mtha' 'dra ba gcig byung na'ang / gsar skyes yin pas rab sbyor mtha' dbyi ba mi thob/ na a la drangs/ ṣa ra ṛ la sogs na ṇa/ ṣa drangs/ rnam bcad/ do lngaXste/yang na zhes na mtha' mi byed na/ do ṣaX/ zhes pa'o/ ༈des mtshon te/ do khu ṭā ā/ do ska sgo / / zhes pa nas/ ༈do khri os/ do khoX/ ༈do snoX/ lko pa'i bar ro/ ༈do ṣa la sogs pa zhes pa'i sogs khongs nas/ sa sdos/ se ba g.yog nang zan lta bu'i bri ti ste snying nye ba'i ming ngo / /ā shis shis brjod/ ha biṣa sreg rdzas kyi khyad par dkar gsum lta bu'o/la sogs pa ste/ de dag kyang sgrub tshul/ do skye'i cho ga de kho na dang 'dra ba las/ sa dzu ṣa da'ang / ā shi skye'i ra sa la ring po ste/ tshig mtha' la'o/ /zhes gzhan las 'byung bas 'dir tshig mtha' ni si byin pa phyis pa'i skabs te de dang / tshig mtha' min yang / ra sa/—172—

bha sa rnams la rtags kyi dbyangs mtha' ma ring por byed pa khyad par te/ sa sdo'i si/ si phyis/ dzu ring po/ hūṃ ṣa ni ru/ ru rnam bcad/ sa dzuX gzhan sa dzu lko sa dzu khaXl sogs pa dang / ༈he sa dzuXl sogs pa dang / ༈bha sa la/ ṣa ḍa/ sa hūṃ ḍaXbhā/ sa tshwa sgro/ ༈sa mtha' can las/ puXsa'i sgra la/puXs si/ puX so a sdang/ puXs la a su dra'o/ /puX sa'i sgra la pha rol tu/si au dzas da au/ ste rnam dbye lnga po de dag gang byung yang / rtags mtha' a sud du bsgyur/ sub gi dra ni mtha' brjod pa'i don te dbyi/ mtha' brjod pa'i go don/ dra yig dang 'brel bar brjod pas/ rtags yongs rdzogs sam yi ge du ma bsgyur ba ma yin gyi/ mtha'i yi ge gcig kho na bsgyur pa'o/ /su'i u ni brjod don yang yin/ u dang ṛ rjes 'brel gyi rtags mtha' la/ nus thob pa'i phyir yin pas dbyi'o/swa re maX/ dbyangs la ma'o/ kha cig mdo 'di dbyangs can ma'i gsung la med zer/ gang ltar yang don la dgos 'dra/ pu gyi nga ro mu yig nyid du byas gral la sgrigs/ pu ma ri as/ zhes pa 'byung / mu drangs/ u dang ṛ dag gi nus 'o/ /zhes pas nus ā ga ma ster ro/ /nus de puXs la ster bas dbyangs mtha' ru yin te/ ma dang sa yig gi bar du'o/ /pu mu nas si zhes pa'o/ /na sa da ma ha tra kyi dhi min pa la ring po ste/ zhes pas ma thung du ring bor song /rab sbyor mtha' sa yig dbyi/ si yang dbyi/ pu mun/ lhag ma bzhi la/ a sdong du bsgyur ba dang / nga ro mu ru bsgyur ba dang / nus dang ring po rnams de dang 'dra bar byed/ rab spyor gyi mi dbyi/ na yig ni ma ring po'i klad skor du byed do/ /—173—

puXs au/ sa a sdang du/ nga ro mu sa u dang dra phyis/ mu a la drangs/ nus/pu mu na snga au/ zhes pa bzhag /ma ring po/ sa drangs/ pu māX so/ zhes grub/de bzhin du/ dzas sogs la/ pu māX saX/ ༈pu māX saX/ pu māX so/ zhes so/ ༈bod si la ni gzhan thams cad gong si dang 'dra ba las/ na sa ri ma ha ta gyi dhi min pa la zhes dhi la ring por mi 'gro bar bshad pas ma ring por mi 'gro'o/ he pu man/ bod pa phyi ma gnyis la 'dra ste/ he pu māX so/ he pu māX saX/ ༈lhag ma shas sogs dbyangs la 'di ltar/ puXs shas/ sha dbyi/ drangs/ puX saX/ de kho nas rigs 'gre/ ༈puX swā/ ༈puX se/ ༈puX saX/ ༈puX saX/ puX soX/ puX swāX/ ༈kru si/puX soX/ zhes so/ ༈bha ldan rnams la rab sbyor phyis pa kho na te/ puXsu sgyu mu/ su phyis/ puX bhāX/ puX bhiX/ puX bhāX/ sda bro la de dang 'dra bar rab sbyor phyis na/ puX su/ma phyis par drangs na/ puX sgru/ zhes pa gdam ka ni/ sgra gzhus kho na'i lugs dang / ༈sdeb sbyor dang rig byed la tshig phrad sgrub pa ni/a saX bha be puX saXka klo/ mi 'byung ba la puX sa'i ka ka te sa la'o/ /mi 'byung ba ni mi thob pa ste/ puX sa ni skyes bu rang nyid te/ rang ni gcig pu kho na las gnyis dang mang por med pas/ su pra kyi mang tshig mi thob po zhes/ rig byed mtha' pa la sogs pa smra na/ de ni sus kho nar ma zad gnyis tshig mang tshig kun la 'dra mod/ 'dir rang dngos gcig yin kyang rigs dngos du ma yod pas/ /bdun pa'i mang tshig sa yi rkyen la rigs kyi don du ka ka ā ga ma ster ro/ /de yang rkyen la mi ster ming la ster te/ mtha' brten kra rjes 'brel/ a brjod don/ puX sa kra su/ zhes pa'o/ /—174—

skor rā dros sa ka dag gi la dang po dag gi yang ngo / /skabs 'di'am/'di rigs la/ ā ga ma'i ka dbyangs med dang / sa dbyangs med gnyis 'dzom pa las gang 'dzom pa'i dang po ste thog ma dbyi ba las/ 'dir su dang por byung bas sa yig dbyi'o/ /de nas ka mthong bas su khu ru song / kra ṣa la drangs/ khyu/puX khri grub po/ 'phags ma'i gsungs 'dis/ a nu bhū ta ā tsaru'i dbugs phyung ba yin no/ ༈ /da ni bi dwasa'i mkhas pa sgra la/ bi dwas si/ u dang ṛ dag gi nus zhes pas/ cus ā ga ma/ na sa da ma ha tra kyi dhi min pa ring po zhes pas/ dā ring po/ si dbyi/ rab sbyor phyis/ bi snyen/ bi dwas au bzhug /nus ring po/ na rjes su nga ro/ sa drangs/ bi dāX so/ bi dwas dzas nus au dang 'dra/bi dwaX saX/ ༈bi dwas ri/ nus/ bi dā saX/ bi dwas au/ nus/ bi dāX so/ ༈bod pa gsum gyi dang po/ si dngos dang 'dra ba las ring po med/ gzhan gnyis 'dra/he bi dwan/ he bi swāX so/ he bi dāXsaX/༈ba so rba u/ ba sa'i u'o/ ba sa'i mtha' can ni mang mod/ 'dir dwas zhes/ dwa zhes pa'i lha zur ni ba sgra ste de dang / sa dbyangs med 'dus la'o/ /des na bsu la shas sogs dbyangs byin pa mthong ba na/ dbyangs tha ma ba dang bcas pa de u ru 'gyur te bas de us su 'gro bas/ bi dwas zhes pa de/bi dus su song / bi dus as/ sa ni nā mi'i pha rol dang / ku i la sogs ṣa ru song / drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ bi du khaX/ bas mtha' la/ shas sogs dbyangs rkyen dang / de phan dang / zhis dang / yī yig rkyen las/ ba dbyangs bcas u ru 'gyur ba las 'dir dang po'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ bi du lga ༈bi du ṣe ༈bi du khaX/—175—

༈bi du khaX/ ༈bi du khoX/ bi du lgaX ༈bi du khri bi du khoX/ bha su la/ bas rnams kyi ra sa la'o/ /zhes pas/ rnams ni mang tshig ste/ sraXs la sogs pa rnams la yang ste/ sa yig dra yig tu 'gro/ drangs pas/ bi dwa daXbhā/ bi dwa rnyiX/ bi dwa khyiX/ bi dwas su pra la/ kha sa la tsa pa sogs/ dra ta/ bi du sri// ༈su ba tsas legs smra ba kyi sgra la/ su ba tsas si/ a tu dang sa'i si la'o/ zhes pas/ tsa ring por song /si phyis/ sa rnam bcad/ su ba tsāX/ su ba tsas/ au/ su ba tsa so/ su ba ri dzas/ su ba tsa saX/ ༈bod pa la ring po med/ he su ba tsaX/ gnyis po 'dra/ ༈su ba tsa saX/ su ba tsa so/ su ba tsa saX/ ༈su ba tsa swā/ ༈su ba tsa se/ ༈su ba tsa saX/su ba tsa saX su ba tsa soX/ su ba tsa swāX/ ༈su ba tsa si/ su ba tsa soX/ ༈bha sa la/ su ba ri sgyu mu/ sa ru dag gi rnam bcad ces/ sa rnam bcad hab la'o zhes/ a dang ha ba'i bar du rnam bcad u'o/ u o/ su ba tso bhāX/ su ba tso bhiX/su ba tso khyoX/ su ba tsa sgu/ ༈de bzhin du/ tsā spro mas zla ba kyi sgra'ang de dang 'dra'o/༈u sha nasa'i pa sangs sgra la/u sha na swāX/ u sha nas rnams kyi'o/ /rnams kyi zhes pas/ pu ru daX shas dang / a ne has rnams kyang bsdu ste/ dhi min pa'i si ni u sha nas kyi pha rol tu gyur na/ si'i su/ khu'i yi ger 'gyur/ de ni ta yin pas/ nas kyi as dbyi/ ḍa yig ṭi phyis pa'i don te dbyi/ drangs/ u sha nā/ u shanas au/ drangs/ u sha na so/ u sha na saX/ ༈u sha nas bod si/ u sha nas kyi dhi la na mtha' nyid dang a tra mtha' nyid la yang na'o zhes/ u sha nas te sa mtha' can ni gdod ma yin la/ tshig phrad kyis/ na mtha' u sha nan dang / a ta mtha'i u sha na zhes pa'ang —176—

yod pas/ u sha nas/ si'i sa/ ha se ra she sogs phyis/ rtags mtha'i sa rnam bcad/ he u shanaX/ de la sa na ru bsgyur/ u sha nan/ si phyis/ he u sha nan/u sha na'i sa ar gyur pa la yang / si phyis/ he u sha na/ zhes pa'o/ gzhan yang / ༈ u sha na saX/ ༈ u sha na so/ u sha na saX/ ༈ u sha na sā/ ༈ u sha na se/ ༈ u sha na saX/ ༈ u sha na saX/ u sha na soX/ u sha na sāX/ ༈u sha na si/u sha na soX༈ bha sa la/ rtags mtha'i sa rnam bcad sogs/ su ba tsas dang 'dra/ a sha no bhāX/ bhiX /khyoX/ u sha na spru/ ༈ a das kyi sgra la/ a das si bzhag /kyi du sogs rnams kyi a kho nar bsgyur ba'am/ mtha'i gsal byed kho na dbyi ba gang rung bya/ rjes gzugs la khyad med/ 'di rnam dbye nyer gcig kun la sbyor/ a da si/so saX/ si la sa'o/ a das a da ru song ba des/ pha rol si mthong bzhin pa la yang / da yig sa yig tu 'gyur ro/ /si la zhes pas 'di rnam dbye gzhan la ma yin no/ /as sa/se ro/ si yi e'o/ /de nas si'i sa dbyangs med de/ au ru bsgyur/ au la au ru song / drangs/ a so/༈ a das au/ ṭi a/ da'i ma'o zhes pas/ a da'i da yig ma yig tu bsgyur/ 'di yang si las gzhan pa'i rnam dbye nyi shu kun la 'gre/ au la rtags mtha' au/ a mo/mā du/ ma las u dag go /de ya a das/ a ma dra zla/ra pa'i skabs/ma'i srog gi a phral nas/ tshu rol ma'i nus pas/ pha rol dbyangs de 'gyur 'gro ste/ de yang dbyangs thung ngu yin na u thung ngu dang / ring po yin na u ring —177—

por 'gyur ro/ a mu dang / a mū ru 'gyur/ 'di yang mang tshig rnams ma gtogs phal cher la 'jug go /u dag ces pas mū ring po dang thung ngu gnyis bstan no/ /'dir a das/ a ma ru song / ma yig rkyen au dang 'brel bas mo ste/ a au/ zhes pas srog au ni ring po yin te/ mtshams sbyor yi ge la thung ngu med pas so/ /de phyir u ru bsgyur pas/ a mū grub/ a das dzas/ ṭi a/ da'i ma/ sa spru sogs la/ dzas yī/ a i la e/ a me/ zhes so/e rī ba hu tī/ e'i yī mang po la'o/ mang tshig la a das kyi rtags mthar e byung na sī ru bsgyur ro/ a sī/ ༈ a das da/ ṭi a/ da'i ma/ ma las srog u sa da gyi a phyis/ a muX/ a das/ au/ gong dang po'i gnyis tshig bzhin/ a mū/ a das shas/ 'di sa spru sogs dang pho rtags yin pas/shas kyi sa na/ ṭi a/ da ma/ ma was u ste/ mu shas la'o zhes pas mu ring po/shas kyi a phyis/ a mun༈ a das ṭā/ myi a/ da yi ma/ ma las u/ ṭā nā ru bsgyur/ a mu nā/ a das bhāXmu/ ṭi a/ da ma/ bha la ā ta'o/ /zhes ma ring po/ā ring po de u ring por song / a mū dz+nyāX/ a das dhis/ ṭi a/ da ma/ rtsis bsgyur nas nyis bha e ru mi bsgyur pa'i phyir yin/ bha sa mang po nyid la ni e'o/zhes/ pas/ a me/ e yi yī mang po la'o/ /zhes/ pas/ a me ni/ /a sī ste/ a sī bhiX/ ༈ a das nge/ ṭi a/ da ma/ sma ṭa byin/ e la i/ sme/ ma las u/ mu/ku i las sme/ cha ru song / a mu cha/ a mu dhīX/ gong dang 'dra/ a sī khyuX bhiXdang 'dra'o/ ༈ a das nga si/ ṭi a/ da ma/ nga/ uta/ sma ṭa/ 'dra ba ring po/smu ta ma las u/ ku i las a mu shrī ta/ a mū sgyuX/ a sī khyuX ༈ a das —178—

ngas/ ṭi a/ da ma/ ngas su/ ma las u/ ku i la/ a mu lga a das os/ṭi a/ da ma/ os la'o zhes rtags mthar e/ da/ drangs/ ma las u/ a mu yoX/ a das/ u mu/ ṭi a/ da ma/ su ḍa/ u mu/ su ṭa/ u mu/ sa bha mang po nyid la ni e zhes pas/ mer e'i yī mang po la'o zhes pas/ a sī/ sa drangs/ku i la/ a sī khriX/ ༈a das ngi / ṭi a/ da ma/ ngi smin/ ma las u/ a tshus na/a das os/ ṭi a/ da ma/ os la e/ e a yu/ a mu yoX a dasasus/ ṭi a/ da ma/ sa bha mang po/ a me/ e yi sī/ a sī/ ku i la/ a mū khu ༈a das kyi 'gyur ba gzhan sgrub pa la/swa mā rkye a dasaXkaXbyā di rwa mtshungs pa la a das kyi ka ste si sogs bzhin no/ /rgya skad swā mā na zhes pa spyi'am mtshungs pa zhes pho mo ma ning gi dbye ba med pa'i spyi ming ste/ ga ge zhig che ge zhig gcig de zhes pa lta bu'i thun mong gi don gyi a das la/ ka rkyen du 'byung ste/ de yang si sogs bya ba 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ a das ka/ ṭi a/ da ma/ ma'i u ste/ a mu ru bsgyur thub nas/ka nyid rtags mthar sbyar te rang gnas su gnas pas/ a mu ka ste che ge mo zhes pa sgrub po/ /de ni sa spru sogs kyi khyad par gro sogs yin yang / rtags mthar gnas pa'i rkyen gyi dbang gis/ rnam dbye'i bya ba phal cher a thung mtha' can/ sa spru lugs ci rigs su sbyor te/ a mu ka si/ a mu kaX/ a mu ka au/a mu ko a mu ka dzas/ dzas yī/ a mu ke ༈ a mu ka da/ a mu kaX a mu ka.au/ a ma ko a mu ka shas/ a mu kwan/ ༈a mu ka ṭā/ a mu ke na/ a mu kasgyu mu/ bha la uskyu zhes pas/ a mu kā bhāX/ a mu ka dhis/ lha'i bha a'o/ /zhes—179—

pas/ a mu kaiX/ ༈a mu ka te/ sma ṭa/ a mu ka sme/ a mu kā bhāX/ sa bha mang po nyid la ni e zhes pas/ a mu ke khyuX/ ༈a mu ka nga si/ gi yi/ ru bsgyur/ sma ṭa/a mu ka smutra/ a mu kā bhāX/ a mu ke khyoX/ ༈a mu ka da/ gya ru se(nga / a mu ka phya/ a mu ka os/ ri la'o zhes rtags mtha' e ru song / da/ a mu ka yoX/ a mu ka u mu/ sdoskyu/ sa bha mang po nyid la e/ a mu ke ku i la las ṣa sa/ a mu ki lgaX ༈a mu ka ngi / smin/ a mu ka smin/ a mu ka ri/ a mu ka yoX/ a mu ka su pu/ sa bha mang po nyid kyis ke ku i la sogs/ su khu ru song /a mu ke sgyu zhes pa'o/ /de dag gis ha sa mtha' can pho rtags rnams rdzogs so/༈ /de nas ha sa'i mtha' can bud med kyi rtags rnams bshad par bya ste/ de la dang por mo rtags ha mtha' can ni/ u pa na hre'i sgra la/ u pan sga se bzhagan ho dhaX/ na hu yi dha 'o/ /na ha yi mtha' can gyi pha rol ra sa'i rkyen byung ba dang / rang nyid tshig mtha' ra gyur ba la mtha'i ha yig dha yig tu 'gyur ro/ /ra sa pha rol ni 'og tu bha ldan dang sus yin la/ 'dir ni tshig mtha'o/ /de yang si phyis/ tshig mthar song / ha dha ru bsgyur/ gnas med pa zhes pas/ dza ba'i dbang du byas nas/ dha dra rung ma/ tsa pa'i dbang du byas na/ dha dra dang / dra tra ru 'gro /u pa na tra/ u pa na dra/ ༈au sogs dbyangs rkyen la/dbyangs med pha rol sbyor ba kho na yin la/ ༈bha ldan la/ na gye'i dha 'o zhes pas hu dha/ dzha bha las dza bzhes pas/ dha dra ru song / drangs/ ༈su pub la de dang 'dra —180—

ba las kha sa la/ tsa ba la sogs/ dā tra ru bsgyur ba yin no/ ༈u pa na ho/ u pa na rnyaX/ ༈he u pa na tra/ he u pa na dra/ he u pa na ho/ he u pa na rnyaX/ ༈u pa na haX/ u pa na ho/ u pa na haX/ ༈u pa na hā/ u pa na geX/ u pa na rnyiX/ ༈ u pa na he/ u pa na smyoX/ u pa na smoX/ ༈u pa na haX u pa na stuX/ u pa na : ༷༷/ ༈u pa na haX/ a pa na hoX/ u pa na hāX/ ༈u pa na hi/ u pa na hoX/ u pa na phyi/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ba yig mtha' can la/ di ba kyi sgra ste/di ba au so/ di ba yi au si la'o/ /di ba kyi si la e'o byas na go bde/di ba'i sgra la/ si byin pas/ ba yig au sa ā de sha bya'o/ /di ba si/ di ba yi au si la'o/ /zhes pas ba au ru song / di ri/ di'i i phral/ i yu ru bsgyur/dra yu au la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ droX/ di ba la au sogs/ di bo/ di baX/ ༈he droX/ he di bo/ he di baX/ ༈di ba ra/bā mi/ da la ā yang na'o/ /di ba la da pha rol tu byung na ba ni ā ri 'gyur te/ yang na zhes pas/ yang na ba a ru mi 'gyur ri la sbyor zhes pa ste/di a/ da/ i yu/ da yu a ri/'dra ba la ring por drangs pas phywaX/ yang na di baX/ zhes pa'o/ /di bo/ di baX/ ༈di bā/u ra se/ ra sa la u'o/ ra sa'i rkyen pha rol tu byung na/ mo rtags ba mtha'i ba u yig tu bsgyur ba ste/ sa bha can ni ra sa yin no/ di ba sgyu mu/ ba u/i yu/ dra yu u/ drangs/ byu bhāX/ rlu bhiX/ tai be/ byu bhāX/ byu khyuX/ tai baX/ byu bhāX/byu khyuX/ ༈di baX/ di boX/ di bāX/ ༈di bi/ di boX/ sus la bha ldan dang 'dra ba las/ ku i la sogs/ rlu khu ༈ re pha'i mtha' can la/ grangs brjod pa mo —181—

rtags tri sgra dang / mo rtags tsa yis gyi sgra ste/ 'di la'ang mang tshig kho na te/tri tsa tu roXs+t+ri yāX ti mṛ tsa ta hṝ ba tra/ tri tsa tus dag gi bud med la ti mṛ tsa ta hṝ 'dra'o/ /mo rtags kyi tri sgra dang tsa tus gyi sgra la/ dzas sogs rkyen bdun po gang byung yang / tri ni/ ti sri mo gsum dang / tsa tu ru mo bzhi ni tsa ta mṛ ru bsgyur dgos la/ tsa ta sri thung du yin mod / hṝ 'dra ba zhes pa'i grwa smos bas/grwa ring po dang 'dra ba'i don te/ de gnyis dngos su ṛ thung yin yang / grwa ring po dang 'dra bas/ sa ༷ dag gi ri/ /zhes pa'i mdo 'jug pa med pa'o/ /de'i go don ni/ ṛ de ri du byed dgos pa 'dra cig 'dug kyang / mi byed par ṛ de ru ru bsgyur ba'o/ /tri dzas/ tsa tu ru dzas/ tri ti mṛ dang / tsa tu ru/ tsa ta mṛ ru bsgyur/ ti mṛ a sra/ tsa ta mṛ as/ zhes 'byung / ṛ yig gis a mthong / ru ru song / drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ ti sraX/ tsa ta sraX/ ༈/de kho na bzhin du shas la 'ang ste/ ti sraX/ tsa ta sraX/ ༈bha ldan la ti mṛ dang / tsa ta mṛ ru bsgyur ba las gzhan rnam 'gyur med/ ti mṛ bhiX/ tsa ta mṛ bhiX/ ༈ti mṛ khyuX/ tsa ta mṛ khyuX/ zhes bzhi pa dang / ti mṛ khyuX/ tsa ta mṛ khyuX/ lnga pa'o/ ༈u mu gyi skabs 'dir sdeb sbyor las/ rtags mtha' ring po dang thung ngu gdam ka yin la/ sgra gzhud rang lugs la ring po'o/ /tri u mu/ tsa tu ru/ u mu/ nus ste/ bsgyur/ ti mṛ na uskyu/tsa ta mṛ na um/ ring por byed na/ nā mu la'o/ zhes pas/ ti mṛ na u mu/ tsa ta mṛ na zhwa mu/ drangs/ ṣa ra ṛ sogs/ ti shrī ṇaX/ tsa ta hṝ ṇaX/ ti hṝ ṇaX/ tsa ta mṛ ṇaX/༈su pu la/ ti mṛ dang / tsa ta mṛ ru bsgyur/ ku i la sogs/ ti mṛ khya tsa ta mṛ khusna/ rnga//—182—

༈ru mtha' can gi ru gyi sgra la/ tsho ha se/ i u dag ra ba la dang ha sa la'o/ /i dang / u ni/ i kā ra dang / u kā ra tshig sdud kyis bsdus pa yin pas/ i thung kho na dang u thung kho na yin par bshad do/ re pha'i byings yin pa'i ming la mtha'i sngon ma i ta dang utu gang rung yod pa la si byin/ i ta/ yī dang / uta u ru 'gyur te/ u yig 'og tu 'byung / 'di i ste/ gi ru si/ gi de gī ru song / si phyis/ ru rnam bcad/ gīX/ ༈he gīX/ ༈lhag ma au sogs pha rol du drangs ba kho nas chog pa las bha ldan la bha ldan la bha nyis 'gyur du 'dod do/gi ro/ gi raX/ ༈gi raX/ gi ro/ gi raX/ ༈ gi rā/ gī khyuXbhā/ gyi sti bhaX/ ༈gi re/ bhāX khyuX/ ༈gi raX/ dhīX khyuX/ ༈gi raX/ gi ro/ gi rāX/ ༈gi ri/ gi roX/ chu/ ༈ de kho na dang 'dra bar/ pu ru dha ru sogs kyang ste/ pūX/ pu ro sogs/ pu rbaXt+yā/ glu cho sogs so/ ༈siX/ rmyu ro/ dha rgyuX/dha rlu/ ༈dha'i mtha' can/ sa mi dha yam shing zhi sgra la/ /sa mi dha si/ si dbyi༄/ tshig mtha' la dha da ru song / gnas med sogs yang na tra'o/ /sa mid/ sa mi ta/ ༈he sa mid/ he sa mi ta/ ༈bha ldan la/ dha dra/ swas la dra yang tra ru 'gro /dbyangs rnams la pha rol du drangs/ sa mi dho/ sa mi dhaX/ ༈he sa mi dho/ he sa mi dhaX/ ༈si mi dhaX/ sa ma dho/ sa mi dhaX/ ༈sa mi dh+wa/ si mi rgyuX/ si mi dhiX/ sa mi khyu/ dhīX khyuX/ ༈sa ma dhaX/ bhāX khyuX/ ༈sa ma dhaX/ sa ma dhoX/sa mi dh+waX/ ༈sa mi dhi/ si mi dhoX/ sa phyi/ ༈ bha mtha' ni/ ka ku bha yul phyogs lta bu ste/ ka ku bha si/ si phyis/ gnas med sogs/ bha ni ba ru 'gyur ba'am yang na pu ru song / ka ku ba/ ka ku pu/ ༈hre ka ku ba/ he ka ku da zhes so/ ༈ /bha ldan la dzha pa sogs kyis ba dang / su pra la kha sa la sogs kyis pra ru 'gro //—183

༈dbyangs la pha rol tu 'dren pa kho na'o/ ka ku bho/ ka ku bhaX/ ka ku bhāX/ ka ku bho/ ka ku bhaX/ ka ku bhā/ ka ku khyuX/ ka ku dzoX/ ༈ka ku bhe/ dz+nyāX khyuX/ ༈ka ku bhaX/bhāX khyuX/ ༈ka ku bhaX/ ka ku bhoX/ ka ku bhāX/ ka ki bhi/ ka ku bhoX/ ka ṭa khyu// zhes/ pa'o/ ༈da yig mtha' las trad sogs rnams so/ /de rnams la kyid sogs la mtha'i ṭi phyi ba yin kyang / dbyangs mi dbyi ste/ gsal byed kho na dbyi'o/ /yang de'i dbyangs mtha' rten pa a ru yod pa dang / bud med la a la u pra'o/ /zhes pas/ mo rtags skabs 'dir tu du sogs la rtags kyi a yig la zhwab kyi rkyen ster/ u pu kyi pra rjes 'brel dang / si phyi pa'i don no/ /rtags kyi a dang u pra'i ā mtshungs 'dra ring po bya/ gzhan mo rtags sa rgyu'i bya ba dang phal cher mtshungs/ngi ta la sogs pa 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ gaṅgā dang yang 'dra'o/ /de yang / kyi du si/ zhi'i dra phyis/ u pu byin pra phyis/ 'dra ba ring po/ ta'i sa'o/ /zhes pas/ t+yā yi tra sa ru bsgyur/ si dbyi/ sgyu/ tud/ au/ dra dbyi/ ā da/ 'dra ring / au sī/a i la e/ drangs/ rkye/ kyi dra dzas/ dra phyi/ u pra/ ring po/ dzas kyi a 'dra ba/rnam bcad/ t+yāX/ ༈tud ri/ dra phyi/ /u pra/ ri gyi a 'dra ba'i/ t+yāX/ au gong bzhin/ rkye/ shas dzas bzhin/ t+yāX/ ༈rtsod ṭu/ dra dbyi/ u pra/ ṭā os dag la e/ e a spra/ drangs/ t+ya yā/ kyid bha mu/ da phyis/ u pu/ t+yā bhāX/ de dang 'dra bar/t+yā bhiX/ ༈tud nge / dra phyi/ u pra/ ngi ta rnams kyi ya tre'o/ /ya ṭā las a tra yang ngo / /zhes pas so/ t+yā kyi srog ā ring po a tra du song zhing / ya tre kyi gong du sus ā ga ma ster/ tu sa yu e/ zhes so/ /ya'i a i/ ཿkhye/ t+yā bhāX/ t+yā khyuX/ ༈kyid nga si/ dra phyis/ u pra/ ya ṭā/ yas la e tra yang ngo / /zhes pas/ ba smra rtags —184—

mtha' ni sngar ring po yin pa thung ngur song / t+ya sa ya us/ drangs/ rnam bcad/tu snyaX/ t+yā bhāX/ t+yā khyuX/ ༈rtun ngas/ ngas su'o mi 'jug kyang / nga dang 'dra/ tu sgyuX/ kyid os/ dra phyis/ u pra/ 'dra ba/ ṭā os dag gi e/ e a yu/ tu yu da/ drangs/ tu yoX/ tud u mu/ dra dbyi/ u pra/ yang na thog mar sus byin/de'i rjes su u pra/ khyus u mu/ drangs/ t+yā sāX/ ༈skrud ngi / dra phyis/ u pra/ ngi u mu du 'gro /t+yā u mu/ zhes so/ ya ṭa/ sus/ mtha' thung / t+ya su yu u mu/drangs/ kyi sgyuX/ os gong dang 'dra/ tu yoX/ rtu ni sus/ dra dbyi/ u pra/ t+yā su/༈des mtshon te/ tsā dang / yad dang / e to sogs kyi mo rtags kyang cho ga 'di kho nas sgrub ste/ lus 'gyur la the tshom mi 'jug pa'i phyir mgo smos na/tad si/ dra us/ ta yi sa'o/ /zhes pas/ ta sa ru bsgyur/ si phyis/ swā/ zhesapa grub/ au yī ru bsgyur bas/ te/ de bzhin du/ tāX/ ༈tāX/ te/ tāX/ ༈ṭā os dag la e'o/ ta yā/ tā bhāX/ tā bhiX/ ༈tad de/ ngi ta rnams kyi ya ṭa'o/ /ya ṭa la a tra yang ngo / /zhes pas nga ldan la ya ṭa/ sdoskyu/ thung ngu rnams te/ ta myi/ tā bhāX/tā khyuX/ ༈de dran par byas te/ ta sgyuX/ tā bhāX/ tā khyuX/ ༈ngas nga 'dra/ ta byāX/ṭā os dag pa e/ ta yoX/ su ṭa byin/ tā swāX/ (pe zhwa mu/ ya ṭa/ su ṭa/ tu byāX/drug pa'i gnyis pa dran/ ta yoX/ tā su/ zhes so/ ༈ra la ta yig med pas si la sa ru 'gro rgyu med/ gzhan 'dra/ yā/ ye/ yāX/ ༈yāX/ ye/ yāX/ ༈ya yā/ yā bhāX/yā bhiX/ ༈ya phye/ yā bhāX/ yā khyoX/ ༈ya sgyuX/ yā bhāX/ yā khyuX/ ༈ya sgyuX/ ya 61༷༷/ yā swāX/ ༈ya phywaX/ ya yoX/ yā su/ zhes pa'o/ ༈e tad la si'i skabs su/ dra phyis/ta sa ru song / ku i la sogs/ nā mi e las sa yig ṣa yig tu 'gro—185—

gzhan 'dra ste/ e khyi/ e te/ e tāX/ ༈e tāX/ e te/ e tāX/ ༈e ta yā/ e tā bhāX/ e tā bhiX/ ༈e ta phyi/ e tā bhāX/ e tā khyuX/ ༈e ta phywaX/ e tā bhāX/ e tā khyuX/ ༈e ta sgyuX/ e ta yoX/ e tā swāX/ ༈e ta sgyuX/ e ta yoX/ e tā su/ ༈de bzhin du ki mu gyi sgra la/ pha rol du rnam dbye nyer gcig po gang byung yang / ṭi a ru bsgyur bas ka 'ba' zhig tu song / gzhan tud sogs kyi mo rtags yin pas 'dra/ kā ke kāX/ ༈kwaX ke kāX/ ༈ka yā/ kā bhāX/ kā bhiX/ ༈ka spyi/ kā bhāX/ kā khyuX/༈ka phywaX/ kā bhāX/ kā khyuX/ ka byā/ ka yoX/ kā swāX/ ༈ka byāX/ ka yoX/ kā su/ zhes/so/ ༈da ni mo rtags i dmu gyi sgra'i dbang du byas nas/ thun mong ba rnams bo dang 'dra/i yaX s+t+ri yāX/ bud med la i da mo/ /i dmu si/ i brjod don/ mo rtags la/ i dmu sa dang bcas pa i da du bsgyur ro/ /zhib mor na/ ṭi a dang / dra ma ru song / u pra byin/ mā ring po/ i mus dang bcas pa i da mo/de bzhin du/ 'og ma thams cad la yang / ṭi a/ i dmu/ i da ru song / da'i ma'o zhes da ma ru song / u pra byin/ mā ring por song bas/ i mā ru bsgyur zin pa gzhir bzhag byas nas sgrub dgos na/ au sogs la sngar/ i mo la sogs par 'gro ba bzhin mi byed par/ bshad ma thag pa'i tu du sogs mo rtags bzhin byas pas/ i me/ i māX/ ༈i māX/ i me/ 6/ māX/ zhes rbe(/ ༈6/ mā ṭā/ i mā ṭā os la a na zhes pas/ i mā a na du song ṭā os dag la e zhes pa'ang 'jug a ne ā byung / e a ya/ drangs/ a na yā/ pho rtags a ne na dang mi 'dra bar rtags mtha' e dang e a yar byed pa'o/ ༈bha sa la a'o zhes i —186—

ma ni a ru bsgyur/ u pra byin/ ā 'di bha ldan dang sus kyi skabs thams cad la mdos zin/ gzhan la min yang 'di man chad thams cad la sbyor dgos pa nyid du dran par bya'o/ /ā bhāX/ ā bhiX/ ༈ya ṭa/ bskyu/ thung ngu / a myi/ ā bhāX/ ā khyuX/ ༈a byāX/ ā bhāX/ ā khyoX/ ༈a byāX/ a na ru song / a e ra mi song / e a yu/ drangs/ a na yoX/ sdoskyu/ a swāX/ lte nge u mu/ da/ sdoskyu/ thung ga a sgyuX/a na yoX/ ā su/ ༈mo rtags tsu mtha' las/ twa sngo pags pa 'i sgra la/ twa tsu si/tsa re ku'o zhes pas tsu kra ru song / gnas med pa la yang na'o/ /zhes/ kra nyid du gnas pa'am/ ga ru bsgyur/ si phyis/ twa / / twa ga/ twatsu/ au/ drangs/ twa tso/de gnyis kyis mtshon te/ bha sa si dang 'dra la/ dbyangs rkyen au dang 'dra ste/ twa tsu dzas/ twa tsaX/ ༈he twa kra/ he twa ga he twa tso/ he twa tsaX/ ༈twa tsaX/ twa tso/ twa tsaX/༈/twa tsā/ tsu kra sa dzha bha las dza ba sogs/ twa gaXbhā/ raX/ ༈twa tse/ twagaXbhā/twagaXbhāX/ twa tsaX/ twagaXbhā/ twa ga bh+yaX/ twa tsaX/ twa tsoX/ twa tsāX/ ༈twa tsi/ twa tsoX/ kra ru bsgyur/ ku i la sogs/ khu drangs/ kra ṣa 'dus pa k+ṣa/ twa ku/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ de bzhin du/ ṛ rig byed kyi tshig rkang la sogs par 'gyur ba dang / bā tsu/ bāka la sogs pa'i 'gyur ba thams cad twa tsu dang 'dra ste de sogs mang ngo/'o// ༈pu yig mtha' can/ da chu'i ming lta bu ste/ 'on kyang 'di la mang chig kho na 'jug go ri dzas/ na sa / da ma had kyi dhi min pa la ring po ste zhes pas da kyi a ring po ste ā ru bsgyur/ ri drangs/ sa rnams bcad/ ā paX/ ༈da shas/ drangs/ rnam bcad/a ba bhi da pāX/ ri rnams kyi bha la da'o/ /da lhis bzhag a da —187—
