rnams zhes ri la sogs pa mang po'i don te/ pha rol bha ldan la/ rtags mtha'i pu dbyangs med dra ru 'gyur te/ ad bhiX/ drangs/ a rnyiX/ ༈a:༷༷/༈a sgruX/ da/ u mu/ a pāX/ ༈da sdo/pra/ a sdi//༈ sha yig mtha' la/ di sha'i rtags ni/ di shā si/ di shāX kaX/di shra rnams kyi ka'o/ /rnams kyi zhes pas/ dro shra lta ba/ spra sh-i reg pa/ mṛ sha na rdzu la sogs mang po zhig di sha phyogs dang bya ba gcig pa'i don no/ /'di rnams la pha rol du ra sa so sor bsdu ba'i rkyen bha sa byung ba dang / tshig mthar / gyur pa si phyis rjes lta bu la/ rtags mtha'i sha yig kra ru bsgyur ba ste/ 'dir si phyis/ sha ka ru song / di kra/ yang na/ gnas med sogs/ kra ga ru bsgyur te/ digadabyangs rkyen rnams la drangs pa kho nas chog di sho/ di shaX di shaX/ di sho/ di shaX༈di shā/ di sha sgyu mu/ kra dzha bha la sogs kyis ga/ digaXbhā/ di ga bh+yaX/༈di she/ digaXbhā/ di ga bh+yaX/ ༈di shaX di raXyā/ di lha yaX/ ༈di shaX/ di shoXdi shāX/ di shi/ di shoX/ sub la shra kra dang su sgyu drangs pas khri/ di khri/ ༈he di kra/he di gra/ /he di sho/ he di shaX/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ ṣa yig mtha' ni/ twa ṣa lta bu mdzes pa bkod pa legs pa lta bu'o ste/ tidzi si/ ṣa'i ḍa 'o/ ṣa yig ḍa ru song / gnas med sogs/ ḍa ṭa ru byas kyang rung / tin/ tig/ tī lko ti khaX/ ༈zhigaX tīlkoti khaX/ ༈tī khyi/ bha sa la ṣa ḍa ru song / bha la drangs/ stu ḍaXbhā/ tir+bheX/ /༈tī ṣe/ tī ḍaXbhā/ tī ḍa bh+yaX/ ༈zhi yaX tī ḍaXbhā/ tī ḍa bh+yaX/ ༈tiṣ+ṭhaX/ ༈tī ṣeX/ stu lgaX (rtsedizhi dzāX / hi tha sus/ kha sa la sogs ḍa ṭa ru bsgyur/ rgya/ ༈sa yig mtha' ā shing la/ ā shi dzi si/ do ṣa rnams kyi ra'o/ zhes pas/ ṣa ru ru song / si phyis/ sa dzu —188—

ṣa'i dang / ā shi ṣa'i ra sa la ring po ste tshig mtha' la yang ngo / /zhes pas/ shī ste ring por gyur/ ru rnam bcad/ ā shīX dbyangs rkyen rnams la ṣa yig phar drangs/ ā shi lko ā shi khaX/ ༈he ā shiX/ he ā shi skyo he ā sha khaX/ ༈ā shi lgaX.ā shi lko ā shi khaX/ ༈ ā shi lga bha ldan la do ṣa rnams kyi ra'o zhes pas/ ṣa ra sa ra sa la ring po zhes pas/ shī ring po/ ā shi rgyuX/ ā shi stuX/ ༈ā shi ṣe ā shi rgyuX/ ā shī khyuX/ ༈ ā shi khaX/ ā shī khriX/ ā shī khyuX/ ༈ yī shi khaX/ ā shi taX.ā shi lgaX ༈ ā shi ski ā shi ṣeX/ ṣa ra ṛ la sogs/ ā shi chu/ ༈yang na bha ldan la dzi'i ḍa 'o/ /zhes ṣa yig ḍa yig tu/ su pra la ḍa ṭa ru bsgyur ba ste 'di sa dzu sa dang gcig par bshad par ltar na'o/༈ da ni me rtags su 'gyur pa'i a das la/ a das yi/ si la sa'o zhes pas/ da sa ru song / a sas/ si yi au/ zhes pas/ si'i i phyis sa au ru bsgyur/ de ti tra kyi ming can yin pas/ ni tra la ṭi dbyi bas/ sa gong ma'i dbyangs dang / sa 'og ma dbyangs med sbrags pa phyis/ as/ au byung as pha rol au la drangs/ a so/ zhes pa grub ste pho rtags dang 'dra'o/ au man chad kun la/ kyid sogs la ṭi a ru bsgyur/ a da/ da'i ma'o zhes pas/ a mu/bud med la a la u pra zhes pas/ u pu/ 'dra ring / a mā/ zhes pa dang por grub par bya/ kun la a mā kho na bzhag ma las u dag go zhes pa'ang kun la 'byung ba blo la bzhag a mā au/ o au la o'o/ a mo/ ma la ā ring po/a mū/ a mā dzas/ 'dra ba ring por song zin/ ma la ྅/ a mūX/ ༈a mā ri 'dra ba las a phyis/ ma las mū/ a mū/ au la gong bzhin/ a mū/ shas kyang 189—

ngas dang 'dra/ a mūX/ yang na da shas kyi a dbyi'o gzhan 'dra/ ༈a mā khyu/ khyu os dag la e/ a me/ ā e a yu/ ma las u thung / a mu yā/ a mā khyu mu/ma las mū ring/ a mū bhāX/ a mū bhiX/ ༈a mā nge / ngi ta la ya ṭa/ zhes pas/ya ṭa/ ya ṭa las kyang ngo / /zhes pas/ sus te ya ṭa kyi gong du byin zhing / mā ni thung ngu ma ru song ngo / /drangs/ am sa ya e/ zhes byung / e i la i'o/ zhes pas/ yi/ drangs/ myi/ ma las u thung / ku e la las sa lga u mu thi ngas dang / ngi la yang de'i skabs 'di dran par bya'o/ /a mū bhāX/ a mū khyuX/ ༈a mā/nga si/ ya ṭa/ su ṭa/ thung phywa i'i tshab la mtshungs pa ring po/ drangs/ ma las u/ku i la/ a mu khyuX/ a mū bhāX/ a mū khyuX/ ༈a mā ngas/ yas/ sdoskyu/ thung sa'adra ba'i/ ma las u thung / ku i/ a mu gyiX/ a mā os/ ṭā os dag la er/ a me/ e a yu/ ma las u thung / a mu yoX/ a mā u mu/ sdoskyu/ a mus/ u mu/ zhes so/ /drangs/ ma las mū ring / ku i la/ a mū lgaX a mu snga /ngi u mu/ ya ṭa/ sus/ thung phywa a mu sa ya u mu/ ya u mu/ 'dra ba'i/ drangs/ma las u/ ku i la/ a mu ṣ+kaX/ a mā os/ gong bzhin/ a mu yoX/ a mā su pra/ ma las/ mū ring / ku i la/ a mū khu /zhes so/ de ltar na ha sa'i mtha' las mo rtags rdzogs so/ /༈ de nas gsal byed mtha' can ma ning gi rtags bshad de/ de la ra yig mtha' can gyi sgra las/ bā ru si/ ma ning la si no 'jig sa ru dag gi rnam bod/ bāX/ bā ru au/ au yī drangs/ bā rī/ bā ru dzas/ dzas shi/ shra song / drangs/ bā ri/ ༈ bā ru ri ma ning la si da phyi/ ru rnam bcad/ bāX/—190—

au gong dang 'dra/ bā rī/ shas kyang dzas dang 'dra / bā ri/ 'di ni ru yig mtha' ma can te/ ra ni ya ma so sor bsdud pa'i yi ge yin pas/ /ya ma la shus mi thob po/ ༈ bā ru ṭā/ drangs/ bā rā/ bā ru sgyu mu/ ru phyis/ bā bhāX/ bā bhiX/ ༈de dag gis mtsho ni te/ bā re/ bā dhīX/ bā khyuX/ ༈bā raX bā bhāX/ bā khyuX/ ༈bā raXbā roX bā rāX/ ༈bā ri/ bā roX kwa tha/ ༈tsa tus gyi rtags la yang mang tshig kho na ste/ tsa yis dzas shi/ tsa tus gyi shi la um/ mu phyis/ tsa tur uru i zhes pa byung / u ba'o/ ā la drangs/ tsa tā ru/ i la drangs/ tsa tā ri/ ༈bod pa'ang 'di dang 'dra ste/ he tsa tā ri/ shas kyang dzas dang 'dra/ tsa tā riX༈ bha ldan la ru drangs/ tsa shur+bheX tsa tu rgyuX tsa tu rgyuX tsa shun um nus na gnyis su bya drangs/ ṣa ra ro las na ṇa nyis rtseg ru drangs/ tsa snyaXsnri/ ༈tsa tu ru su pra/ ku i la tsa tu chu/ de yan chad dmigs gsal med pa la bod pa thams cad rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra'o/ /༈ na mtha' ahan gyi sgra la/ ahan saX/ a han gyi sa'o/ahan gyi pha rol du si ri bha sa gang 'byung na yang / na yig sa yig tu 'gyur ro/ ༈a han si/ si phyis/ han gyi na sa ru song de rnam bcad ahaX/ ahan au au yī e de dag la yang na'o/ /zhes pa las skabs 'dir yī yin te/ au yī ru bsgyur ba de'o/ /de la u pa dha'i dbyangs dbyi ba dang mi dbye ba gdam ka ste/ phyis a tan yī 'dir rab sbyor mi dbyi ste/ pha rol dbyangs yin pas hu na gnyis ka yī la drangs a snri/ u pa dh+wa ma phyis na na kho na drangs a ha ni/ a han dzas shi/ na yi u pa dha 'o zhes pas hā ring po a hā ni/ ༈de bzhin du/ a han ri si/ a mu —191—

'jig a ha na gyi sa'o/ /zhes pas mtha'i na sa ru de rnam bcad/ a haX.au la gong bzhin/ au yī dang / u pa bhā dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba'i bye brag gis/asnri/ a ha nī/ shas kyang dzas dang 'dra/ a hā ni/ ༈a han khyu/ u ngo dh+wa phyisa.a l+lī/ dbyangs rkyen kun des 'gre/ a ha na lham/ a han gyi sa'o/ /na sa ru sa rnam bcad a dang ha ba'i bar du rnam bcad u / a u la o/ a ho bhāX/ bha ldan thams cad de dang 'dra/ a ho bhiX༈a han nge a ha ne/ a ho bhāX/ a ho khyoX༈a han nga si a snaX/ a ho bhāX/ a ho khyoX a han ngas/ a t+naX/ a ha na os a snoX/ ahan/ um/ a snaX/ ༈sī ngi dag la yang na'o/ zhes pa las 'dir ni ste/ u pa bhā phyi ba dang mi phyi ba'i dbye bas/ a nyu/ a ha ni zhes pa'o/ /a ha na/os/ a snoX a nyon su pa/ a tshin gyi sa'o/ /na sa/ drangs/ a ha smu/zhes pa'o/ ༈ na lo paX na dbyi'o/ ma ning gi rtags brarmi na la sogs pa la ra sa pha rol dang tshig mtha' la/ na dbyangs med dbyi ste/ brarmi na si si phyis/tshig mthar song bas na phyis/ brarmi/ brarmi na au au yī drangs/ ṣa ra ṛ las na ṇa/brarmi ṇi/ brad+ma na dzas shi na yi u pa dha 'o/ /mā ring po/ bra grwa ṇi/ ༈sgrub tshul de gsum kho na dang 'dra bar/ ri au shas la/ brad+maX/ brad+ma ṇi/ bra grwa ṇi zhes so/ /༈'dir bod pa la si'i skabs su yang na/ na mi dbyi ste/ he brarmi na/ he bra smi/ he brarmi ṇi/ he bra grwa ṇi/ zhes te phyi ma gnyis dang po'i phyi ma gnyis dang 'dra'o/ /༈de bzhin du dbyangs la drangs/ bha la na dbyi/ brad+ma ṇa/ brarmi sgyuX/ brad+ma bhiX/ ༈bra h+ma ṇi/ brarmi bhāX/ brarmi khyoX/ ༈brad+ma ṇaX brarmi bhāX/ brarmi khyoX brad+ma —192—

ṇaX brad+ma khoX brarmi ṇaX/ ༈brad+ma ṇi/ brad+ma khoX brarmi khu ༈brad+ma na sogs pa ni/ tsa rman pags pu/ ka rngan las/ wa rngan go cha'am gsor/ sha rngan ngo tsha'am skyid ba la sogs pa ste/ cho ga 'di kho na'o/༈ nān+ta da da rta smon si ngi sho bī lo pa/ na mtha' a ta ngi shi dag gi yang na dbyi ba sdeb sbyor la'o/ /'di ni kha cig 'grel par mdo gzhan gyi lung drangs pa mdo 'dir bcug pa yin zer/ kha gcig dbyangs can nyid kyi mdo yin yang zer ro/ /gzhan las kyang/ sdeb sbyor las ni ā ga ma dang ā ga ma ma yin pa dag gi dbyi ba dang mi dbyi bgo zhes bshad pas/ ma ning na mtha' dang a thung mtha' la rig byed dang de'i yan lag sdeb sbyor las ngi dang dzas shas kyi shi la yang na zhes na dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba gdam nga'i don/ ā ga ma'i na dbyi ba dang /rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i na mi dbyi ba'o/ de yang / pa ra me byo man sa rbu dh+wa tā ni/ zhes pa lta bu ste/ pa ra me byo man ngi/ ngi phyis/ tshig mtha'i na ni mi dbyi/༄a han/ brarmi na sogs la bshad pa bzhin/ byo ma ni zhes/ na ngi la 'dren pa sgra'i lugs yin yang / rig byed skabs su/ 'di ā ga ma lta bu gsar byung min pas gdod ma'i yi ge de 'dra brjod pa bde na mi dbyi'o/ /sarba dzas shi nu mu rtags mtha' ring po/ bha ta/ dzas/ shi/ nus/ rtags mtha' ring / bhā tun/ i drangs/bhā tā ni/ de nas rig byed lugs la shi dbyi bas/ sarba'i rnam ༄dbye dbyi ba na shi kho na phyi ba ma yin par na yang dbyi ste/ 'di ā ga ma yin pas brjod pa bde na dbyi ba skabs su bab bo/ na dbyi yang sarba'i ring po mi dbyi ste/ de na'i stobs las byung yang / rtags mtha' kho na'i 'gyur ba yin gyi/ pha rol gyi yi ge la mi —193—

the bas so/ zhes pa rig byed lugs la skabs 'di'i don yin gyi/ gnas skabs thams cad du nges pa ni ma yin no/ /sgra rig kho na'i lugs la/ sa rgyu ni bhā tā ni/ zhes ba kho na'o zer/ ༈khyad sogs la si dang ri dbyi ste/ de gnyis le ṭi da sgyur ba med/ rnam dbye gsum pa phan chad sa spru'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /kyid si/ si 'jig gnas med sogs kyi/ dra yig ta ru bsgyur ba'am dra yig rang la 'jog pa gdam nga yin/ tu tu/ kyid/ rtsod/ au au yī/ ṭi a/ t+ya yī/ a i la e kyi/ kyid dzas/ shi/ ṭi a/ num/ na'i u pa bhā sogs kyis ring po/ drangs/ t+yā ni/ ༈tud da si a mu phyis/ gnas med tud tu tra/ tud au/ ṭi a/ sī bye/ kyid shas/ ṭi a/ shi nus ring po/ t+yā ni/ ༈de bzhin du/ kyid kyi du bsgyur ba thams cad la sngon du 'gro bas/ ṭā i na/ bye na/ t+yā bhāX/ tseX/ yo spro/grwa khyuX/ skye khyuX/ ༈t+ya sma ta/ t+yā bhāX/ khye khyuX/ ༈t+ya su/ phya yoX t+ya lgaX ༈t+ya smin/ t+ya yoX stukhu ༈cho ga de kho na to la'ang sbyar bas/ tsā/ ta tā te/ tā ni/ lan gnyis/ ༈te na/ tā bhāX/ taiX/ ༈ta smi/ tā khyuX/ te khyoX/ ta shā tra / tā khyuX/ te khyuX/ta phya/ ta yoX te 'aX ༈te sten/ ta yoX te khu ༈de bzhin du yad la'ang ste/yad ya ta ye/ yā ni/ lan gnyis// ༈ye na/ yā bhāX/ yiX/ ༈ya smi/ yā bhāX/ ye khyuX/༈ya smutra/ yā bhāX/ ye khyuX/ ༈ya phya/ ya yoX yi lgaX ༈ya smin/ ya yoX ye khu ༈de dang 'dra bar/ e tad la e tad e ta ta/ e te/ e tā ni lan gnyis/ ༈e te na/ e tā dhīX/ e taiX/ ༈e ta smi/ e tā ra/ e te khyuX/༈e ta sna skrun/ e tā khyuX/e te khyuX/ e ta su/ e ta yoX e te lgaX ༈e ta smin/ e ta yoX e te khu༈ki mu yang 'dra ste/ ki mu la si dang da phyi/ ska kho na yin/ lhag ma kyi dra sogs —194—

la ṭi a byas na/ ka yang na ki mu nyid ka sa ā de sha byas kyang chog ste/ ka ru bsgyur pa kho na la rnam 'gyur byas kyang rung ngo / ska ke/ kā ni lan gnyis/ ༈ke na/ kā bhāX/ kaiX༈ kasmi/ kā khyuX/ ke khyuX༈ ka rgyu khri sna/ kā khyuX/ ke khyoX/ ༈ka su/ ka yoXke khriX/ ༈kasmin/ ka yoX ke khu zhes so/ ༈i dmu la yang / i dmu si dang da phyi g.yin med/ lhag ma rnams la/ ṭi a/ nga'i ma'o zhes i mar bsgyur zin pa kho na la bya ba bsgrub ste༈ i daX/ i me/ i mā ni/ ༈i daX/ i me/ i mā ni/ ༈ṭā os dag la a na'o/ ṭā i na/ a ne na/ bha sa la a'o/ zhes dang /bha la u'o/ zhes pas/ ā bhāX/ bha sa mang po nyid la e'o/ /e bhiX/ ༈'di man la bha sa min pa la yang a ru bsgyur te/ u smi/ ā bhāX/ e khyuX/ ༈a smutra/ ā bhāX/e khyoX/ ༈a su/ ṭā os dag la a na'o/ /a na yoX e lgaX ༈a smin/ a na yoX e khu gsum pa la sogs pa/ ṭā man chad kun du sngar i daX la bshad pa'i bya ba dang mtshungs pa'o/ /pra kyi sngo la/ pra tu tsa/ si phyis tsu'i ku'o/ /tsu ka ru song / gnas med sogs kyis yang na kra gra ru song / pra kyi ka 'am/snyo au/ sī/ pra kyi ri/ so sor phye/ a phyis/ yu i ru log i de ring po/ yī ru song / tsu drangs/ pra tī ā+o ཾ / pra.o/ dzas/ shi wo/ t+ya dang tsa'i bar du'o/ /pra ༅sngo i na rjes su nga ro/ pra t+yaX tsi/ ༈da dbyi au yī/ shi/ nus rnams kyi cho ga sbyar bas/ pra tu kra pra tī rti/ pra t+yaX tsi/ ༈de bzhin du ṭā sogs la/pra tī tsā/ ༈pra tī tse/ ༈pra tī tsaX/ ༈pra tī tsaX/ pra tī tsoX/ pra tī rtswa/ ༈pra tī tsi/ pra tī tsoX/ zhes pa rnams e'i skabs kyis rigs 'gre/ ༈bha ldan la tsu ka ru kra ga ru song / pra sgyugaXbhā la sogs pa dang / sus la pra kyi ku/ zhes te ṭā phan chad pho —195—

rtags dang 'dra'o/ ༈dza ga tra kyi sgra la/ dza gta si phyis/ dza gta/ dza ga dra/dza ga tī/ dza gaX ti/ ༈dza ga ta/ dza gdu/ dza ga tī/ dza gaX ti/ ༈ dza ga tā/ tra dra ru song / dza ga rgyuX/ dza ga rnyiX/ ༈ dza ga te/ dza ga rgyuX/ dza ngaX/ ༈dza ga ta/ dza deX dza ga sgruX/ ༈ dza ga taX dzag toX/ dza ga tāX/ ༈dza ga ti/ dza ga toX dzag h+phu/༈de bzhin du/ ma/ ha tra/ ma tad/ ma ha tī/ ma snya ti/ ༈ma ha ta/ ma ha dra/ ma ha tī/ma hāX ti/ 'dir hāX zhes ring po 'byung ba ni/ na sa da sogs kyis yin la/thams cad du shus ni rtags kyi dbyangs mthar yin gyi/ gsal byed mthar min sna// /ma ha tā/ ma rwaX/ ma ha rnyiX/ ༈ma ha te/ ma ha rgyuX/ ma ha 2 dz+nyāX/ ༈ma ha taXm ha smiX/ ma ha rgyuX ༈ ma ha taX ma ha rkesteX /ma ha tāX/ ༈ma ha ti/ ma ha toX ma ha klu/ zhes so/ ༈pra tu sngo la da ma gtogs dbyangs rkyen kun la/ pra ti ri so sor 'phral/ a phyis/ tī ring por byed pa khyad par dang / ma ha la dzas shas skabs/ na'i u pa bhā ring po'i khyad par yod/ gzhan gra tha/ dang dza ga tra dang ma ha tra rnams sgrubs tshul 'dra'o/ /༈ sa mtha' la/ pa yas kyi sgral si ri 'jig au gnyis la yī/dzas shas la ma ha ta dang 'dra/ gzhan dbyangs la phar 'dren/ ༈bha ldan la sa rnam bcad/ rnam bcad dbyangs dang ha ba'i bar du u/ u o/ su pra la rnam bcad byed dam phar 'dren pa gdam ka'o/ /pa yaX pa ya sī/ pa yāX si/ na sa sogs kyis ring po'o/ /lan gnyis/ ༈pa ya swā pa yo dz+nyā/ pa yo bhiX/ ༈pa yo se/ pa yo bhāX/ pa yo khyoX/ ༈pa ya saX pa yo bhāX/ pa yo khyoX/ ༈pa ya saX pa ya soX pa ya swāX/ ༈pa ya si/ pa ya soX pa ya sgru pa yaXsu/ ༈de bzhin du/—196—

te dzas/ o dzas/ ba tsas la sogs pa'ang ste/ te dzaX te dza sī/ te dzāX si la sogs pa dang / ༈ba tsaX ba tsa sri/ ba rtswa si la sogs pa'o/ ༈ha bi 9'i sgra la/ ha bi ṣa si/ si phyis/ ṣa ru ru song / ru rnam bcad/ ha biX/ gzhan pa yas dang 'dra/ ha bi khyi 'di yang ṣa dang sa mtshungs pas na sa sogs kyis ring pa'o/ /ha bī ṣi ༈ha biX ha bi khri ha bī ṣi ༈ ha bi lga ha biṣa bha mu dzi ru/ ha bi rgyuX/ ha bi r+bheX/ ༈ha bi ṣe/ ha bi rgyuX/ ha bi rgyuX/ ༈ha bi khringaX ha bi rgyuX ha rgyuX/ ༈ha bi khaX ha bi ṣeX ha bi khraX ༈ha bi ski ha bi ṣeX ha birlu/ ha biXkhuha biṣ+ṭha/ zhes so/ ༈a das ma ning la/ a das si phyis/ sa rnam bcad a daX/ri la'ang de dang 'dra/ g.yin rnams la a das a ma ru bsgyur ba sngon dang 'dra ba'am/ ṭi a ru bsgyur mtshams rkyen gyi bya ba byas/ de nas da ma du bsgyur/dbyangs u ru byed par yang bshad pas ci bde bar bya'o/ /dper na a da snga/6( yī/ ṭi a/ ad sī byung / a i la e/ a de/ da ma/ ma lab/mū/ a mū/zhen/ pa'am/ ṭi a/ da ma/ a i la e a me/ ma las mū/ a mū zhes kha pa'o/ /dzas shas shi nus na'i u pa dh+wa a mū ni/ ༈a ma ṭā/ a das a mu ru song / ṭā nā/i u'i mthar/ ṭā nā 'ong ba thog ma a mu ru song ba dgos so/ /a mu nā/ bha la a'o/ /a mā ma las mū/ a mū dhīX/ gsum ka 'dra/ bhas dang byas gnyis la bha sa mang po la e/ a me a'i yī mang po la'o/ /zhes pas/ a sī ste/ a sī bhiX/༈a sī khyuX/ de dang 'dra bar a sī lgaX ༈a sī khu ༈os gnyis po la/ os la'o zhes/ a me/ e da/ ma mu ru bsgyur/ a mu yoX/ ༈gzhan u mu khyi/ ༈a —197—

ldi tra/༈swā mu muX༈a mu t+tha sngas rdzung sngon dang 'dra'o//spyo pa ha sa mtha' can gya swā nang dbye rā dge / cigang lha sa/bre she༈/da na rnam da nyar gas kau 'al ba da ni 'di ni brjo 'a par bya dho las/yurmi da/a : ྅ ni ga tsho zhe 'i kya sdo ༷ba bsha/da /'a brjad pa' ye she ni ba/ni pa gi pha mam nang meng pa sna ste di yang khug tu ༷nga rdeb la/dngas sngi / ma / ma nang snra 'gyur hā pa ga ༷si/ sa si /gsaX lags paX dzog sna ༵di pa po'i ga /sdo ba ni bye/she nā/she/ge rje sde ge mu zhed rmed shad dodage//yas sa/ da pa pa sgra sbyar ba / da pa dang las phyags gag pa' dan te/si dang ming lhan cig tu bsgyur ba'i go byed do//des na si dang yu ri lhan rdo bye rlos/ rdo bye glo ni rdo ni/dz+nya/rdeg stso/zhes pa'i snga phyi snaX'athug dge ge ge ge ge rdo de ge ge ge ge ge na ge cha/'a sangs ba the//she dang asmad sa bo dri snga phya' sha 'a lta~X wo dang a wo grangs she sbyar ra/༈ye ba ba(spya//snas dbye byung na go rim bzhi zu /yu'i asmad la pha ral tu she gā ni shes/gyi rnam dbyedang tha ba dang /rdzu byā rdzo / bsgyur dgas/der ri kha sto na yan spru /ma dad dang sto pa / /ge/rde/sa na bar kyibs ra/yurmi da a/asmad a sa pa da yu ba a/a ba a sa ༷༷ra ri ༷sgro/rder rdaX/rderde/ 'a bsto 'i bye phoniXspege rje she ma/a u mu'//yurmi da asmad kya pha ral tu byung ba 'a rnam da a urang para'i a smad a bzhe//ra bas/yu sa spe/a ba u mu/'a yu'i ḍi gā dang /asmad aX ba ༷sa par gyur pa' mtha' a dang u mu gya ā 'dra ba rang pa byas pas yu bā a bā/ 98

༈ ྅ yaX ba yaX dza swā/ dzas kyis ྅ yaX ba yaX mo/ /kyis zhes byed pa po'i sgras rnam dbye dang bcas par bsgyur ba ste/ yurmi da dzas asmad dzas/ zhes ba theg yurmi da dzas/ pū yaX du bsgyur/ asmad dzas/ ba yaX du sgyur/ mū yaX/ ba yaX༈ twa'i de ka tī/ gcig nyid la twad ma ta ngo / dang po'i gcig tshig ma gtogs pa'i gcig tshig gi rkyen pha rol du byung na/ yurmi da twata zhes dang / asmad ma ta/zhes par bsgyur ba las/ skabs 'dir gnyis pa'i gcig tshig yurmi da da/asmad da/ twata/ ri/ ma ta ri/ u spro bha/ ri sa bhi la u'o/ /'dir da dang 'og tu 'chad pa sa dang rtsis la/ tshur rol ṭi ā ru 'gyur te/ 'dir tā ri/ mā am zhes pa'o/ /'dra ba ring po/ pha rol dbyi/ tāX māX༈ gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig au ni/ dang po'i gnyis tshig au dang 'dra ste/ yu bāX/ ā bāX/༈ sha so nogs kyi na'o/ /'di mdo dngos min lung 'dren yin zer ba yod na'ang/ shas kyi bya ba ston byed gzhan med pas mdo rang yin pa 'thad do/ /shas la ni yu yi ni shas asmad shas ṭi a/ shas nyid kyi sa na ru bsgyur ba las gzhan rnam 'gyur gsar ba khyad chos gang yang med/ 'dra ba ring po yod /yu spyin/ a smun/ ༈ e ṭu droX/ ṭā ngi dag la e'o/ /'dir ṭā dang 'og tu ngi la rtags mtha' e 'gyur ro zhes pa ste/ pu khyud ṭā/ asmad ṭā/ gcig tshig la twata/ma ta du bsgyur/ de dang de'i zhi a ta gnyis po e ru 'gro /drangs pas tī ā me ā/ e a yu/ drangs/ twa yā/ ma yā/ ༈sgyu mu rigs gsum ka gnyis tshig yin pas yu bar bsgyur/ yu ba sgyuX/ a ba dhīX/ spyi 'gro bha la a'o/ zhes/ pas rtags mtha' ring po/ yu bā khyuX/ a bā bhāX/ ༈pu khyud lhis asmad nyis ṭi a/ ri sa —199—

nyis la ā ro zhes pas/ shi'i a thung ring por song / yu sgri bhiX/ a smu bhiX/༈tu khyuX ma phyaXng yā/ nge yis tu khyoX mas mo/ pu khyud nge asmad nge de dang lhan cig yurmi da tu bh+yaX du bsgyur/ asmad ma tho du bsgyur dgos te/ yis zhes pa'i tshig zur las so/ /tu khyoX/ ma hraX/༈gnyis tshig yu bā dhīX/ a bā bhāX/ 'dra༈smyas sha smya mu/ smyas sha snu mu'o/ /bzhi ba'i smyas ni/ sha sdu mu du bsgyur te/de yang yurmi da smyas/ asmad smyas/ ṭi a/ byas sha smya mu du bsgyur sha yig sngar thog ma byas yin pa'i dbang du byas na/ bha sa mang po nyid la e zhes pa dgag pa dang / phyis bya mu thung ngur song ba ltar na yang gnyis tshig lham ring po dang cha 'dra pas/ bha la a zhes 'jug par dogs pa dgag pa'i don du byung ba tsam yin gyis gzhan don med pas phyis te/ sdo mi khyuX/ asma khyuX/༈nga si khyu soX ༈༷༷/ nga si smyas dag gi shu'o/ lnga pa'i gcig tshig nga si dang mang tshig smyas ni shu ru bsgyur ba ste/ dang por gsum pa'i gcig tshig dang 'dra bar/ yurmi da twa tra dang / asmad ma ta ru bsgyur/ twa tra as/ ma ta as zhes pa bsgyur bas/ twata/ shu/ ma ta ltu zhes so/ sha ni thams cad 'gyur ba ste/ as yongs rdzogs tra ru bsgyur ba'i rtags don yin pas phyis/ u brjod don/ gong rtags mtha'i tra yang dbyi ste/ ṭi a'o/ twa dang ma rkyen gyi tra dbyangs med dang sbyar twata ma tra༈gnyis tshig yu bā bhāX/ a bā bhāX/ 'dra'o/ ༈pu khyud smyas/ asmad sdus ṭi/ a/ sdo yil smyas a sma smyas snus jo/ ru bsgyur/ yurmi shu/ asma shu/ sha dang u phyis yus sna asma ta/ nga si skabs kyi twata ma tra dang lnga pa'i mang tshig gi udzi asmad zhes mtha' rten 'di rnams rkyen gyi lus 'gyur ro/—200—

༈ta ba ma ma nga swā/cig ma mar+sha ba ma ma'o//yu kho ngas 'a sbyin tshigs ba/she ra kau lhan gam ma ru bsgyur/de rje ḍi drug pa' gag byegs la thag ma rtags kha na twata ma tra du bsgyur nas sprudra zhe/sa zes twata ma ta rnam da dang dzos pa ta ba she ma sa tshig la kyang 'dra ra/tshob/wob/༈yu'i mi spyisniri she/ga tsho she ri rdo ce khrig gnyas ga la yu ba ༵nga a ba ru gang bshe bsgyur/she 'gra as mu zhi shā////rtags mtha' a ya drangs/yu ba yaX/a ba yaX/༈yu bi u mu ༷ aṭa ra/put+paX/um rdo//sa skyes kyi ji/nga / steswā mā ka/swa mu u kam ma/swa mu sa sus ri sa she la draXngs pa ༷ sus u mu pi a mong ji pa ā ka mu du nging ga/'dra ba nga pa yu 1 ka/a smu ka/༈pu yid / asmad /twa tra/ma taṭ+wā dag la e'o//tī i/me i zhes so//khri se/ri no sa 0ri spyo ri lbo ngo ra tsho ra 7song bas pa ba : ///sa/twa ya/ma ya/༈gnyas g.yu /ba yaX'o zhes rngaXgang chang pa sdo ste ṭi/༈sbrang she/ su pra asmad su pra ri rtsa / zhe sa she la dzog/'i/sa pa de / de dag sa ā ru sang /sdo snying//a smra su/ sa spru ni/༈da / 'ad bsha/da /de dag las slar yang rdod she gas du 'gyur tshul /ā sha la yang /ā sha gzhan she 'a / rjo//spe/dhi ste me bsno lteyus na sma tabazhiX/gle tsa s+t+ri ya 'i ce skye sku bas spya sa/yu snga she rko de la nga per myo pa pa'i gcig tshig la ri yo da she bas nas dag pri༈ she dar na/drug ༷ bde te rno yu kho twata du sang twa tra dang ngas kya gebs rang/sa pa ta ba ru sang ba /she ri bde sla ze pa dang me zho /sa bar bas rab bsgyur as dang bcas pa/ma ma ru ༷nga ba /slar/ bar bsgyur ba

dang / ༈drug pa'i gnyis tshig la yu yo yu ba yoXdang / asmad ā ba yoXru song zin pa de/ yu ba yoXri dang / a ba yo shoX ru bsgyur ro/ ༈drug pa'i mang tshig la yu yid/ yu snyi kaX du bsgyur/ asmad a grwa kaX du bsgyur zin pa de/ rdza snyi kaX bas dang / a smu kaX nas zhes par bsgyur ro/ ༈de bzhin du bzhi pa la tu khyoX te dang /ma phyaX me ru 'gro zhing / ༈yu bā dhīX/ da dang / a bā bhāX/ no ru 'gyur la/ ༈rdzas khyuX bas dang asma bh+yaX nas zhes par bsgyur ro/ ༈yang gnyis pa la tāX māX dmigs gsal can de 'gyur ba dang / yu bāX da/ a bāX no ru 'gro zhing / ༈pū yaX bas dang / ba yaX nas zhes par bsgyur ro/ ༈drug pa bzhi pa gnyis pa zhes pa dngos su yin la/ go rim zlog par bstan pas 'os shing 'dod na tshig phrad kyi lugs la gzhan la'ang sbyar te/ dang po la twa thu te dang / a has me zhes par 'gro zhing /yu bāX da dang / a bāX no zhes par 'gyur la/ ༈yu yaX bas dang ba yaX nas zhes par bsgyur ro/ ༈gsum pa la/ twa yā te ma yā me ༈yu bā dhīX bam/ a bā bhāX no༈sdo yakhri bhiXri/ a smra bhiX nas/ ༈lnga pa la twata te ma ta me ༈yu bā rgyuX da/ a bā bhāX no/ ༈yus ta bas asma tra nas/ ༈bdun pa la/ twa yi te/ ma yi me ༈yu ba yoXri/ a ba yoXno/ ༈sdo snyi su bas/ a smra su nas zhes pa rnams su'ang res 'ga' zhig na kun du bstan par bya'o/༈tā mā ma/ ri gyis tā mu'o/ /rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig da dang bcas pa'i pu rmid asmad ni tā dang mā ru bsgyur te/ yurmi da da tāX dang /a smrad da māX du song ba de slar yang 'dir tāX twa dang / māX mā ru bsgyur ro/ ༈de ltar na te me da no bsu nas tā mā ste/ ā de sha brgyad po 'di/ drug pa bzhi pa —202—

gnyis pa rnams la byed pa mang la/ ༈dang po gsum pa lnga pa bdun pa rnams la spyir btang la mi byed pa kho na yin yang / tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa la skabs 'gar srid do/ dngos su smon pa dang shugs la lugs zlog gi rim pa'i brdas bstan pa'i dgos pa ni de yin zhing / ༈twaX dang a ha mya nas yu sgyu su dang a smu su bar du 'gyur ba ni nges pa yin la/ ā de sha ni mi byed pa'i skabs kyang mang mod/ ā de sha byas na tshig gi bya ba rdzogs par 'dod do zhes g.yin las 'chad do/ ༈yurmi dra rnam dbye'i rkyen bcas rnam 'gyur ni/ /twaX dang yu bāX ྅ yaX dang po ste/ ༈ /tāX dang yu bāX yu yin gnyis pa'o/ ༈ twa yā yu bā bhāX dang sdo mi bhiX/ ༈tu khyuX yu bā dhīX dang sdo mi khyuX/ ༈ /twa tra dang yu bā sgyuX dang yus na dang / ༈ ta ba yu ba yoXdang pu spyi kaX ༈ twa yi yu ba yoX dang sdo sri su// ༈ asmad rkyen bcas rnam par 'gyur ba ni/ a haX ā bāX ba yaX dang lnga'o/ /༈ māX dang ā bāX a smun gnyis pa'o/ /༈ /ma yā a bā khyuX dang a smra bhiX/ ༈ ma phyaX a bā khyuX dang / a smu khyuX ༈ ma tra dang a bā bhāX dang asma tu gsum/ ༈ /ma ma a ba yoXdang a grwa kaX༈ /ma yi a ba yoXdang a smu su/ ༈ /dang po'i gcig tshig mang tshig dang / ༈ /bzhi pa lnga pa'i gcig tshig rnams/ /rtags dang rnam dbye lhan cig bsgyur/ ༈ /gsum lnga drug bdun gcig tshig ni/ /twata dang ma tra la bya ba sgrub/ ༈ /gnyis tshig kun la yu ba dang / /ā bar bsgyur nas bya ba byed/ ༈slar yang shin du bsgyur ba ni/ /tāX ni tā ru 'gyur ba ste/ /māX yang mā ru bsgyur bar bya/ ༈ /tu khyuX ta ba te yin te/ /ma phyaX ma ma me ru 'gyur/ ༈ /yu bāX dang ni yu bā bhāX/ /yu ba yoXrnams da du 'gyur/ ༈ /ā bāX dang ni a bā bhāX/ /a ba yoXrnams no zhes bya/ /yu yaX sdo mi khyoX dang ni/ /yusgri kaX rnams bsu zhes bya/ ༈—203—

ba yaX asma zlaX dang ni/ /a smra kaX rnams nas zhes bya/ ༈ /rnam dbye dgu la ā de sha/ /rnam pa brgyad po de dag ni/ /drug bzhi gnyis pa rnams la yod/ /tshig phrad la ni gzhan yang 'dod/ /zhes bya ba nyer mkho sngoms kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/༈ nā do/ dang po la ma yin no/ /tshig re re'i dang po ste thog ma la/ ta ba mam sogs rnam 'gyur thog ma kho na byed kyi/ te me la sogs pa'i ā de sha phyi ma mi byed do/ /'dir dper brjod tshigs bcad 'grel bar 'byung ba ni/ swā sī te sa sa mā ya taX/ swā sī me swāX pra taX ga taX/ na ma ste bha ga ri yo/ de hi me mok+ṣa ma bya yaX/ khyod kyi rje de legs 'ongs sam/ /bdag gi rje bo do lta byon/ /zhes drug pa'i dang po dang / bcom ldan khyod la yang yang 'dud / /mi bzad thar pa bdag la stsol/ /zhes pa bzhi pa'i dang po ste/ rkang pa dang po'i yi ge gsum pa la te dang / gnyis pa'i gsum pa la me ni/ khyod kyi dang bdag gi zhes drug pa'igacig tshig yin no/ /gsum pa'i gsum pa la te dang / bzhi pa'i gsum la me ni/ khyod kyi ched don la dang / bdag gi ched don la zhes pa'i don gyi khyed la dang bdag la ste bzhi pa'i dang po'o/ ༈swā sī bu nu dza hā so smo dro gyu no dā na yā tsa nāX/ ༈rwadzā baX dwa su te dā naX/dz+nyā naX no ma dhu snyu da naX/ ༈jo bo khyed dag gi bzhad gad / /nged kyi spyin khrom 'khrugs 'chos mthong / /rkang pa dang po'i yi ge gsum pa ban ni ri ste/ khyed dag gi zhes drug pa'i gnyis tshig dang / gnyis pa'i yi ge gsum pa no na nged cag gi zhes sam bdag cag dag gi zhes drug pa'i gnyis tshig go ༈khyed dag la sbyin rgyal pos byin/ /nged la ye shes sbrang rtsi dgras/—204—

rkang ba gsum pa'i yi ge gsum pa baX ni khyed dag gi ched du zhes pa dang / bzhi pa'i yi ge gsum pa no ni nged cag gi don la zhes bzhi pa'i gnyis tshig go /de la dza hā sa gad mo/ u ni mthon po ste bzhad gang yin/ khrom 'khrugs 'chos pa ni/ spyin pa gtong pa la hab thob byed pa'i khrom 'khrugs pa la khrom 'chos pa'i phyir brdeg pa ste/ dā na yā tsa na zhes pa'o/ /༈de bo bā ma pa twadhi :rna ra kesno dza nā rna naX/ ༈sta grwa bo ba la bān rā dza swā sī no so dza nā rna naX༈'jug sel lha yis khyod dag la'ang ste/ /dmyal las bdag cag srungs shis skye bos mchod/ /rkang pa dang por da khyed dag la zhes dang / gnyis par no zhes pa 'di dang bdag dag la zhes pa gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig go/ ༈stobs ldan rgyal bo khyed cag rnams kyi rje/ 'gro bas mchod de bdag cag rnams kyi rje/ zhes te/ /gsum par/ bo zhes pa ni/ bas kyi sa rnam bcad ha ba la u/ u o zhes pa'o/ /bzhi par no ste/ khyed rnams kyi dang / bdag cag rnams kyi zhes pa drug pa'i mang tshig go /na mo bo bra h+ma bi dzhai sbyo dz+nyā naX no dī ya tāX dha naX/ ༈swā naX dwa t+paXpra pa shā mo naX pa sto mo naXsu duXkhrin/ ༈rab mkhyen tshangs pa khyod rnams la 'dud do/ /bdag cag rnams la ye shes sbyin pa stsol/ ༈ khyod rnams la ni kun dgar rab tu mthong / /rab tu sdug bsngal bar mthong bdag rnams la'o/༈rkang pa dang po'i bo zhes pa bas te/ khyod rnams kyi don la zhes dang / gnyis pa'i no ni bdag cag rnams kyi ched la zhes bzhi pa'i mang tshig dang / ༈gsum pa'i baX ni bas te khyed rnams la zhes dang / bzhi pa'i naX ni nas te bdag rnams la zhes gnyis pa'i mang tshig go ༈pa shā mi tā ma dwa lī khyuX/ pa shā mā ma —205

da bhe da kaX/: khyod la bltas na myos pas dregs/ /nga la myos pa 'jig par mthong / /rkang ba dang po tā ni khyod la zhes dang / gnyis pa'i mā ni nga la zhes pa ste/ rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig go ༈rkang ba so so'i thog ma la/ te me sogs su mi bsgyur ba'i dper brjod ni/ ta ba ye sha tra bo rā dzan/ ma ma te bya te sha tra ba/ ༈ ta ba mi bhā ṇi yā ni su rma ma mi t+yā ṇi tā n+ya pi/ ༈rgyal po khyod kyi dgra bo gang / /bdag gi yang ni shin du dgra/ ༈khyod kyi gnyen bshes gang yin pa/ /bdag gi bshes kyang de yin no/ /rkang pa so so'i thog mar ta ba ma ma zhes pa yod kyi te me med pa dang / ༈ru dro pi shwe shwa ro de po/ yu sgri kaX ku la de ba hā/ sa e ba bha ga bān+ta tho/ a smra kaX pā pa na sha naX/ sna tshogs dbang phyug lha drag po/khyed cag rnams kyi rigs kyi lha/ ༈ /de 'dir mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag cag rnams kyi sdig ba 'joms/ /rkang pa gnyis pa dang bzhi pa'i thog mar/ pu snyi kaX dang / a smra kaX yod kyi bsu nas med pa bzhin no/ ༈de bo lha sgyu rgyu hi na ha re/ bi sto khri lha tak+ṣa sarba dā/ saX bho da na pa dā da gre/ na saX bha ba ti ba sā da yaX/ bod pa'i tshig gi rjes thogs la/ bas sogs 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /kye lha bdag skyongs mi'i seng ge /rtag par bdag srung khyab 'jug kye/ /zhes te/ de bo bas sogs mi 'byung / de ba asmad/ biṣ+ṭha asmad zhes 'byung ba bzhin no/ ༈tshig rkang gi dang po ma yin na 'gyur ste/ pāX tu po snra si dha phyan kha lāX ga la ko ṭa yaX/ hi ra khyu ka shi po rba k+ṣaXspu tru mṛ skarda mā ru ṇaX/skyongs shig khyed rnams mi yi seng ge yis/ /sen mo'i gshol khyi rtse mos 'dro skyong bu/ /gser can gyi ni lto ba'i ngos dral ba'i/ khrag gi 'dam rdzab 'char —206—

ka'i dmar bo 'dzin/ /zhes te/ pāX tu sngon la song bas bo ste bas yod pa bzhin no/༈tsā di tho tsa la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang ngo / /'og tu 'chad ba'i tsa la sogs pa lnga dang sbyor ba'i tshigs la yang / ā de sha brgyad bo de mi bya ste/ ta ba tsa ma ma tsa mai hi tsan+d+ra le khe ba sa rna te/ khyod dang nga yi byams 'dris ni/ /zla ba yar ngo bzhin du 'phel/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ te tsa/ me tsa/ mi zer bar ta ba tsa/ma ma tsa zer ba lta bu'o/ /tsa la sogs pa lnga ni/ tsa pā a ha e ba e waX zhes so/ /de dag gi yu'i dra dang asmad kyi rnam 'gyur phal cher bshad zin to/ /༈ /da ni mi zad pa'i sde rags rim du bstan par bya ste/ tsā di ni pā taX/tsa la sogs pa ni pā ta'o/ /ming gcig gis don du ma ston pa ni/ a bya yi te mi zad pa zhes sam/ ni pā ta zhes bya'o/ tsa la sogs pa ni 'di dag yin te/ tsa dang yang / bā yang na dang 'dra ba aha tshig gi kha skor smras pa e ba 'di zhes nges pa e baX bzhin nas mtshungs/ nā naX nges pa bṛ tha kra so so bi nā spangs pa nā nā sna tshogs swa sti bde legs/ a sti yod pa do khri mtshan ma na k+taX/ sgro khri mi brdzun byā brdzun ma thas gsang ba dang 'dres pa gnyis a tha de nas bkra shis a tho bar mtshams med dang phyis nas phya sa las shwa sa sang nyin u rtsis mtho ba nī tsis dma' ba su ru mtho ris aX ta ru bar mtshams pra ta ra zhogs pa pu na ru slar bhu yas mang po a ho ngo mtshar sī tra rnam rtog u ta mtho ba dang de ring sa ha bcas ṛ te spangs a rnya re ṇa spangs a rnyar bar stongs na mas 'dud a laX rgyan kṛ ta mu byed pa dgag tshig gi sgra a mā no nā bzhi dang / i ldan chung ngu ki la gtam —207—

kha lu tshig rgyan be+e spangs pa hi rgyu/ ā rā ta thag ring thung gnyis ka smi shaX phul byung ṛ taX bden pa swā kaX mthun su rnaX mthun/ ya ta ta ta/ de ltar lnga bcu nga gsum par a la sogs pa dbyangs rkyang pa ming du gyur pa —dang / bod pa dang don gsal bar byed pa rnams kyang ngo/ ༈gzhan yang ta tra la sogs pa rnam dbye'i don can te/ rtags rnam dbye can bsgyur ba mang po la yang / ni pā ta yod de/ta tra/ ya tra/ ku tra/ ku ha/ kwa/ ta dwa/ ya dā/ e ka dā/ a n+ya dā/ ka dā/ ta thā/ ya thā/ ka thaX/ i tāX/ ta taX/ ya taX ku taX a taX i taX/ la se(gas pa'o/ /de yang ta smin zhes pa ta tra/ ya smin zhes pa ya tra/ ki mu gyi ka smin zhes pa ku tra dang / ku ha dang / kwa zhes pa gang rung du bsgyur te/ de dag bdun pa'i sgra dkyus ma yin la/ ༈dus dang 'brel ba'i bdun pa yin na/ ta smin zhes pa ta dā/ya smin zhes pa ya dwa/ e ka'i sgra la e ka dā/ a nu smin la a n+ya dā/ ki mu gyi kasmin ka dā/ la sogs pa dang / ༈gsum pa'i don la/ te na zhes pa pra ka ra ston byed la/ ta thā/ ye na zhes pa ya thā/ ki mu gyi ke na la ka thaX/ i dmu gyi a ne na la/ i t+thaX la sogs pa dang / ༈lnga pa'i don la ta tra kyi ta smutra zhes pa/ ta taX/ ya ta la ya smutra zhes/ pa ya taX/ ki mu gyi rka'i/tra zhes pa ku taX/ i dmu gyi a smutra zhes pa a taX/ e tad la e ta grwa ta la i taX/ la sogs par bsgyur zin pa rnams mi zad pa'o/ /༈ swaṇ+ḍa bi bhasti ka stas i rkye ke/ rnam dbye thams cad pa la tas zhes pa gcig pu rnams so/ kha cig tshig 'di lung 'dren yin yang zer ro/ tas kyi rkyen rnam dbye thams cad la sbyor du rung / 'on kyang de'i don ni gcig pu'i don la —208—

sbyin te/ gcig pu don ni gcig kho na dang / ches gtso bo kho na la 'jug gotas kyi mtha' can yang ni pā ta'o/ ༈sa spru la tag zhes pa byin pas/ sarba taXzhes pa lta bu ming po la 'jug go /༈yang purba smin zhes pa pu ra stuta/ a dhar smin zhes pa a dha stuta/ pa ra smin zhes pa pa re ṇa zhes par bsgyur ro/ /༈yang da sti ṇa dang 'brel ba'i i ta ra de rigs dma' ba la/ a hi zhes pa'i rkyen tha mar sbyar na yang mi zad pa'i rtags te/ dak+ṣi ṇa hi ba paṃ ti tsaṇ+ḍa laX/ lho phyogs thag ring ba na gnas par byed gdol pa'o/ /zhes par 'gyur/ gdol pa rnams grong khyer phyi rol lho phyogs na yod pa'o/ /a hi zhes pa dak+ṣi ṇa dang 'brel bas gnas gzhi'i don dang rgyang ring ba gnyis ka ston no/༈kimaXsā mā rkye tsi dwa diX/ ki mu las spyi sgra la tsitra sogs so/ /ki mu gyi sgra la gong du bshad pa'i pho mo ma ning rtags ci yin yang rung / rnam dbye nyer gcig gang byung kyang rung ste/ tsita rkyen spyin du rung zhing / byin pa na mi thad pa/ni bā ta yin no/ /tsitra sogs zhes pa'i sogs khongs nas tsana'i rkyen sogs kyang ste/ dper na ka dā tsitā la sogs pa dang / ༈kaXzhes pa la tsita btags pas/ kalci tra la sogs pa dang / ༈kwatsita/ kwa tsan/ ku khya tsitra/ ku ha tsitra la sogs pa thams cad la sbyar ro/༈ ta da dhī na de yo rbu sa ta/ de'i g.yog 'khor dang tshogs mtha' dag 'dus pa la su ta yang na'o/ /g.yog 'khor gyi don la swa ta ster te/ dper na rā dz+nyā dhi na/ rgyal po'i g.yog 'khor zhes/ su ta rkyen ma byin pa dang / de la su ta byin na/ rā dz+nyā/ rā dza ru log a dhi na phyis te/ su ta nyid gnas pas/ rā dza —209—

gta zhes par 'gyur yang don de mi 'gyur bar de ka la gnas pa lta bu'o/༈sarbaX bhasma thams cad thal ba zhes/ pa/ de la su tra byin pas/ sarbaX phyis bhasma su tra zhes pa ste/ kun 'dus pa'i don la su ta do/ ༈smras ba'i tshig la don bzhin sgrub pa sogs mtshan ma bzung ba'am/ mang po las gcig bzung ba'i don la/mū rī u ra ri u ra rī/ zhes pa rnams kyang ni bā ta yin zhing / ༈sarba'i sgra dus kyi don/ sa du la sogs pa ste/ sa du sa pa ti de ma thag gam 'phral du a ju de ring a dhu nā da ni i dā nāX da lta saX pra ti da lta swāX pra taX da lta pu dzo byuXsang / ba re byuXganangs / a n+ya byuXgazhes dgus sogs/ ya di dus gang la/ ya lha/ dus gang la/ ta di de'i dus tarti/ ā su mgyogs po shighaX/ mgyogs po dza gyi ti mgyogs pa tu rje/ rnams kyang mi zad pa'o/ /pra di ru ba sa rgaX/ pra la sogs pa nyer bsgyur ro/ /pra la sogs pa ni/pra/ pa rā/ a ba/ da/ a nu/ a ba/ na ru/ du ru/ bi/ gi zhi ni/ adhi/ a bi/ a ti/ su/ utu/ a bhi/ pra ti/ pa ri/ u pa/ zhes pa ste nyer bsnyur nyi shu dang / nyer sgyur dang phyogs mtshungs pa ā bi ste nyer gcig /pranywa toX/ byings la thog ma'o/ /snyer bsgyur rnams phal cher byings kyi thog mar rab tu sbyor rgyu'o/ /ta da bya yaX/ de mi zad pa'o/ /tsa la sogs pa nas pra sogs kyi bar la mi zad pa zhes bya'o/༈zhwa duX taX tsa/ k+ta la sogs pa yang ngo / /de ltar na tsa nas ā bi bar du ma zad/ ka tā la sogs pa tshes mang po zhig kyang mi zad pa'o/ /'og tu yang 'chad par 'gyur mod/ mtshon pa tsam ni/ khu kri nya byed pa la'o/ /khyu dang nya phyis/ kṛ —210—

bzhag ghā yi rkyen byin/ kṛ ma phyis par ba 'ag na/ gro'i ri yon tan da du byed dgos pa las/ 'dir kra phyis pas kra nyid la gnas nas/ kṛ tā byas nas/de bzhin du/ ga phyin nas twa/ na twa phyag 'tshal nas/ stu twa bstod pa byas nas/da t+ta byin nas/ dro gyu bltas nas/ ma twa shes nas/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/༈khu spo nya/ kṛ tu thu zhes pa'i rkyen byin/ ṛ yon to ka rtuX byed pa'i don du'am byed pa la/ de bzhin du/ ga rmeX phyin pa la'am 'gro ba la/ na tuX phyag 'tshal ba la/sto tuX bstod pa la/ dā tuX ster ba la/ ma mruX shes pa'i phyir/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/༈a bya yu dhi bha lte rlu ku/ mi zad pa las rnam dbye rnams 'jig go/ mi zad pa'i rtags kyi sde la/ rnam dbye bdun gsum nyer gcig thams cad 'jig pa'o/ /zhes pa spyir btang su bshad nas/ ༈sgrar gyur pa'i mi zad pa la dmigs gsal du rnam dbye mi 'jig par bya ba byed pa srid de/ rig byed dang tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa yin te/ pra kri ya la sogs pa nas bshad do/ /mi zad pa'i sde la/ pho mo ma ning gi dbye ba'i rtags tha dad mi 'dra ba cung zad kyang med de/ kun la sbyor bar bya ba kho na'o/ /gsungs pa/ rtags gsum la ni mnyam par mtshungs/ /rnam dbye thams cad la yang ngo / /tshig rnams thams cad la yang ste/ /dbyer med gang de mi zad pa'o/ /bshad pa 'dis na/ rtags kyi dbye ba med do/ /gang las kyang mi 'gyur bas na mi zad pa'o zhes bshad do/ /gzhan yang 'di ltar go dgos te/ mi zad pa'i sde dpag tu med pa zhig yod kyang /grags che ba dag 'dir smos pa la/ rgya skad du a bya yi zhes pa ni mi zad pa ste/—211—

si sogs rnam dbye'i rkyen byin yang / rnam par 'gyur ba med pas mi 'gyur mi zad ces bya/ yang tshig gcig la yang skabs thob kyi don sna tshogs pa 'byung bas/ don zad pa med pa'i phyir yang mi zad pa zhes bya/ ༈yang 'di la rgya skad du/ni pā ta zhes kyang zer ba/ sngon gyi lo tsa ba rnams kyis ni pā ta tshig phrad du bsgyur/ 'on kyang ni nges pa dang / pā ta tshig yin pa/ nges tshig zhes pa'i don du 'gyur gsungs / nges pa'i sgra don yang rkyen gyis mi 'gyur ba'i don no/ ༈sgra'i skabs 'dir ni pā ta zhes gnyis yod pa/ ni pā ta tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa dang / ni pā ta nges tshig gi rtags gnyis don mi gcig ste/ 'di dag ni pā ta'i rtags yin la/ cig shos ni sgra sgrub tshus dmigs gsal gyi nang tshan zhig go/ ༈mi zad pa'i rtags kyi sde la dbye na/ ngo bo nyid kyi mi zad pa dang / bsgyur pa'i mi zad pa dang / rkyen gyi mtha'i mi zad pa gsum yod do/ ༈dang po la dbye na/ nyer bsgyur dang / nyer bsgyur ma yin pa gnyis so/ /nyer bsgyur ni nyi shu'am ā bi bgrangs na nyer gcig yin la/ ༈gnyis pa la ming rkyang pa zhes pa dbyangs/ kho na ming du bzhag pa rnams dang / a la sogs pa dgag tshig rkyang pa rnams dang /tsa la sogs pa mtshams sbyor ba'i tshig dang / nu naX la sogs pa rang rkang can gyi tshig dang sa bya la sogs pa dus kyi don can te rig lnga yod do/ ༈gnyis pa bsgyur pa'i mi zad pa ni/ ta smin ta trar bsgyur ba dang / puṇ+ḍa smin pu ra stuta ru bsgyur ba la sogs pa rnams so/ ༈rkyen gyi mtha' can gyi mi zad pa ni/ tas dang e hi dang tsitra dang tsan dang / slad dang / k+ta dang tu mya gyi mtha' can la sogs pa'o/ ༈gzhung 'dir/ rtags drug dang /yu smad asmad du rnam dbye 'jug —212

tshul dang thams cad rnam 'gyur 'byung tshul rgyas par bshad nas de rnams kyi dmigs gsal du rnam dbye rnams 'jug kyang rnam 'gyur med pa mi zad pa'i le'u bstan pa yin no/ /nyer bsgyur rnams rtags mtha' 'byung ba nyung la/ si sogs rnam dbye'i rnam 'gyur pha rol du mi 'byung zhes bya yi/ spyir rkyen gzhan gyi rnam 'gyur ni ches mang ste/ be+e shra ba ṇa dang / au pa ga ba lta bu'o/ /de la tsa la sogs pa lnga bcu nga gsum dang / ༈ta tra la sogs pa bcu dgu dang / ༈sa du la sogs pa bco brgyad dang / ༈nyer bsgyur nyi shu po rnams la ngag byang bar bya zhing / nyer bsgyur rnams kyi don la blo gros kyi 'jug pa rgyas par yang bya ste/ re zhig de tsam gyis kyang mkhas pa'i bya ba cung zad byed do/ /de yang phyogs mtshon tsam ni 'di lta ste/ ༈pra thog mar sbyar ba la/ pra ṇa ma ni rab bsngags te/ /phyag 'tshal ba'am oṃ yig go /pradz+nyā shes rab/ pru lta thob/ /pra mā ṇa dang pra ki rna/ /tshad ma dang ni bkram ba'i don/ /pra kṛ ti ni rang bzhin la'o/ /pra bhu khyab bdag pra be sha/ /'bebs pa la'o/ pra bha 'od/ /gzhol ba la ni pra ba ṇa/ /thal 'gyur la ni pra saX ga /tho rangs pra ta ru pra sa sno/ /dang ba pra gra ha srabs pa/ /pra dh+wa na ni gtso bo la/ /pra ya ts+tsha ni sbyin pa stsole// /pra yā da ni bka' drin zas/ /pra yo dza na dgos pa ste/ /prapra dha shin du sbyangs pa la/ sogs kyi don la pra mu kha/ /pra rdzu ta 'o pro lha dang / /pra ṇi ta ni gya noms pa'o/ gnyis pa pa rnga'i don la/ /pa rā sgyi bi ti ni brnyas pa'o/ /pa rā kra ma rnam gnon lkog gyur la/ /pa ro3 lnga'o pa rā spo ni reg /pa rā bit+ta ta ni yongs gyur ro/ /rim min pa rā brit+ta ta/ /pa rā dzi ta mchog tu rgyal/ /pa rā ga ta bral ba'o/ /pa rā mu kha phyir —213—

phyogs pa/ /pa rā shu ta rnam par rmongs// 10༈gsum pa a ba pa'i don ni/ /zhu gsol a ba tsā ya nā/ rma 'bebs a ba ka ra sgyi/ /a ba rā dha gnod par bshad/ /bral ba a ba ga ta ste/ /sel ba la ni a bo ha/ /byang grol a ba brga ste/ /a ba pā ta smad ra'o/ /gnod pa a ba kā ri ṇaX/ /mi gsal a ba ba ra ṇaX/ /gsang tshig a ba la bha 'o/ /bsnyon dor gsang ba a ba hu/ 12 ༈bzhi ba a nu'i don ni/ /rjes thogs a nu ṣaX ga ste/ /rjes dpag a nu mā nar brjod/ /a nu kū la mthun pa ste/ /a nu sha ya phra rgyas kyang bag la nyal/ /mthu la a nu bhā bar bshad/ /a nu ka sba rtse ba la/ /rjes 'brang a nu pā ri ṇa/ /rjes gnang la ni a nu dz+nyā/ /a nu pan+ti dma' ba'i phyogs/ /skyar ma dang thuni yang yang dang / /snga ma'i rjes 'jug don la mang /13 ༈lnga pa a ba'i don ni/ /a ba la sba 'dzar ba'i don/ /a ba dā na rtogs brjod la/ /a ba nā da zhal gdams so/ /zhus pa a ba sī naX ste/ nges bzung dkar ba zur bkol la/ /a ba dh+wa ra ṇa zhes grags/ /a ba dā ta dkar po ste/ /a ba ya ba cha shas la/ 'jug pa bar stongs skabs dang bklags/ /'od snang a ba bhā sar brjod/ /a ba ta ra skye dang 'jug /a ba ki rte khyab pa'o//16 ༈drug pa ni ru gyi don ni/ /'di ni phal cher dgag tshig mang / /ni rā ma ya skyon med te/ /nges pa'i tshig la ni ruk+ta/ /ni shing ni nges pa la'o/ /ni rde sha ni rgyas bshad do/ /ni rbu ṇa dang ni rlu ṇa/ /mya ngan 'das dang nges 'byung la'o/ /ni shraX ya ni nges legs te/ /ni sh+ka l+ya ni zug rngu spangs/ /ni sh+ka laX ka rnyog —214—

bral dang / /cha med pa la'ang 'jug pa yin/ /cho 'phrul ni rmi ta zhes brjod/ /ni ga ta ni gsal ba yin/12 ༈bdun pa dus gyi don ni/ /ngan pa dang ni dka' las la/ /phal cher dus gyi sgra 'jug ste/ /du rga ti dang du bī sa/ /du cu k+ta dang dus dza na/ /ngan 'gro gnas ngan za nyes dang / /mi ngan rnams la rim bzhin brjod/ /du rga rdzong ste bgrod dka' zer/ /rnyed par dka' la dus la bha/ /dka' ba byed la du ṣ+ka ra/du rba la ni nyams chung ba/ /duXkha sdug bsngal yin par grags/ /du rlo dha na 'thab dka'o/11 ༈brgyad pa bi yi don la/ /bi nā ya ka rnam log 'dren/ bi pā ka ni rnam smin no/ /be+e ro tsa na rnam snang mdzad/ /bi ma la dang bi pa ju/ /dri bral dang ni lhag mthong yin/ /bi dra lha ka bi de ha/ /lus 'phags nyid yin 'phags skyes zer/ /bkraX dang khyad 'phags pi shig /sna tshogs la ni bi tsita/ /bi ti grub pa'am cho ga la/ /bi bhu mnga' bdag byā sta khyab/ /bi ma ti ni the tshom mo/ /bya ba lo ka lta ba ste/ /bkod pa bhu ha la sogs/15 ༈dgu pa ging gyi don ni/ /ā di dang po ā ka sha/ /nam mkha' ā yu tshe la'o/ /ā kā ra dang ā ka ra/ /rnam pa dang ni 'byung gnas la/ /le lo la ni ā la phya/ ā sha ya dang ā sha ni/ gnyis ka 'dod dang bsam pa la bza' ba la ni ā ha ra/ /'phel ba la yang ā be sha/ /lung dang sngags rgyud ā ga ma/ /ā khya ta ni bshad pa'i ming / /ā bar ta ya zhugs pa ste/ /skor ba la ni ā brit+ta/dad gus la ni ā da ra/ /ring po ā ya ta zhes brjod/ /tha gru la yang ā ya ma/—215—

ā bho ṣa ni 'bad rtsol yin/ /ā bsti ni lhung ba zer/ zil ba la yang ā bar ta/ā shi rba ta shis brjod yin/ /ā ha smras dang bod pa la'o/ /u sku bka' lung gnang ba'i don/ /ā li dbyangs dang phreng ba'o/ /kun dga' ra ba ā rā ma/ /ā de sha ni snang ba dang / /kun nas sgyur ba'i don du 'dod/ /ā yu dha ni mtshon cha ste/ /ā bha ra ṇa rgyan la brjod/28 ༈bcu pa ni'i don ni/ /nges pa'i skad dod ni ya ma/ /ni ya ta yang de dang gcig /ni pā ta ni nges tshig ste/ /ni bā sa na gos dang thabs/ ni brit+ta zhes log pa'i don/ gling gzhi'i don la ni dā na/ /ni ma rgyu zhes brda byed pa/lhung zhing 'gyu/la ba ni pa da/ ni ka ṭa zhes thag nye ba/ /tshogs la ni ka ra zhes 'dod/ 10/ bcu gcig pa a dhi'i don ni/ /a dhi lhag pa'i don la mang /dper na lhag pa'i shes rab la/ /a dhi pradz+nyā zer ba bzhin/ /de sogs mang ste 'dir ma smos/ /a dhi pa ti bdag po che/ /a sgyut+pa ni nang gi don/ /lhag po la yang a dhi kaX/ a ju shi ta lhag par byung / /dag lus pa la a dhī na/ /a dhi ka ra dbang du byas/ /a dhi te ni 'don cing klog /bla dag a dhi bā tsa naX/10 ༈bcu gnyis pa a bi yi don ni/ /'di ni phal cher tshig gzhan gyi/ /mtshams sbyor phra mo yin pas na/ /thog ma la yang srid mod kyi/ /phal cher tha mar 'byung ba yin/ /thog mar bzhug pa'i dper brjod ni/ /a pi tsa ni gzhan yang ste/ /a pi hu zhes yin mod kyi/ /tha mar yod pa 'di 'dra ste/ /ta thā pi na de lta mod/ /ya thā bi ni ji ltar yang / /de bas kyang la ta ro3 bi/ /gang yang gzhan yang yo3 bi'o/ /ci 'dra'ang ya thā bi na ma/ /'di ni dbus su —216—

bzhag pa yin/ /a bi kho na'i tshig de yang / /kyang dang yang dag 'ang gi don/11 ༈bcu gsum pa a ti'i don ni/ /phul byung a ti sha ya ste/ /a ti mā tra chad med pa/ /a ti bā ta brgal ba'i tshig /a ti bh+ra ma shin du 'khor/ /a ti sa ra 'khru/ skyug ste/ /'das pa'i dus la a ti ta/ /a ti bra sidha zhes pa/ /mchog tu gsal bar grags shing grub/ /a ti phal cher shin du'i don/ /9 ༈bcu bzhi pa su'i don ni/ /su ni bzang bo mdzes dang bde/ /rab dang legs dang phul byung don/ /byed sla ba dang gces pa'i nor/ /de sogs rnam pa kun la 'gro /su dhī blo bzang zhes bya ste/ /su ba hu ni dpung bzang sogs/phal cher bzang po'i don la 'jug su rū pa ni gzugs mdzes dang / /bde gshegs su ga ta zhes bya/ /su bha dra ni rab bzang dang / /rab dga' la yang su ra ta/ /su kri ta ni legs byas te/ /lo legs skye rgyal su bhak+ṣi/ /su bi sko khyu zhes pa ni/ khren du rnam dag ces la sogs/ khren du'i don la'ang yod pa mang / /rnyed sla 'i don la su la bha/ /su hrid sems la gces par 'dzin/ /su ka ra ya bya sla ba/: /dang ba'i yid la su mā na/20 ༈bco lnga pa utu gyi don ni/ /rgyas pa la ni uskru la/ /dar ba rgyas pa skye dang 'byung / /'char ba rnams la u da ya/ /udzin zhes skye ba la/ /dga' ston la yang ut+pa ba/ /byang phyogs mchog dang 'das pa dang / /bla ma phyi ma ut+na rdo/ /ut+ta ma yang mchog la'o/ /ud dā na ni sdoms tshig ste/ /mdor bstan pa la ud de sha/ /u smo ra ṇa smra dang brjod/ /ud gha ṭa dang ut+pa ṭa/ /ut+pa ra gsum rim pa bzhin/ /phye dang shas che bsgrags pa'o/ 19༈bcu drug pa a lha'i —217—

don ni/ /'di ni phal cher mngon par gyi/ /don la 'jug mod gzhan yang yod/ /a bhi mu kha mngon du phyogs/ /a bhi bhu ni zil gnon yin/ /a dhik+ṣa ṇa yang yang ste/ /ming la a bhi dha nar brjod/ /a byu da ya mngon par mtho/ /a bhi ju zhes brnab sems te/ /a bhi pru ya dgongs pa'o/ /a bhi u pa ga ma zhes/khas len pa la rab tu grags/ /a bhi khyu ya brjod bya'o/ 10༈bcu bdun pa pra ti'i don ni/ /lan la pra ti ba tsa na/ /gzugs brnyan pra ti bisba'o/ /pra ti hi ta byin pa 'phrog /pra ti ki rna yal ga ste/ /pra ti ṣi ta dgag pa'o/ /pra ti ban+ta mi mthun pa/ /mngon sum la ni pra trak+ṣa/ /bshags 'bul pra ti de sha na/ /spobs pa pra ti bhā na'o/ /rkyen la pra tu ya zhes bya/ /chu ngogs pra ti ra ñtsa dang / pra ti gha dang pra ti dz+nya/ khong khro ba dang dam bca' la'o/ /sku gzugs pra ti mā na ste/ pra ti ban+ta 'brel ba dang / /pra ti gro hā zhes pa ni/ /zhugs pa'i don la bshad pa'ang yod/ /yal ga rgyas pa'i don la ni/ shwa ga pra ti zhes bya ba/ /tha mar sbyar ba'ang 'di la yod/ 14 ༈bco brgyad pa pa ri'i don ni/ /rnam grangs la ni pa rlu ya/ /pa rlasko ni skyil krungs dang / /mal stan la yang 'dod pa yin/ /yongs rdzogs la ni pad+man+ta/ /yongs su 'joms la pa ri gha/ /pa ri pa ra'am pa ri lga /'khor g.yog nye ba'i ming du brjod/ /pa ri mi ta blos 'jal ba/ /pa ri ṇa ma bsngo ba dang / /yongs su bsgyur ba'i don yin no/ /pa ri shespyi ta zhes dang / /pa ri bit+ta yongs su bskor/ /pa rī t+ta ni chung du'o/ /smre sdags pa ri de ba na/ /longs spyod pa ri bho gar bshad/ /kun rgyu pa ri pra dza ka /pa ri ka ra zhes pa ni/ /yan lag la 'jug sdoms la'ang 'jug 26 ༈bcu dgu pa u pa'i —218—

don ni/ /u pa ya na u pa har/ /u pa gra haX u pa dh+wa/ /de bzhi skyes dang 'bul ba dang / /zhu rten phyag rten rnams kyi ming / /u pa ma na u pa mā/ /dper dang nyer 'jal gnyis la 'jug /u pa dra ba nyer 'tshe ga nod / /u pā hi ta rang bzhin no/ /u pa ra ta spangs pa yin/ /gdan khri u pa dha zhes brjod/ /u pā shu ni 'gol ba la/ /u pā ya ni thabs yin no/ /mal gdan u pa khyu nar brjod/ /u pa li ni nye bar 'khor/ /u pa ba dha tsi lang ṭi/ /u pa dh+ya yi mkhan lnga'o/ /u pa nā zhes bya ba ni/ /bsnyen gnas len pa'i ming du brjod/ /u pā sa ni snyung gnas so/ /nyer sgyur dang ni gnod byed la/ /u pa sa rga zhes par grags/ /u pa n+ya ba nye bar 'god/ /u pa rā ga'ang nyer sgyur dang / /lam du 'god dang glu lan len/19 ༈nyi shu pa da gyi don ni/ /sam+bha ra dang saX ke ta ni tshogs dang brda/ /kun 'dzin san+ta ra ste 'byor ba saX kṛ dhi/ /kun 'byung sa mu da ya spyi la su mā na/ /chags thogs sa ma saX ga phyags dar saX ka ra/ /sa mya ka yang dag saX dz+nyā mi/ /sa mā ga ma mjal dang 'phrad/ /sa nā na ni rgyu la'o/ /brjod dang sdud pa sa sgyi ti/ /bsdus pa la ni saX gra ha/ /dus dang brda dang rtogs pa dang / /gzhung lugs grub mtha' dam tshig la/ /sa ma ya zhes brjod pa yin/ /saX ra naX ni dbyibs la'o/ /sa sban+ta ni 'brel bar bshad/ /the tshom la ni saX sha ya/ /tshogs pa'i don la sa no ha/ /kun spyod sa mā tsa ra ste/ /sa man+ta ni kun nas so/ /yang dag rgyal las rā taṭa/ /sa snyen ni tshim pa yin/ /'pho ba la yang sañtsa ra/ /saX pri ta ni kun —219—

rdzob bo/ /g.yul 'gyed pa la saX gra ma/ /saX ha ta na grims lnga'o/ /sdud pa la ni sañtsa ya/ /saX khyu grangs kyi ming yin te/ sa sba khru ra dus kyi lo/ /phun sum tshogs pa saX bsno/ 37 zhes bya'o/ /nye bsgyur nyi shu po 'di dag la/ /ka tsan gnyis kyi lugs so so la yang go rim mi 'dra ba re 'dug cing / 'dir bshad pa yang /slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi'i gzhung dang go rim 'dra mod/ go rim mi gcig na/ a nu sogs pus sogs zhes pa lta bu ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba tsam dgos pa ma gtogs/ lar ni ngo bo gcig pas don la khyad med do/ da ni lugs 'di la nyer sgyur bzhi pa yin par dkyus la bshad kyang skabs 'dir nyi shu par bton pa ni/ thog ma pra dang / tha ma saX du byed pa tshig bkra legs pa'i don no/ ༈ pra pā rā pa sa ma nā ba ni rdu rgyud/ n+ya dha yo3 bya ti snyu da bha ya pra ti pa rlu pa/ zhes pa lugs 'di dang mthun pa'i rim pa ltar nyer sgyur mtshams sbyar ba'i sdoms yin/༈ka lā pa'i lugs kyi go rim ni/ pra dang pā ra ni ni ru utra dud ri/ /bi dang a ba a nu pa ri dang / /a bhi a dhi pra ti su dang mi ṇa ri/ /a ti a ba a pi u ba'o/ /de la 'phags mchog tsan+d+ra go mis/ nyer bsgyur la 'grel ba bsdus pa mdzad/ paṇ+ḍi ta gha ṭa ba'i 'grel ba cung zad rgyas pa yang yod/ dbyangs can brda sprod rang lugs la yang mang du yod 'dug na'ang ma mthong la/ phyis bod du lo tsa ba chos skyong bzang pos rgya dpe mang po gzigs nas rnyed tshad bsdus pa'i 'grel chen yod pas rgyas par de dag tu shes par bya'o/ /'on kyang phyi ma 'di la 'dod rgyal kho na'i ming 'ga' re nyer sgyur rang min pa'ang cung zad 'dres sam snyam mod / mkhas pa'i phyag rjes la blun pos skyor 'byin mi byed do/ /lar nas —220—

dpe de mthong na nye sgyur gyi don la ngo mtshar ches che ba skyed par snang ngo / /de ltar na mi zad pa'i le'u bshad zin to/༈ da ni rtags gsum ngos bzung pa'i don du khyad par shes par 'dod pas/ mo rtags kyi rkyen nam/ bud med du sgrub pa'i rkyen 'jug tshul bshad par bya'o/ /bud med la a las ā ri/ /zhes pa'i mdo sngar byung ba 'grel pa mkhan pos/ dgos pa'i dbang las gong du bcug gi /gzhung gi go rim la 'dir 'jug go /de yang / dzā ya zhes pa la ā pra bud med rkyen byin/ da rjes 'grel/ 'dra ba ring bo/ dzā yā/ bu mo mtshan bzang mo des mtshon nas de bzhin du/ ma ya la/ ma yā nor can ma'o sgyu ma can/ me dha la/ me dh+wa blo ldan ma/sha dha la 'ju dad can ma/ dhar la dha rā myong ba dang mtshon cha'i so/ mā la la mu lu phreng rgyud mkhan ma/ sogs pa'o/༈ a dzā de tshwa rdza/ a dza la sogs pa'i yang zhwas 'o/ 'di yang dpe 'ga' las/ bak+ta byaXzhes lung 'dren du byas pa dang / phal cher 'di nyid kyi mdo dngos su 'dod pa gnyis byung ba/ bak+ta bya zhes pa med pa'i phyogs mdo dngos yin pa legs par sems so/ /de yang bud med la a la ub zhes byung bas a dza la sogs pa dgos su smos pa ci snyam na/ dza yā sogs la u pu byin pa mo rtags yin yang 'jug pa'i yul ma nges pa nyid de/ /pho dang ma ning gi dngos po la 'gro ba'ang yod la/ /a dza sogs la bud med kyi rkyen u pu byin pa ni yul bud med kho na la 'jug pas/ mo rtags kho na las nam yang 'gyur ba med par go ba'i phyir ro/ /a dza la ri byin na/ a dzā ra mā de bzhin du/ e ṭa ka la/ 221—

e ṭa lug ma mo/ kā ko ki la la/ ko ki 'khu byug mo/ bā la la/ bā bu lā mo lo bcu drug ma/ shu dra la/ shu drwa dmangs mo/ /ga ṇi ka la/ ga ṇi kā tshogs can ma ste smad 'tshong ma/ sogs pa'o/ /de yang dza yā sogs la brjod bya'i yul mo ma nges la/ a dzā sogs la nges pa'i phyir don la khyad par yod pas kha gsal byed dgos byung ba yin no/༈ kwa pya taX kwa pra la i a ta kyi'o/ /kā pi i a tra ngas rnams sbyar ba las mdo tshig de ltar byung ste/ kā pi zhes pa ni/ kwa pu dang di'o/ /kwa pra ni mo rkyen u pra dang bcas pa'i kā yi ming ste/ kwa pu'i snga rol kyi de ma thag pa'i a yig ni i yig tu 'gyur te/ kā ra ka u pra pa rjes 'brel/ kā ra kā zhes par song ba'i rjes de ma thag /ra'i a de ka pra'i sngon ma nyid yin pa'i phyir/ i yig tu 'gyur bas/ kā ri kā byed mkhan nam tshig le'u byas pa bsgyur te/ zhes pa grub bo/ /pā ṭha kā/ pā ji kā klog pa mo/ pā tsa kā pā tsa gī 'chos pa mo ste g.yos pa/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ka n+ya kā la sogs pa la ni/ kwa pu'i mtha' yin yang / gong ma'i a yig i yig tu mi 'gyur te/ ka rkye kwa zhes pa mi bsgyur te/ ka n+ya kā nyid la gnas pa'o/ ༈'grel par kha bkang ba la/ nyer bsgyur a ba a bi dag gi a dbyi bar bha gu ri 'dod do zhes 'byung ste/ bha gu ri ni drang srong zhig go/ de yang gdam nga ste/ a ba gā phyaX zhes pa la/ /rang gnas/ ba gwa phyaX zhes pa dang / a pi dh+wa naX la rang gnas sam/ pi dha naX zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈yang hasa'i mtha' rnams la 'dir zhwas yang ngo / /zhes kyang drangs te/ bā tsu u pu pra rjes 'brel/ bā tsā ni sha u pra/ ni sha di sha u pra/ di shā zhes pa'o/ ༈hra swo bā/—222—

thung ngu yang na'o/ /myo rtags la kwab pha rol du yod pa'am/ ta rā pha rol tu yod pa la/ snga ma rtags mtha'i dbyangs ring po yod na thung ngur 'byung ba yang yod de/'dam ga la 'dra mnyam dang / shas che chung gnyis yod pa las/ thung ngu shas che'o/ /kas pha rol la/ be ṇi kā lan tshar can ma/ zhes pa'am/ be ṇi kā na di kā zhes pa'am/ na dī/ rgyun can ma ste chu bo ༈ ta rā pha rol can ni/ shri ya si ta rwa'am/ shri ya dge legs can ma sī ta rā kā zhes so/ ༈ /no kā gru mkhan ma la sogs pa mang po zhig la ring po thung ngur bsgyur pa'i bya ba mi thob ste/ dper/no kā thung ngur byed na/ nu kā ru 'gyur ba las/ 'dir de ltar mi 'gro'o/ /gzhung gis yang na bar bshad pas/ no kā sogs la mi bsgyur bar nges pa yang ci snyam na/ yang na'i skad dod bā zhes pas zin te/ tshig gcig la don du ma yod pas na mi zad pa ste/ bā zhes pa 'di yang mi zad pa yin pas/ skabs 'dir yang don gnyis te/ be ni kā sogs la/ yang na ba'i don dang / no kā sogs la byed pa 'gog pa'i don de gnyis ka 'jug pa'o/ /de ltar gyur pa'i u pu'i mtha' kun la rnam dbye 'jug tshul gang gā'i sgra dang 'dra'o/༈ /na ṇi zhis/ na ṛ an las zhi pa'o/ /na mtha' ṛ mtha' aṇa mtha' ste/ aṇa gyi rkyen byin pa'i der rjes a'i mtha' la yang / mo rkyen 'jug pa yin na rkyen ci lta bu snyam na zhi pu 'jug go /da rten la zhi pra/ pa rjes 'brel/ drangs/ daṇ+ḍa nī dbyugs pa can ma'i chad pa mkhan ma/ da rnyin/ zhwa pra/da rnyi nī so ldan ma/ kā rin/ zhi pra/ ka ri ṇi glang chen ma/ mā lin/ zhis/ mā li ni 'phreng ldan ma/ rwadz+nyā zhis/ us la rwatswa'i a dbyi'o zhes bshad pas/ rwadz+nyā —223—

dngos su dbyangs mtha' yin yang / rā dzun las byung bas 'dir smos te/ ༈re a phyis/ yī la drangs/ no dhī rgyal ma/ shwan zhis/ shwa yi ba sgra u ru bsgyur te/ shu nī khyi mo ṛ mtha' la/ go rto zhi pu/ ṛ ru ru dang ta yī la drangs/ ka dhī byed pa mny-itre zhwas/ ha mo dhī rkun chung / ༈ aṇa mtha' la/ u pa ga ba/ bu brgyud rkyen gyis 'gyu byer ba/ tse( pa ga ba/ ba'i a phyis/ zhi pā la drangs pas/ 6( pa ga bī/ phyugs skyong ma/ ༈ mu ༷ ma dang dang / su sri sgyug mo la sogs pa ṛ mtha' bud med kyi don yin yang / zhis mi 'jug ste bud med kyi rtags su rang grub pas so/ /zhes dgongs so/ ༈yu ban klu pra/ yu ba'i ba u ru song / /u 'dra ba'i yi ge yu ring po/ kū nī lang tsho ma/ ma gha ba na/ zhis wa u ru song / a u la o ru song / ma sgo nī brgya byin mo zhes so/༈ ya phya lo paX i a dag gi dbyi'o/ /rtags mtha' la i'am a yod la/ /pha rol rkyen dbyangs dang ya yig yod na/ a dang i phyis par 'gyur ro/ gong gi au pa ga ba'i ba yi a dbyi ba'i gzhung yang 'di kho na'o/ /lte ngo btaXdzig u ṛ las so/ ṣa yig rjes 'brel sngon song can te/ da lta rjes 'brel dngos su med kyang / sngar byung ba'i rigs dang / de bzhin du ṭa dang u dang / ṛ yig rjes 'brel sngon song can gyi ming la mo rtags byed na/ zhwa pra ster te/ ༈ṣa rjes 'brel gyi dpe ni/ ba rā ka lta bu ste/ de byings/ bṛ la dzika'i rkyen btags pa las byung ba'o/ ༈ṭa rjes 'brel dper brjod/ ku ru tsa ra/ ṭa byin pa'i rjes yin pa dang / u rjes 'brel/ go ma ta lta bu ste/ sngon go ma tu zhes pa bsgyur bas so/ ༈pa tsan+ta/ pa ṭhaX ta/ bha baX ta/ zhes pa/ pa tsaXrta la sogs par yod pa —224—

rkyen gyis bsgyur bas 'di dag ṛ rjes kyi dpe'o/ /de rnams la zhwas ster bas/i a dag gi dbyi'o/ zhes pas/ rtags mtha'i dbyangs phyis/ drangs pas/ pā ra gī mdzes ma/ ༈ku ru tsa rī ku rle'i yul gyi bud med/ ༈ go ma tī chu bo'i nang tshan/ bha ma brnyi skal can/ ༈ pa tsaX tī g.yos ma/ ma ṭha n+ti klog ma/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/༈ na dwa deX/ na da la sogs pa las so/ na da/ go ra/ go ta mi/ tsa tu lha/pañtsa mi/ pi tan+ta/ sharba ra la sogs pa la yang / zhi pu ster te/ i a dag gi dbyi ste/ na dī/ go rī/ go ta sī/ tsa tu shrī pañtsa sī/ bī baX tī/ sharba rī zhes par lngar ro/༈isgru de rā ṇi pra tsa/ in+d+ra la sogs pa las ā ni pu yang ngo / /in+d+ra la sogs pa rtags mang po la/ ā rjes ster te/ 'dra ba ring po byas pas/ in+da ṇi/bha bā ṇi/ ru drwa ṇi/ ༈zhis sa mā hu re gu tho zhis mnyam par bsre ba la yon tan yang ngo / /mnyam par bsre pa'i don can gyi mthar zhi pu byin pa la gong ma yon tan dgos te/ dper/ tra ya ṇi/ zhes gsum rnams/ be dā nāX/ zhes pa rig byed rnams zhes pa tshig de dag dang / rig byed gsum po sdoms par byed pa la/ /be dā nāX gsal bar brjod don yin pas phyis/ nus kyi na yang brjod don/ /tshig sdud rnam dbye u mu phyis/ tra yu tsam las da rkyen phyis pas rang gnas su ldog /tri ru song / klu pra yī e ru song / e yu ru drangs/ tru yī/༈pho dang ldan pa la yang zhis 'o/ /zhes bshad pas/ shā dra la/ zhwa pra/ i a dbyi/drangs/ shā dhī/ dmangs rigs kyi chung ma zhes skyes pa yang go ba lta bu ste/ ga ṇa —225—

gī/ rtsis mkhan gyi chung ma zhes pas rtsis mkhan yang go ba la sogs pa'o/ /yang zhes pas/ go bā la ka phyugs rdzi'i don te/ de dang sbyor ba la mo rkyen du zhwa pra mi 'byung ste/ u pu kho na'o/ /kwa pra a ta kyi i'o/ /zhes pa/ la li ru song / go bā li kā/ zhes sogs mang po dag go༈ dzā te ra yo ba dha ta/ rigs las ya ma yin pa'i u pa bhā las so/ /rigs brjod pa'i don la u pa dh+wa la ya yig med pa zhig byung na/ de la zhi pra thob ste/ bud med kyi don du sgrub pa'i dbang du byas pa gzhir bzhag pa la'o/ /me lga ma hi lga shā ka ra/ haX sa/ lha ka ṭa/ bru rmi ṇa/ zhes pa rnams la zhi pra byin/ rtags mtha'i a phyis/ me khri ma hi khrishā ka rī/ haX sī/ ku klu khyi/ brarmi ṇi/ zhes par gyur pa sogs shin du mang po'o/༈ya min pa zhes pas u pa dh+wa ya yig yin na zhwa pra mi ster te/ k+ṣa tri ya dang / be+e khyo zhi pra mi thob/ mo rtags su byed na/ us byin te/ k+ṣa tri yā/ be+e shā zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈dang po'i na tshod brjod pa la/ a ta las zhis 'o/ /zhes bshad pas/rgan po dang dar bab la sogs pa'i don mi brjod par/ na tshod dang po byis pa dang gzhon nu brjod pa mo rtags la ji pra thob ste/ ku mā ra/ rdzis rtags mtha'i a phyis/ ku mā rī/ ki sho rī/ ka la snri la sogs pa mang po'o/ ༈dang po'i na tshod smos pas/ pri dha dang / za bi rā ches rgas pa/ zhes pa lta bu mo rtags la u pu ster ro/ ༈a tra las zhes pas/ dang po'i na tshod yin kyang / i u sogs la/zhis mi thob ste/ shi shuXzhe so pa lta bu'o/༈swāX gaṅgā lus mdzes la zer/ rang lus la yang na'o/ /rang rang gi lus kyi yan lag gi don brjod pa la mo rtags sbyor na/ zhis ster/ yang na zhis —226—

bkag ste/ u pra ster zhes pa yin na/ rang lus zhes pa'i rang gi don shes pa po dang bcas pa ster/ sems rgyud kyi bzung ba'i don no/ /yang na'i don yang rtags gcig la/ yang na bar sbyor ba min te/ yan lag gi don can gyi mo rtags su bsgrub rgyu'i sde tshan gcig la zhi pu dang / gcig shos la u pra ster ba'i don no/ /su mu kha la/ zhi pra/ i a dbyi/ drangs/ su mu khri/ de bzhin du/ mṛ ga k+ṣa la/ mṛ ga spyi/ ta nā gaX lus phra la/ ta na ji/ la sogs shin du mang po'o/༈yang na ba'i don/ pad+ma ba da na lta bu mo rtags su zhwa snga mi ster te/ u pu ster bas/ 'dra ba ring bo/ pad+ma ba da nā/ de bzhin du/ ka ma la na ya na u pra/ ka ma la na ya nā/ ka phywa ṇa kro ḍa us/ ka phywa ṇa kro ḍā/ ki sha la ya ka ra u pra/ ki sha la ya ka rā bu mo lo bcu gcig ma'am/ chu shing sdong po 'dra ba'i lag ma/ tsho ṇa la bhu dza u pu/ mṛ ṇa la bhu dzā zhes pa ni ku ba 'dra ba'i sa'i khri shing ring po gcig ste de dang 'dra ba lag pa ring bo 'a'o/ su hasta u pu/ su hasta/ de dag la sogs pa mang po zhig la zhis mi 'jug go /༈spo tra kyi i yig ghi min pa la zhwa pu yang na'o/ zhes bshad pa/ spo ta rkyen nang gi i yig yod pa'i rkyen yin pa/ sti ma yin pa de lta bu rkyen gyi mtha' can la zhwas ster ba dang mi ster ba gdam nga ste/ aṅgā la li/ zhis byin na/ i a dbyi/ drangs/ aṅga lī/ si 'jig zhis ma byung na/ de la si byin pa rnam bcad/ aṅga liX/ dhu li zhi pra i phyis/ dhu lī/ yang na si rnam bcad dhu li ༷༷/ a dzi zhwa pra byin pa la/ a dzi ma byin pa la/ a dziX/ de rnams lti can ma yin te/ de sogs gzhan yang ngo / ༈sti ma yin pa zhes pas/ ghi rkyen mtha' can la/ zhis —227—

mi 'byung ba kho na ste/ si rnam bcad du byas pas/ kṛ tiXbhā tiX ma tiX lha tiX dha tiX/ la sogs pa'o/ / ༄༈i tsa ma nā deX/ ma nu la sogs pa las mai yang ngo / /ma nu la sogs pa mo rtags su sgrub pa la/ snyi pra sbyin na rtags mtha' e ru 'gyur te/ ma nu zhwa pra/ ma nai/ i ā yā/ man ā yu yī drangs/ ma nā yī/ tshangs pa'i bu ma nu zhes pa'i rgyal po bcu bzhi'i chung ma rnams la de 'drar brjod do/ yang zhes pas/ au ru bsgyur ba'ang yod de/ ma nu zhi pu/ ma no yī/ au ā ba/ ma nā bī/ bṛ khri ka pā dbang phyug gi glang ste phyu mchog spre'u zer/ zhwas/ i bri khri ka bai/ e ā yu/ bṛ khyi ka bā yī/༈pa tan da yaX/ pa tan la sogs pa'o/ /pa snri bud med/ o rnya rba snri klas thams cad kyi nang nas nye ba ma/ sa khri grogs mo/ a sa khri grogs min mo/ /adhe dza ra tī phyed rgan mo/ u ba tī lang tsho ma/ a shi shrī phru gu med de mo gzham/ 'di rnams ni pā ta yin te/ /mo rtags su bsgyur bas 'gyur ba'o/ /pra tī dz+nyā da yaXsha sdu ni pā tha rnye/ pra tī tsa la sogs pa'i sgra ni pā ta rnams so/ /pra tī tsa la sogs pa ni/ pra tī rti nub/ u dī rti byang/ pru ā+o ཾ shar/ a pā rti shar lho/ la sogs pa mang po dag go /pa nyu la sogs pa dang / pra tī tsā la sogs pa 'di rnams/ zhwa pu ster ba la ma ltos par/ pa sni la sogs pa dang / pra tī tsā la sogs par bsgyur ba kho nas mo rtags su grub pa'o/ ༈ dā ra bud med kyi ming la sogs pa bud med la brjod pa yin mod / da dang zhis mi 'jug cing / rtags kyi ngo bo yang mo rtags ma yin te/ pho rtags yin no/ de'i phyir rnam —228—

dbye pho rtags dbyangs a'i mtha' can spyir btang bzhin yin pa las/ gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig mi 'jug pas dzas sogs mang tshig bdun po kho na 'jug ste/ dā rāX/ dwa rwan/ de riX/ dā re khyuX dā re khyuX dā rā ṇaX/ dā re khu zhes ཿnga ngo / /dā ra'i sgra 'jug yul bud med kho na yin kyang ming pho rtags yin no/bo rgu ṇa tra/ yang na u yon tan la'o/ /tshul rol u yig mtha' can yon to brjod pa'i don las/ pha rol tu bud med kyi rkyen zhi pu ster ba dang mi ster ba gdam ka ste/ byin na/ pa ṭu zhis/ i dang a yin na dbyi mod kyi/ 'dir u yin pas mi dbyi ste u ba ru 'gyur/ pa smi/ yang na zhes pas zhi pra mi ster bas/si rnam bcad de/ pa ṭuX/ de bzhin du/ mṛ dī/ tsha du 'jam mnyenaX ta nī/ta nu lus graX ṛ dzī/ ri dzu 'jam klas maX zhes pa la sogs pa dag go༈u ta mūX/ u ta las chi'o/ /u yig mtha' can gzhan bud med du sgrub na/chis zhes pa'i mo rkyen ster/ de yang gdam nga ste/ paX gu zhes pa la/ chis byin/'dra ba las ring po/ si rnam bcad/ riX/ u pra ma byin na/ si rnam bcad tsam ste/ pa duX bā mo rū chi pra/ bā mo rū brle mdzes ma/ yang na bā mo ruX/ ka ra bho ru ྅pra/ ka ra lho rū lag mdzes glang mo'i sna zhagasaX ka ra bho ruX ༈྅ nastiX yu ban las ti'o/ yu ba na'i sgra la ti zhes pa'i rkyen ster te/ na phyis te/yu ba ti/ si rnam bcad/ yu ba tiX/ zhes so/ /de ltar bshad pa de rnams ming gi pha rol du si sogs rkyen 'jug pa'i gnas sam gzhi ru sgrub pa'i bya byed de/ mo rtags su bsgrubs zin pa gong du bshad pa de thams cad la tshig tu sgrub pa'i phyir/ si sogs ster dgos pa las/ re zhig dper na si sbyin pa'i dbang du —229—

byas na u pra'i mtha' la/ u pra kyi si dbyi ba dang / zhwa pu mtha' la yang ha sa dang zhi pra la si dbyi/ a ni pra yang / zhis tu ga|gis/ gzhan ྅ dang ti la si rnam bcad do/ /u pra mtha' kun la gaṅka dang 'dra/ zhwa pu mtha' kun la na dī dang 'dra/snyu pra mtha' kun la bā dh+wa dang 'dra'o/ ༈mo rtags la byings las ming du grub tsam na mo rtags su rang grub pa dang / sngar ming du grub zin pa gcig slar mo rtags su bsgyur ba dang / mo'i don la skyes pa'i bya ba ste gsum mo/ ༈dang po ni/ s+t+ri dang mā tri la sogs pa yin la/ ༈gnyis pa la yang bsgyur ba tsam dang / mo rtags sgrub byed kyi rkyen byin pa gnyis so/ ༈dang po pa nyu la sogs pa thung ngu pho rtags rnams ring po mo rtags su byas pa blos bzung ba tsam mo/ /de bzhin pra t+yaX tsa/ pra tī stu/ u da sma u dī rtswa/ prug/ pru khyi/ a bā tsa/ a bā tsi/ zhes par blos bzung zhing ngag gi bsgyur ba tsam yin gyi/ rkyen gyi byed pa can ma yin no/ /༈gnyis pa rkyen byin pas bsgyur ba la gzhung 'dir/ u pu/ zhi pu/ a khyi pra/ chis ti zhes pa ste rkyen lnga bshad/ u pra la dbye na/ sbyir btang yul nges pa dang ma nges pa gnyis/ dmigs gsal ka pra la yang kwa pra spyi dang / dmigs gsal gyi yang dmigs gsal gnyis yod do/ /dis dang ḍa pra dang hi tshe dang /ud / tshwa pa/ ti dang / yid ste bdun/ zhes pa ltar bud med kyi rkyen bdun gzhung gzhan las bshad do/ ༈gsum pa bud med kyi don la skyes pa'i bya ba ni/ dwa ra'i sgra la sogs pa'o/ ༈bud med kyi rtags ni bye brag ba yin pas gsar du sgrub tshul rgyas pa yod/ pho dang ma ning gi rtags ni phal cher rang grub ba'o/ /de —230—

ltar na/ bud med kyi rkyen gyis mo rtags su 'gro tshul rags pa ni de tsam mo/bud med kyi rkyen 'jug tshul bshad zin to/ /༈ da ni byed pa can gyi le'u'i don cung zad bshad par bya'o/ /de yang byed pa can dang byed pa can ma yin pa'i dbye ba bshad pa la/ tshig nyung ba'i phyir byed can gyi le'ur ming btags pa yin gyi/ don la le'u 'dir/ rnam dbye thams cad kyi 'jug pa'i yul rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de yang rnam dbye sde tshan bdun las/ don tsam ste dngos po'am rdzas gtso bor brjod pa ni dang po yin la/ dngos don de'i khyad par dang 'brel ba'i ldog pa nyid thun mong min pa'i brjod byar byed pa ni phyi ma drug go /byed po bya ba byed pa las bzhi'i don gtso bor ston pa byed can du grags pa ni/ dang po sogs lnga dang bdun pa ste/sde tshan drug po de yin la/ sde tshan drug pa ni 'brel ba gtso bor ston pas byed can du mi 'jog go de dag las rnam dbye dang po'i yul bshad pa ni/༈ lid+ma rnye pra tha mā/ rtags kyi don la dang po'o/ /'dir rtags dang ming dang sgra zhes bya ba rags par na don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su bya'o/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ ji skad du/ rtags la sogs pa yang dang po'i don no/ /zhes 'byung ste/ sogs pa ni bod pa la sogs pa'o/ rtags zhes pas pho rtags/ mo rtags/ ma ning gi rtags gsum car bsdus te/ byings la krita mtha'i rkyen byin pas/ byings las 'gyur te ming du grub la/ si sogs dang ti sogs kyi rnam dbye'i rkyen ma byin pa de la rtags zhes bya ste/ ming dngos yin la/ ming gi mthar si sogs kyi rkyen byin zin pa dang / byings kyi mthar ti sogs kyi rnam —231—

dbye'i cho ga grub zin pa ni/ tshig zhes bya ste/ de'i nang na ming yod kyang / mthar gzhan du gyur/ mthar gzhan du gyur pa sogs kyi phyir/ rtags kho na dang / ming rkyang ba dang ming tsam ma yin no/ /skabs 'dir ming gi mthar si sogs byin pa'i che dog grub pa na/ ming las yongs su gyur te tshig tu grub pa zhes bya ste/byings las ming du sgrubs/ ming las tshig tu sgrubs pa'o/ /'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba ti sogs kyi rkyen rnams kyis ni/ phal cher ming ma brgyud par byings nyid las tshig tu sgrub par byed do/ /de ltar na skabs 'dir 'brel bar rkyen bor ba zhes pa ni/ gong du rnam dbye spangs shing zhes bshad pa dang don gcig pas/ rnam dbye'i rkyen kho na ma byin pa la zer gyi /rkyen yin tshad la 'jog pa ma yin te/ rkyen du mas ming du sgrub zin pa'i phyir ro/ ༈de lta bu'i ming de la yang /dgos pa ni don yod pa tsam ston pa'i tshig hu sgrub pa'i phyir/ rnam dbye dang po 'jug ste/ ji skad du snyan tshigs gi rig byed las/ ta tra zlo h+ma zhes 'byung ba bsgyur na tshangs pa de yod pa'o/ zhes so/ de zhes pas lkog gyur go dgos la/yod pa ni bden pa'o/ /brad+ma ni myongs pa zhes pa ste/ grags shing grub pa'i skyes bu dang / sems rgyud tsam gyi gang zag dang / lha chen myongs pa rnams la ci rigs par 'jug go /'dir tshangs pa zhes pa bden pa zhes dang 'brel bas/ sems tsam gyi skyes bu ste bdag la zer gyi /lha myongs pa nyid la zer ba ma yin la/ g.yin yang 'di 'dra gnas skabs mang por go dgos so/ /grags shing grub pa'i skyes bu lha mi ni/ ngan par grags pa dang grub pa la mi zer gyi/spyod pa bzang po'am/ bde bar kun la grangs shing dngos su de 'dra yin pa'i —232—

gang zag la zer ro/ bod ston mkhas rlom grub mtha'i bshad pa byed pa rnams kyis/ grags shing grub pa la tshangs pa dang / skyes bu tsam gyi tshangs pa dang /mes po lha tshangs pa'i dbye ba ma phyed par cal col smra bar byed do/ /dper na/bu gcig tshangs pa mchog tu bden/ zhes pa'i tshangs pa'ang skyes bu sems la zer/ tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa ye min no/ don yod pa tsam zhes pa ni/ dngos po de'i don gyi ngo bo tsam ston gyi/ tsam zhes pas ldog pa'am khyad par mi ston pa'i don yin te/ lha zhes spyi ming nas brjod pa'am/ /brgya byin zhes dgos kyi ming nas brjod kyang wo khyad med de ngo bo tsam zhig ston no/ dngos po thams cad kyi ming la des rigs 'gre /ldog pa mi brjod ces pa yang / ldog pa'i khyad par gtan nas mi brjod pa ni ma yin te/ rnam dbye dang po la yang lha dag lha rnams zhes gnyis dang mang po brjod pa yang / /lha'i ldog pa'i khyad par brjod pa yin no/ /de bzhin du/ /ba lang dkar po la sogs pa'i khyad par brjod pa la yang rnam dbye dang po nyid 'jug ste/ las dang bya byed dang 'brel ba'i ldog pa'i khyad par mi brjod pa la 'dir ldog pa mi brjod ces pa'o/ /des na las su bya ba la sogs pa byed tshig rnams ni khyad par can gyi ldog pa brjod pa ste/ 'jim pa la sku gzugs bzhengs zhes brjod na/ /sku gzugs nyid 'jim pa las rdzas gzhan du ni med la/ gnyis po rnam pa thams cad du gcig na ni 'jim pa nyid sku gzugs su thal ba'i phyir/ las su bya ba'i yul 'jim pa la 'bras bu sku gzugs byed mi dgos par 'gyur na/ sku gzugs su gyur pa ni 'jim pa de'i ldog pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'jim pa la zhes pa'i tshig phrad kyi la yig ni ldog pa sku —233—

gzugs lta bu de la 'jug gi /las su bya ba'i ldog pa gang yang med na/ la zhes pa'i tshig gi phrad la don stong pas/ phrad kyi sbyor ba des ni ldog pa las su bya ba de ston no/ ༈de bzhin du byed pa po'i ngo bo dang po'i tshig gis ston kyang /byed por mtshon pa'i tshig gi nus pa bya ba'i tshig dang byed pa'i tshig la yod pas byed pa por 'jog byed/ dper na byed pa'i tshig lag pas/ mang pos/ gnyis kyis zhes pa'i pas/ pos kyi zhes pa'i yul ni byed pa'i ldog pa la 'jog pa dang / ༈ched du bya ba yang / yul las dang byed pa po 'dzom pa'i ldog pa yin pa dang / ༈des mtshon te gnas gzhi'i bar du yang / byed tshig rnams kyis dngos su ldog pa nyid brjod par byed do/ ༈'dir dang po'i don la dper brjod kyi tshigs bcad gzhan gyis bshad pa ni/ ra bi ri ba rā dza te rā dzā/ ro khyi sku mā rī ro rū ya te/ bo bhu dzu te bhu baX bhā pā laX/ pru gwa staX rā ma ri kho/ de bod skad du/ nyi ma 'dra bar rgyal po gsal rber byed/ /gzhon nu ma ni khros las ngu bar byed/ sa la longs spyod byed de sa skyong ba/ dga' byed mtshan ldan dag ni sngon dus byung /zhes te/ rā dzā zhes pa rgyal po/ rnam dbye dang po byed pa po'i don tsam ston pa'i dpe yin/ /gcig tshig gi rkyen si'o/ rā dzan si/ u pa dh+wa ring po/ /si dang na dbyi ba'o/ /rā dza te zhes pa gsal bar byed ces te bya ba'i tshig go nyi ma dang 'dra dper brjod pa yin kyang byed pa ston no/ /nyi mas mun pa sel dngos po gsal bar byed pa/ rgyal pos kyang khrims dag pas skye bo rnams bya byed kyi rim pa go bar byed do/ ku mā rī ni gzhon nu ma ste byed pa po/ bud med la si phyis dang po'i gcig tshig yin/ ro rū ya te ni ngu bar byed de/ bya ba'i tshig —234—

go /dh+wa pā laX/ sa skyong pa ste byed pa po dang / dang po'i gcig tshig si rnam bcad/ rtso baX zhes pa sa la ste gnyis pa las kyi tshig ri gyi rjes so/ /bo bhā dzu te longs spyod par bya ba ste kṛ ya'i tshig go /kho zhes dang po'i gnyis rngog e'i rjes so/ /de ni rā ma dga' byed/ 'i ṇa rā ma'i nu bo mtshan nyid ldan te/de dag la dngos po dang ngo bo dang byed po gnyis yod pas so/ /pru ga a staX/sngon byung ba zhes pa kṛ ya pa da'o/ /dpe kha gcig las/ bhu pā lāX/ sa skyong rnams zhes dzas kyi rjes yod na/ dang po'i mang tshig dper brjod do/ /yang sa rnyi san+taXki yan+taXlegs par byed pa/ legs pa ji tsam zhes pa ste/ sa rnyi legs par byed/ san+taXlegs pa po/ ki yan+taXci tsam zhes te/ spyod tshul legs pa'i skyes bu legs po bzang po mang nyung ji tsam yod ces pa la/ san+taXbyed po'i tshig dang / /sa rnyi bya ba'i tshig go /de bzhin du/ ku mā rāXshe ra te swe raX/ ro rū ya rnye tsa nā ra kāX ye gī ya rnye tsa gī ta dz+nyāX/ me mṛ ya rnye ru dzā dzi tāX de bsgyur na/rang dga' nyol shig gzhon nu rnams/ /dmyal ba pa rnams ngu bar byed/ /glu shes gang rnams glu len te/ /nad las rgyal min 'chi 'gyur bdag /ces so/ /ku mā rāXni gzhon nu rnams zhes byed po ste/ dang po'i mang tshig dzas/ she ra te ni nyol shig kṛ ya pa da swe raX rang dgar zhes pa ste/ byed pa brjod pa yin mi zad pa'o/ /nā ra kāX/ dmyal ba pa rnams te/ ka rta'i tshig dang po'i mang tshig dzas so/ ngu bar byed ces pa bya ba'i tshig go/ ye zhes pa gang rnams/ gī ta dz+nyāXglu shes pa rnams/ zhes pa byed po dang po'i mang tshig /glu len pa ni bya ba'o/ /ru dza nad/ a dzi tāX/ rgyal ba ma yin pa'o/ /nad kyi sdug bsngal ni —235—

rigs mang bas sam/ yang chen po la yang mang tshig 'jug pas/ tāXzhes dzas kyi rnam 'gyur byung gi /nad pa mi mang po'i don ma yin te/ bdag ces gcig pur 'chad pas so/ /'chi 'gyur ni bya ba yin/ bdag ces pa las tshig go /'di rnams dang po'i mang tshig dper brjod pa'o/༈ ā ma rgyu ṇi tsa/ bod pa la yang ngo / ā ma rgyu zhes pa'i bod pa ni/ pho nya btang ste 'gugs pas 'bod pa lta bu dang / lag brda la sogs pas ma yin te/asti mu kha zhes pa mngon du phyogs pa'am / dngos su mthong thos kyi yul skad kyis bod pa'o/ /bod pa'i don la rnam dbye dang po kho na ste/ /dang po'i ni gcig tshig gnyis tshig mang tshig thams cad 'jug tu rung ngo / /gnyis pa la sogs pa gzhan mi 'jug ste/ las sogs ston pa'i tshig 'ga' bod pa'i zla la byung srid na'ang / de 'dra dang 'dres pa yin gyi /des bod par mi 'gyur te/ rta la zhon pa'i mi zhes bos na/ rta la zhes pa bdun pa'i tshig yin kyang / de ni bod pa min la/ ming zhes pa de la bod tshig 'jug ste/ de ni dang po kho na'o/ /rkang pas 'gro ba de zhes bod pa la/ rkang pas zhes gsum pa'i mtha' can byung yang /de tshig gzhan yin/ de la rkyen gsar pa mi 'jug gi 'gro ba de zhes pa la bod tshig 'jug mod/ de ni dang po don tsam ston pa yin gyi gzha ma yin no/ /de bzhin du/ drug sgra la/ bram ze'i bu zhes brjod na/ bram ze'i zhes 'brel ba brjod pa'i tshig yod kyang / de la bod pa'i don mi 'jug gi bu zhes pa la 'jug na/ de ni dang po'i mtha' can kho na'o/ nang sel gsum mngon sum gyis grub ste/kye lhas byin zhes dang / kye pha bu dag ces dang / kye dge 'dun rnams zhes bod 236—

pa lta bu'o/ /kye mchod sbyin myur du song zhig ces pa lta bu mchod sbyin zhes pa nyid bod pa yin te/ dang po'i mtha' can dang / myur du ni las/ song zhig ni byed pa yin kyang / las la skul ba yin gyi bod pa ma yin no / /rgyang ring po nas skad chen pos rgyug cig song zhig sogs dang / phu nas chu byung ngo sogs ni/ skad gsangs tsam yin gyi bod pa ma yin no/ /bod pa na/ dper na/ kye lhas byon zhes 'bod kyi/ kye lha byin gyis/ kye lhas byin gyi phyir du/ zhes sogs 'bod pa mi 'byung ste/ de skad byas kyang don gzhan la sbyor ba yin gyi/ skyes bu de la bod sna mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /kye bum pa khyer shog ces pa lta bu/ kye zhes pa kho na bod pa yin/ bum pa khyer shog ces pa las la skul ba tsam yin kyang /ming med pa rnam dbye'i gzhi stong snyam na 'di 'dra rigs la ming dngos su med kyang khong na yod de/ dang po ming yod pa tshig phrad phyis pa'o/ /mngon du phyogs pa zhes mngon gyur du bshad pa la/ gnyis ka phan tshul mngon du gyur pa yang yod/ bod pa pos ma mthong la/ 'bod rgyu'i yul gyis mthong ba la yang yod kyi/yul des 'bod pa po dang bos pa'i sgra mi rig na/ ā ma spro'i don gyi bod pa ma yin te/ bod pa po la de mngon du gyur kyang / de la bod pa po'am skad mngon du ma gyur na/ khu stong dang 'dra bar 'gyur bas so/ /dper brjod ni/ māX sa mu khyur go bin+da pra sī da pa ra me shwa ra/ ku mā ro swe ra mā swā thāX k+ṣa ma dh+waX bho ta ba sī naX/ de bsgyur na/ bdag la rjes su bzungs shig go bin+da/ /rab tu bsil ba stsol shig dbang phyug mchog /rang 'dod bzhin du 'dug gcig gzhon nu dag /bzod par mdzode cig dka' thub can rnams kye/ /zhes pa ste/ māX bdag la zhes pa —237—

las/ sa murnya ra rjes su bzungs shig bya ba/ go bin+da ni ba lang srungs ste lha khyab 'jug yin la/ bod si phyis pa'o/ /des rigs 'gre ste/ pa ra ma shwa ra/ mchog gi dbang phyug ste 'jig rten byed pa po'i ming yin / bod si phyis pa ste dang po'i gcig tshig gi dpe dang / ku mā ro gzhon nu dag ste/ dang po'i gnyis tshig au byin pa'i rjes dang / ta pa sī naX/ dka' thub can rnams te/ dang po'i mang tshig dzas byin pa'i rnam 'gyur ro/ /༈bho saX/ bho su rnams so/ /'di kha skong gi mdo yin zer/ bod pa'i nang sel yin te dper brjod tsam mo/ /stos la sogs pa rnams ni/ sgos bha gos a sgos gsum mo/ /'di dag ni tshig phrad kyi bya ba dang 'brel lo/ k+ṣa ma su bho du rā rā khyu/ bha go stu bhāX na ma stu te/ a dhiṣ+ṭha bho ma hā pru dz+nyā/ ghā ta yā sgo swa lha sma raX/ de bsgyur na/ bzod par mdzod cig dka' bas skyob pa kye/ /skal ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo bstod par bgyi/ /bshad par mdzod cig shes rab chen po kye/ /bdag gi sdig pa ce gros shig sdig med kye/ /snyam swa bya ba'o/ /sgos la si si dang sa yal/ bho ni bod pa nyid do/ co a rā ju ni byed po'o/ /he bha gos don la yod sa yal/ /bod pa'o/ /he a stos/ don la yod/ a sgos si dang /sa yal/ gha ta ya'i ya la a sbyar ring por song pa'o/ /bdag gi ni las so sdig choms bya ba'o/༈ sho khriXka rle ka shā su dha na yorda na ā tre bi she khri brjo saX ban+ta dh+wa ra bha ba yoXlhag ma bya ba dang byed pa bos sgrub pa'i thabs dang / sbyin pa'i snod dang / bye zhing lhung pa dang / 'brel ba dang rten du gyur pa dag la'o/ /de ltar rnam dbye —238—
