ka n+ya ya ṭa nga si/ dzā ta si/ ya as/ 'dra ring / sa rnam bcad/ si rnam bcad/ka n+ya yāXdzā taX/ bu mo las skyes pa zhes pa ste/ bu mo gzhon nu ma khyo med kyi nal bu'o/ /don de la ka n+ya yī na/ ṇi tra kyi ming can la dang por 'phel ba dang / ya dbyi ba'ang ngo zhes/ mdo 'dis na'i ya btags phyis/ i a'i dbyi/ rkyen la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ kā nī naX/ ༈pu byushā yuk+ta si/ 'di pho rtags yin pas/ ṭā i na/ pu rnyu ṇa yuk+taX/ skar ma rgyal dang 'dus pa ste/ rgyal gyi zla ba'i don yin/don de la/ pu bya aṇa ṇa rjes 'brel/ dang por 'phel ba/ mdo 'dis ya btags phyis/ i a dbyi/ rkyen gyi a la drangs/ si/ po khaX/ rgyal gyi zla ba rang gi ming yin/ ༈yang po lga mo rtags kyi rkyen snyi pu sbyin/ po ṣa klu pu pra rjes 'brel/ i a dbyi/ drangs pas/ po khri zhes pa grub ste/ rgyal gyis nya ba ste/rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs te yar ngo'i tshes bco lnga pa'o/ ༈ /yang mo rtags kyi rkyen zhis spangs te/ de phan gyi yī na byin na/ rtags mtha'i a phyis/ drangs/ ṣa ra ṛ sogs na ṇa si/ po khyi ṇa/ rgyal gyis nya ba'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ pu rna mā sa la/ aṇa sbyin pas/ rnge rte mā sa/ de la zhwas gyi rkyen sbyar bas/ rnge rte mā sī/ zla ba nya gang ba'am zla ba rdzogs pa ste/ yar ngo'i tshes bco lnga pa'o/ ༈'dir 'phros don nyer mkho bshad na/ ma ghā ṭā yuk+ta si/ 'di mo rtags u pra mtha' yin pas rtags mtha' e/ e da/ ma gha yā yuk+taX/ zhes tshig sbyor ro/ /rnam dbye'i rjes sogs phyis ma ghā aṇa/ dang por 'phel ba/ rtags mtha'i srog phyis/ drangs/si mā ghaX/ mchu'i zla ba/ ༈mā gha snyi pu/ rtags mtha'i a phyis/ drangs/ mā sgyi/yang na yī na byin/ ma sgyi naX/ ma cas nya ba'i tshes so/ ༈de bzhin du/ phalgu ṇa la —341—

yang tshig sbyor de dang 'dra/ aṇa sbyar bas/ phu lha ṇa/ dbo'i zla ba/ ༈de la zhis sbyar bas/ phu lhu ṇi/ yī na byin na/ phu lha ṇi na/ dbo yis nya ba'o/ ༈de kho na ltar/tsi tra aṇa/ tsi tra/ nag pa'i zla ba'o/ tsi tra zhis/ tsi khyi/ yang na yī na/ tsi hi ṇa/nag pas nya ba'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ bi shā ji aṇa/ be+e shā kha/ sa ga'i zla ba'o/ ༈be+e shā kha zhis/ bai shā khri/ yang na/ yī na/ be+e shwa/khri na/ sa gas nya ba'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ nga aṇa/ la snron gyi zla ba'o/ ༈dze sgra snyis/ rje spyi/ yang na/ yī na/ ho na/snron gyis nya ba'i tshes so/ ༈chu stod sogs zla ba gsum gyi ming / rgyal dang 'dra bar pho rtags yin/ tshig sbyor gyi skabs su/ ṭā i na byed/ gzhan 'dra ste/ a khri lha aṇa/ ā khri khyu/ chu stod kyi zla ba'o/ ༈ā khyi khyu zhi pra/ ā khri dhī/ yang na/ yī na/ ā khri khyi na/ chu stod kyis nya ba'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ shā ba ṇa/ aṇa/ shā ba ṇa/gro bzhin zla ba'o/ ༈grwa ba ṇa/ zhis/ shā ba ṇi/ yang na yī na/ grwa ba ṇi na/ gro bzhin gyis nya ba'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ bha dra pa da/ aṇa/ bhā dra pa da/ khrums stod kyi zla ba'o/ /bhā dra pa da zhwas/ bhā dra pa dī/ yang na/ yī na/ bhā dra pa dī na/ khrums stod kyis nya ba'i tshes so/ ༈tha skar gyi skad dod/ a shi nī/ zhes pas mo rtags snyi pra mtha' yin pas/ tshig sbyor gyi skabs/ rtags mtha'i yī ni yu ru bsgyur/ṭa'i ā la drangs pas/ a tha/ rgyu yuk+taX/ zhes pa dgos/ a shrī nī aṇa/ dang por 'phel ba/ rtags mtha'i yī ring po phyis/ drangs/ ā shi na/ tha skar gyi zla ba'o/ /༈ā shī na/ zhis/ ā shi nī/ yang na/ sī na/ ā shi nī na/ tha skar gyis nya ba'o/ ༈kṛ ti kā mo rtags te tshig sbyor ma grwa'i skabs dang 'dra/ kṛ ti kā aṇa/ka rta na ka/ smin drug gi zla ba'o/ ༈ka rta di kā/ klus/ kwa rte gī/ yang na/ yī na/—342—

kartiki na/ smin drug gis nya ba'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ mṛ ga shi ra/ 'di pho rtags yin/ tshig sbyor rgyal gyi skabs dang 'dra/ mṛ ga shi ra aṇa/ mu rga shi ra/ mgo'i zla ba'o/ ༈mu rga shi ra zhi pra/ mu rga shi rī/ yang na/ yī na/ mu rga shi rī na/ mgo yis nya ba'i tshes so/ zla ba dang tshes kyi rtags mthar/ si rnam bcad sogs rnam dbye sbyar na bya ba rdzogs pa yin la/ zla ba'i skad dod kyi mthar/ zhwa pra dang yī na ster ba'i sngon du/ rnam dbye'i rjes yod na phyis aṇa gyi rjes yod yod pa de ka la ster dgos te/ nya ba'i tshes ni zla ba de nyid kyi nang sel yin pas so//'on kyang skabs 'di'i i a dbyi ba de ni/ aṇa gyi a dbyi ba de nyid yin mod kyi/ yī yi rkyen dang sbyar bas aṇa gyi dod thub yī rkyen gnyis po ṇa rjes 'brel ma yin kyang / dang po'i 'phel ba ma nyams par gnas so/ /de yan chad kyis ka dang yī na 'phros don dang bcas pa song / ༈yī ya'i rkyen gyi bya ba mtshon byed ni/k+ṣa tra yī ya/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si/ k+ṣa khyi yaX/ yang na aṇa byin/ dang por 'phel ba/ gzhan 'dra/ nywa traX/ gdugs dang ldan pa'am/ dpa' bos bskor ba zhes bya ste rgyal po'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ shu kra ngi bha ba shu kre bha ba/ ngi sogs dbyi/shu kra yī ya/ si da/ shu khyi yaX/ a ṇa sbyar na/ si rnam bcad/ sho kraX/ ༈in+d+ra yī ya/ irnyi yaX/ aṇa sbyar na/ in+d+raX/ dbang po'i tshogs pa'o/ ༈i ka'i rkyen gyi bya ba ni/ ak+ta nyis/ ngi bya te/ asne rdi bya te/ dhis sogs phyis/ ak+ṣa e ka thog mar 'phel ba/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ ā k+ṣa kaX/ rab tu gsal ba'i mig go ༈sha rdi ngi bha ba/ sha sde bha ba/ ngi sogs phyis/ shabha i ka/ 'phel ba/ mtha' phyis/ drangs/ si/ shwa sdi kaX/ sgra'i nang nas zhes pa'o/—343—

༈de bzhin du/ be da ngi bha baX/ be de bha baX ste rig byed kyi khongs nas 'byung ba'o/ /'byung ba'i don la i ka ste/ be da i ka gong bzhin bsgrubs pas/ be+e di kaX༈ta rke bha ba/ rtog ge'i nang na yod pa zhes tshig tu sbyar ba yin/ tan i ka gong bzhin/ tarki kaX/༈ t+ya ta no/ tu dang ta na dag go /ki mu la sogs pa dang / a bya la sogs pa rnams la sngar bshad pa ltar gyi 'byung ba la sogs pa'i don du/ tu gyi rkyen dang tana'i rkyen ster te/ ki mu 'gyur ba'i/ ku tra la/ tu sbyar bas/ ku tra rmaXsi rnam bcad/ ༈ku taXl tu sbyar bas rnam bcad kyi sa ta la drangs pas/ ku ta sduXsi rnam bcad/ ci yang rung ba la zhes pa'o/ ༈ta tra la/ kyi sbyar/ si rnam bcad/ ta tra tuX/ der de la zhes so/ ༈a du la/ ta na sbyar si/ a du ta naX/ de ring byung ba/ ༈sa dā la/ ta na sbyar bas/ sa nā ta naX/ rtag tu byung ba/ ༈phyaXl ta na sbyar/ si rnam bcad/ sa drangs/ hra lha naX/ kha sang zhes pa'o/༈gshe pi/ rang gi don la yang ngo / /sems can du gtogs pa'i skyes bu rang so so'i dngos po brjod pa la/ rang gi don zhes bya ste/ de la'ang sngar bshad pa'i rkyen de dag ci rigs par 'jug go /dpen na/ de ba dat+ta si e ba ba theg si phyis/ de ba dat+ta e ba/ lha sbyin 'di'o zhes sam/ 'di ni lha sbyin no/ /zhes pa tshig sbyor ro/ /de ba dat+ta ka dang por 'phel ba/ si rnam bcad/ di ba dat+ta kaX/ ༈tsa tā ra brta e ba/ rigs bzhi po 'di rnams zhes pa ste/ de'i don la/ tsa tu rba rte khyu/ ṇa rjes 'brel/ dang por 'phel ba/ i a phyis/ drangs/si da/ tsā tu rba rtsuX/ ༈tso ra/ e ba/ rkun mo 'di zhes pa'i don/ tsa dzir aṇa/—344—

dang por 'phel ba/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ tso raX/ ༈'grel par lung drangs pa/ aṇa ā+oṃ na dag gi yurmi da asmad dag ta ba ka la sogs pa'o/ /zhes 'byung bas tshur rol pu mid dang asmad la/ pha rol aṇa dang yī na'i rkyen gang byung yang / yu yid ta ba ka dang / yu'i ka gang rung du 'gyur la/ asmad ma ma ka dang / asma ka gang drang du 'gyur/ zhes pa ste/ ༈yurmi da dang / asmad kyi pha rol tu/ aṇa re re bzhag yu khyud ta ba ka dang / asmad ma ma kar bsgyur/gnyis ka la dang por 'phel ba dang / i a phyis/ drangs/ se mi a ma da/ ༈tā ba kaX/༈mā ma kaX ༈yang zhin byin na yang sgrub tshul de kho na dang 'dra bas/ tā ba gī naX/༈mā ma ki naX/ ༈yang / rdza snga kyi rnam 'gyur yu ba yo dang / asmad kyi rnam 'gyur/ ā ba yo la so sor aṇa re re bzhag yu yi ni/ sdo yang / dang / asmad a smra ka ru bsgyur/ dang por 'phel ba/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/༈yo rmi kaX/ ༈u smra kaX/ ༈de bzhin du/ yu ba yo dang / a ba yo la/ yī na byin/sgrub tshul snga ma dang 'dra/ ༈yo shā gī na/ ༈u smu gī naX/༈bstu mye/ bta mnyam pa la'o/ /mnyam pa ste phan tshun 'dra ba'i don la/rkyen bta sbyor ba yin te/ dper brjod na/ tsan+di ṇa sa dra shaX mu khaX/ zla ba dang mtshungs pa'i gdong zhes pa ste tshig sbyor ro/ /tsan+t+ra ba ta rkyen du byin/ /mthar mu kha bzhag go /bta kyi trad da nar bsgyur/ drangs/ si da/ tsan+d+ra banu khaX/zla ba 'dra ba'i gdong ngo / ༈de bzhin du/ gha ṭi na sa dra shaX u da ri/ bum pa dang 'dra ba'i lto ba/ zhes pa ste de'i don la/ en dang sa dṛ shaX phyis te/ bta rkyen du byin/ tra dra ru bsgyur/ drangs pas/ bha ṭa ba du da raX/ ༈bhā be ta twa yaṇa/ gyur pa —345—

la ta twa yaṇa 'o/ rgya skad du bhā ba zhes pa skabs thob kyi don mang po la 'jug kyang / 'dir gyur pa zhes pa mtshan nyid kyi don no/ /yang rang bzhin du yod par gyur pa'am khyad chos su yod par gyur pa'i don te/ tsha bar 'gyur pa me/ gsher bar 'gyur pa chu/ zhes pa dang / nog lkog shal can du yod pa ba lang / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar na mtshan nyid kyi don la/ rkyen ta dang twa dang yaṇa rnams 'jug go ༈bru rmi ṇa phya bhā ba/ bram ge la yod pa'am/ bram ze'i mtshan nyid de/ tshangs skud can mtho nge ste/ bram zer 'dug ces pa lta bu'o/ /pru rmi ṇa rkyen ta sbyar/ u pra byin/ mtshungs 'dra/ pru rmi tā bram zer gyur pa'am/ bram zer 'dug ces pa'o/de yang ta mtha'i rtag tu bud med kyi rtags so/ /zhes pas rkyen ta yig la bud med kyi u pra ster dgos/ ༈twa yaṇa ma ning nyid do/ /zhes pas rkyen de gnyis byin na ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur/ bru rmi ṇa la rkyen twa sbyar/ si da/ bru smi ṇa twaX/༈bru rmi ṇa la rkyen yaṇa byin/ ṇa rjes 'grel/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si da/ bru rmi khyuX/ ༈de bzhin du/ su ma nas/ yaṇa ṇa rjes 'brel/ dang por 'phel ba i a phyis/ drangs/ si da/ so ma na suX/ ༈de bzhin du/ su bha ga yaṇa/ so bha gyaX/༈de bzhin du/ bi du ṣa yaṇa/ be+e du byaX/ ༈yang 'grel bar/ mnyam par tshogs pa la ta yi yon tan yang ngo / /zhes bshad pas/ tri u mu/ sa mā hā ra/ de la nus byin/ i da ru bsgyur/ tra yā ṇaX sa mā hā ra/ gsum po rnams mnyam par tshogs pa/ zhes pa ste/ rig byed gsum mam/ me gsum mam/ yon tan gsum tshogs pa lta bu ste/ gang ci yang rung ba gsum tshogs pa'o/ /rnam dbye sogs phyis pas tri ru log /de la rkyen ta yig sbyar/ bud med kyi u pra byin pa na/—346—

mnyam 'dus kyi don yin pas/ rkyen tā ring po'i nus pa la/ tri'i i yig ni yon tan e yig tu 'gyur ro/ /tre tā ces pa grub/ bod skad du/ gsum tshogs pa ste/ gsum ldan gyi dus la/ tre tā yu ga zer ba bzhin no/ ༈de bzhin du/ dza na nus u mu/ sa mā hā ra/ /si de dag sbyar bas/ dza nā nāX sa mā hā raX/ skyes bo mang po rnams mnyam par 'dus pa/ zhes pa'o/ /tshig gi sbyor ba de'i don la dza na la ta'i rkyen sbyar/ mo rtags kyi rkyen u pra/ dza na tā zhes pa grub/ a thung gi yon tan ni a thung yin pas rnam 'gyur med do/ ༈yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/las rnams la yang yaṇa 'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ bru rmi ṇa gya karma na si/ zhes pa bzhag si dang rtags mtha'i na phyis/ bram ze'i las zhes pa'o/ /rnam dbye sogs phyis/ brad+ma ṇa la yaṇa byin/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si da/ bru rmi khyoX/༈yang rā dz+nya i dmu karma/ rgyal po'i las 'di zhes pa tshig sbyor ro/ /de rnams phyis te/ rā dzan yaṇa/ cha gnyis bzhag /na yi yang na'o zhes pas/ lugs gcig la na srog med khre'i srog a dang bcas pa phyis/ dzu ya la drangs/ si rā rju/ ༈lugs cig shos la na dbyangs med ya la drangs/ gzhan 'dra/ rā dza n+yaX/༈lo hi tā de ṇ+ḍi gi man/ lo hi ta la sogs pa'i i man ni ni ta to/ /lo hi ta la sogs pa'i rtags la mtshan nyid du rkyen i man ster te/ i man la ni ta kyi tha snyad 'jog cing / ni tra ces btags pa'i dgos pa ni/ ṭi dbyi ba'i phyir ro/ /lo hi ta gya bha ba/ dmar po'i masno nyid te/ dmar po rang la yod pa'i ngang tshur te mtshan nyid don chos la 'jog pa dang go ba gcig go /lo hi ta/i man ṭi phyis/ ta i la drangs/ si/ u ba dh+wa ring po/ si phyis/ na yang phyis te/—347—

lo hi ti mā/ ༈de bzhin du/ a ṇa da bha ba si nga ldan la u o/ ngas kyi a phyis/sa rnam bcad/ ru drangs/ a kho rta baX/ phra mo'i mtshan nyid ces pa'i don la/ a ṇa i man ḍi ta la ṭi/ drangs/ si/ u pa dh+wa/ si dang mtha'i na phyis/ a ṇi mā/༈ṛ ra i ma ṇi/ re'i ra i man la'o/ ṛ yig dang por yod pa'i rtag la i man gyi rkyen sbyar na/ ṛ yig ni ra srog ldan du 'gyur ro/ ༈bṛ thu ngas bha ba/ bṛ tho rta ba/ rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid/ ces so/ /rnam dbye sogs phyis nas/ mṛ thu i man bzhag pa'i srog gi ṛ phral/ ṛ ra srog ldan/ pra dbyangs med ra la drangs/ ṭi phyis/ mthar si/ na'i u pa bhā si dang na phyis/ pra thi mā/ (dro dhi i man/ dra dhi mā/ brtan pa'i mtshan nyid ces bya/ de bzhin du/ mṛ du i man/ mra di mā/ 'jam po'i rang bzhin zhes so/༈ba ho rlo po dh+wa tsa ba hoX/ ba hu yi ba hu las dbyi zhing bhu yang ngo / /ba hu'i sgra la pha rol tu smra man gyi rkyen byung na/ rkyen gyi i yig mi snang bar 'gyur zhing / ba hu nyid yongs rdzogs bhā ring por bsgyur ba yin no/ 'grel par ba hu'i phyi ma rnams kyi zhes dang/ i man la sogs pa'i zhes 'byung bas/ i man du ma zad rkyen du ma la yang ngo / ༈de yang / ba hu i man zhes pa bzhag go /ba hu'i nus pas rkyen gyi a phyis/ de'i nus pas ba hu zhes pa bhu ring por bsgyur/mthar si/ u pa bhā ring bo/ rnam dbye dang ṇa phyis pas/ bhu mā/ mang po rnams kyi mtshan nyid ces bya'o/ ༈'grel bar/ ba hu'i gnas su zhes 'byung ba ni/ ba hu phyis nas de'i shul du bhu bzhag ces pa'i don no/ /a sdu rje ma tu pu/ yod pa'i don la ma tu pra'o/ gang gi'am gang la yod pa de'i don la/ ma tu pra kyi rkyen ster —348—

ba yin no/ /pu rjes 'brel/ u yig ni nus ster dgos pa'i don yin/ go ma tu pu/ pra rjes 'brel/ u dgos don/ u dang ṛ dag gi nus mo/ zhes pas ma dang tra'i bar du nus ā ga ma byin/ go man tra si zhes pa byung / a tu dang sa'i si la'o zhes pas mā ring por bsgyur/ si phyis/ rab sbyor mtha' las tra yang phyis/go mun/ zhes pa grub/ de'i don ni tshig sbyar ba la/ go a phya e ste i ti/'di'i ba lang yod pa nyid do zhes pa ste/ lha sbyin gyi ba lang yod zhes pa lta bu/bdag po dang 'brel ba yod pa dang / lhas na ba lang yod ces pa lta bu gnas gzhi'i don gnyis ka ston to/ skabs don so so'i dbang gis so/ /ba lang 'di zhes pa ni mngon gyur gyi sgra yin/ ba lang yang yin 'di yang yin pas gzhi mthun bsdu ba yin no/ ༈yang go ma tu pu/ pra rjes 'brel/ u rtags don/ go ma ta/ i kra sbyin/ kra rjes 'brel/ drangs/ go ma ti/ don snga ma dang 'dra/ ༈de bzhin du/ shrī a spya askyi ti/ zhes pa'am/ shrī bi du te ya phya dpal yod pa gang gi zhes pa'am/ gang la yod pa'i dpal zhes pa'o/ /de'i don la/ shrī ma tub bzhug nus mā ring po si phyis/ shrī mun ta/ rab sbyor mtha' la tra yang phyis te/ shrī mun/ ༈yang na shrī dang / ma tu pu/ bzhag shrī ma tra du song / zhi ka kra rjes 'brel/ shrī ma tī/༈a i ko ma twa zla/ ma tu'i don la a dang i ka dag go /'dir ma tu'i don zhes pa/ ma tu dang dgos don gcig pa'i don te/ gong bzhin yod pa'i don nyid la sbyor ro/ ༈be+e dza yan+ti bi du ti ya gya/ do shal yod pa gang gi'am gang la zhen/ pa'o/ /be+e dza yi n+ta a zhen/ pa bzhag/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si —349—

rnam bcad/ be+e dza yan+taX/ ༈yang mā ya i ka yang i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ mā yi kaX/ sgyu ma can yod ces sam/ nor can yod ces pa'o/༈mu rnyo pa dh+wa dwa tī no/ mā dang a'i mtha'i u pa dh+wa las ba ta i na dag gom yig mtha' can dang / ma yig u pa dh+wa yod pa dang / a yig mtha' can dang /a yig u pa dh+wa yod pa ste/ rtags mtha' bzhi po de la ba tu dang / ina'i rkyen ster te/ 'dir ba tu zhes pa u ni gong bzhin nus ster ba'i don yin pas phyis te/ rkyen ba tra nyid do/ /rkyen 'di dag kyang yod pa'i don nyid te/ ༈dper brjod na/ bha go li du te ya gya/ skal ba yod pa gang la zhes pa ste/ ga'i na ro ni si rnam bcad u'i rjes yin no/ /na ro sogs phyis te/ bha ga ba tra zhes bzhag ba dang ta zhi bar du nus bā ring po/ si phyis/ rab sbyor mtha' tra yang phyis/ bha ga bān grub/ bcam ldan nam/ skal ldan nam/ legs ldan te/ a mtha' la rkyen bta ster pa'i dper brjod do/ ༈de bzhin du/ dha na bi tu te ya gya/ gang la nor yod pa zhes bya'o/ /dha na in/ i a phyis/ dha nin/ si nī ring po/ si phyis nā mi'i mtha' la na phyis/ dha nī/ ༈de dang 'dra bar/ nywa khyi/ daṇ+ḍi/ kwa grwa/ da sī sogs kyang sgrub tshul de khas sgrub/ ༈sha ma si bi t+ya te ya su/ si rnam bcad/ u rtags mtha' o/ sha mo bi du te ya su/ gang la zhi ba'i ngang tshul yod pa zhes so/ /na ro man chad phyis te/ sha ma la in byin no/ kha ma in/ i a phyis/drangs/ sha min/ mthar si/ u pa bhā ring po/ si phyis/ nā mi'i mtha' las na yang phyis/ sha sī zhes pa ste/ a mtha' la rkyen in ster ba'i dpe'o/ ༈yang dṛ ṣa ṭa pha rol du/ ba tra ṭā dā ru song / ba la drangs/ mo rtags kyi rkyen zhi pu byin/ ta —350—

dbyangs med yī ring po la drangs/ dra ṣa dwa tī/ sa gzhi yod pa'o/ /'di ni a u pa dh+wa yod pa la/ rkyen bta phyin pa'i dpe yin/ ༈ki mu bta zhes pa bzhagasi/ ba dang tra'i bar du nus/ u pa dh+wa ring po/ si phyis/ rab sbyor mtha' la ta/ki tshwan/ mu yig mtha' can gyi dpe'o/ ༈yang la snye ba tra sri nus/ u ba dh+wa ring /si dang rab sbyor mtha' phyis/ lasgyi bān/ ma u pa dha'i dpe'o/ ༈ta ḍi dā di khyulgata ḍi tra la sogs pa rnams las kyang ngo / /ta ḍi tra la sogs pa'i sgra la yang /ba tra dang i na'i sgra sngar bzhin 'jug go /ta ḍa tra ba tra tra ba la drangs pas/ ta ḍi twa tra/ si nu sogs sngar bzhin/ ta ḍi tā na/ rlung ngam dbang po yod ces so/ /de bzhin du/ ma ru ta ba ta/ ma ru twa tra/ si nu sogs sngar bzhin/ ma ru tan/ rlung yod pa'o/ ༈e ta ta kim yad tad rnams las so/ /zhes 'byung bas/ tshad ston pa'am sa mtshams gcod pa'i don la/ e ta ta la sogs pa bzhi pa de rnams la/ bta kyi rkyen sbyin par bya ste/yat+ta do rā/ yad tad dag la u'o/ yad dang tad kyi mthar bta kyi rkyen byin pa na/ ṭi ste rtags mtha' ni ā yig ring por 'gyur ro/ ༈yad bta de tsam zhes pa bzhag yad kyi srog dang mtha' brten ta sbrags pa ā ring bor bsgyur/ si nus sogs sngar bzhin sbyar bas/ yā zhes so bān gang tsam/ ༈tad ba tā tad kyi ṭi ā ring por gyur/ si nus sogs sbyar ba sngar bzhin/ tā bān de tsam/༈kimaXrdu ki mu ni ki ste ya yang ngo / /ki mu gyi sgra la bta kyi rkyen sbyar ba na/ kimu nyid ki ru bsgyur ba dang / rkyen bta kyi ba yig ni ya yig tu 'gyur —351—

ro/ /ki mu bta ki mu ni rkyen bta mthong bas ki zhes par/ bsgyur zhing / de mthong bas bta kyi ba ya yig tu bsgyur/ ki ya tra zhes pa byung / de la si nu sogs gong bzhin sbyar/ ki mun/ ci tsam pa'o/༈ā snge ta do bā/ ā dang i'ang e ta ta dag la'ang na'o/ /e ta ta kyi sgra la ni/ bta kyi rkyen byin na/ yang na ṭi ni ā ring por bsgyur ba dang / yang na i ru bsgyur ba yin la/ ā dang i'ang zhes pa'i 'ang gi sgras ṭi kho na e yig tu bsgyur ba ma yin gyi/ e ta tra yongs su rdzogs pa ir bsgyur ba dang / rkyen gyi ba ya yig tu bsgyur ba'ang yin no/ ༈e ta ta bta zhes pa tshar gnyis bgagacig gi ṭi ā ring bor bsgyur bas/ e tā bta byung / de la si nus sogs sngar bzhin—bsgrubs pas/ e tā bān/ ༈cig ye tshes la e ta ta zhes pa i ru bsgyur/rkyen gyi ba ya ru song / i ya tra ces pa byung / si nus sogs sngar bzhin bsgrubs pas/ i yun zhes pa'o/༈spyan dā de ri laX/ tu sdo sogs la i la'o/ /tsasdo a su asti/ 'di yi lte ba yod pa zhes bya ba ste/ yod pa'i don ni dngos po'o/ /yang tī bya ma tshur bsgyur ba'ang yod/ do zhes pa si'i rjes so/ /rnam dbye sogs phyis te/ tu n+da la i la zhes pa rkyen bzhag i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ shu rje laX/༈au la sogs pa'i khongs na/ spyir mang po yod mod kyang / 'dir dper brjod ni/ ud ra'i sgra ste/ ud ro a su a ste/ 'di yi gsus pa'i dngos po zhes so/ /u da ra i la/ ra'i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ u da ri laX/༈o sno bye da stu du raX/ o sno dan+t+ra las u ru'o/ 'dir un ni mtho ba/ da.ā+oṃ—352—

ni so ste/ o sno te dan+ta ni/ tshes mtho ba'i so ste/ so ring zhing sbom pa'o/ tshig sbyor ni de kho na yin mong / yang ut+na dzas/ dan dzas/ a phya bzhaga.un+taXd stuX.a su/ 'di'i so mtho ba zhes pa'ang yod do/ /de rjes dan+ta la ur gyi rkyen byin/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si/ da skyeraX/༈sha dz+nyā de rluX/ sha ju la sogs pa la lu'o/ kra dz+nyā bi bya te ya gya/ dad pa dang ldan pa gang gi zhes pa'o/ /tha ju ces pa li rkyen lu sbyar/ si/ shudz+nyā luX/ tshig sbyor dang sgrub tshul de kho na dang 'dra ba las/ ༈ni drwa luX/ gnyis dang ldan pa/༈kṛ pā luX/ brtse ba dang ldan pa/ ༈lungs drangs pa/ as mā yā me khyu sra ka rnams las yod pa'i don la bi na 'o/ /zhes bshad pas/ ri kyi mtha' can dang / mā yā dang / me dh+wa dang / /sra ka ces pa'i sgra rnams la yod pa dngos po'i don du/rkyen bin thob pa yin te/ ༈de yang / ta pa la as byin/ i a phyis sbyar bas/ta bas/ zhes pa byung / tshig sbyar ba'am ngag ni sha dz+nyā dang 'dra/ ta bas/ bin sa dbyangs med pa la drangs/ si/ na'i u pa dh+wa ring po/ nā mi'i mthar na dang si phyis/ ta ba sdi/ dka' thub can nam sdom ldan no/ ༈de bzhin du/ mā yā la bin rkyen du byin/ si/ u pa dh+wa ring / na dang si phyis/ mā yā bī/ sgyu ma can nam 'byor pa can no/ ༈me dh+wa la yang sgrub tshul de kho nas/ me dh+wa bī ste blo gros can no/༈sra ka la yang de dang 'dra ba las/ pha rol dza ba mthong ba'i nus pas/ krag ru bsgyur/ ba yi steng du drangs/ de nas si spyin/ dzo/ 'phreng ba dang ldan pa'o/༈bā tso smi niX/ bā tsa la smi ni'o/ bā tsware sgra la dngos po'i don du rkyen gli ni 'jug ste/ bā sngo gli ni zhes pa bzhag rkyen gyi ga yig ni rjes 'brel yin pas phyis/—353—

na'i i yang rjes 'brel dbyi/ bsngo min zhes pa byung / tsu ni pha rol ma yig mthong bas kra ru gyur/ kra ga ru song / rkyen gyi ma'i steng du drangs/ bā ga min sin yi u pa dh+wa/ si dang na phyis/ bā smri/ smra brjod can no/ ༈ā lā ṭo ku ta bhā khri ṇi/ ngan pa'i tshig smra ba la ā la uṭa dag go /bā tsa zhes pa la ā la zhes pa'i rkyen sbyar/ si rnam bcad / bā tsā laX/ smra ba ngan pa can te rdzun chen po/༈yang bātsu zhes pa la rkyen ā ṭa sbyar ba yang / bā tsā ṭaX/ ces te don dang sgrub tshul de kho na dang 'dra'o/༈yī ṣa da pa ri sa mā bho kalpa de khyo de shī yāX/ yongs su rdzogs par ma tshang ba la/ kalpa de ju de shi ya rnams so/ /klog pa la sogs pa dgos pa'i bya ba gang yin de phal cher yongs su rdzogs zin/ lhag ma cung zad ma tshang ba'i bya ba dang ldan pa'i skyes bu yin pa'i don la/ rkyen kalpa zhes pa dang / de khyo dang /de shrī ya rnams 'jug go yī ṣaṭa a pa ri sa mugaXsarba dz+nyaX/ ṭā ḍa ḍa dra ru song / drangs pas/ sī ṣa da 'ong / yongs su rdzogs pa las cung zad ma tshang ba'i thams cad shes/ zhes pa ni ngag go /yī ṣa sogs phyis/ sarba dz+nya bzhag ste/kalpa zhes pa'i rkyen dang sbyar/ si/ sarba dz+nya kalpaX/ ༈de bzhin du/ tshig sbyor 'god pa'i skabs/ yang pa ṭu yī ṣaṭa un zhes pa'o/ /pa ṭu la rkyen de khyo sbyar/si pa ṭu de juX/ cha shas tsam nyams shing phal cher la mkhas pa'i don no/ ༈yang pa shu'i tshab tu ka bi ste ngag go /ka bi la de shī ya sbyar si ka bi de shī yaX/ ma rdzogs pa'i snyan ngag mkhan no/༈pru shaX swā yāX rā paX/ kha bsgyur ba la rū pa'o/ /mi mkhas pa la mkhas —354—

par rdzus pa la sogs pa/ yon tan dang mi ldan pa yon tan dang ldan par 'chos pa/ dper na rtog ge'i gzhung lugs klog dang byas pa tsam la/ rtog ge par khas 'che ba dang / gzhung tshigs bcad gcig kho na shes pa la gzhung rdzogs par shes so zhes rdzu ba ni kha bsgyur ba ste/ 'dir pra sha sto be+e yā ka ra khoXrdzus ma'i brda sprod mkhan po zhes bya'o/ /de'i don la/ be+e yā ka ra ṇa la/ rkyen rū pa sbyar/ si/ be+e yā ka ra ṇa rū paX/ ༈ṭa / nu yaX pā shaX smra ba ngan pa la pā sha'o/ /ku 2 to be+e yā ka ra kho/ brda sprod pa rdzun du smra ba zhes pa'o/ /be+e yā ka ra ṇa la pā sha sbyar/ si be+e yā ka ra ṇa pā shaX/ zhes so/ ༈de bzhin du/ ku khyu to a ghi dzika/ smra ba ngan pa tshig rtsub can no/ a bhi dzika la pā sha sbyar si a bhi ṣa klu shaX/༈ku khri to be+e yā ka ra ho ba hu/ brda sprod pa tshig ngan smra ba mang po'o/ /ba hu la pā sha sbyar/ si/ bā hu pā shaX/༈bhu ta stse tsa ra ṭa/ sngon dus shes pa la tsa ra ṭa'o/ /purbaX srin bi du te ya gya/ sngon dus shes pa gang la yod pa zhes pa'o/ ste lho tsa ra ṭa ṭa rjes 'brel/si rnam bcad/ sgi 〉 tsa raX/༈pru cu khya bi kā ra pra dh+wa rgyu di khu ma ya ṭa/ spyi bungs dang / rnam 'gyur dang /rang dbang du byed pa sogs rnams la ma ya ṭa 'o/ /nang bar ston mo byed rgyu'i zas spyi sprungs mtshan mo g.yos pa dang / rdza so gtong ba sogs bzo'i rnam 'gyur dang / gzhan gyi ngag la rag ma lus par bya ba rang blos byed pa'i gtso bo la sogs pa rnams kyi don la/ rkyen ma ya ṭa 'jug go /an ma pru tsa ra ba smin ya dzhai/ lha mchod kyi zas spyi sbungs 'di la zhes so/ ༈asno zhes pa la rkyen ma —355—

ya ṭa sbyar/ ṭa rjes 'brel/ si rnam bcad/ mthar ya dz+nya zhes/ pa bzhag/ ze ma yo ya dz+nya/ mchod sbyin gyi zas btsos pa'i spyi bungs zhes so/ ༈yang mṛ ta bi ka ra gha ṭā/ sa'i rnam 'gyur bum pa zhes so/ /rmi tra la rkyen ma ya ṭa/ ṭa rjes 'brel/ tra srog med ni ma mthong bas nar song / drangs/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/spo nā yo gha ṭaX/ ༈s+t+ri pra bhā n+ya ma gya sdi ti/ khyim bdag mo bud med 'di yod pa'o/zhes so/ /sdi ces pa la rkyen ma ya ṭa byin/ ṭa rjes 'brel/ si rnam bcad/mthar dzu lpa si bzhag /sdi ma yo grwa smaX/ zhes pa ste/ dzu smaXbud med rang thag gcod mkhan gyi don yin la/ ma ya ṭa kyi rjes ma yo zhes pa kho na/ spyi bungs dang / rnam 'gyur dang / las yod kha shed can ma rnams la skabs thob dang tshig grogs tha dad pa'i dbang gis so sor 'jug go ༈yang phi rtse na a mṛ ta tsan+d+raX/gang ba'i zla bas bdud rtsi spro/ zhes pa ste/ ngag go /a mṛ ta la ma ya ṭa/ sngar bzhin bsgrubs pas/ a mṛ ta ma yaX/ zhe ṇa/ 'byu/nga / a : ta ma ya shu yi / ༷༷/ zhes/ so/ skabs 'dir/ de rig byed kyang klog pa de la 'dir aṇa 'o/ /zhes bshad do/ zhes 'grel bar lung drangs te/ de yang gong du dper brjod la/ be+e yā ka ra ṇa zhes lan mang du byung ba de la 'phros don brjod pa ste/ de yang brda sprod shes par ma zad rig byed kyang bklags shing shes pa la khyad par mchog gi don du aṇa gyi rkyen ster dgos zhes pa'o/ /de la byā ka ra ṇaX a dhī te be ta be ti bā/brda sprod la bklags shing rig byed kyang rig pa/ zhes pa ste ngag bkod pa'o/ /na sa rnyi sbo rmug tsa/ ma yin te mtshams sbyor gyi yu ba dag i us kyang ngo / /de la dper mtshon na/ byā ka ra ṇa'i ming la sgra dang rig byed gnyis ka —356—

shes pa'i don du sgrub pa la/ byā ka ra ṇa'i sgra la dang / rta bzang po ste/ swa shwaX/zhes pa'i sgra la/ rgyud bzang la dngos su 'gro dang gzugs 'dzom pa'i don du sgrub pa la/ aṇa byin pa'i tshe/ rkyen de byin ma thag dang por 'phel ba byed pa ma yin te/ ā ring po nyid 'phel bar gdod nas grub pa yin gyi gsar du 'phel ba byar med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na thog mar yi ge rab sbyor rab tu phye zhing phral/de nas yi ge i yig gam u yig yod pa'i i yu dang u bar bsgyur ba'i mtshams sbyor byed/ de rjes ā ga ma ster te yu yin na sngon du i ṭa dang / ba yin na sngon du uṭa ster/ de'i rjes su aṇa gyi ṇa rjes 'brel gyi nus pa las/dbyangs dang po 'phel ba yang byed do/ /zhes pa'i don yin no/ ༈de la byā ka ra ṇa aṇa zhes pa bzhag /'dir byā zhes pa/ bi dang ā rab tu sbyor ba yin pa las/de gnyis phral zhing phye nas rim pa ma 'chol bar bi gong du bzhag /bi ā ka ra a zhes so/ /bi'i srog gi i ni yu dbyangs med/ yu'i gong du i ṭa ā ga ma bzhag /ṭa rjes 'brel/ ba ri ā ka ra ṇa a zhes pa byung / de yan chad du 'phel ba mi byed/ skabs 'dir bya ste/ nya ṇa rjes 'brel gyi nus pa las/dbyangs dang po i ni/ e ka sha can du 'phel ba byed/ so sor drangs pas/ be+e yā ka ra ṇa a zhes so/ /i a phyis/ ṇa a la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ be+e yā ka ra ṇaX/ legs par grub/ ༈de dang 'dra bar ba yig dang uṭa yi dper brjod ni/so bha no po/ gzugs dang 'gros gnyis ka phun sum tshogs pa'i rta'o/ /don de nyid la/ a shwa zhes pa'i sngon du/ nyer bsgyur su bzhag de gnyis mtshams sbyar/mthar si rnam bcad/ rta bzang ngam rta mchog go /su shwaXtaX be de ti/ rta mchog —357—

der rig go /zhes pa rgyud bzang po go ba ste ngag go /de yang swa shwa aṇa zhes pa bzhug /ṇa rjes 'brel/ swa ni su dang a rab sbyor yin pa las/ de gnyis so sor phral te su gong du bzhag /sa'i srog go u phral nas ba ru bsgyur/ de'i sngon du uskyu bzhag ṭa rjes 'brel/ sa u ba a shwa a zhes pa byung / de yan chad du 'phel ba mi byed/ skabs 'dir bya ste/ ṇa rjes 'brel gyi nus pas/ u ni o kai sha can du bsgyur/ sa au dang ba a la drangs/ shwa'i srog phyis/ rkyen gyi a la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ so ba shwaX/ zhes pa grub ste/ kha cig 'di la bu rgyud kyi don du aṇa byin na/ rta mchog gi rgyud dang / dngos po'i don du byin na 'gros gzugs 'dzom pa'i rta zer ba'ang yod te de/ re re la de tsam mi dgos pas/ngag sbyor gyi skabs las kyang go nus te gnyis ka tshang ba'i don yin no/༈i to dzā twa : / skyes pa'i don la i ta dag go /'dir skyes pa ni phyi rol kyi dngos po ma yin te/ ngo tsha skyes pa dang / dga' ba skyes pa dang / bkres ngal skyes pa sogs sems dang tshor ba'i rnam 'gyur ro/ /don de la i ta'i rkyen ster te/ la sgra ldi ta i a phyis/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ la : taX/ ngo tsha skyes pa/༈sgrub tshul de kho nas/ tri pa i ta si/ tri pi taX/ tshim pa skyes pa/ ༈de bzhin du/khri da i ta si khri di taX/ bkres ngal skyes zhes/ pa'o/༈ta ra ta me ya sri ṣ+ṭhaXpra ka rnye/ ta ra ta ma sī ya su rnge rnams khyad 'phags la'o/ /dngos po khyad par du 'phags pa la phul du byung ba'i don du/ rkyen ta ra dang / ta ma dang / yī ya su dang / nga zhes pa rnams 'jug ste/ dper na/ a ti sha ye na rwaX/ tshes shin du nag po zhes so/ de'i don du/ spos dang rkyen ta ra —358—

ba theg si rnam bcad/ kriṣ+ṭha ta raX/ ༈a ti sha ye na shuklaX/ phul du byung ba'i dkar po'o/ khri'i la rkyen ta ma sbyar si/ shukla ta maX/ ༈'grel par lung drangs pa/ yī ya su dang nga dag ni ta nyid do/ /zhes 'gyung bas/ rkyen de gnyis la ḍi tra kyi ming 'dogs te/ dgos pa ni ṭi dbyi ba'o/ /yī ya su zhes pa'i sa'i u ni nus ā ga ma ster ba'i don te/ ya dang sa'i bar du nus mo/ /dper brjod ni/a ti sha ye na la tshoX/ ches yang ba'am/ tshes nyung ba'i don no/ /la ghu yī ya su/u dgos don/ la tsho yī yas zhes pa byung / ṭi phyis/ gha yī la drangs / mthar si/ u dang ri dag gi nu mu'o/ zhes pas rkyen gyi ya dang su'i bar du nus 'o/ rgyu u pra snya ha ta kyi dhi min pa la ring po'o/ /zhes pas ya ring por gyur/ ha sa klu pu sogs kyis si phyis/ rab sbyor mtha' la sa yang phyis/ la sgyi yun/ zhes pa grub bo/ /cho ga de kho nas/ ༈pā pa yī ya su/ pā bī yun/ tshes sdig pa can/ zhes so/༈mo rtags su sgrub pa la ni/ la ru yī ya su bzhag u rjes 'brel/ ṭi phyis/ gha drangs/ mthar rkyen zhi pra byin/ pra rjes 'brel/ la sgyi ya sī/ shin du yang ba mo/༈yang pā pa la/ yī ya su byin/ ṭi phyis drangs/ mthar zhwa pra ster te/ pā bī ya sī/shin du sdig chen mo/ ༈la tsho la bzhag /ṭi phyis drangs/ si/ la ghi rjaX༈pā pa nga si/ pā pi sdeX/ don snga ma dag dang gcig pas/ 'di thams cad la tshig sbyor du thog mar/ a ti sha ye na kho na sbyar ro/༈gu rbu de ri sne mi ya su ga rā skyi 1 lo rtu gu ru la sogs pa'i nga i ma yī ya su la ga ru la sogs pa ste ṭi dbyi ba ma yin pa yang ngo / gu dra'i sgra la sogs pa'i pha rol tu nga dang / i man dang / yī ya su ste rkyen gsum po de —359—

dag gang byung yang / ga ru du bsgyur ba la sogs pa ā de sha ni byed/ ṭi dbyi ba mi byed do/ /'di la skabs 'gar rtags mtha'i dbyangs dbyi ba yod kyang / ṭi dbyi ba ma yin te/ dper na/ gu ru zhes pa ma 'gyur ba'i skabs/ ṭi phyis na gu ru zhes par 'gyur yang / slar ā de sha byed dgos pas dang por ṭi phyis pa dgos med du 'gyur ba dang / ga ru du bsgyur nas ṭi phyis na/ mthar brten ru dang ga'i srog gnyis ka yal bas gra srog med 'ba' zhig lus yong ba/ grub pa'i gzugs ga rī ya dang 'gal bar 'gyur te/ gi yan du thal bas so/ des na 'di ltar bya ste/ a ti sha ye na gu ruX/ phul du byung ba'i bla ma'o/ /don de la/gu ru yī ya su zhes pa bzhug /gu ru ga ru du bsgyur/ ru drangs/ si nus/ /rgyu mtha' las ring po/ ha sa dang / rab sbyor las si dang sa phyis/ ga rī yun/ ༈gu ru dro ga ru du song / drangs/ si rnam bcad/ ga sngeX/ ༈yang gu ru i man zhes bzhug /ga ru du bsgyur/ drangs si na'i u pa dh+wa ring po/ si phyis/ nā mi mtha' las na phyis/ ga ri mā/ ༈'di gsum la yang na tshig sbyar ba la/ dang por gu ru da bha ba si/ zhes pa/ gu rngarja baX/ zhes par 'gyur te/ skal ba dang ldan pa'am legs pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma zhes bya/ 'dir gu dra'i sogs khongs nas mang po 'byung yang / mtshon byed ni/ ngag sbyor gyi skabs/ a ti sha ye na/ zhes pa la pri ya sbyar ba dang / snyu la sbyar ro/ ༈phri ya yī ya su/ zhes pa bzhag /pri ya ni pra zhes par bsgyur/ a i la e/ pre yas si nus/ na sa mtha' la ring po ha sa dang rab sbyor las dbyi ste/ pre yun/ ༈yang gu rle'i sgra dran par bya/ pri ya nga si la/ rjaX/ pri ya i man/ pra a 6khol e si na'i u pa bhā/ si dang / na —360—

dbyi/ pre mā/ phul du byung ba'i dga' ba'am snying nye ba'o/ ༈yang snyu la yī ya su bzhag /snya la ni/ s+tha ba zhes par bsgyur/ i a las phyis/ drangs/ si nus sogs gong ji zhin bsgrubs pas/ s+tha gī yun/ ༈snya la/ i nga ba theg s+tha ba zhes par bsgyur/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si/ s+tha bi jiX/ ༈yang snyu la i man/ s+tha ba i a phyis drangs/ si na'i u pa bhā/ ha sa las si phyis/ nā mi las na phyis/s+tha bi mā/ ches shin du sdom pa'o/ ༈sī lo po dz+nyā sha sdu dī ya saX/ dz+nyā gyi sgra las yī ri kyi yī dbyi'o/ /bri dha zhes pa'i sgra'i pha rol tu yī yas kyi yī yig ni dbyi ba dang / birnya ni dz+nyā zhes par bsgyur ro/ /de la tshig sbyor ni/ a ti sha e na bri dhaX/ches shin du rgyas pa'am/ ches shin du rgan po'o/ /de yang bri dha sī yas zhes pa bzhag rkyen de'i nus pas bri dha ni dz+nyā zhes par/ ā de sha ste bsgyur bar bya'o/ /de 'gyur ba'i nus pas rkyen gyi yī ring po phyis/ si nus u pa dh+wa ring /si dang sa phyis/ dz+nyā yun/ ༈pri dha la bzhag a i la e/ si/ sdu ṣ+ṭhaXzi/ dz+nyā gyi sgra'i 'phros don/di rgyu dang / pra sha'i sgra ni/ ā de sha byed pa la 'phros pa yin gyi /yī phyis par byed pa ni ma yin no/ /a ti sha ye na di rgyuX/ tshes cher ring po'o/ /de'i don la di rgyu yī yas bzhag /di rgyu zhes pa ni/ drwa gha zhes par bsgyur/ rkyen gyi yī la drangs/ si nus sogs gong bzhin bsgrubs pas/ drwa snri yun/ ༈de bzhin du/ di rgyu i ṣ+ṭha drwa gha si/ drwa jeX/ ༈yang a ti sha ye na pra shaX/gtso bo phul du byung ba'o/ /pra sha yī yas ba 'ag /pra sha zhes pa ni/ shra ces par bsgyur/ a i la e/ si nus sogs sngar bzhin bsgrubs pas/ shri yun/༈yang pra sha la bzhag a i la e/ si/ she khyiX/—361—

༈ba ho ri ste yiX/ ba shu'i rnge la yi'o/ /ba hu'i sgra la pha rol tu i tsho rkyen byung na/ ba hu zhes pa bhā ring po dang / rkyen gyi i ni yi zhes par 'gro ste/a ti sha ye na ba hu/ mang ba'i phul du byung ba'o/ /de'i don la ba hu sna zhes pa bzhug ba hu bhā ru song / rkyen gyi i yir song / si/ /bhū rjaX/ ༈skabs 'dir 'grel pa las lung drangs pa ni/ ki mu dang mi zad pa dang / kun tu bshad pa las kyang / ta ra ta ma dag gi u mu'o/ zhes kha skong gi don du 'byung ste/ de'i don ni/ ki mu gyi sgra dang / mi zad pa'i rtags dang / kun bshad las 'byung ba'i ti sogs kyi rkyen gyi mthar/ ta ra'am/ ta ma'i rkyen byung na/ rkyen de'i mthar u mu ā ga ma ster dgos so/ zhes pa ste/ de yang ki mu la sbyor na 'di ltar/ki mu gyi mthar ta ra sbyar/ de'i mthar u mu ā ga ma byin pas/ zhi ta rāX zhes pa dang / ༈ki mu gyi mthar ta ma zhes pa sbyar/ de la u mu byin pas/ ki ta māX/ zhes pa 'byung ste/ u mu gyi a mtshungs 'dra mtshams sbyor ba dang / mu dbyangs med gnyis rjes su nga ngor byed pa kho na'o/ de'i don ni cig yod dam/ ci yin zhes pa ste/ smad pa'am/ brnyas pa'i tshig la spyor/ dper na/ mi de 'dra rgyal po ci yin zhes pa'am/ dbul po de 'dra la mdzod ci yod ces pa lta bu ste/ ga la yod dang / ga la yin zhes kyang bsgyur bar bya'o/ /mi zad pa la sbyor pa'i dper brjod ni/ ku taX ta ra/ u sra zhes pa bzhag rnam bcad des ta mthong bas sur song / u mu mtshungs 'dra mtshams sbyar/ mu nga ro/ ku ta sta rā/ de'i don ni/ku ta sta raX pa ra mā ṇa baX/ mchog tu phra ba zhes so/ ༈yang ku taXta ma/ u mu gong bzhin bsgrubs pas/ ku ta sta māX/ zhes pa 'grub/ de'i don ni/ ku ta sta māX te khyiX —362—

ā nga ka twaX/ zhes pa ste/ de rnams rgya chung ngu nyid do/ /zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin du/sdu ༷zhes pa la/ ta ra dang ta ma sbyar/ gnyis ka la u mu byin/ bshad ma thag pa bzhin bsgrubs pas/ un+ti sta rāX/ ༈u/sko māX/ zhes pa 'byung ste/ de dag gwa yan ti zhes pa dang sbyar/ skad gsangs mthon pos smra bar byed do/ /skad chen pos glu len par byed do/ ༈ti sogs kyi mthar sbyor ba'i dpe ni/ pa tsa ti ta ra u mu/pa ṭha ti ta ma u mu/ gong bzhin/ ༈pa tsa ti ta rāX/ shin du 'tshed par byed do/༈pa ṭha ti ta māX/ ches klog par byed do/ /zhes so/ ༈kun tu bshad pa las kyang zhes pa'i/ kyang gi sgras krita rkyen gyi mthar yang / ta ra dang ta ma la u mu ā ga ma ster ba yin yang zer ro/༈pa ri mā ṇi da rtswa da yaX/ tshad la da ghā la sogs pa'o/ /de la gang yang rung ba'i rgya dpangs dang / ring thung dang bong tshod dang / mchu zheng la sogs pa dang / chu'i zabs la sogs pa'i sa mtshams yongs su gcod pa dang / tshad ston par byed pa la/ khri dang / mā tra dang / dwa yas/ ༈zhes pa ste rkyen gsum po de rnams 'jug go /dngos po'i ngo bo bzang ngan gyi tshad ston pa lta bu'i tshad la ni rkyen 'di rnams mi 'jug cing / grangs kyi tshad dang dus kyi tshad ston pa la/ mā tra zhes pa mang du 'jug gzhan gnyis por res 'ga' cud zad tsam 'jug go ༈de yang dzā nu si pa ri mā ṇaX dza la si si dang po phyis/ phyi ma da/ a phyis/ dzā nu pa ri mā ṇaX dzalaX/ chu pus mo nus tsam zhes so/ /don de la dza nu'i mthar da ghā si da drangs/ dzā nu dartswaX/ ༈de bzhin du/ pu ru ṣa mā tra si da/ pu ru ṣa mā traX bṛ k+ṣa/ skyes bu dang mnyam pa'i shing / ༈yang shi da dwa yas/ sa—363—

dbyangs med rnam bcad/ de u/ de o/ mthar si da/ shi ro dwa ya saX daṇ+ḍa/mgo bo'i tshad dang mnyam pa'i dbyug pa zhes so/ ༈yang 'grel bar lung drangs ba/ gnyis sam mang po rnams kyi yang gcig bkar ba la ki mu la sogs pa dag la ḍa ta ra dang ḍa ta ma dag go /zhes 'byung ste gnyis kyi nang nas gcig bkar ba'am mang po'i nang nas gcig bkar ba yin yang rung ste/ don de la ki mu la sogs pa ste/ sogs khogs nas yad dang tad la ḍa ta ra dang ḍa ta ma'i rkyen 'jug go /༈de yang ki mu ḍa ta ra zhes pa bzhag ḍa phyis a bzhagade ni tra yin pas ṭi phyis/ kra srog med a la drangs pas/ ka ta ra/ zhes pa byung /de'i mthar/ bha bta la drug pa'i os byin/ bha ba toXkā ṇaX/ zhes pa gong du bzhag /bha ba toXkā ṇa ka ta ra/ khyed gnyis las ka ṇa'i bu gang yin zhes pa ste/ gcig las gcig bkar ba'i dpe'o/ ༈yang ki mu ḍa ta ma bzhag /ḍa song ṭi phyis/ drangs/ ka ta ma grub/ si rnam bcad/ ka ta maXde'i mthar/ bha bta la drug pa'i skyu mu/ bha ba tāX tu rnyi ka si rnam bcad/ka ta maX/ ma'i rnam bcad u sogs 'dra/ ka ta mo bha ba tāX tu rnyikaX/ khyed rnams las sngags rgyud mkhan po su yin/ zhes pa mang po las gcig bkar ba'i dpe'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ yad la ḍa ta ra bzhag ḍa song ṭi phyis/ sbyar bas/ya ta ra byung / ༈tad la ḍa ta ra bzhag ḍa song ṭi phyis/ drangs pas/ ta ta ra byung / ༈de bzhin du/ ḍa ta ma dang sbyar bas/ ya ta ma dang / ༈ta ta ma 'byung /don ni gang dang ci dang de la sogs pa'o/ ༈des na/ bha ba to rlu ta ra stu ska ka sta tar u nge gra ṇa tu/ khyed dag las gang zhig rtog ge mkhan po de ni smra ba mchog tu —364—

'dzin pa'o/ /'di ni gnyis dang mang po las bkar ba thun mong ste khyad par can gyi don no/ / ༈saX khyu ya bi she khri a ba bhā ra rje di tri bhāX tī yaX/ grangs kyi bye brag logs su bkol ba la dī dang tri dag las tī ya'o/ /grangs kyi khyad par logs su bkol ba ni/ gzhan rnams kyi nang nas grangs de dang ldan pa bkol ba'i tshig ste/ gnyis po gsum po zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈de yang di dang tī ya ba thegasi rnam bcad/ dī tī yaX/ gnyis po zhes bkar ba'am/ gnyis pa zhes gnyis dang ldan pa'i rtags can no/ /de la dī ni gnyis yin/ tī ya'i nus pas bye brag zur du bkol ba'i don la/ gnyis po'am/ ldan pa'i rtags can la gnyis pa zhes par 'gyur ba yin/ ༈de bzhin du/ tri tī ya si/ tri'i i dang ra ni dbyangs kyi ṛ ru bsgyur ro/ khro tī yaX/ tri zhes pa gsum yin la/ de la tī ya sbyar bas gsum pa'am gsum po'o/ /'dir ra'i gi gu dbyangs ṛ ru bskyur ba 'di la/sa spra sā ra ṇa'i tha snyad mdzad do/༈kho tsa ru ro sgraX/ kho dang tsa tu ru dag gi tha'o/ /de yang ṣa ṣa tha ni tshul rol gyi ṣa mthong bas ṭha ru song / /drangs/ si rnam bcad/ khu〉༷/ ༈yang tsa dzis tha si ru tha la drangs/ tsa shu rgyaX/ ༈ka ti ka ti pa yā bhāX thaX/ka ti dang ka ti pa ya dag las kyang tha'o/ /ka ti la tha sbyar/ si rnam bcad/ ༈ka ti pa ya la tha sbyar/ si rnam bcad/ ༈ka ti thaX/ ji tsam/ ༈ka ti pa ya thaX/ ji tsam byung / 'di grangs kyi rim pa min yang ji tsam zhes pa grangs la dmigs pa dang/ tha'i rkyen sbyor bar mtshungs pa'i phyir 'phros don no/ /dpe kha cig la tshig 'di 'og na yod do/—365—

༈pañtsa de rmaX/ pañtsa sogs la ma'o/ de yang pañtsa nam si/ na mtha' phyis/pa3 mimaX/ ༈de bzhin/ du/ sa sta maX/ aṣ+ṭa maX/ na ba maX da sha maX ce lta༅ sbyar ro/༈e kā da shā de ḍiX/ bcu gcig la sogs pa rnams la ḍa 'o/ /bcu gcig gi skad dod e ka da sha'i sgra la/ rkyen ḍa byin/ ḍa rjes 'brel/ ṭi dbyi/drangs/ si rnam bcad/ e ka da shaX/ di khram ya btags yin u nāX dwa tra yo3rtsaXdī tri a gin rnams kyi dā tra yo ag rnams so/ /dī dang tri dang a gin rnams ni da sha dang sbyor ba na rim bzhin dwa tra yo ag rnams su 'gyur te/de bzhin du bcu gnyis la/ /dā da shaX/ ༈bcu gsum la tra yo da shaX/༈bcu bzhi la tsa tun shaX ༈bco brgyad la aṣ+ṭa da shaḥ/ ༈bcu dgu la na ba da shaX༈ bi sha t+yā de bī ta ma ṭa/ nyi shu sogs la yang na ta ma ṭa 'o/ bi sha zhes pa'i mthar/ rkyen ḍa ti bzhag ḍa rjes 'brel/ ṭi dbyi/ drangs/ bi sha ti/nyi shu tham pa'o/ ༈yang na/ bi sha ti/ zhes pa de la/ rkyen ta ma ba theg si rnam bcad/ bi sha ti ta maXnyi shu kho na'am/ nyi shu tham pa'o/ ༈bi sha ti ḍa ti/ nyi shu la ḍa ti zhes pa'o/ /zhes kyang 'byung bas/ 'dir ḍa ti zhes pa ni/ rkyen ḍa kho na la ti ni pa ra smi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig yin pas/ nyi shu'i don la rkyen ḍa byed do zhes pa'i don yin gyi rkyen ḍa ti ma yin par 'chad pa'ang lugs gcig go ༈'di ltar na/ bi sha ta la rkyen ḍa byin/ ḍa rjes 'brel/ ṭi phyis/drangs pas/ dzi sha'o/ ༈de bzhin du/tri sha tra la ḍa ti sbyar na gong bzhin sgrubs —366—

pas/tri sha ti ste sum cu dang / de la ta ma sbyar/ si rnam bcad/ byas na/tri sha ti ta maXste sum cu tham pa zhes pa 'byung / ༈yang tri shad kho na la ta ma sbyar ba'ang yod/ ༈yang tri shad la ḍa rkyen du byin/ sgrub tshul gong bzhin byas pas/tri sha zhes pa'ang 'byung ste/ don sum cu tham pa'o/ ༈ sha tā de sna kyiX/ brgya la sogs pa la rtag tu'o/ /brgya'i skad dod sha ta la rkyen ta ma sbyar/ si rnam bcad/ sha ta ta maXbargya tham pa'o/ /rtag tu'o zhes pa'i don ni/ ta ma kho na rtag tu spyor gyi/ ḍa ti dang ḍa kho na'i rkyen rnams mi 'byung ngo / ༈sogs khongs nas/ brgya tham pa bzhin du grangs med kyi bar du'ang 'ba' zhig pa'i don la/ ta ma kho na 'byung ngo / /sa has ta maX stong tham pa dang / lak+ṣa ta maX'abum phrag dang / ko ṭi ta maXbyed ba phrag ces pa ste/ des gzhan yang mtshon no/༈ saX khyu yāXpra kā re dh+wa/ grangs rnams kyi rab tu dbye ba la dha 'o/ grangs kyi rab tu dbye ba ni tshan par bcad pa'i ming ste/ gnyis tshan gsum tshan la sogs pa yin la/ der ma zad kha zas gcig pu byin zhes pa lta bu'i gcig pi la yang thob cing / gcig las 'phros pa'i gcig gi sde tshan lta bu la nges par thob bo/ ༈de yang / dī ces pa'i sgra la rkyen dh+wa sbyar bas/ dī dh+wa/ ces pa gnyis sde shaṃ du bcad pa'i don no/ ༈de bzhin du/ tri dh+wa/ tsa au/ ces sogs te/ de tsam las rnam 'gyur gzhan gang yang med do/gu kho ྅ ṇa bā/ yon tan la aṇa yang na'o/ gzhan la dngos po sgyin par gtong ba sogs kyi don dang 'brel na/ rkyen dh+wa byin pas rnam 'gyur yod de/dbyangs dang po yon tan du 'gyur ro/ dī bhā/ tre bhā/ de ltar yon to du gyur zin —367—

pa la/ nges par aṇa gyi rkyen ster/ ṇa rjes 'brel/ yon tan 'phel bar 'gyur/ i a phyis/ drangs/ si ri/ a song / 'a/ tre dh+waX/ tsā tu khyuX ces pa la sogs pa'o/༈kṛ yā yā ā khro sto kṛ twas/ bya ba'i ched du kun nas 'jug pa la kṛ spyo'o / /zas dus yang yang byed pa dang / thun du ma yod pa sogs lan mang du bskyar ba'i bya ba'i don la/ kṛ twas zhes pa'i rkyen ster ro/ pañtsa bā rwan bhuX ste/lan lngar lho za'o/ /zhes pa steng ngag go /don de la/ pañtsa kritwa sa zhes pa bzhag mtha'i su rnam bcad/ pañtsa kṛ twaX/ khris kra twaXlan drug tu zhes pa'o/༈dī tri bhāX suX/ dī dang tri dag la su'o/ /di zhes pa dang / tri zhes pa la rkyen su zhes pa re re byin/ su'i u brjod don/ pha rol tu uk+ta zhes pa re re bzhag sdus uk+ta se/ trig uk+ta si zhes byung / sa srog med rnam bcad/ nā mi mtha' las ru/ drangs/ si da/ di ruk+taX/ tri ruk+taX/༈ba hā de shaX su/ ba hu la sogs pa la shas 'o/ /ba hu ni mang po ste/ mang po zhes pa'i spyi ming ngam bzhi'am lnga la sogs pa mang po'i bye brag gi don la/shas kyi rkyen byin na lan mang po'i don du 'gyur ro/ ba hu'i sogs khongs nas yang yang dang / bskyar ba dang / rjes su 'jug pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈'dir/ ba hu bā hūṃ ti/ 'di ni lan mang por ro/ /zhes pa tshig sbyor ro/ /de'i don la/ ba hu'i mthar/ rkyen shas bzhag sa rnams bcad/ ba hu shaXzhes so/༈ta yā ya ṭo saX khyu yāX/ ta ya a ya ṭa dag gi grangs kyi ched du'o/ /grangs kyi ming la rkyen ta ya ṭa 'am/ a ya ṭa bzhag na/ grangs de dang ldan pa'i dngos—368—

po'i don te/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ ༈de yang / di'i mthar ta ya ṭa ba theg ṭa rjes 'brel/ si ri/ dī ta yaX/ gnyis pa'am gnyis can zhes so/ ༈de bzhin du/ tri la ta ya ṭa sbyar bas/ si da/ tri ta yaX ste gsum pa'am gsum can no/ ༈a ya ṭa la ni 'di ltar byed de/ di'i mthar thog mar ta ya ṭa byin/ ta ar bsgyur nas a ya ṭa 'o/ /a de ni ḍi tra yin la/ ṭi phyis pas du dbyangs med du song / drangs/ si ri/ dwa yaX/ ༈de bzhin du/ tri ta ya ṭa/ ta ar bsgyur/ ṭi phyis/ drangs/ si da tra yaX/ don snga ma dang 'dra/ ༈de rnams spyi la 'jug tshul yin la/ bud med nyid dang / chu dang / khang pa dang /snod la sogs pa la u pu kyi rkyen 'jug ste/ dper na/ dī ta ya sngar bzhin bsgrubs nas/ de la mo rtags su sgrub pa'i rkyen zhi pu bzhag go /ri rjes 'brel/ i a phyis/ drangs/ dī ta yī ba dhu/ bu mo gnyis pa zhes pa lta bu ste/༈de bzhin du/ tri ta yī/ zhes pa dang / a ya ṭa'i rjes/ dwa ya dang tra ya la zhis byin pas/ dwa yī/ tra yī/ zhes pa 'byung ngo / ༈bar 'dir 'grel ba'i dpe 'ga' zhig las/ kha 'gangs lung drangs pa yod de/ dzaX lha'i sgra la sogs pa la i na a la la sogs pa dag go /de yang / rdza gha dang / sogs khongs nas dza ba lta bu la rkyen i na byin/ a i la e/ dza bhe na/ dza be na/ ༈de bzhin du/ dzaX gha dang / a la bzhag /'dra ba'i yi ge ring po/ si rnam bcad/ rja ghā laX/ grub bo/ ༈yang dzaX ghā kā ra/ sogs khongs kyi rkyen/ i ka i a'i dbyi/ si rnam bcad/ rdza ghā kā ri kaX/ brla mdzes pa'o/ ༈yang rjo gha la rkyen i ka byin/ i a la phyis/ drangs si/ dzaX ghi kaX/ dza ba sogs la'ang de dag 'gre'o/ ༈yang pā ṇi —369—

pa'i lung drangs pa/ bud med dang skyes pa dag la na ṇa sna ṇa dag go /bud med kyi skad dod sdi la rkyen na ṇa dang / skyes pa'i skad dod/ puX la sna ṇa zhes pa'i rkyen ster te/ sdi na ṇa/ ṇa rjes 'brel/ dang por 'phel ba/ ṣa ra ṛ las na ṇa ra song / si da/ ste ṇaX/ bud med mdzes ma'o/ ༈puX sna ṇa ṇa rjes 'brel/ dang por 'phel ba/ rab sbyor mtha' la mu dbyi dgos pa/ nga ro nyid mu yig pas phyis/ si da/ po snaX/ zhes pa grub/ skyes pa dpa' bo'i don no/ /spyir rab sbyor mtha'i phyi ma mi snang bar byed pa yin kyang / 'dir snga ma phyis pa tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa yin/ rjes su nga ro rab sbyor gyi ya gyal du byed pa ni gzhan du'ang mang po yod pas ma brjed par bya'o/ /mdo gzhan gyi lung drangs pa 'di gnyis 'grel ba'i dpe gnyis la ma mthong ngo /༈she khyi ni pā t+yā ka t+yā da yaX/ lhag ma tshig phrad rnams ni ka ti la sogs pa'o/ /'dir tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa zur tsam smos pa ste/ lhag ma gzhan rnams ni/slob dpon gyi man ngag dang / klus bkod pa'i 'bum pa sogs las shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don yin/ ༈ki mu la rkyen ḍa ti bzhag /ḍa rjes 'brel ṭi mi snang / drangs pas/ ka ti zhes pa byung ste/ gang tsam mam ji tsam zhes pa'o/ ༈de la rkyen pa ya sbyar/ rnam 'gyur med/ si rnam bcad/ ka ti pa yaX/ ji tsam byung zhes pa ste/ grangs 'dri ba'o/ /de ltar de dag ni de phan gyi rkyen nyer 'kho che ba 'ga' zhig gi bya ba rags pa tsam brjod pa'o//༈da ni dbyi ba bi kā ra ṇa'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ de la byings a da sogs la/ lu kra bi kā ra ṇa 'jug ste/ ༈de la dang po/ pa ra sme pa ti'i dbang du —370

byas te/ a da za ba la'o/ /da yig gi a ni brjod don no/ /a dā rlu ka /a da la sogs pa rnams kyi 'jig go /byings sde tshan dgu las/ a da la sogs pa la da bi kā ra ṇa 'byung mod kyi/ de ma thag tu 'jig pa'i phyir/ da las rdzas g.yin du med kyang / 'jig pa bī ka ra ṇa zhes rnam grangs gzhan du brda sbyar ba yin no/ 'o na 'jig pa la slar bya ba med par bshad na/ 'dir de'i rjes su aṭa yī la sogs pa 'byung ba ci zhe na/ de ni da kyi yul te shul la i la sogs pa'i rkyen gsar pa byin nas des rnam 'gyur byed pa yin gyi/ da nyid yod pa'i dus dang / zhig pa'i dus gang la yang /da kyi nus pas byings rtags kyi mtha' dang / pha rol rnam dbye sogs gang la'ang rnam 'gyur med pa'i phyir/ dbyi ba tsam ma yin te 'jig pa nyid do/ /a da sogs 'jig pa'i skabs/ da ces byung ba rnams/ da 'jig pa kho nar go bar bya'o/ /spyir 'jig pa la zhig zin nas rnam 'gyur med pa yin gyi/'jig 'gyur la nus med du ma nges so/ ༈de yang / a da ti zhes pa bzhagada'i a brjod don/ da byin 'jig kha sa la dzha sa rnams tsa pa'o/ /zhes pas dra tra ru song / pha rol ti yi steng du drangs/ asti/ za bar byed/ ༈a dra tas/da 'jig /su rnam bcad/ g.yin snga ma dang 'dra/ at+taX/ ༈ad an+ti da/ dra drangs/ a da rnyi/ ༈a gā si da tra drangs/ akli/ khyod zas za bar byed/ ༈ad ri da dra ta drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ at+paX/ ༈ad tha da gong dang 'dra/ at+pa/ ༈ad ri da dra nā drangs/ a tri / zas za bar byed do/༈ad bas da da drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ a druX/ ༈ad mas/ da snga ma —371—

bzhin/ ad+maX/ ༈cho ga 'byung ba la/ ad stuskyu da dra yā la drangs/ a sde ta/༈de bzhin du gzhan brgyad la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ ad yā tāX/ da a rgyu tāX/༈ad yus a pra sa rnam bcad/ a byuX/ ༈ad rdzas da/ rnam bcad/ a byuX༈ad yā tāX/ ri/ a rgyu tāX/ ad yā tā/ da/ a rgyu tāX/ ༈ad rdza mu/ ri mu nga ro/ aṅgāX/ ༈a du yā ba/ ri a rgyu ba/ ༈ad yā ma da a rgyu ma/ ༈shis byed la/ad—tu pra/ pra rjes 'brel/ ri dra tra drangs/ a stu/ yang na/ tus twatad du bsgyur/ taX gi ra phyis/ a stu ta/ ༈ad tāX ri/ a stuX/ ༈ad an+tu/ ri dra a la drangs/ a dan+tu/༈dzha sa rnyidheX/ dzha sa las hi dhi 'o/ /tshul rol byings kyi mtha' dzha sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yod la/ de'i pha rol tu rnam dbye hi byung na/ hi yig de dhi yig tu 'gyur ro/ ad hi da/ hi dhi ru song / dra dha'i steng du drangs/ a rnyi/yang na hi tā tad du bsgyur/ a stuta/ ༈ad tāX da a stuX/ ༈ad ta ri at+ta/༈a du ā ni pa/ da/ da a la drangs/ pra rjes 'brel/ a dā ni/ ༈ad ā ba/a pra drangs/ a dā ba/ ༈ad ums/ da drangs/ a dā ma/ ༈lung drangs pa/ad kyi di si dag la aṭa ā ga mar 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'byung bas/ dis sogs la sngon du aṭa'i rkyen sbyor dgos par ma zad/ dis dang da gnyis la byings kyi mthar yang / aṭa ā ga ma ster dgos so/ ༈ad di pu zhes pa bzhag /pra rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/ dra dbyangs med lus/ a/pu/byings kyi mthar aṭa/ sngon du yang aṭa/ ṭa gnyis phyis/ a ad ad/ ces pa byung / a dang po gnyis 'dra ba ring / dra snga ma a la drangs/ phyi ma ta ru song /— —372—

ā da ta/ ༈ad tāX da/ sngon du aṭa/ 'dra ring / drangs/ ut+taX/ ༈ag an da sngon du aṭa/ 'dra drangs/ ā dan/ ༈ad da/ pra rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/ ri byings la aṭa/ sngon du aṭa/ a ad as zhes byung / 'dra ring / dra a la/ sa rnam bcad/ ā daX/ ༈ad tāX da/ aṭa ut+taX/ ༈ad ta da/ aṭa ut+ta/ ༈ad a no/ pra rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/ ra sngon du aṭa/ a ad ri byung / 'dra ring / dra a la/ mu nga ro/ ā daX/ ༈ad ba da aṭa dra ba'i steng du drangs/ ud+ma/ ༈ad ma da/ aṭa/ ut+pa/ ༈da ni at+pa ne'i tshig can rnams bshad te/ shing nyal ba la'o/ /dra yig ni bdag don gyi tshig can mtshon pa'i don yin pas phyis/ 'di rnams la yang sngon ma bzhin du da ni 'jig pa nyid do/shingaX/ shing la'o/ 9khri zhes pa'i byings la/ at+pa ne'i rkyen de rnams gang byung yang / byings kyi dbyangs yon tan du 'gyur te/ sha'i srog gi sī ni yon tan e ru 'gyur bas/ she zhes pa sha stag 'byung ngo / ༈shing te zhes pa bzhug /dra khyad don/ da 'jig /yon tan i e ru song / she te/ ༈de bzhin du/ shid ā te da/ yon tan e da/ drangs/ sha yā te/ shi'i skabs 'dir yon tan zhes pa byung na/ i e kho na yin la/ yon tan sogs zhes pa rnams/ i e e da so sor 'dren pa go dgos so/ /༈shī ngo nya to ru ṭā/ shing gi an+ta la rus 'o/ /byings shing gi pha rol tu ad+ma ne'i rkyen/ arnya'i rigs byung na/ byings kyi mthar ru ṭa ā ga ma ster ro/ /ā toX ྅ to da na taX/ utra kyi an+ta la uta te a min pa'o/ /'dir uskyu —373—

ces pa ut+pa ne'i tshig can gyi byings la zer/ de lta bu'i pha rol na yod pa'i rkyen arnya'i rigs ni a ta ru sgyur dgos te/ ta'i srog gi dbyangs ni rang gnas su gnas pas lus 'gyur gyi dbang du byas na/ an ta'i na yig gam klad skor kho na spangs pa'o/ /'on kyang byings kyi mtha' na a yig yod na/ an+ta a ta ru mi 'gyur ro/ /'dir ni ā ga ma'i rā yig byings mthar yod cing / shī dang she gang gi skabs yin kyang rung ste/ byings mtha' a yig ma yin pas/ a ta ru bsgyur ba kho na'o/ ༈de yang shid a rnye ba 'ag /ri phyis/ yon tan/ rus ā ga ma byin/ṭā rjes 'brel u brjod don/ /a rnye a te ru bsgyur/ drangs/ she ra te/ ༈shing se da/ yon tan/ ku i la sogs sa lda she ske ༈shing ā the/ da yon tan sogs/ sha yā the/ shing khro/ ri yon tan/ she khyu/ sgo e/ da yon tan sogs/ sha ye/ ༈shing ba he/ da yon tan/ she ba he/ ༈shing ma he/ /da yon tan/ she ma he/ ༈shing yī ta/ ri yon tan sogs/ sha yī ta/ ༈shing yī yā tāX/da yon tan sogs/ sha yī yā tāX/ ༈shing sī ran/ da yon tan sogs/ sha yi ran/ ༈shing sī ri/ ri yon tan sogs/ sa rnam bcad/ sha yī thāX/༈shing yī yā thāX/ ri yon tan sogs/ sha yī yā thāX/ ༈shing zhwa dh+waX/ da yon tan sogs/ sha zhi dh+waX/ ༈shing sī ya da yon tan sogs/ sha yī ya/ ༈shing sī ba hi/da yon tan sogs/ sha yī ba hi/ ༈shing yī ma hi/ da yon tan sogs/ sha yī ma hi/ shing tāX ri yon tan sogs/ she tāX/ ༈shing sgo ā tāX/ da yon tan sogs/ sha yā tāX/ ༈shing an+taX/ ra yon tan/ rus ster/ an+ta a tar bsgyur/she ra ta/ ༈shid swa da yon tan/ ku i la sogs/ she lga ༈shing ā da/ da —374—

yon tan sogs/ sha yā thaX/ ༈shing dh+waX/ da yon tan/ she dh+waX/ ༈shing i da yon tan sogs/ sha yi/ sgo ā ba hipra/ ༈da rjes 'brel/ da/ yon tan sogs/ sha yā ba hai/ ༈shing ā ma he pu/ pra rjes 'brel/ da yon tan sogs/sha yā ma hai/ ༈deng ma yin pa'i don la tan la sogs pa dgu ste/ sngar bshad pa bzhin 'di thams cad la thog mar aṭa bzhag par bya'o/ khred tan/ na rjes 'brel/ da yon tan/ aṭa a she ta/ ༈shing utāX/ da yon tan sogs/aṭa a sha yā tāX/ ༈shing ri an+ta/ rus sgo yon tan/ an+ta a tar bsgyur/ aṭa/a she ra ta/ shi5 thus/ da yon tan/ aṭa a she thāX/ ༈shing a thu mu/ da/yon tan sogs/ aṭa a sha yā thāX/ ༈shi5dha mu/ da yon tan/ aṭa a she dh+waX/༈shi pa ri i da yon tan sogs/ aṭa a sha yi/ ༈shing ba hi/ ri yon tan/aṭa a she ba hi/ ༈the skyed ma hi ri yon tan/ aṭa a she ma hi/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈gnyis ka'i tshig can gyi dper brjod ni/ bru nya gsal bar brjod pa la'o/ /nya ni gnyis ka'i tshig can gyi rtags don yin pas dbyi/a bā dā bī bi ti khrim/ da la sogs pa dag gi sī te pi tra kyi ta sa ma'o/ /tshul rol na byings bhū nya yod cing / pha rol rnam dbye'i rkyen gyi thog ma'i yi ge la/ ta sa ma rnams gang rung yod pa dang / pi tra te pu rjes 'brel yin pa gzhi mthun na nges par yin zhing / gzhan nges pa med de de lta bu'i byings kyi mthar/ da zhig pa'i yul la sī ring po rkyen du 'gyur zhing / bru yi srog u ni yon tan o ru 'gyur zhing / o a bar 'gyur ba yī dang mtshams sbyor ba sogs bya'o/ /'dir da la sogs pa zhes 'byung ba ni/ sogs khongs nas 'don rgyu —375—

med/ dang po'i don yin pas sngon da byung ba da ltar mi snang bar byas pa'o/༈byu nya ti ces pa bzhag nya rjes 'brel/ /no 'jig /rkyen yī byin/ bhū yi yon to bro/ o ab/ ba yī la drangs/ bra bī ti/ ༈ta sa ni 'dir ta rkyen yin yang / pi ta min pas/ yī rkyen dang yon tan sogs mi byed de/ bru ta sa/su rnam bcad/ bhū taX/ ༈yī mū byings kyi da ub dag dbyangs pha rol la'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ spyir bi kā ra ṇa'i byings kyi mtha' la yī yig dang mū yig yong la/ pha rol du ti sogs kyi bye brag dbyangs rkyen byung na/ i yu dang ub ru 'gyur zhes pa spyir btangs su bzhag /yang i u dag gi yang na'o/ /zhes kyang 'byung bas dbyangs du ma can te/ yig 'bru gnyis gsum sogs yod pa/ gsal byed rab sbyor te gsal byed du ma brtsegs pa ma yin pa de 'dra'i mtha'i i yig yu dang / u yig ba ru 'gyur ro/ /de bzhi du nu byings la'o/ zhes 'og nas 'byung ngo / /'on kyang dmigs gsal 'dir/nā na phyo rbaX/ da med pa la u ngo ma yin no/ /ri phyis pa'i shul du byings kyi mtha'i u yig ni ba yig tu mi bsgyur bar/ u pu zhes pa yi ge gnyis su bsgyur bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang / bru zhes pa 'di ni/ ba dang ru brtsegs pas gsal byed rab sbyor yin/ dbyangs du ma ma yin te/ u yig gcig pu nyid yin pas kyang / spyir btangs mi 'jug pa'o/ des na/ bhū an+ti zhes pa bzhag /da bru'i srog gi ྅ ring po ni/ phral te u bur bsgyur/ bla u thung ngu la drangs/ ba a na la drangs pas/ bru brnyi/ ༈yang bru si pu/ ri zhi byin/yon tan/ o ri/ drangs/ ku i la sogs/ bra bī khri bru nya thas/ sa rnam —376—

bcad/ bhū thaX/ ༈ bhū tha yang de dang 'dra/ ༈bhū da/ da yī yon tan sogs/bra bī mi/ ༈bhū bas sa rnam bcad/ bhū baX/ bhū da/ sa rnam bcad/ bhū maX/༈yang 'dir dmigs gsal gyi khyad par ni/ bru ba ā ha : pa thu ṇaX/ ga ā hu yang ste lnga po rnams so/ /bru'i byings la ti pu sogs thog ma'i rkyen lnga po ni/ ṇa sa la sogs par bsgyur ba yang rnam 'gyur lugs gcig yin no/ /de yang lnga car la bhū ni u ha zhes par bsgyur/ pha rol kyi rkyen ti pu ni ṇa pra du bsgyur/ tas ni a shus dang / an+ti ni us dang / da ni da dang / thas ni a thus su 'gyur ba yin no/ /༈bhū ti pu bzhag ri 'jig zu zhes pa ā ha ru bsgyur/ ti pu zhes pa ṇa pra du bsgyur/ pra rjes 'brel/ ṇa bya ba'i don/ hu dbyangs med a la drangs/ ā ha grub/ ༈ba tag da bhū ā har bsgyur/ tas ni a tus su bsgyur/ha drangs/ su rnam bcad/ ā ha tuX/ ༈bhū a rnyi da/ bhū u ha/ an+ti us/ ha drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ a huX/༈nuṅgā toX/ byings la nu'o/ /mdo tshig 'di skabs 'di na yod kyang 'og tu 'chad do/ ༈ta the/ tha la ta'o/ /pha rol tu rnam dbye'i rkyen tha yig byung la/ snga rol tu bhū yi rnam 'gyur uta yod na/ ha dbyangs med des/ pha rol rnam dbye tha yig mthong bas/ rang nyid tra yig tu 'gyur ba yin no/ ༈bru pra/ da u ha/ da da/ ha ta ru song / drangs/ utā/ ༈bru thas ri/ gi rgya thas a thus su bsgyur/hu drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ ā ha thuX/ ༈at+pa ne'i tshig can la ni bhū te bzhaga.ub byed/ bru bā te/ ༈ub a rnye a te/ bru ba te/ ༈ku i la sogs/ bhū ṣe—377—

༈u zhi/ bru bā the/ ༈bhū khyo/ ༈ab/ bru be/ ༈bhū ba he/ ༈bhū ma he/ zhes pa rnams so/ /༈chog 'byung la/ bhū na ta/ bhū yā tāX/ ༈bru yuX/ bru yā ༈bru yā tāX/ ༈zla yā ta/༈bhū yāX/ ༈bru yā ba/ ༈bru yā ma/ de rnams ni rkyen dang sbyar ba tsam yin swā) rnam 'gyur med do/ ༈at+pa ne'i tshig can la/ dgu po rnams ub 'ba' zhig gi rnam 'gyur yin te/ bru bī ta/ bru bī yā tāX/ bru bī ran/ ༈bru bī thaX/ bru bī yā thāX/ bru bī dh+waX/ ༈bru bī ya/ bru bī ba hi/ bru bī ma hi/ ༈shis byed la/ bhū tu pu zhes pa ba thegapra rjes 'brel/ da/ 'di bi ta yin pas yī/ bhū la yon tan/ o ab/ so sor drangs pas/ bra bī tu/ yang na/ tu pu tā ta dra ru bsgyur bas/ /bru tā tra/ ༈bhū tāX/ ub/ bru bskye/ 'di la'ang spyir btangs ltar na a tun bsgyur ba thob kyang lag len du mi byed par snang ngo / ༈bhū hi/ yang na/ bhū tu tra/ ༈bhū taX/ ༈bhū ta/༈bhū ā ni pa bzhag pi ta yin pas yon tan/ o ab/ ba ā la drangs/ bra bā ni/de dang 'dra bar yon tan/ o ab/ bhū ubs/ bra bā ba/ ༈bhū ā mab/ bra bā ma/ ༈at+pa ne la/ bhū tāX/ ༈ub/ bru bā tāX/ ༈bru ba tāX/ 'di a ta ra song ba yin/༈ku i la/ bru lga ༈ub/ bhū ba thaX/ ༈bru dh+waX/ ༈bhū da/ pi ta kyi yon tan/ o ab/ drangs/ bra be+e/ ༈de dang sgrub tshul 'dra ste/ bhū ā ba he pra/ bra bā ba hai/༈bhū ā ma hipra/ bra bā ma hai/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈deng min pa la thams cad kyi sngon du aṭa 'jog dgos/ dang por pa ra smi la/ bhū di pu bzhag da/ sī yon tan/ o da/ aṭa/ pra rjes 'brel/ i khyad don/ dra trar song / a bra bi tra/ ༈a bhū tāX/ ༈u bu/ a bru ba na/ ༈bhū da/ pra rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/ pi ta kyi yon tan/ o ab/ drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ a bla baX/ a bhū tāX/—378—

a bhū ta/ bhū a da/ pra rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/ yon tan/ o ri drangs/ ma nga ro/ a bra baX/ ༈a bhū ga a bhū ma/ ༈at+pa ne la/ bhū tan/ na rjes 'brel/ a bhū ta/ ༈u ba/ a bru bā tāX/ ༈u ba/ a bru bta/ ༈sa rnam bca/da/ a bhū thāX/ ༈u ba/ a bru bā thaX/ ༈a bhū dh+waX/ ༈spru yi pe a bru bi/ ༈a bhū ba hi/ ༈a bhū ma hi/ zhes pa rnams te/ 'di ni gnyis don can yin pas byings thams cad pa'i rkyen bdun cu rtsa gnyis kar 'jug pa'o/ /'di rnams 'jig pa bi ka ra ṇa'i yul yin pa'i phyir/ byings la rnam dbye bkod ma thag tu da 'jig pa yin mod/ 'dir yi ge mang bas 'jigs pa te re re bzhin ma bris mod kyi/ a da'i byings kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin du rigs bsgres te go bar bya la/ sa ris byed pa rnams kyis kyang sla chos mi byed par 'bri bsub byed pa gal che'o/ /de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang rig par bya'o/ ༈'jig pa bi ka ra ṇa'i yul yin kyang / hu la sogs pa rnams la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod te/'dir byings gnyis su 'phel ba'i rigs la ni gnyis brjod ces bya'o/ khu spyin pa dang mchod pa dag la'o/ /zhes byings hu la dper brjod bya'o/ /hā rtu hu la sogs pa las gnyis kyang ngo / /'dir thams cad la yang gong bzhin ri 'jig go /de yang byings hu la 'dir bstan gyi rnam dbye byings thams cad la gang byin yang / byings nyis 'gyur du 'phel bar 'gyur te/ 'dir hu hu zhes gnyis 'byung ba yin no/ /sa swa rā di rdir dīX/ dbyangs bcas dang po gnyis te gnyis ma yin pa'o/ /dbyangs dang po can gyi byings la ni/ dbyangs nyid gnyis su 'phel bar —379—

'gyur gyi /cha shas sam rjes 'brang gsal byed ni gnyis su 'phel ba ma yin no/ /mdo 'di gnyis kyang ngo zhes pa las 'phros pa ste/ dper brjod 'og tu 'chad skabs 'dir bya ba med do/ /ku ho zhuX/ ku dang ha yi tsun/ /thog mar yod pa'i byings de'i mtha' la/ku ste ka sde dang gzhan ha yig yod na'ang / de dag tsu ste tsa sder 'gyur ro/ /de la ka kha ga gha nga / rim pas/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya rnams su 'gyur te/ dper brjod 'og tu ston/ ha yig ni tsa sde'i bzhi pa dzha yig tu 'gyur ro/ /dzha pā nāX dza ba tsa bāX dzha pa rnams dza ba dang tsa pa rnams so/ /dzha pa so sor bsdu ba ni/ sde pa lnga po rnams kyi da sogs spangs pa'o/ /dza ba ni sde pa'i gsum pa rnams so/ /tsa pa ni dang po lnga'o/ /rnams kyi zhes pa'i tshig zur ni kha pa so sor bsdu ba ste/ sde pa rnams kyi dang po rnams dang gnyis pa rnams so/ /des na byings gnyis su 'phel ba'i thog ma de ni/ dzha pa'i yi ge gang yin kyang / sde pa'i nang sel gyi grangs dang mthun pa'i dza bar 'gyur la/ rnams kyi sgras kha pa yin na/ ka par yang 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i don yin mod kyi/ de yang dzha pa thams cad dza bar 'gyur ba ni spyir btangs dang / dza ba'i nang sel kha pa ni dza bar mi 'gyur bar/ tsa par bsgyur ba dmigs gsal yin no/ /'dir ni bzhi pa dzha sogs/ gsum pa dza sogs su 'gyur ba 'di dgos so/ ༈de yang hu ti zhes pa bzhag /da phyis/ hu la sogs pa'i gnyis kyang ngo / /zhes pas hu las hu gcig gral 'gor 'phel/ ku ha dag gi tsu'o/ zhes pas hu gral 'go ma skyo zhes par song / dzha pa rnams kyi dza ba dang tsa pa'o/ /zhes pas/ dz+nyā de yang dzu —380—

ru song / dzu hu sgrub tshul 'di 'og ma thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ pi tra la yon to te/ hu ho ru song/ tso rmo ti/ ༈dza hu tas/ sa rnam bcad/ dzu hu taX/dīX/ gnyis las so/ gnyis su brjod pa'i tha ma'i an+ti a tar bsgyur dgos te/ dzu hu an+ti da/ dzu hu a ti/ hu'i u ri song / drangs/ dzu hwa ti/༈da la yon tan/ dzu ho ski ༈sa rnams bcad/ dzu hu thaX/ ༈yang dzu hu tha/༈da ni pi tra te yon to no/ /lo mi/༈o rba mo rlu lo paX/ ba ma la u dbyi ba yang na'o/ /pha rol rnam dbye wa ma gang rung byung na/ tshu rol byings kyi mtha' yi u yig ni yang na dbyi bar bya ste/'dir 'grel pa las rkyen la gnas pa'i u dbyi bar dngos su bstan zhing /shugs la gzhan yang yod par bshad pa las/ rkyen gyi u yig dbyi ba skabs gzhan du 'byung / 'dir gzhan dbyi bar bshad pa de yin te/ byings sa la yod pa'i u yig yin pas so/ ༈des na mi 'phyid pa'i phyogs la dzu hu baX/ ༈dzu hu maX/ 'di la sa rnam bcad ma gtogs pa'i rnam 'gyur med/ ༈dbyi ba'i phyogs la he'i srog gi u phyis/ ha ba'am ma la drangs/ rnam bcad byas pas/ dzu twoX/༈dzu h+maX/ ༈de bzhin du ra la/ dzu hu yā tā/ dzu hu yā tāX/ dzu hu yuX/ dzu hu yā / dzu hu yā taX/ ༈dzu hu yā ta/ dzu hu yāX/ dzu hu yā ba/ dzu hu yā ma/ ༈de bzhin du lo ṭa la yon tan/ dzu ho tu/ /yang na dzu hu twa tra/ dzu hu tāX/ a skye la a tar bsgyur/ hu yi u zhi/ dzu hwa tu/ he lhaX/ hi dhi 'o/ skabs 'dir/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig hi ni dhi ru bsgyur ba ste/ dzu hu dhi/ yang na/ dzu hu tā tra zhes pa'o/ /dzu hu taX/ dzu hu ta/ ā ni da la pi tra yon tan no/ /dzu ha bā ni/ de bzhin du yon tan te/ dzu ha bā —381—

ba/ dzu ha bā ma/ zhes pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du sgo zhes pa la thams cad kyi 'gor aṭa sbyar/ dzu hu di pra/ pra dang i phyis/ hu yon tan/ da ta/ a dza ho ta/ a dzu hu tāX/ a na us/ an ni us so/ gnyis su brjod pa'i skabs 'dir/ deng min skyes bu dang bo'i ming tshig an ni us su bsgyur ba yin no/ /dzu hu an bzhag /an us su bsgyur/ dzu ho o ab/ drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ a dzu ha buX/ ༈ri ni bi ta yin pas/ hu la yon tan/ pra dang i phyis/ sa rnam bcad/ a dzu hoX/ a dzu hu taX/ a dzu hu ta/ ༈a da la pra dang i phyis/ yon tan o ab/ drangs/ mung ro/ /a dzu ha baX/ ba ma la bas mas bzhin sgrub ste/tsu'i u phyis na/ a dzu hwa/ a dzu h+ma/ ༈ma phyis na/ a dzu hu ba/ a dzu hu ma/ de ltar na byings hu la pa ra smi pa ti sbyar ba'o/ ༈ /da ni gnyis brjod pa'i ut+pa ne'i dper brjod ni/ de yang khu : tra gnas pa dang rgyas pa la'o/ /o skru 'gro ba la'o/ /tshod mchod pa la'o/ /zhes pa rkyen 'di gsum ni/ za la sogs pa zhes tha snyad byed do/ ༈de las skabs 'dir o skru dper brjod du bzung ngo / /hra swaX/ thung ngu'o/ /de yang byings gnyis 'phel ba'i thog ma ste/ gral 'go na yod pa de sngar ring po las phyis thung ngur bsgyur bar bya'o/rtso yāX lu ki /rtso nya rnams kyi 'jig go 'dir o hwad yang lha la sogs pa ste/ 'di rnams la byings dang po'i srog gi a yig ni/ i yig tu bsgyur ba dang /'jig pa gnyis yod do/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ gnyis nyid dag la mi snang ba rjes su 'jug ste/ yī yig yang ngo / /zhes kyang 'byung bas/ byings gnyis su brjod pa'i skabs 'dir/ pha rol dbyangs thog ma can —382—

gyi rkyen la/ pa ti ma yin par ngi ta du yod na byings kyi mtha'i a yig dbyi ba yin zhing / ha sa te gsal byed thog ma can gyi rkyen di ta byung na/ byings kyi mtha'i ā yig yī yig tu 'gyur ba yin no// de yang o co dra khyad don/ o ni bya ba'i don/ hā te zhes pa bzhag go /da phyis/ byings nyis 'gyur gcig gong du bzhag /thung ngu'o zhes pas hā snga ma thung ngur song / ku dang ha'i tsun/ ha dzha/dzha sa rnams kyi dza ba'o/ /zhes pas dzha dza ru song / rtso i rnams kyi 'jig go /zhes pas byings dang po'i srog gi a ni ir bsgyur te/ dzi hā zhes pa byung / te'i ta ni gsal byed thog ma can yin pas/ byings mtha' hā yi srog ā ni yī ring por 'gyur/ dzi hi te/ de bzhin du/ dzi hā sgrub tshul thams cad la 'dra/dzi hā ā te zhes pa bzhag /ā te ni dbyangs thog ma can gyi rkyen yin pas/dzi he'i srog ā ring po phyis/ ha ni ā te'i ā dang sbyor/ dzi hā te/ de gnyis kar pi ta kyi rkyen ma yin no/ /des gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ a rnye a ter bsgyur/ dzi ha te/ ༈ku i la/ dzi he ṣe dzi hā the/ dzi hi khro/ ༈dzi he/ dzi hi ba he/dzihe ma he/ ༈sgo la dzi hi ta/ 'di'i hi ring po ni gsal byed kyi rkyen las byings mtha' zhir gyur pa ma yin/ dbyangs rkyen yin pas/ byings mtha'i ā ring po phyis nas/ rkyen gyi yī la hu drangs pa yin te phyi ma brgyad la'ang 'di bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /dzi hi yā tāX/ dzi hi ran/ ༈dzi hi thāX/ dzi hi yā thāX/ dzi hi dh+waX/ ༈dzi hi ya/ dzi hi ba hi/ dzi hi ma hi rnams so/ ༈lo ṭa kyi sde rnams la/ sngar bshad pa'i dbyangs gsal thog ma can rnams dran par byas te/ dzi hi tāX/ dzi hā taX/ a tan bsgyur/ dzi ha tāX/ ༈sa ṣa ru song / dzi hi lga dzi hā thaX/ dzi hi dh+waX/ ༈dzi hai/ dzi hā ba —383—

hai/ dzi hā ma hai/ ༈ri gi rkyen la aṭa sngon du bzhag tan gyi na phyis/ a dzi hi ta/ a dzi hā tāX/ a tang bsgyur/ a dzi ha ta/ ༈a dzi hi thaX/ a dzi hā thāX/ a dzi hi dh+waX/ ༈a dzi hi/ a dzi hi ba hi/ a dzi hi ma hi/ zhes pa'o/ ༈o hwa ka gtong ba la'o/ kra rjes 'brel/ o brjod don/ dang por la ṭa pa ra smi'i dbang du byas te/ hā hipra zhes pa bzhag/ ri 'jig hā gnyis 'phel/ hā gong ma thung ngu ha ru bsgyur/ de dzha dang / de yang dza ru bsgyur te/ dza hā ti/ 'di pi tra yin pas mtha'i ā dbyi ba dang / yī ring bor bsgyur ba gnyis kar med do/ ༈hā tas/'di gsal byed thog ma can yin pas byings mtha' yī ring por bsgyur/ dza hi taX/ ༈dza hā in+ta a ti ra bsgyur/ two'i srog ā phyis/ hu a ti'i a la drangs/ dza ha ti/ ༈de ltar gsum po de mtshon byed du byas nas rigs 'gre ste/ pi ta yin min gyi khyad dang / ngi tra la yang gsal byed dang po can dang dbyangs dang po can gyi dbye ba so sor shes par bya ste/ dza hā si/ dza hi thaX/ dza hi tha/ ༈dza hā mi/ dza hi baX/ dza hi maX/ zhes so/ ༈'dir dza hā nyid yā tra la sogs pa rnams kyi a dbyi'i zhes/ mdo gzhan las bshad pas/ byings dza hā la thu chu la sogs pa/ri pa ra smi rkyen dgu po gang byung kyang / he'i ā ring po phyis te ha yig yā yi steng du 'dren pa yin no/ /dza rgya ta/ dza t+yā tāX/ dza ཿ ༷༷/ ༈dza rgyuX/ dza rgyu tāX/ dza t+yāX ta/༈dza byāX/ dza byā ba/ dza t+yā ma/ ༈lo ṭa yi pa ra sme/ dza hā tu/ yang na dza hi spyan/ 'di sngar pi tra yin pa de tu ta ru bsgyur zin pa na/ 'gyur nas ngi ta gsal byed dang po can du song bas/ byings mtha'i ā yig sī yig ring por bsgyur ba yin te/ don 'di sngar phyi mang po gcig tu 'byer dgos pa yod do/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ dza hi tāX/—384—

༈ a skye/ a shun bsgyur/ ā phyis/ dza ha tu/ ༈ zhi bī ho/ hi la i yī yang na'o//skabs 'dir rnam dbye hi la sngar bshad pa ltar gyi rnam 'gyur med pa dang /tu tad du bsgyur ba gnyis thun mong dkyus 'gro yin la/ 'dir o tshi gi byings la byings mtha'i ā i thung ngu'am/ yī ring po gang rung du bsgyur ba 'di nyid kyi dgos chos yin/ spyi 'gros dang dgos chos gdam kha yin pas/ 'di la rnam 'gyur bzhi 'byung ngo / /dza hā hi/ dza hi tā tra/ spyir 'gros gnyis so/ dza hi hi/ dza hi hi/ dgos chos gnyis so/ ༈de bzhin du/ dza hi tāX/ ༈dza hi ta/ ༈ā nib la ri dang i phyis/ pa tra yin pas byings mtha' la rnam 'gyur gzhan med/ rkyen gyi ā mtshungs 'dra sbyar/ dza hā ni/ de dang 'dra bar mtshungs 'dra sbyar bas/ dza hā ba/༈dza hā ma/ ༈la da pa ra smi ni/ 'di rnams la aṭa sngon du bzhag /dza hā dis/'di 'dra'i rigs gsal byed snga ma can yin yang / pi tra yin pas/ hā la rnam 'gyur med/ dis kyi pra dang i phyis/ dra tra ru song / a dza hā tra/ de bzhin du/a dza hi tāX/ ༈yang a dza hā/ an u su su bsgyur/u sgyu lo paX/ us kyi ā dbyi'o/ /rkyen an zhes pa us zhes par bsgyur zhing/ tse( hwa ka gi skabs 'dir rkyen us kyi nus pas/ byings mtha'i ā ring po phyis par 'gyur/ hu u la drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ a dza huX/ ༈da kyi pra dang i phyis/ sa rnam bcad/ pi ta yin pas gzhan rnam 'gyur med/ a dza tshiX/༈de bzhin du/ a dza hi tāX/ a dza hi ta/ ༈a da la pra i phyis/ 'dra ba/ mu nga ro/ a dza hāX/ a dza hi ba/ a dza hi ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈khu dwa nya spyin pa la'o/ /nya yig gnyis ka'i don/ khyu yig lka ta kyi bya ba'i don/ gnyis ka khyad —385—

don yin pas phyis/ dā ti pra zhes pa bzhag /byings nyis 'gyur/ snga ma thung ngu / da dwa ti/ ༈dā deX/ dwa la sogs pa'o/ /khu dwa nya la sogs pa'i byings gnyis su brjod pa dag la/ dā phyi ma'i dbyangs ā yig ni pha rol du pi tra ma yin pa/ngi ta kyi rnam dbye dbyangs gsal thog ma gang yin yang 'dra ste dbyi bar bya ba yin no/ de ltar na da dā grub par byas te pha rol du tas bzhag /'di gsal byed dang po can gyi di ta yin pas/ dā phyi ma'i srog gi ā ring po phyis/ da dbyangs med ta ru song / rkyen gyi steng du drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ dat+taX/ ༈da dā/a rnyi zhes pa bzhag /a tir bsgyur/ ā phyis/ dra dbyangs med rkyen gyi a la drangs/ da da ti/ ༈'dis mtsho ni nas gsal byed thog ma can rnams la/ du srog med rkyen gyi yi ge dang rtseg dgos/ yi ge'i grogs kyi dbang gis tra ru bsgyur ba'am/ da nyid du gnas pa ci rigs yin/ dbyangs thog ma can gyi ngi ta rnams la dra srog med rkyen gyi dbyangs rnams la 'dren no/ /de ltar na/ da dra si/da dhaX/ da tho/ ༈da dā mi/ da druX da d+maX'ajug bzhin pa'i pa ra sme'o/ ༈da ni 'di dag la dā phyi ma'i ā phyis te/ rkyen gyi ya'i steng du 'dren pa kho na ste/ da sde ta/ da phywa tāX/ da byuX/ ༈da byāX/ da phywaX tāX/ da byā ta/ ༈da phywaX/ da bya ba/ da byā ma/ chog 'byung gi pa ra sme'o/ ༈ da dā tu/ yang na/ da stuta/ da stuX/ an+ta a shun bsgyur/dwa'i ā dbyi/ da da tu/༈dāX ho/ da rnams kyi hi la'o/ /rkyen hi pha rol du mthong na/ dā gnyis yod pa'i thog ma dbyi zhing / phyi ma'i dbyangs ā ring po e yig tu bsgyur dgos pa'i don no/ /de yang dā hi zhes pa bzhag /byings nyis 'gyur/ dā dā hi zhes —386—

pa byung / dā dang po phyis te/ phyi ma'i dbyangs e ru bsgyur pas/ de hi/ ༈yang na spyi 'gros kyi hi tā tad du bsgyur/ dā yi byings kyi dgos chos la phyi ma'i dbyangs phyis pas/ da stuta/ ༈de bzhin du/ dat+taX/ ༈dat+ta/ ༈a ni pra sogs gsum la mtshungs pa sbyar ba ste/ da dā ni/ da dā ba/ da dā ma/ shis byed kyi pa ra smi rnams so/ ༈dis sogs kun la aṭa thog mar sbyar/ a da dā/ di pra pra rjes 'brel/i brjod don/ dra tra/ a da dwa tra/ ༈de bzhin du/ a da stuX/ ༈an us/ a da duX/ ༈a da dāX/ a dat+taX/ a dat+ta/ a da dāX/ da rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/a 'dra ba/ mu nga ro yin par go dgos/ ༈a da dru/ a da d+ma/ deng min pa'i pa ra sme rnams so/ ༈da ni ud+ma ne tshig can la/ pi tra rnams bor ba'i ngi tu kyi rkyen dbyangs thog ma can dang ha sa thog ma can gang yin yang 'dra ste byings nyis 'gyur gyi phyis ma'i dbyangs/ ā ring po ni dbyi bar bya ba 'ba' zhig go /༈ da dā te zhes pa bzhag /byings kyi dā phyi ma'i dbyangs ā ring po phyis/ da tra ru song / rkyen gyi ta'i steng du drangs/ da ste/ ༈da dā/ ā te zhes pa ba 'ag /byings rting ma'i ā phyis/ dra dbyangs med rkyen gyi a la drangs/ da dā te/ ༈a rnye a ter bsgyur/ da da te/ ༈de bzhin dra dbyangs med tar bsgyur/ da khye/ da dwa the/da rnye/ ༈da de/ da d+ma he/ da d+ma he/ 'byung bzhin pa'i at+pa ne'o/ ༈da dwa sī ta/ zhesapa bzhag /di'i ā phyis/ rkyen gyi yī dang sbyar/ da hi ta/ des rigs 'gre ste/da dī yā tāX/ da dī ran/ ༈da dī thaX/ da dī yā thā/ ༈da dī taX/da dī ya/ da dī ba hi/da dī ma hi/ cho ga 'byung gi ut+pa ne'o/ ༈dkyus bzhin du/ da ltuX/ da dwa tā/ a ta ru bsgyur/ da da taX/ ༈da h+phu/ da dā thāX/ da juX/ ༈da dā da zhes pa ba theg /e 387—

i la i'o/ da di/ phyi ma 'di gnyis la 'dra ba sbyar/ da dwa ba lha/ da dwa ma hai/shis byed kyi ut+pa ne rnams so/༈da ni 'di rnams la aṭa sbyor te/ da dā wā zhes pa bzhug /gong du aṭa/ na rjes 'brel/ dwa'i dbyangs phyis/ ta ru song / rkyen gyi ta la drangs/ a dat+ta/ ༈a da dā tāX/ ༈a ta ru bsgyur/ a da da ta/ ༈a da t+thaX/ a da dā thāX/ a da juX/ ༈a da di/ a da dwa hi/ a da du hi/ deng min pa'i ut+pa ne rnams so/༈khu dha nya 'dzin pa dang rgyas pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings la/ khyu dang nya phyis/ dh+wa bzhag go /de yang la ṭa gyi gzhan don gyi rkyen las/ ༈khyu ti pra/ pra rjes 'brel/ da 'jig /byings nyis 'gyur/ khyu gong ma thung ngur bsgyur/ dzha pa rnams dza ba'o/ /zhes pas dha thung ngu de da ru song / da dhī ta/༈phu rba gya ngi ti dzha se dhaX/ ngi ta dzha sa la dang po'i dha 'o/ /byings dza ba so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge can yin la/ pha rol tu rnam dbye di ta yin pa/ dza (dzha )sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yin pa byung na/ byings snga ma da yig ni/ dha yig tu bsgyur ba yin te/ skabs gzhan du ni/ gdod ma'i da yig dha yig tu bsgyur ba la dgongs pa yin mod kyang / 'dir ni dha yig da yig tu bsgyur ba de nyid/ slar yang dha yig tu bsgyur dgos so/ /nges pa 'di yang / khuṅgā nya la sogs pa 'ga' zhig la yin gyi/ kun la 'jug par ma nges so/ /'dir dzha sa zhes pa ka lwa par mthar gnas dang rjes su sna ldan ma yin pa'i gsal byed dhu ṭa'o/ /zhes pa dang phal cher gcig ste/ 'on kyang 'dir ha yig bor ba ni khyad par ro/ /de'i phyir rnam dbye 'di rnams kyi nang na/ gsal byed dang por yod pa'i rkyen la/ da/—388—

mas/ ma hai/ ma/ ma hi/ staskyu sogs dgu rnams/ dzha sa so sor bsdu ba ma yin pa/ bsu/ ba he/ ba/ ba hi ste bzhi po 'di rnams mthar gnas yin pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dzha sa'i lugs mi byed pa dang / pa sde gsum pa yin pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dzha sa'i lugs kyi bya ba byed par 'dod pa gnyis yod cing / gzhung 'di na'ang ci rigs pa las/ pa sde'i lugs gtso che bar 'dod do/ ༈dh+wa tas da/ gnyis brjod/ bhā gong ma da thung ga slar yang dha ru log ste thung ngu nyid/bhā phyi ma'i a phyis/ dha dra ru song / de tra ru song / drangs/ dha t+taX/ ༈bi tra rnams dang dbyangs dang po can la/ da yig dha yig tu bsgyur ba med/ an+ti a tir bsgyur/ a phyis/ drangs/ da dha ti/ ༈da dh+wa si/ ༈dha t+thaX/ ༈bhañdza/ da dh+wa mi/ ༈pa sde'i dbang du byas na/ da druX/ ༈mthar gnas kyi dbang du byas na/ da dh+waX/༈dasaX/ ༈dpeX/ ri ki g.yin don la/ gong dwa'i byings kyi rigs 'gre ste/ da khyu tra/ ༈da khyi tāX/ ༈da kwaX/ ༈da khyuX/ ༈da khyi taX/ ༈da khyu ta/ ༈da khyuX/ ༈da dha ba/ ༈da bha ma/ ༈lo ṭa'i gzhan don la/ da dh+wa tu/ yang / dha stu tra/ ༈dha stuX/ ༈a skye a tu ru bsgyur/ da dh+wa tu/ ༈hi'i skabs 'dir/ da rnams kyi hi la'o/ /zhes pa ltar/byings gong ma da phyis/ phyi ma'i dbyangs e ru bsgyur bas/ khyu hi/ yang na/dha stuta/ ༈dha t+taX/ ༈dha ta/ ༈da bhā ni/ ༈da bhā ba/ ༈da dā ma/ ༈ri gi gzhan don ni/da dh+wa dis/ aṭa/ a da dha ta/ ༈a dha ltuX/ an us su bsgyur/ dha'i ā phyis te drangs/ a da dhuX/ ༈a da bhāX/ ༈a dha stuX/ ༈a dha t+ta/ ༈a da dh+waX/ ༈a da dh+wa/ ༈a da ju/ zhes pa rnams so/༈da ni bdag don gyi rnam dbye las/ la ṭa yi bdag don ni/ dha ste/ ༈da —389—

dha te/ ༈a rnye a ter bsgyur/ da dha te/ ༈dha khye/ ༈da bhā the/ ༈dha rnye/ ༈da dhe/ ༈dhad+ma he/ ༈dhad+ma he/ ༈da gi bdag don ni/ da dhī ta/ da dhī yā tī/ ༈da dhī ran/ ༈da dhī thāX/ ༈da dhī yā thaX/ ༈da dhī bhā༈da dhī ya/ ༈da dhī ba hi/ ༈da dhī ma hi/ ༈lo ṭa'i bdag don ni/ dha stuX/ ༈da bhā tāX/ ༈a tar bsgyur/ da da tāX/ ༈dha grwa/ ༈da dh+wa thaX/ ༈dha juX/༈e i la e/ da lha mtshungs pa sbyar/ da dh+wa ba hai/ ༈da dh+wa ma hai/ ༈ri gi bdag don ni/ thams cad la a thog mar sbyar/ tan gyi na rjes 'brel/ ā dha t+ta/ ༈a da bhā tāX/ ༈a da dha ta/ ༈a da t+thaX/ ༈a da dh+wa thaX/ ༈a dha juX/ ༈a da dhi/ ༈a da dh+wa hi/ ༈a dasmo hi/ zhes pa rnams so/ /de rnams ni 'jig pa bi ka ra ṇa'i sde tshan te/ thams cad du da 'jig pa go bar bya'o/༈ /dis rtsed mo dang rgyal bar 'dod pa dang / 'du 'god dang gsal ba dang bstod pa dang / rmi lam dang dga' ba dang myos pa dang 'gro ba rnams la'o/ /zhes pas byings di pra zhes pa ba theg go /byings mdo sngar bsgyur ba na/rgyal 'dod kyi skad dod/ bi dzi gī rdo bar 'dod pa dang / bya ba hā ra tha snyad du bsgyur ba spyir de yin mod kyang / 'dir 'du 'god kyi don yin/ byu ti/ sdu gu zhes bar bsgyur 'dug /rmi lam dga' myos gsum mi snang ngo / /di bā de rlaX/di pra la sogs pa la ya'o/ /di pra la sogs pa'i byings kyi tshogs rnams la/ ti pu la sogs pa'i rnam dbye sum cu rtsa drug byin pa'i tshe/ bar gyi rkyen du ya bi kā ra ṇa 'byung ngo / /ya'o zhes pas/ ri kyi rkyen mi 'ju/ga pa shugs las 'phangs so/ /gong du i u pu dag ra ba ha sa la'o/ zhes 'byung bas/ rkyen la ra dang ba dang ha sa dag yod na/ byings kyi thog ma'i dbyangs de ring por 'gyur ro/ /des ——bye90—

na 'dir/ dis tis zhes pa bzhag /bar du rkyen ya byin/ ya ni ha sa'i rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ di'i yī ring por 'gyur/ pra dbyangs med ya'i steng du drangs/ dī bya ti/ ༈tas la sgrub tshul de kho na dang 'dra/ dī bya taX/ ༈a rnyi la rkyen ya'i dbyangs a phyis/ yu dbyangs med an dang sbyar/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra/ dī bya rnyi/ ༈des mtshon te thams cad la rkyen ya byin/ dī ring por song / ba ya la drangs pas/ dī bya zhes 'byung ba go bar byas te/ de la rnam dbye sbyar ba'i lus 'gyur so sor byed do/ /dī bya si/ ༈dī bya thaX/ ༈dī bya tha/ ༈dī byā mi/ ༈dī byā baX/ ༈dī byā maX/ de gsum la ba ma dag la u'o/ zhes pa dran par bya'o/ ༈sta chu sogs las yus yu mu spangs pa'i bdun po la yā rnams i yig tu bsgyur zhing / de ya bi kā ra ṇa la/ a i la e zhes mtshams sbyor rgyu yin/ ༈yus kyi skabs/ yu la rnam 'gyur med/ ya ba'i mthar/ i ṭa ā ga ma 'jug ste/ ya bi dang mtshams sbyor byed pa yin/ ༈yu mu gyi skabs su lha mu i da du bsgyur nas mtshams sbyor ro/ /de ltar byas pas gzugs 'di bzhin du 'byung ste/ dī bye tra/ ༈dī bye tāX/ dī bye yuX/ ༈dī byeX/ ༈dī bye tāX/ ༈dī bye ta/ ༈dī bye yaX/ ༈dī bya ba/ ༈dī bya ma/ zhes so/ ༈tu pu sogs la/ dī bya tu/ yang na/ dī byā twata/ ༈dī byā tāX/ ya bi'i a phyis/ bya dbyangs med an dang sbyar/ hi bya skye/ rkyen hi ni a mtha' la dbyi ba'am/ yang na ta tad du bsgyur ro/ /dī bya/ dī bya ā/ ༈dī bya tāX/ ༈di bya ta/ ༈dī byā ni/ dī byā ba/ dī byā ma/ de gsum la 'dra ba ring po'o/ ༈rnam dbye dis sogs ni thams cad la aṭa mgor sbyar/ da phyis pas/ dib du ru song / de tra ru song / a di bya tra/ ༈a dī bya tāX/ ༈an gyi skabs ya bi'i a phyis/ ya phar drangs/ a dī —391—

byan/ ༈ri rnam bcad/ a dī byaX/chi༈a dī bya tāX/ ༈a dī bya ta/ ༈a ri kyi skabs 'dir/ ya'i a phyis/ pha rol a la drangs/ mu nga ro/ a dī byaX/ ༈ba ma la ā dran/ a dī byā ba/ ༈a dī byā ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ /di pu pa ra sme pa ti yin pas/ bdag don gyi rkyen rnams mi 'jug go /༈khun gcod cing rdung ba la'o/ /ā duXgiXsnaX/ dang po'i ṣa ṇa ni sa na 'o/ /byings kyi thog ma'i yi ge ṣa yig yod na/ sa yig du 'gyur ba dang / ṭa sde'i ṇa yig yod na/ ta sde'i na yig tu 'gyur/ zhes pa ste rkyen rnams dang phrad pa'i nus pa'o/ /swā de rnuX/ su la sogs pa la nu'o/ /'dir byings khun ni su zhes par 'gro ba yin pas/ su ste khun la sogs pa'i byings kyi tshogs pa la pha rol tu byings thams cad pa'i rkyen sde tshan bzhi po gang byung yang / bar du rkyen nu bi ka ra ṇa 'jug par bya'o/ gal te byings la dang por ṣa yig yod na sa yig dang /ṇa yig yod na na yig tu 'gyur ba yang skabs 'dir yin no/bhā py-i tho ta thā to su na rmā/ su dang na ma dag pa la sogs pa rnams kyi de ltar gnyis lnga'o/ khu la sogs pa dang ṇa mu la sogs pa'i byings kyi/ ṣa yig dang ṇa yig de dag ti pu sogs rnam dbye nu bi dang bcas pa phrad pa las sa dang nar song ba de la nyer sgyur mi sbyor na de ka gnas mod de dag la sngon du pra la sogs pa'i nyer snyur nyi shu po gang bzhag kyang 'dra ste/ sa dang na gnyis po rang gi sngon gyi gnas ṣa yig dang / ṇa yig nyid du slar ldog ste 'gro ba yin no/ /nu pa/ nu dang u ba'o/ /pha rol pi ta kyi rnam dbye yod na nu bi kwa ra dang /—392—
