ge phyi ma dbyangs ṛ yig yod/ ṛ yig uru zhes par 'gyur ro/ ༈rlud srog 'dor ba la'o/ /mṛ ti pra sa rkyen/ pu'i ṛ uru/ mu ru sa ti gnyis brjod/ gras mu ru/ ru dang po yal/ sa la ring po'o/ /u phyi ma ring po'o/ /sa ṣa mu myu rna te/ ji skad du sa dang lkog gyur sogs la pa ra smi'i tshig go /zhes 'byung bas sa rkyen bshad ma thag pa de yin/ ༈lkog gyur gyi rkyen la mtshon na/ mṛ ṇa pra/ ṇa dang pra yal a ba theg gnyis brjod/ mṛ mṛ/ dang po'i ṛ a/ phyi ma 'phel/ uru/ma mu uru a drangs/ ma mā ra/ zhes so/ ༈yang gal te sa yang med ṇa pu mi byed na ya ga ster/ at+pa ne byed te/ smri ya ka te ba theg ṛ i ru bsgyur/ mi ya te/ ༈ru dwa de tsa tu rtaX twa swā deX/ ru da sogs kyi ha dang ba sa dang po la ste bzhi po rnams la'o/ /ru da sogs kyi byings la pha rol ti pra sogs byings thams cad pa bzhi'i rnam dbye yod cing / ha yig dang ba sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge rkyen du yod na/ /i ṭa ā ga ma ster ro/ /ad sog la 'jig go /zhes pas da ster te 'jig go /ru dir mchi ma 'byin pa la'o/ /da yal dra du/ da/ ti pra/ pi ta la yon to/ da 'jig /i ṭa rod i ti/ ro di ti/ ༈byings a kha/apra ti/ a 'jig i ṭa khya swa swa pi ti/ ༈byings su pu swa pra da ti pu a 'jig i ṭa swa pi ti/ ༈ byings an an da ti pra na ṇa a pra 'jig i ṭa pra gong 'dra ba ring / pru ṇi ti/ ༈de bzhin du pi tra min pa la yon tan med/ rnam dbye dbyangs la i ṭa med/ ru di taX/ ru da rnyi/ ༈ro di ṣi/ ru di thaX/ ru di tha/ ༈ro di mi/ ru di baX/ ru di maX/ ༈ji skad du/ ru da sogs kyi ngi dang si dag la i ṭa dang aṭa 'o/ /zhes bshad pas dis ri phyi ma la/ i ṭa dang aṭa gdam khar —545—

byed/ gnyis ka bi ta yin pas byings la yon tan no/ /ru da zhi ṭa di pu yon tan no/ /aṭa gong a ro du snyid/ a ro byin/ aṭa byin a ro da ta/ gzhan 'dra/༈rud zhi ṭa si pra yon tan aṭa gong a rod zhis/ a ro dīXgrub/ a byin/ a ro daX/ zhes so/ ༈ /ru da'i sogs khongs gsum po'ang des rigs 'gre/ a su rdi yin/ a su bta/ ༈65 su bīX/ a/ su baX/ shegs dang / ༈a swa ji smon/ a su sa dra/a su sīX/ a su saX/ zhes dang / ༈an pra sngon aṭa kyi sngon du 'jog /pu a/an/ lha khro mtshams sbyar/ pā 'i ta/ pru ṇa ta/ ༈bhā ṇiX/ bhā ṇaX/ zhes pa'o/ /༈'grel pa'i dpe kha cig las swa pi ti tsi ba su si tiX pru ṇi tista thā/ dza k+ṣi ti tsi ba bi dz+nya yo ru diXpañtsa ko ga ṇaX/ 'di 'dra ba ni su pi ti yang ste/ swa si ti dang de bzhin pru ṇi ti/ /dzak+ṣa ti yang 'di dang 'drar shes bya/ /ru da la sogs lnga po tshogs pa'o/ /zhes lung drangs te/ ༈ shwa sa srog la'o/ /shwa si ti/ ༈ /nyi lnga pa nyal la'o/ /sta su du bskyur/ sā si ti/ lo ṭa'i hi dang sbyar na su pi hi/ ༈yang na an ma yin par byings rang la pru ṇa rtsed mo la'o/ /pru ṇi ti/ i ṭa kho na las aṭa med pa'ang gzhung 'di'i dgongs pa'o/ /dzak+ṣa dang bha k+ṣa rgod pa la'o/ /sngar bzhin te/ dzak+ṣa i ṭa/ tis/ drangs dza spyi ti/ dzik+ṣa taX/ dzak+ṣa de raX to ྅da na usaX/dzak+ṣa la sogs pa'i an+ta dang a ta dang an us so/ /'di kha skong gi gzhung du 'dod pa dang lung 'dren du 'dod pa gnyis yod/ gang ltar yang / dzak+ṣa sogs kyi byings la rnam dbye an+ta a ta dang an u su su bsgyur ro/ dzak+ṣa dzā⑪ da ṛ drwa shā sa/ di dhi bo rtswa tsa kā sri ste byings bdun dzak+ṣa la sogs pa ste/ drang srong thub pa kha cig gi 'di rnams la a khyu rta'i ming bzhag go ༈ 'dir aX ti a ti bsgyur/—546—

dzak+ṣa ti/ an us su bsgyur bas/ dza ltuXyong ngo / ༈tsa kā mṛ mdangs bkrag la'o/ /tsa kā mṛ/ ṛ rjes 'brel/ ti pra bzhag bi ta la bya ba med/ sa ta la drangs/ tsa kā sti/ tsa kwa staX/ ༈aX ti'i nga ro phyis sa a la drangs tsa kā sa ti/༈ dzā kṛ gnyid sangs pa la'o/ /dzu gro ti pra/ twa la yon tan/ dzā ga rte/ ༈ltas ngi tra ha sa yin rnam 'gyur med dzā gro taX ༈dzā kṛ aX ti/ a tir bsgyur ji ta dbyangs yin/ ṛ ru dzā/ ga ru a ti drangs dzā gra ti/ zhes so/ ༈ /da ri drwa de ri dā lo pañtsa di ti/ dā ri dra sogs kyi ngi ta la i te a dbyi ba'o/ byings da ri drwa sogs la pha rol rnam dbye ngi ta dbyangs dang po can byung na/ byings mtha' ā dbyi bar 'gyur zhing / ngi tra ha sa dang po can byung na/ byings mtha' ā ring po i thung du 'gyur ro/ ༈ /da ri drwa ngan par 'gro ba la'o/ /da ri drwa kho/ rnam 'gyur med/ da ri drwa ti/ ༈tas ni ngi tra ha sa yin te/ da ri drwa tas/ byings mtha'i ā i ru song / da ri dri taX/ ༈da ri grwa aX ti/ byings mtha'i ka a phyis dra a la drangs da ri dra ti/ zhes sogs so/ thus rjes su 'thor ba la'o/ shwas zhes pa'i byings 'di da ri drwa sogs zhes pa'i sogs khongs mtshon byed yin/ nus pa dang cho ga gcig kyang rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba 'byung bas nges pa skyed pa'i don du bshad do/ /de yang cis zhe na/ da ri drwa zhes pa dbyangs ā ring po'i mtha' yin/ shus gsal byed mtha' can yin pas mi 'dra ste/ ā mtha'i i ru 'gyur yang sa mtha' i ru mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang nus pa dang cho ga'i bya ba 'dra ba ni/ /snga mar ngi tra gsal byed mthong na dbyangs i ru 'gyur ba'i dod u pa dh+wa i ru 'gyur ba yin no/ shas nyis pi ta la rnam 'gyur med/ sa ta la drangs/ shwasti/—547—

༈shas tas gsal byed u pa dh+wa i shi/ i ku la/ sa lga ṣa mthong ta ṭa shi giX/༈shwa su aX ti nga ro phyis/ ā mtha' yin na yal bar byed kyang / sa mtha' la dbyangs med pas mi dbyi ste/ a la drangs/ shā sa ti/ ༈shā sa na ta/ u ba dh+wa i/sa ṣa drangs/ shi ྅ tra la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /yī ḍi shoX/ zhi ḍa dang yī sha dag gi'o/ /dpe kha cig las ni/ zhi ḍa dang yī sha dag gis dang khyu la i ṭa 'o/ /zhes bzhad do/ 'di gzhan gyi lung du byas pa'ang snang ste don la 'dra'o/ /byings zhwa ḍa dang sī sha la sbyor ba'i se rje'i rnam dbye'i sngon du i ṭa ā ga ma ster ro/ ༈ /zhwa ḍa bstod pa la'o/ /yi tha dbang phyug spyod pa la'o/ /zhi ḍa/ te/ yī sha te bzhag kha sa la tsa pa sogs te ḍi ḍa/ iṅge/ sha ṣa ru song / te ṭi ru song drangs/ ilge༈ā ḍā te/ yī shā te/ aX te a te/ zhi ḍa te/ yī sha te/ ༈des mtsho ni i ṭa/ yī ni tshe yī ṣi ṣe ༈yī ḍa the/ yī shā the/ i ṭa/ zhwa ḍi dhe/ yī shi zla/ sī ḍi/ yī she/'a spre ༈yī ḍā he yī shwa he/ ༈zhi zla he/ zhi shā he/༈o ro/ rnga ri u' e'o/ /da lta 'chad 'gyur yu sogs byings bzhi la sogs pa mang po zhig rnam dbye mthong na byings kyi u yig au ru 'gyur te de yang ti sogs thams cad la ma yin pi ta kyi ming can la ta sa/ thog mar yod pa la'o/ /yu nu ru stu khyu klu bī/ yu nu ru stu rnams las yī ru yang na'o/ /yu sogs bzhi la yang u 'phel ba or 'gro /yang na yon tan o ru song ba zhi ru rkyen du ster/ ru rjes 'brel lo/ ༈ /yu rdzi / / u au ru song / yo ti/ ༈yu zhi ru ti/yu yon tan/ o ab ya da yī ti/ ya bī ti/ ༈des mtshon ru tipya/ ro ti/ ra —548—

bī ti/ ༈nu ti pu/ no te/ na bī ti/ ༈stu ti pu/ sto ti/ sta bī ti/ ṇa tul cho ga g.yin te/ stu tas// stu taX/ ༈nu byings la'o zhes pas u ni u lnga/ ru bsgyur ba dbyangs rkyen la yin te/ stu aX ti/ u ni/ ub ru bsgyur/ stu brnyi/ ༈stu ri/sto ski yang na yon tan zhi ru/ sta bī ṣi la sogs pa'o/ /lo pa sta nu dat+ta ta nāX/tan rnams a nu dat+ta la dbyi'o/ /tan sogs kyi byings la a nu dat+ta nya ma so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge ste sde pa'i lnga pa rnams yod na dbyi ste/ ki ta dang ngi ta dzha sa'i yi ge thog ma can pha rol du yod pa la'o/ ༈ /han tis/ 'di ngi ta min/ pi ta yin pa dbyi ba min/ na nga ro/ haX ti/ ༈tan tas/ ngi ta dzha sa pha rol can yin pas nya ma'i yi ge na dbyi/ ha haX/ a ti dbyangs yin/ dzha sa min/ han aX ti ga mu rnams kyi dbyangs la'o zhes pas u pa dh+wa a yig yal/ ha dbyangs med/gha lhan aX ti drangs/ dzo /༈namaX/ na mu la'o/ /bar rkyen na mu byung na'ang / nya ma'i yi ge byings la yod pa de dbyi'o khyad par du na yig nges par dbyi'o/ /hid si 'tshe ba la'o i brjod don hi ngas ti pu/ tu dha sogs la na mu'o/ /hid dang sa'i bar du na mu/ mu rjes 'brel/ hid ti byung / he'i mthar brten dra'am klad skor na nyid yin pas dbyis drangs/ hi na sti/ ༈nyidas tas na mu hi byonas/ tas hi dra gi nga ro snga ma yal/ na'i a phyis/ na nga ro drangs/ hi staX/ ༈de dang 'dra sa a la drangs hid+ma rnyi/༈bha thu bsnyed pa la'o/ /bha dz+ra/ ti pra/ na mu/ bhan/ dza)/ dzu ṣa ru song / dzika bha na sti/ ༈na nga ro/ dzu ṣa kra/ bhaX khyiX/ ༈dbyangs dang phrad drangs/ bhaX dza rnyi/༈a pi raX dza daX sha ṣaX dza khyaX dzāX/ raX dzu daXshra ldaX sdo ṭhaX dzā rnams da kyi'o/ raXdzu —549—

la sogs pa 'di rnams da dang bcas pa'i rnam dbye pha rol u pa dha'i na dbyi'o/ /de raXdzu zhes klad skor dang / ran dzu zhes na dngos dang / rañdza zhes nya yig byung kyang rung ste lus 'gyur mi 'dra ba yin gyi /don la skabs 'dir na zhes pa de yin te/ dbyi ba go dgos te snga phyi phal cher la rigs 'gre de ltar go dgos so/ /raXrdzu da/ ti pra/ nga ro/ na yin pas dbyi/ ra dza ti/ ༈raXdzu/ ri/tas/ ra dza taX/ ༈'di la ri med/ ra snyo/ ༈daXsha a pu ti pu nga ro yal/ da sha ti/ da sha taX/ da sha ti/ ༈saXdzu/ da/ ti mu/ sa dza ti/ sa dza taX/ sa ja rnyi/༈ṣiXshu'i/ ṣa sa ru bsgyur/ nas na yal bar byed pa yin/ ṣaX dza la de dang 'dra ste/ṣaX dzu da/ ti pra/ su dza ti/ su dza taX/ su dza rnyi/ an+ti ku na la da med do/ /bi do na pā nāX t+yā dī nāX ṇa bā di rbu/ bi da'i ti sogs dgu rnams ṇa pra sogs su yang na'o/ /byings bi da'i pha rol du byung ba ti pra dgu /ṇa pu sogs dgu ru rim pas grangs bzhin bsgyur nas bya ba byed do/ /yang na'o zhes gdam ka ste/ yang na mi bsgyur bar ti pu sogs rang gi sgrub tshul byed ces pa ste/ ༈de yang ti pra ṇa pu du bsgyur/ tas a thus su'o/ /an+ti us su'o/ /ri da skyo/ /thas ni a thus su'o/ /mi pra ni ṇa pra tu'o/ /bsu ba ru bsgyur/ mas ma ru bsgyuraba'o/ /ṇa pu gnyis la pra dang ṇa phyis/ a bzhag de gnyis dang / ri la yon tan/ bi be du 'gro /dbyangs rnams da'i srog tu bcug /tha la dra tra ru song ba drangs/ ba ma la dra rang nyid 'dren/ ༈be da bi da 6༷/ bi duX/ ༈bet+ta/bi da thuX/ bi da/ ༈be da bid+ma/ bid+ma/ ༈mi bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ ti la yon tan ti/ tas la dra ta drangs an+ti a la dra 'dren pa kho na'o/ /be sti/ bi t+taX/ bi da rnyi/—550—

༈be 〉 / bit+thaX bit+tha/ ༈be d+me/ bid+maX bid+maX/ zhes pa'o/ ༈bet+ta raX to bā ru ṭa/bi da'i mtha' la wo yang na'o/ /'di kha skong gi mdo yin zer/ bi da'i byings la yang na rus ug ma ster ro/ /bid da/ te/ rus/ ṭa rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ bi das a te drangs/ bi dra te/ ༈tso me da na/ bid da te/ bid te/zhes sogs ut+pa ne pa ti yang sbyor ba dmigs gsal la lo/ ༈de bzhin du/ bi byā tra la sogs pa'o/ /bestu/ bistuta/ tu pu la gnyis so/ /bistuX/ bi da skye/ ༈birnyi/bistuta/ hi la gnyis so/ /bit+taX/ bit+ta/ ༈be dā ni/ be dā ba/ be dā ma/ ༈a de ta/a bed/ di pra yal/ ta ru bsgyur ma bsgyur gyi khyad yin/ a bit+taX/ an us/a bi tuX/ ༈da sa'o zhes pas da la dra sa ru bsgyur na a bid da yon tan/dra sa da phyis sa rnam bcad/ a beX/ ༈ma bsgyur na da phyis pa tsam te/ a bed dra tra ru song na/ a bi ta/ a bit+taX/ a bit+ta/ ༈a be daX/ a bid+ma/ a bid+ma/༈as yod pa la'o/ /da ti pu pi ta yin rnam 'gyur tsam med de/ a sti/ ༈na mu da la'o/ /zhes pas ji tra pha rol la ri a dbyi'o/ /as tas a dbyi su drangs staX/ ༈de dang 'dra aX ti sa rnyi/ ༈si saX/ si'i sa'o/ da la da kyi a mi dbyi sa dbyi'o/ /as da sa yal/ a si/ ༈pi ta ma yin pa'i rigs gzhan kun a yal ba ste su drangs pa'o/ /s+thaXs+tha/ ༈a smi suX smaX/ ༈sgyu tra/ byā tāX/phyuXsogs so/ ༈as tra pra pi ta yin/ a stu/ tā tab du bsgyur na pi ta min par song bas a yal/ stuta/ ltuX/ sa skye/༈dza hre dhi shā dhiX/ snyi e dhi shā dhi 'o/ /byings tī ni dza hi ru ā de sha byed/de bzhin du/ da ni e dhi zhes bsgyur ba dang / shas ni shā dhi zhes par tshig phrad —551—

kyis bsgyur ba yin te/ de yang byings gsum po de la hi byin pa hi phyis te bsgyur ba'am/ byings hi dang bcas pa bsgyur ro/ ༈ /dza hi/ e dhi/ shudhi/ zhes pa kho na'o/ /staX/ sta/ ༈pi ta dran/ a sā ni/ a swā ba/ ༈a swā ma/ ༈a ste zib/ as nyid la snyiṭa 'o/ /as kyi pha rol du di pu dang ri byung na zhwaṭa ā ga mar 'gyur ro/ /as di pu 'di pi ta yin aṭa aṭa bzhag klu ṭa byin/ a a a sa lha dra byung rim pas mtshams sbyar/ ā sri tra/ ༈yang da dang a da ma ga|gis pa la as kyi a yal/ aṭa aṭa sbyar ba'i ā yod/ ustaX/ us na/ ༈da la da a 'jog /i ṭa ster ra phyis sa rnam bcad ā sīX a staX/ usta/ ༈a da a sdod/ da yal/ ā saX/ a sba/ asma/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈li hu ro myang ba la'o/ /li ha ti pu bzhag gye'i rte'o/ /ha sbru ru song / ta tha dag gi dha 'o/ /ti dhi ru song / stu las skye'o/ /dhi khyi ru 'gyur pi ta rnams la u paṅgā thung ngu'o zhes pas li yon tan le ru 'gro /le khyu ṭi zhes byung / lha la ṭi dbyi ste ring po yang ngo / /zhes dhi'i rde mthong ba ṭi te lha snga mā mi snang bar 'gro la/ pi tra min/ ta thog ma rnams la yon to mi byed par u pa bhā ring por byed do/ ༈ /tib kyis skabs su le dhi zhes pa'o/ /ta rkyen rnams dang tha rkyen rnams la dha dang lhar bsgyur ba dang / dbyangs mtha' ma yin/ da dang wa ma spangs pa rnams la ha lha ru bsgyur nas dbyi ba yin mod/ da dang ba ma rnams la ma yin no/ /ri dang po/ si sdod pas ha rte ru song ba yang ka ru song / si ṣi ru song ba kra dang 'grogs k+ṣa ru 'gro /phyi ma skabs 'dir 'jig /ha khyu ru bsgyur ba ste dza ba ḍa' ma tsa pa ṭa ru byed do/ /ba ma dang dbyangs ngi ta ya tra sogs la yon to dang ring po —552—

yang mi byed/ ha nyid ma bsgyur par 'dren no/ ༈ /tas sogs la lī khyuḥ/ li ha rnyi/༈le k+ṣi/ lī lhaX/ lī khyu/ ༈le smi/ li smiX/ li hangaX/ zhes so/ ༈yang li rgyu tra sogs dgu'o/ ༈le ḍū lī lha ta/ lī bhāX/ li han/ ༈dzha sa las hi dhi 'o/ /zhes hi dhi ru 'gro ba dang / dhi lha'o/ /yang i ṭa 'byung bas li ha'i ha dang sbyor/ hi hi rang la gnasayang tā taX ru bsgyur ba pi tra min pa'i ta rkyen spyi dang 'dra'o/ /lī dhi/ li hi hi/༈li rta'i i ṭa 'o zhes bshad do/ /lī bhā ta/ ༈lī sgyeX/ li khyu/ ༈le hā ni/ le hā ba/le hā ma/ zhes so/ ༈di pra dbyi/ dza ba ḍa dang tsa pa ṭa 'dam ka dang pi ta dran aṭa a leṭa/ a leḍa gdam ka'o/ /ā lī bhāX/ a li han/ ༈da yal/ a leṭa/a leḍa/ gdam nga'o/ /a lī bhāX/ a lī lha/ ༈a le haX/ a li hā/ a lid+ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈tshwa dra gsal bar brjod pa la'o/ /ri rjes 'brel dgos don no/ /sko rā sgo sa dang ka dang po yang ngo / /byings kyi mtha' la gsal byed rab sbyor yod pa'i nang na/ sa dang ka yig yod na dbyi'o/ /de yang pha rol dzha sa so sor bsdu ba yod pa la yin no/ ༈ /tsak+ṣa te zhes pa bzhag k+ṣa dbyangs med kyi kra dang dzi so sor phral bas ka ni dang po'i rgyu ṣa yig pas ṣa ru log /ṣa ni dang po sa yin pas sa ru log /tsa yis te byung gsal byed srog med gnyis phan chad 'dzom na gsal byed rab sbyor zer ba dran par bya/ skabs 'dir rab sbyor gyi sa dbyi/ tshu rol ṣa mthong bas pha rol te ṭi ru song / drangs/ tshwa ska bi dang ud sngon du bzhag na/ bi u tsasne/ byā tsasne/ ༈dbyangs lak+ṣa rang 'dren tsak+ṣu te/bi ud sbyor ba kun la 'gre aX te la tsak+ṣa te/ ༈ṣa'i sa la ka'o/ /zhes pas ṣa sa —553—

dzikar song su dbyi rnam dbye se ṣe ru song kra drangs tsa snye/ ༈tsak+ṣu the/ ༈su yal ṣa kra de ga ka/ yang na/ tsarte/ ༈tsak+ṣi/ ༈ji skad du/ sde par ma byung ba pha rol gyi gzugs la'o/ /zhes 'byung ba ma yig sde pa yin yang dzha sa'i yi ge ma yin la/ba yig ni pa sde'i ba yin na/ dzha sa yin pas sa dbyi dgos kyang mthar gnas yin/ sde ba min zhing dzha sa min pas sa mi dbyi ste/ k+ṣa yongs rdzogs pha rol ba'i gzugs la 'dren no/ /tsak+ṣa ba he/ tsak+ṣu he/ zhes pa'o/ ༈chog 'byung la/tsa spyi ta/ tsak+ṣi yā tāX/ tsa spyir na la sogs pa'o/ ༈shis byed la/ tāX sogs te sa phyis/ tā ṭā tsasaX/ tsak+ṣu tāX/ a taX/ a taX ngo / tsak+ṣa taX/ ༈tsak+ṣa tsak+ṣu thaX tsarmāXhwa de gnyis sa yal ṣa yang ka ru slar log pa'o/ ༈tsak+ṣi/ tsak+ṣu ba hai/ tsak+ṣu ma hai/ zhes so/ ༈deng min la tan gyi na yal su dbyi/ ta ṭa/ tsa ni/ tsak+ṣu tāX/ tsak+ṣa ta/ ༈thus la sa yal/ ṣa kra/ zaX/ tsak+ṣu thāX/ tsa hāXhwa/ ༈tsak+ṣi// tsa nyu/ tsak+ṣi/ha hi/ byā tsak+ṣu hi/zhes so/ ༈a n+ya tra so dzaX/ gzhan du sa dza'o/ /o la rdzi ngo tshar byed pa la'o/ /o khyad don yī brjod don/ la sgra te bzhag da 'dir sa hro rab sbyor yin yang sa mi dbyi ste/ sa nyid dzu ru bsgyur la dzu dzu a te byung drangs/ la dz+dza te/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/༈di pi sa phya taXsi pi bā/ di pra kyi sa'i tra ste da la yang na'o/ /sa mtha' can gyi byings la di pu byin na byings mtha'i sa hu ru 'gro la da byin na ha byed dam rnam bcad byed gdam ka yin/ di pu da gnyis po rang dbyi bar bya'o/༈tsa kā mṛ gsal ba la'o/ /ṛ brjod don tsakwa sa di pu sa tra di pu yal/ aṭa/ a tsaka ta/ tsakwa sa da yang sa tra ri a tsaka ta yang na ri yal sa rnam bcad—554—

a tsa kaX/ zhes so/ ༈gzhan hi dhi ru bsgyur/ an us lhag ma rnams sa pha rol du drang ngo / /'di pa ra smi'o/ ༈khyu gto gyi sbyor ba la'o/ ༈khyu ti pu ud sngon du bzhag /ā khyu ti/ zhen/ dang / ༈ā khyu na yin sogs dang / ༈ā khyu tu/ ༈aṭa/'dra ba/ ā khyu tra/ ces sogs so/ ༈tsho sdo'i gtsang ma la'o/ /pra dze rba rdi bi ti/ rmudza la 'phel ba ste bi tra la'o/ /mṛ dza'i byings la bi tra pha rol du byung na rmi la 'phel bar 'gyur nges pa di tra dang bo dbyangs yin pa la gdam nga'o/ /mṛ hro ti da/ mṛ 'phel ba mā ru sgoX ta ṭa drangs/ mu pri ni/ ༈tas la 'phel ba med/ rmyu giX/ ༈dbyangs la rnam rtog ste/ mu rdzaX ti/ rmidza rnyi/ ༈mṛ rgyu ta/spo dz+nyā tāX/ mṛ dz+nyāX/ ༈muṇ+ḍa/ khrugata/ mṛ gaX/ mṛ rnga ca/ mu rdza skye/ ༈a mu rna/ yang na/ a muṇ+ḍa/ a spogaX/ amri dzan zhes/ pa la sogs pa ste/ 'dir mu riṣ+ṭha zhes pa la/ mā ra sa 'i zer blta bur klog /tsak+ta'i k+ṣa lta bu sgra 'gyur ba yin kyang /dbyangs med na/ tsa ka kha zer ba 'dra rung 'don/ sgra mi 'gyur ba/ a ma ṭo brtsegs pa srog med la/ a ma ra tre zer ba lta bu dgos kyi/ blun po'i mun sprul dang mkhas su re ba 'dra'i tshod rgyag la snying po med do/༈ni dzāX gu ṇaX/ ni dza rnams kyi yon tan no/ /ni dza la sogs pa'i byings kyi thog ma'i yi ge la yon tan du 'gyur te da zhig pa'i yul la'o/ /ṇi dzi ru dag byed dang so sor byed pa la'o/ /da rjes 'brel ṇi dzā ti pra zhes pa bzhagaḍa ni ru bsgyur gnyis brjod thog ma ha sogs dzu snga ma phyis/ ni dza rnams kyi yon tan no/ /zhes pas ni snga ma la yon tan no/ /yon tan 'di ni dza'i skabs 'dir rtas tu 'jug go /ne ni thu ti byung ti pra pi ta yin pas de'i yon to ni gnyis —555—

brjod phyi ma la'ang 'byung ste/ ne ne dzu ti byung dza ga ga kra/ ne ne sti/ zhes pa grub/nyer sgyur ni ru sngon du bzhag /ṣa ra ṛ sogs ne dang po ṇi ru drangs/ ni rte ne sti/ ༈tas pi ta min pas yon tan phyi ma med/ ni rje ni k+taX/ ༈gnyis la'o/ /zhes pas/ an+ta a ta ru bsgyur/ ni rje ne dza ti/ ༈hro ka sis khri ni rje ni k+ṣi/ dzu kra drangasani rje ni sbaX/ ni rje sna/ ༈ni rte ni rmi/ ni rje ni dz+waX/ ni rje ni smoX/ ༈yang at+pa ne la mtsho'i na/ a ba rje don du bzhag/ /a ba ne ni khyu/ a ba ne ni dzā te/ a ba ne ni dza te/ ༈a ba ne ni ltuX/ a ba ne ni dzā tāX/ a ba ne ni dza taX/ a ba ne ni dza k+ṣa/zhes pa la sogs phal cher snga ma rnams dang 'dra'o/ ༈bi ji ru tha dad du gnas pa la'o/ /da yal bidz+ra ti pra da dbyi gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa ni dza rnams kyi yon tan no/ /zhes pas bi dang po be yon tan 'di skabs 'dir kun la'o/ /pi ta yon tan te bi phyi ma be'o/ /tsu yi ku'o/ /drangs be be snyi/ ༈de dang 'dra ba las pi ta ma yin pas yon tan phyi ma med/ dzu drangs be bi rgyu tra/ ༈tu pu pi ta yin/ dzu kra dang ṣa ru 'gro/ be si/ be bek+ta/ ༈di pu dbyi pi ta aṭa dzu ka'am gra/ a be bekra a be beg /pir+sha khyab pa la'o/ /pi bla hipra gnyis brjodaṣa yal yon tan yang yon tan/ ti ṭi be be spyi/ ༈snga mas 'gre be bi rtsi ta/ bebestu/༈ṣa sbru/ a be be dh+ra/ a be be ṭa zhes sogs so/ ༈bṛ srung ba dang gang ba la'o/ /pro)pra gnyis brjod/ da dbyi/ re bro riXbārba gya/ ṛ dang bṛ dag thog ma'i i'o/ /byings ṛ dang bṛ dag la gnyis brjod thog ma'i ṛ yig de i yig tu 'gyur ro/ /bi ud sngon du bzhag ṛ bṛ sgrub pa la bi ud dgos pa min kyang nyer sgyur sbyor ba la nges pa ster ba'i dgos don no/ /bṛ bṛ da ti pu ri —556—

yal ṛ dang po i/ phyi ma da/ pi pra ri ti/ pi pa rte/ bi ud byā pi pa rti/༈ti pu min la yon tan phyi ma med/ bṛ pri da tas da yal/ pi phri taX/༈dbyangs la ri ru ru gzhan 'dra/ /da ri a ti/ pi pra ti/ zhes so/ ༈de bzhin du yun sogs/ byā pi mṛ yan/ ༈tu pra pi ta dran byā pi pa rtu/ ༈ji skad du/ ṛ dang bṛ dag gi di dang si dag la yang na aṭa ā ga mar 'gyur ro/ /pra bṛ dis aṭa bi ud aṭa dis dang / ṭā yal byā pi par ta/ yang na bi ā pi pra no di pra yal ru rnam bcad byā pi paX byā pu ba paXbyā pi bṛ tāX/ an us yon tan byā pi pa ruX/༈ṛ 'gro ba la'o/ /ji skad du/ mtshungs pa'i yi ge ma yin dbyangs kyi thog ma'i i yig ni i yur kun nas bsgyur ba'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /ṛ ti pu da phyisaganyis brjod ṛ thog ma i/ phyi ma ri/ i dang ṛ mi mtshungs a dang yang mi mtshungs pas i ni da ru 'gyur ro/ /spra da gyi a la drangs i ya rte/ ༈pi tra min la da med/ sgo (ra btags yin ) na chu/ ༈shu blo la da/ i ya rtu/༈dbyangs dang po la gnyis pa'o/ /zhes pas gong du aṭa gnyis 'jog go/ṛ di pu da dbyi aṭa byin/ ṛ ṛ aṭa dang po/ i a/ a i/ no byung i ni i yu zhes par song / ri phyi ma yon tan/ a i e/ e la i/ i yu song /dus kyi yu da gyi a la drangs/ da gyi ru aṭa gyi a la drangs da tra sa i ya ra twa/ ༈yang na/ ṛ ṛ di pra da dbyi dang po i/ i ni ri/ gong du aṭa gnyis/ a a i yu a ru di pra/ a i e/ i da da as a la drangs dis yal ru rnam bcad/ i yaX/ re re ta mya/ a a ṛ re 3 5 / re gong ma i i de i yu ru song / a i la e e yu ṛ la drangs i ldi (ra btags yin ) tāX/—557—

༈ṛ ṛ/ an us su bsgyur/ a a ṛ tsho us/ a a ri ri/ us/ i ya ruX/ zhes so/ ༈iṇa 'gro ba la'o/ /ṇa rjes 'brel i ti pra pi ta la yon tan e/ e ti/ i tas i taX/ i a rnyi da dbyangs med du song drangs/ yan+ti/༈i yu ta/ de la rnam 'gyur med/ ༈i lcog yon tan/ e tu/ i hi/ rnam 'gyur med/ i a ni pra yon tan/ i e/ e da/ yu drangs/ a yā ni/ ༈a a i di pra i tra/ a a i tāX/ e tāX/ ༈a a i a na/ e an/ e u yu ā yan/༈'di man chad la da mi byed kyang ya ka rkyen ster ya ka bzhi po la'o/ /zhes pas so/ /i te yakra ster/ yī ring po/ yī ya te/ at+pa ne'o/ ༈iṇa pra gnyis brjod/yang gsum pa 'phel/ i i i a byung / i bar ba yu ru song / phyi ma la drangs pas yi/ de la 'phel ba yi byung/ i.u ya/ da/ u yu/ dzi gnyis drangs/ i yā ya/ grub bo/ ༈i a shus i i i a shus/ i dang po gnyis 'dra ring phyi ma yu dbyangs bral/ de a la drangs rnam bcad sī ya lcoX/ ༈i us/ i i i us gong dang mtshungs/ 'dra ring / phyi ma yu rnam bcad/ yī yuX/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈i khu 'dod pa la'o/ /u yal i ṣa ṇa pra gnyis brjod gsum pa dbyangs 'phel gyi yan lag mi 'phel/ i i ṣa in+t+ra a byung / thog ma'i ha sa sogs ṣa mi snang / i.i.i ṣa a byung / i bar ba yu/ phyi ma la yon tan/ yu dang ṣa drangs i ye lga zhes so/ ༈i ṣi a kyis/ gnyis brjod/ ṣa dang po yal/mtshungs 'dra ring / drangs/ rnam bcad yī ṣa lcoX/ ༈i ṣa us/ i ṣa i ṣa us gong dang 'dra bar sgrubs/ yī khyiX/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /byings rnams kyang ni mtha' yas nyid/ /sna tshogs don nyid thams cad du'o/ khams rnams —558—

mngon gsal nus ji bzhin/ kun bshad rdzogs par bshad pa'o/ /zhes 'grel bar 'byung ste/ byings mang po dang re re yang don mang po dang / de dag gi byings kyi don gsal bar brjod dgos pa/ rang gi nus pa dang 'tsham pa kun nas bshad pa'i don tshang bar bshad zin zhes pa ste/ rgya skad du/ sha kya rma laX/ zhes 'byung ba'i a laX gang ba'i don yin de ni rdzogs pa dang cha tshang ba'i don no/ /kun nas bshad par ming btags pa tib sogs rnam dbye'i rab tu bya ba re zhig bshad zin to//༈ //da ni byings las ming du sgrub pa krita rkyen nam byed po'i rkyen gyi sgrub tshul rnams bshad par bya'o/ /de yang krita zhes pa byed pa po dang byed pa gnyis ka la 'jug /byed pa yang byed po'i cha shas yin pas byed po'i rkyen zhes byas mod/ 'dir thun mong du go ba'i phyir byed rkyen zhes bya'o/ /krit+ta rta ri/ byed pa po la krita 'o/ /'chad par 'gyur ba tri dang puṇa la sogs pa'i rkyen rnams la krita rkyen zhes bya ste/ gtso bor byed pa po'i don la ster ba yin no/ /de yang si sogs ti sogs de dag tshig tu sgrub pa'i rkyen yin la/ 'di ni ming du sgrub pa'i rkyen ming rkyen zhes kyang bya'o/ /si sogs ni ngo bo dang bya ba dang byed po ming gcig la brten pa'i don gyi dbye ba mang po ston pa dang / tis sogs ni dus dang bya ba'i rab dbye mang po zhig ston zhing / gnyis kas kyang gcig gnyis mang po dbye ba mtha' yas ston pa'i phyir rnam dbye zhes zer la/ 'dir ming tsam du sgrub pa dngos po dang / byed pa so so'i don tsam zhig gtso bor ston gyi/ don gyi ldog cha mtha' yas pa mi sgrub pas/ spo tra rkyen la rnam —559—

dbye mi zer ro/ /ltu bu kho/ tri dang puṇa dag go /rkyen mang po dag las thog mar ༷ rkyen dang bu paṇa'i rkyen gyi bya ba bshad par bya'o/ ༈khu pa sngos 'tshed pa la'o/ /pa sngo ༷ bzhag /tsu'i ku'o/ /sngo ka pa kra rta drangs pa sto/so rā/ si'i u'o/ /ming gi brda chad can du si sogs rnam dbye'o zhes 'byung ste/ ming du grub pa mtshon byed du si sogs rnam dbye ster dgos pa las skabs 'dir rkyen ṛ yig mthar si byin na si de ā ring por bsgyur dgos la/de rdzita yin/ ni ta la ṭi yal/ lhag ma'i yi ge ā ring po la 'dren no/ /pa sto si bzhag/ si ā/ ṭi dbyi snya ā la drangs/ pa ltu/ grub/ ༈ pa shā skye⑥ 'di ma 'gyu/ra bas ti ta min/ des na/ ṭi mi bsub 'dir ṭi ṛ 'phel/ uru du 'gyur ru au la drangs pa ltu ro/ ༈ /de dang 'dra ba la pa shā dzas dzu yal sa rnam bcad pa ltu raX/ ༈khu spo nya byed pa la'o/ /spo ༷ ba theg kṛ yon tan chu si si ā ṭi mi snang /drangs/ ka rta/ ༈ka rto au/ ṛ uru pa ltu ro/ ༈gong dang 'dra/ ka rtaraX/ skyo nye 'phrog pa la'o/ khro tri lha yon tan ha shā si ā/ ṭi yal/ ha rta/ ༈tshwa au 'phel ba drangs/ pha ro/ ༈tshwa dzas as 'phel/ ha tī raX/༈kṛ taX/ krita la'o/ /byings zla sogs gsal byed mtha' tshu rol na yod/ pha rol pas so sor bsdu ba'i yi rge dang po can gyi spo tra rkyen yod na/ i ṭa ā ga ma ster ro/ /bhā tri bzhug byings la yon tan bha o/ ab/ bha ba tra/ba dang ltu bar du in+t+ra ṭa yal/ bha bi tri si ā ṛ phyis/ bha bi tru/ ༈bha bi ༷ au 'phel ba drangs/ bha bi tā ro/ ༈dzas la gong bzhin/ bha bi tā raX/ ༈e dha 'phel —560—

ba la'o/ /e dhi ༷ i ṭa/ e dhi ༷ / si ā/ ṭi mi snang / e dhi tā/ ༈au ṛ uru/ e dhi tā ro/ ༈dzas la e dhi tā raX/༈mū di to bā/ sgiskyu i ta yang na'o/ /utu ces pa u yig gi ming yin/i tra ces phyis pa'i yul gyi ming yin/ des na yang byings gsal byed mtha' can yin yang / u yig phyis pa la yang na ba ste/ gu bu srung ba la'o/ /da dbyangs u dgos don yin pas phyis/ gung yo/ zhes pa gnyis ba theg gu yon tan go / yang na i ṭa go bo tri zhes pa byung yang / i ṭa med/ ga bi tra byung / go pi tri si ā/ ṭi phyis go pi tā/ yang na ga po tra si ā sogs go stu/ ba lang 'tsho ru chug ces pa'i don no/ ༈au la/ go bi tā ro/ go bhā ro/ ༈dzas la go pi tā raX/go stu daX/ ༈ ṣa ha bzod pa la'o/ ṣaha ltu/ dang po'i ṣa ṇa ni sa na'o/ /zhes pas ṣa yig sa yig ste/ sa dza/sa ha ba ho ro da brta phya/ sa ha ba hu dag gi a yig e rā(/ /byings sa hu dang ba hu la ༷ rkyen byung na/ dbyangs kyi a yig ring thung gang yin kyang o yig tu 'gyur ro/ /sa hu so hu ba ha bo ta ru 'gyur/ ha yi lha'o/ /ha lha/ ta tha dag gi dha 'o/ /tri lha ṣa ṭu rnams las nyu'o/ khro lha khyu snga ma dbyi/ ring por yod yod ba pa'o/ ༈phu sri ā ṭi yal/ so bhā/ bzod par byed du chug so bhā ro/ so bhā raX/ ༈bo lha tra/ hu bha/ tra bha/ dha khyu/ khyu snga ma yal/ dang po ring por gdod nasagrub bo lha si ā ṭi yal/ thob par byed do'i don la/ bo bhā/ bo bhā ro/ bo bhā raX/de dag rta'i bya ba'o//༈ //da ni bu nya'i bya ba bshad de/—561—

yu bo ra nā ko yu bu dag a na a ka'o/ /yu zhes yu rkyen bu zhes bu nya'i rkyen te/ de dag la yu zhes pa an dang / bu nya'i nya phyis nas bu zhes pa a ka ru bsgyur ba yin/ ༈de gnyis las thog mar bu nya zhi bya ba ni/ tsitra nyid la a ta kyi u pa dha 'o zhes pas/ a ka ru bsgyur zin pa'i u paṅgā a la 'phel ba ā 'byung ngo / /'tshed par byed do/ /zhes pa'i don la/ btsu bu nya zhes pa bzhug nya yal/bu a ka/ puṇa 'i ta yin pas byings kyi u pa dh+wa ā ring por song / tsu drangs pā tsa ka rnam dbye dang po si byin/ de rnams bcad/ pā tsa kaX/ zhes pa grub/ pā tsa ka zhes pa'i ming de ltar sgrubs rnam dbye au sogs lhag ma rnams de ba'i sgra dang sgrub tshul 'dra'o/ ༈ /ra gsal por brjod pa la'o/ /da bu nya a ka ru song drangs pung ka/ si/ rnam bcad klogs shig pa'i don la/ pā ṭha kaX/ pā tha ya ti/ klog tu chug cig pa'i don yang yin/ lhag ma 'dra/ ༈khu kri nya byed pa la'o/ /byed do zhes dang / byed du chug ces pa'i don la/ spos na a ka ṛ/ uru ring po drangs/ kā ra ka si rnam bcad/ kā ra kaX/ kā ra ko 'dra ring / kwa ra kāX/༈bhā bu ṇa ṇa 'phel ba'i don te yal/ bu a ka ru bsgyur/ bhā 'phel ba bho da ba lo ka'i a la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ bhā ba kaX/ bhā ba rwa do/ bhā ba kāX/ ༈yang byings snyin/ nya mi snang / lu nā ti/ gcod par byed do/ lā ba ya te/ gcod du 'jug go /zhes pa'i don la/ pū ba ṇa a ka 'phel ba/ lo au ub/ si rnams bcad/ lā ba kaX/ lā ba ko lā ba kāX/ ༈ yu 'dres pa la'o/ /yo ti/bsres so/ /yā ba ya ti/ sre bar byed 'jug go /de'i don la yu bu ṇa a ka 'phel ba/ ub drangs si yā ba kaX/ yā ba ko/ yā ba kāX/ ༈pu nya rnam par dag —562—

pa la'o/ pū puṇa a ka 'phel ba ub drangs si pā ba kaX/ pā ba ko /pā ba kāX/la sogs pa'o/ /des bu na'i bya ba bshad zin to//༈ //nā myu pa twat+paX/ nā mi'i u pa khyu las ka'o/ /byings kyi u pa dh+wa nā mi'i yi ge yin pa de la/ krita rkyen ka yig 'jug ste/ kra yig yon tan dgag pa'i don yin pas phyis te a 'jog go /ka rkyen byung yang nā mi u pa dh+wa can gyi gsal byed mtha' mi dbyi'o/ ༈nā pu byed du 'jug pa la'o/ /khyi pa ti/ byed du chug cig ces pa'i don la nā pu ka kra rjes 'brel te yon tan dgag pa'o/ /a bzhag pra a la drangs khri pa si rnam bcad/ khyo paX/ khyi bo/ spu pāX/ ༈bhi di ru rnam par 'joms pa la'o/ /bhi na rnyi 'joms par byed do'i don la/ bhi di ru da song / ka a bzhag drangs/ si bhi daX la sogs pa'o/ ༈dz+nyā khong du chud pa la'o/ /ā yig mtha' can gyi byings pha rol da med pa la byings mtha'i ā yig dbyi bar 'gyur ro/ /ji skad du/ dzā na la yang ka'o/ /zhes 'byung bas ā mtha' dbyi ba de yang krita rkyen ka byung na yin gyi/ gzhan ma yin no/ /dza nā ti/shes par byed do'i don la/ dz+nyā ka a/ ṭi yal/ a thung la drangs/ si dz+nyaX/ dzhai/dz+nyāX/ sogs so/༈pa tsi naX di gra hā de ra yu ṇi ni/ pa tsin ni gra hā sogs la a yu khri ni'o/ /byings pa tsa sogs la rkyen a dang / naX di sogs la rkyen yu dang / gra ha sogs la krita rkyen ṇi ni ster te/ rkyen ṇi ni zhes pa'i ṇa 'phel ba'i don dang /ni'i i brjod don yin pas dbyi'o/ ༈ /de yang 'di ltar ri a drangs/ si pa tsaX/ 'tshod par byed do zhes sogs so/ ༈ /be rti rig par byed do zhes pa la —563sgro

bid a yon tan be drangs si be daX sogs so/ ༈smra bar byed do'i don la/bid/ i/ si/ gong bzhin sgrubs pa daXsogs/ ༈di bu rtse ba la'o/ /di pra a yon to drangs si de baX/ dī bya ti/ rtsed mo byed do zhes pa'i don no/ ༈khri bu bsnyen pa la'o/ /u brjod don snyis a bzhag k+ṣa sa ru bsgyur ri a byung yon tan/ se drangs/ si se baX/ se ba ti zhes nye bar bsnyen no'i don to/ /ba tsa sogs song ngo / ༈shun di nor gyi tshogs la'o/ khu dang i phyis ṇa da byings so/ /i tra a ta la nus 'o/ /zhes pas/ byings kyi dkyil du nus ā ga ma ster te/i ta ste i yig ni/ i ta kyi tha snyad 'ju/ga pa ni phyis ba de/ 'dir di zhes pa'i i phyis pa lta bu'o/ /ṇa na yu byings kyi dang po ṇa na'o/ /nad sri/ yu a na ru bsgyur na dang dra'i bar du nus/ na nus dra an zhes pa byung / mu dang u yal na nga ro dra a la drangs si naX da na/ phyug por byas so/ /nan+da ti/ ༈ra ma dga' rtsed lī/ /da yu/ yu an/ i phyis pa'i yu la min pas nus med/ drangs ṣa ṛ sogs na ṇa si/ ra ma ṇaX/ ༈bā ma dang kra ma dga' ba la'o/ /bā mu yu an drangs/ si bā ma ṇaX/ ༈kra mu la yang de dang 'dra/ kra ma ṇaX/ dga' bar byed do/ /zhes so/ ༈an+da dang man+da 'dzoms pa la'o/ /a rda/ yu/ an/ dzan gong /mun a rda/ an/ 'dra ba ring po drangs si/ dza nā rda naX/ 'gro ba 'joms byed dam 'gro bas mchod pa'o/ ༈marda naX/ yang de dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /ru sgra la'o/ /'dir yu rkyen gyi khyad par rtsa'i bya ba ni/ro rlu ṇa/ rle'i puṇa 'o/ /ru zhes pa'i byings la rkyen yu ṇa ster/ ṇa yig 'phel ba'i don te dbyi/ ro ti/ sgra byas sdo / /rwa pa ya ti/ skad chen po byed du —564—

'jug go /don 'di la ru sdi ji ṇa song / yu a na/ 'phel/ ro u pra drangasasi rā ba ṇaX/ naX di sogs la yu bshad zin to//༈ //gra ha sogs ni 'di lta ste/ gra hu ṇi ni bzhag ṇa dang i 'og ma phyis/ gra hu in byung / ṇa 'phel ba'i don te ha drangs/ grwa hin grub si in gyi si dang shi'o zhes pas si yal/ nā mi la na song / grwa hi zhes sogs/ ༈de bzhin du/ da ṇi ni da in 'phel ba drangs/ si dbyi ina'i na song bi sngon du bzhag bi tsā rī/ dpyod ldan no/༈ khre shā deXshaX/ thug la sogs pa'i sha'o/ khre sha la sogs pa'i byings la krita rkyen sha zhes pa ster ro/ /rkyen sha yig ni bya ba'i don te dbyi'o/ /shi ti tsa tu rbata/ shi ta bzhi po dang 'dra'o/ 'u ta ces pa phyis/ dbyi bar bya rgyu'i sha yig dang bcas pa'i rkyen te/ sha phyis pa'i a yig go /bzhi po rnams zhes pa byings thams cad pa'i sde tshan bzhi po'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin no zhes pa ste/kun nas bsgyur ba'i khyad par bshad pa sogs kyi skabs la dgongs pa'o/(thi sha sha yal/ a bzhag srin pa thi ru bsgyur ro/ /drangs/ utu sngon du bzhag si ut+pa juX/ sogs so/ ༈khyu lha 'thung ba la'o/ /khyu rdze zha lha dbyi/ sha a/ e ri utu/ sngon drangs si udha yaX/ yang na utu/ spangs/ dha yaXsogs/༈smo sgra dang me rab tu sbyor ba la'o/ /smo sha sha song a spyi ni dha mu ru bsgyur/ utu sngon gzhan snga ma rnams dang 'dra/ udha maX/ ༈pā btung ba la'o/ /pā sha a pā da ru song / gzhan 'dra/ pi baX/ utu sbyar na uh+phi paX/ ༈gh+ra dri snom pa la'o/ /rmi sha a ghā zhes pa/ dzi gh+ra ru bsgyur/ drangs/ dzigh+raX/ zhes so/ /utu sngon —565—

du bzhag tra dzu 'gro drangs urji gh+raX/ ༈to ri ba la'o/ /tī sha/ a dbyangs la u pa khyu dbyi/ hu gha lhan a la drangs si snaX/ go zhes pa lta bu ming gong du ba theg gosnaX/ ba lang gsod pa'o/ ༈ /bid sha a/ muX ā ga ma bi dang dra'i bar du bzhag /mu u phyis mu nga ro/ bin+da si go gong du bzhagago bin+daX/ tud sogs la a'o zhes ā lhag po sbyin pa'i lugs gcig yod kyang mi dgos so/༈dz+wa lā de rngaX/ dz+wa la sogs la ṇa 'o/ /byings dz+wa la sogs la rkyen ṇa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ṇa 'phel don te dbyi/ a bzhag dz+wa la 'bar ba la'o/ /dz+wa lu ṇa a 'phel ba dzā drangs si dzā laX/ ta pu'i byings kyang de dang 'dra/tā paX/ ༈pa thi 'gro ba la'o/ /pa thu ṇa a u pa dh+wa ring / mu mu pā dang tha'i bar du'o/ /u mu phyis nga ro drangs si/ raX ༈ka rnye aṇa/ las ka la aṇa 'o/ /las dang bya ba gnyis sdoms ni/ kar+sha ste las ka'o/ /don de dang sbyor ba'i phyir du/ aṇa gyi krita rkyen ster ro/ /ming g.yin thog ma bzhag pa'i byings la/ 'phel ba ste 'dir ṇa dang bcas pas kyang ngo / ༈ /spo a ṇa ṇa yal/ a/ming nga gong / 'phel ba/ kā ru/ nga kāraX/ ༈kṛ aṇa ṇa yal/ graX tha gong 'phel ba/ uru drangs si sna kā raX/༈ā to ḍaX/ utra kyi ḍa 'o/ /ā yig mtha'i byings la/ las ka'i don du ḍa rkyen ster te/ nā sni tsa/ ming can yang ngo / /ming thog ma'i byings su 'gyur ba la yang ḍa'i rkyen no/ /dper na dā ḍa/ ḍa rjes 'brel/ a ni ta la ṭi dbyi/byings dra dbyangs bral/ a la drangs/ go gong du bzhag dha na gong du bzhag—566—

go daX/ ba lang sbyin pa/ dha na daX/ nor ster ro/ ༈ /pā btung ba la'o/ /pu ḍa/ḍa song / a ṭi yal/ pra drangs dī gong si sdu paX/ gnyis 'thung ngo / /gnyis su 'thung bar byed bas so/ ༈ /dzon ḍa ḍa song / phan/ a ṭi mi snang / hro a dī sngon si dī dzaX/ ༈rnge/ skyur bsgyur ḍa yal/ a ṭi mi snang / gro ha gong / drangs/si kṛ ha snaX/ ༈dru 'gro ba la'o/ /dru za/ a ṭi mi snang / dra a drangs dra rgas sngon du bzhag khu tsaXshā dre/ shu tsa ni dra la shu'o/ khri yo ni hūṃ zhes pas bsgyur/ si rnam bcad shā draX/ gtsang sbra song ba ste dmangs rigs so/༈ /ur saXs lo po mu lha/ u ra sa'i sa phyis pa la mu mu yang na'o/ /ur sa/ rkyen ḍa pha rol tu yod pa/ bar du 'gro ba'i byings yod na/ sa yig mi snang ba dang / de'i shul du mu mu ā ga ma'o/ /u ras/ ga : ḍa/ le rjes 'brel/ ḍa a/ ṭi da yal/ ga drangs sa dbyi mu mu nga ro/ si u raX gaX/ mu mu mi byed na u ra gaX/༈bi hā ya so bi ta tsa/ bi ha ya sa'i bi ha yang ngo / /bi ha yas zhes pa ming gi byings te 'di dang u ras sgrub tshul spyi 'dra ba las/ sa ru ma zad ya yang dbyi'o/ /bi ha yas/ gas ḍa/ ḍa song / a ṭi yal/ ga lus drangs ā bi ha yas bi ha zhes par song / de'i shul du mu mu/ de nga ro/ si/ bi ha ya sā gar+sā/nam mkha' la 'a sro/ /zhes pa'i don la bi haX gaX/ yang na mu mu spangs pas/ bi ha gaX/༈a ṭo/ a dang ṭa dag—go /ming yod cing ming de dang 'brel ba'i las ka'i don la rkyen a dang ṭa zhes pa dag 'byung / de'i ṭa yig ni zhwa shrī kyi don —567—

yin pas phyis te a nyid do/ khre a yon tan/ hra ri so sor/ drangs a snyi gong / ming yin/ si rnam bcad mthar/ shā sbyar a snyi ha ra shwaX / rus pa khyer ro khyis/ zhes/ so/ ༈a smi'i tshab tu ka ba tsa bzhag/ shwa'i tshab tu 'khri yaX/ ka ba tsa ha raX'akhri yaX/ go cha phrogs so rgyal rigs kyis/ ༈bhā ra ha raX/ khur po phrogs so/ /mu mu byung na bhā raX ha raXl sogs pa'o/ ༈dha nya 'dzin pa la'o/ /lha a/yon tan dha ru a drangs dha nu gong si dha nu dha raXku mā raX/ gzhung 'dzin no gzhon nus so/ /de dag la a rkyen no/ ༈ /ri ṭa ṭa phyis a bzhag drangasatsa ra ku ru gong si ku ru tsa raX/ sgra mi snyan du spyod pa'o/ ༈ /yang na zhis 'gyung ste/ bud med kyi rtags so/ /gong ltar ku ru tsa ra sgrubs zhi pu bzhag pra song /byings mtha' yal/ drangs ku ru tsa rī/ sgra mi snyan du spyod pa mo'o zhes so/ /a rkyen gyi mtha' ma byings thams cad pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ ṭa a kri mtha' rnams tsa ra sogs dang 'dra/ zhes 'grel bar bshad de rnam dbye sbyor tshul lo/ ༈spoṭa a yon tan drangs sho ka gong sho ka ka ra byung zhwas mthar ka rgyu zhes ba 'gasho ka ka rī ka rgyu/ bu mo mya ngan byed do/ /zhes so/ ༈ya shaXka ro ti/ snyan grags sgrog go /zhes pa'i don la kā rī gong bzhin thog mthar ming bsnan pas/ya sha ska rī biṅgā/ snyan grags byed do rig pa mo/ /zhes so/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ dra rnam par 'joms pa la'o/ khri ṭa a yon to drangs/ da ra/ pur mu mu pu raX gong si/ pu raX da raX/ pu raX da ra ya ti/ grong sde bcom du bcug go ༈da ra la bha ga gong mu mu si bha gaX da raX/ skal ba 'joms pa'o/ ༈da ṭa drangs bā tsa gong mu mu/ si/ bā tsi ya maX/ ngag 'gog ces pa'o/—568—

༈i kha khi/ i kha khri'o/ /gang yang ming dang bcas pa'i byings kha dang khi dang i ste rkyen gsum 'jug ste byings nyid kṛ i yon tan/ lta sba sngon dang / bṛ hi 'jug tu sbyar/ si rnam bcad bṛ hi sta spaX ka ro ti/ 'bru 'debs par byed do zhes pa'i don la/ staX ba ka ri bṛ hi/ ༈a blo khyab byed la'o/ /'-i rjes 'brel/ri i de ba gong / 'dra ring / drangs si rnam bcad/ de bā nā sto ti/ lhas khyab bo zhes pa'i don la/ de bā piX/ de dag i rkyen gyi dpe'o/༈ khi ti pa da gya/ kha i ta tshig gi'o/ kha rkyen byin rjes/ i ta kyi ming can te gsal byed kha nyid phyis pa la byings kyi thog mar sbyar ba'i tshig gi mthar mu mu ā ga ma ster dgos so/ ༈kṛ kha spu ma gong kha phyis a bzhag ma dang kṛ bar du mu mu u mu phyis mu nga ro/ /kṛ yon to ru drangs spu maX ka raX/ bde bar byed do/ ༈bad kha/ bṛ ya gong / kha yal/ a mu mu bṛ yaX ba daX/ de dag kha rkyen gyi dpe yin no/: /de bzhin du/ hri khi ut+pa gong phyis/ i sbo yon tan mu mu/at+paX bha riX/ bdag rgyas so/ /'byor ba thob pa'i don no/ ༈ /u dar rtsokhi i yon tan/ mu mu/ u da raX bha riX/ lto ba khengs so/ /u da raX bi bha rti/ zhes so/ /de dag khi rkyen gyi dpe'o/༈e dzāX kha sha/ e dzu rnams kyi kha sha'o/ /e dzi ka spa ne/ e dzi 'dar ba la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings e dzo sogs la/ kha sha zhes pa'i rkyen 'jug go /rkyen gyi kha yig ni gong bzhin thog ma'i tshig la mu mu ster bar go phyir dang / sha yig ni la yig bzhi po bya ba mtshungs so ba'i brda yin pas kha gsal byed sha gsal byed mi snang / a bzhag go /dper mtshon na e dzo ṛ rjes 'brel/ e phro kha —569—

sha bzhag /kha dang sha yal a gnas/ nyi ster/ tsu ra sogs la nyi'o/ nya thim/dza na gong / mu mu/ nga ro/ dza naX ye thu i a byung / i yon to/ e da/ nga ro e la drangs/ thu dang yu a so sor drangs/ si rnam bcad/ dza na me dza ya/ grub/dza naX e dza ya ti/ skye bo rnams 'dar bar byed do/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /'dir sha yig ni la yig bzhi bya ba mtshungs par 'grel pas bshad la/ dpe kha cig las ri byed pa la'o/ zhes pa'ang drangs yod pas/ e thu a zhes pa'i skabs der/da byin de phyis pa'i yu lha la ྅ ster ba dgos par mngon mod/ da byin ma thag dbyi dgos phyin bla si sla sgro bcos su byas kyang don 'grub par bsams nas mi 'god pa mang ngo / /'dir rigs can gong 'og thams cad du mang mod/'bri ba rang legs so/ /ma nu shes rig la'o/ /u brjod don man kha sha a di pra sogs la a'o/ zhes rkyen ya ster man ya a sngon du paṇ+ḍita bzhag mu mu nga ro/ /ya'i a yā/ yu a la drangs/ na ya la drangs/ mthar si rnam bcas paṇ+ḍitasma n+ya/ de yang paṇ+ḍi ta mut+ta naX ma n+ya te/ mkhas pa ni bdag rang gis shes so/ /khyu ṭa ka ra ṇi/ byed pa la khyus 'o/ byings gang la byed pa'i don sgrub pa khu ṭa rkyen du 'byung / rkyen de'i kha yig ni mu mu ā ga ma ster ba'i don yin/ ṭa yig ṭa'i bya ba'i don te phyis nas rkyen dngos yu yig las so/ /yu a na'o/ nasna kṛ khyu ṭa/ kha dang ṭa yal/ kṛ yu byung / yu e nar bsgyur/ ṛ da/ gong ma la mu mu/ ka mu mu kra a ru an si zhes pa byung / mu mu nga ro/ kra dang ru a gnyis la drangs/ si ri du gyur drangs nasnaX ka ra khaṃ grub/ a nasnaX 'aX kri ya te a ne na/ 'dis gcer bu min pa sgren mor btang ngo / /de'i don gcig la —570—

dhū taX/ mthong bar byas so te/ sba bar bya ba rnams mthong ba'o/ /de dang 'dra ba snyu laX ka ra r+ṇaX da dhi/ zhes pa'i don ni/ a snyu la snyu la kri ya te/ ska ba ma yin pa ska bar byed do/ /'o ma sla ba'i dngos po de zho bska ba'i dngos por byed pa lta bu'o/ /bha dzāX ba ṇi/ bha dzu rnams kyi bi ṇa 'o/ bha dzu la sogs pa'i byings la byed pa po'i don du bi ṇa rkyen du sbyor ro/ /be:/ bi nyid kyi'o/ rkyen bi ṇa zhes pa'i rjes 'brel ṇa yig ni/ dang por 'phel ba'i don yin/ rkyen dngos bi yin na de yang dbye ba nyid do/ /bha hro nye ba la'o/ bha dzu bi ṇa/ ṇa yal/ bha la 'phel ba bhā/ bi dbyi dzu ga/ ga kra/ a rna gong / si mi snang / adhe bha ka grub/ adhe bha dza ti/ phyed mar byas kyi don no/ /pra tshu bi ṇa/ ṇa yal/ 'phel ba/ pru/ bi nub/ tshu lga ṣa ḍa/ ta twa gong / si mi snang / ta twa pru ṭa/ ta twa pru ṭā/ zhes te/ ta twa bri tsā ti/ de kho na nyid 'dri bar byed do/ /ba hu phyin pa la'o/ ba ha bi ṇa/ bsubs bā 'phel/ bi song / ha dhe/ lha ṭa/bha ra gong / si yal/ bha ra bāṭa/ yang na/ bhā ra zwa ḍa/ khur skyed do/ /bā ho rbo sha sā do su re/ ba he'i ba au te shas sogs dbyangs la'o/ /snga rol na ming ngam byings tshig tu gyur pa a mtha' can yod la/ bar der ba ha'i byings gnas pa'i pha rol du shas sogs dbyangs dang po'i rnam dbye byung na/bgye'i ba au ru ba sbyar te au ha ru 'gro'o/ bhā ru ba hu zhes pa yan chad gong bzhin/si mi byed par shas bzhag khra yul/ ra bhā ra ba hu as byung / brta'i ba au bhā/ ra'i ra'i dbyangs a dang 'dus pa au hu shas kyi a la drangs/ sa rnam bcad bhā ro ha/ khyu la yang 'dra/ bhā ro hā/ sgyu mu dbyangs dang po ma yin pas ba —571—

au ru mi 'gro/ ha sbru ru 'gro/ sbru ḍa drangs bhā ra 'a ḍaXbargyu/ zhes sogs so/ /sa ha lhan du 'grogs pa la'o/ /sa heXkhaXsu lha/ sa ha swā khyu te khri'o/ bi ṇa'i rkyen la byings sa ha ni sa lha ru bsgyur/ sa yig ṣa yig byed do/ /sa hu bi ṇa/ ṇa snang med/ sa ring / ha sbru/ swā lga dhe ḍa' ma ṭa ru song / tu rā gong / si yal/ tu rā khro ṭa/ tu rā khri ḍa/ don ni tu rā sa ha te/ lhan cig mgyogs par ro/ /au dang dzas hu nyid 'dren/ tu rā swā ho/ tu rā sa rnyaXmo no dh+wa to/ byings la ma'i na'o/ /byings ma yig mtha' can yin na/ pha rol bi ṇa la/ mu mtha' na yig tu bsgyur ro/ /bi ṇa'i yang pha rol ra sa so sor bsdu ba'i rnam dbye dgos so/ sham dang dmu nye bar zhi ba la'o/ kham bi ṇa ṇa yal/ sha 'phel bi song / nyer bsgyur ba gong / mun ru bsgyur/ si mi snang / pra shā na/ don ni pra sha mya ti/ rab tu zhi bar byas so/ /ra sa ma yin par dbyangs pha rol la/ pra shā mo/ pra shā maX au dang dzas la'o/ ā dh+wa tam+bha be kṛ ba hwa sti yo ge sgyu/ 'das pa min par gyur pa la/ kṛ bhu as sbyor be+e la nywasno/ 'das nas ring du lon pa ma yin pa'i don du byings kṛ dang sbyor ba ste kri'i rnam 'gyur dang / dh+wa dang sbyor ba as dang sbyor ba la yang ste/ gri rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /rtswa di rgyu sī ༈ gya/ tsi la ring po dang a'i sī yang ngo / /rkyen rtswa pha rol la byings ming gi mtha'i dbyangs gang yang ring por 'gyur zhing / a mtha' ni yī ring por 'gyur ro/ /bi nyid kyi'o/ /zhes pa hrore bi dbyi/ tsu yig kyang dbyi ste rkyen gyi dbye ba shes pa'i don tsam mo/ /dper na a mi thu naX me thu naX kṛ ya te a ne na/ 'di mi 'khrig pa las 'khrig par byed do/ /zhes pa'i don la/ mi thu na —572—

sngon du ba 'ag /kṛ las ka ra ṇa gong bzhin sgrubs/ rkyen stsu ster/ mi thu na tsi ka ra ṇa byung / na'i srog a ni yī ring por song / bi phyis de rjes/ tsu yal/ si da/ mi thu nī ka ra ṇaX/ zhes te 'di ni spo'i sbyor ba'o/ bhū 'gyur ba bhā ba shukla sngon du bzhag /bar du rtswa shukla/ rtswa bhā ba byung / ya'i a ni yī ru song rkyen sngar bzhin phyis/ si rnam bcad/ shu gli bhā ba/ don ni/ a shu'i/༷dzak+ṣa/༷༷bha ba ti/dkar po min pa dkar por song / zhes so/ gri'i sbyor ba'i/ dper brjod ro/ /byings ri su dang / cho ga 'byung gi /na skyu sbyar dus a dbyi bas 'dir sgyutra zhes 'byung / sa hā ya sngon du bzhag /bar du sbyi ya yī/ bi dang tsu yal/ sa ha yī myu ta/ don ni a sa hā yaXs hā yo bha ba ti/ lhan cig pa med pa las lhan cig pa can du gyur to/ /zhes so/ /as kyi sbyor ba'i dper po gad do/ /kṛ dh+wa as gsum dang sbyor ba min yang / sri la snga ma'i mtha' ring por 'gyur ba'i dpe ni/ puṇi shi ga ha ṇa/ ṇi ring po/ rtswa phyis si da/ pā ṇi gra ha ṇaX/ lag pa nas bzung ngo / /zhes so/ de bzhin du/ kṛ gzugs ma gyur ba la yang ste/ he tu rtswa krita zhes pa la tra'i srog mū ring po/ shi yal si da/ he tu kṛ taX/ don ni a he tuXhe tuXkṛ ta/ gtan tshigs mi shes pa la gtan tshigs ston no/ /༈ sa lo tho rtswa la sa dbyi ba yang ngo / /byings man sa dang tse tas dang / ma hā sa dang /ra dzas zhes pa 'di rnams la pha rol du rtswa byung na/ byings mtha'i sa yig dbyi'o/ma nas rtswa bhā ba sa dbyi na'i a ni yī ru song / bi dang tsu yang mi snang / utu sngon/ta ni lnga pa na ru song / si rnam bcad/ ad+ma nī bhā ba/ skyo bar gyur to/ ji skad du/kha cig tu ḍā yang ngo zhes 'byung bas/ duXkhri dang ka ro ti'i bar la ḍā rkyen —573—

bzhag /ṭa phyis ā ṭi phyis/ ā la drangs/ duXji ka ro ti/ sdug bsngal bar byed do/ /bha da dang ka ro ti bar du ḍā a ba 'ag /ṭi dbyi/ drangs/ bha drwa ka ro ti/ don ni a bha dāXbha drwa kṛ ya te/ legs pa ma yin pa rnams legs par byed do/ /ā to ma ni pra kwa ni pra ba ni paX uta lu ma nis kwa ni pra ba ni pra'o/byings mtha' ā yig ring po can gyi pha rol du/ rkyen ma ni pra dang / kwa ni pa dang /ba ni pra gsum po las gcig 'byung ba mang ngo / /rkyen gsum po de'i pra rnams rjes 'brel/ na rnams kyi dbyangs i yig rnams brjod don no/༈ /tā sbyin pa'i byings/ dwa ma ni pra pu rjes 'brel/ i brjod don dwa man si/ u pa dh+wa ring / mā su gong / sngar rtags drug ra dzan gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin/ si dang na 'jig go /su gi da dā ti/ legs pa'i sbyin pa sbyin no/ /zhes pa'i don la/ su dwa mā/ ༈lnga ma ni pra pra i yal/ sta za sa a shwa thu gong / sa mgo mi snang / thu tra/ si dbyi/ na yal/ ta drangs/ a shwa ta i ba sna ti/ 'di ni rta la tshugs pa'o/ /zhes pa la a shwa shrī mā/ sngar g.yin rnams kyis rta shugs su bsgyur ro/ kha cig 'di la a shwatā sngon du bzhag nas tha dbyi ba'i cho ga byas nas/ shing a shwatā la bsnun brdegs kyang mi 'bros pa bzhin g.yul ngor mi 'bros pa la 'chad pa'ang yod do/༈za sī/ sna rnams la zhi'o/ /byings snya dang pā dang gā rnams la byings mtha'i ā yig ring po yī yig ring por 'gyur te/ ki ta pha rol la yin kyang nang tshan ki pra rkyen byung na sī ru mi 'gyur ro/ ༈ /de yang pā kwa ni pu pra i yal/ kra —574—

yang dbyi/ ban lus za rnams la zhi'o/ /zhes pas pā bī zhes par bsnyur/ su gong / si/ u pa dhu ring / pā/ si na 'jig su bī bā/ su gi pi ba ti/ rab tu 'thungs so/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈dā ba ni pra/ da phyis dā ban bhā ri gong / si/ u pa dh+wa ring / na si gnyis sbas so/ /bhu ri dā bā/ ༈ ji skad sdu/ gzhan 'ga' 'ig dag las kyang mthong ngo / /zhes 'byung bas sba dang bā dang dā sogs ā mtha' ru ma zad ā mtha' ma yin pa la yang / ma ni pu sogs 'jug go ༈ kṛ ma ni pra/gong bzhin ṛ ra/ su gong / si/ u pa dh+wa ring / gnyis po yal/ su karmā/legs pa'i las byas so/ ༈su ༈ ka ro ti/ zhes pa'i don no/ ༈sha mni pra kṛ dang 'dra bar sgrubs/ su slo ni no ti/ legs par thos so/ /zhes pa la/ su sha rmā/zhes pa'o/༈ki paX/ kis 'o/ /byings thams cad kyi pha rol du kis rkyen skabs su bab na 'byung du rung ngo / /ha swā gya pi ti kṛ ti dzika/ thung dza'i krita kyi pi ta la dzika'o/ /byings thung dza'i mtha' la krita rkyen gyi nang du gtogs pa'i pi tra kyi ming can pha rol byung na shukra ā ga ma ster ro/ /krita kyi pi ta ces smos pas rnam dbye si sogs ti sogs kyi pi tra ma yin zhes pa'o/ /ki pra/ ki pra yang ngo / /ki pra kyi rkyen ni kra ba da ste yi ge bzhi 'dus pa yin rung thams cad dbyi ste/ dbyi lugs 'di la a pa ha ti kun tu 'joms zhes bya'o/ ༈ /de yang kṛ kyis ki pra ni dus gcig tu dbyi'o/ /ka lā pa'i lugs la kis kyi yi ge bzhi po la mdo tshig re res dbyi mod/ 'dir rkus yang ngo zhes pa gcig pus so/ /gro khyi kra/ karma sngon/ tu/ ka gi kra rjes 'brel/ u brjod —575—

don/ si phyis/ karma spo tra karma ke ro ti/ las byed do/ zhes so/ ༈de bzhin du/asni tsi nya/ ki pra dbyi/ shu mu/ u ka yal/ tra lus/ si 'jig asni tsitra/ asni tsi no te/ me shing gsog go /zhes so/ ༈ /stu kyis mi snang tu ka u kra dbyi/ de ba sngon/ si 'jig de bstu ta/ de baX sto ti/ lha la bstod pa byed do/ /zhes so/ ༈kis yod kyang lco ku rkyen med pa'i dper brjod ni/ /de bzhin du/ ༈pā ki pra tu ka med/ so ma gong / si rnam bcad/ so ma pāX/ de bzhin du/ krug ki pra yal/ si dbyi shra kra sarba gong / sarbarda ka/ thams cad mthong ngo / /sarba pa shu ti/༈phro nya ngag bzhin nyan pa la'o/ /sha ki pra/ ji skad du/ pra smo sogs la ring po yang ngo / /zhes 'byung bas shrī su gong si yal su shrī/ bde ba'i grogs so/ ༈ta twa sngon/ byings ru ki pra 'jig si tsha sha ṣa ra dza sogs tsha ṣa ru song / lnga'i ḍa 'o/ ḍa yang na ṭā ru song / pra tsa sogs la ring po'o/ /ta twa krā ṭa/ ta twa pru ḍa/de kho na nyid la 'dri'o/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ ba tsu ki pra yal/ rtse re ku'o/ /tsu kra/yang na kra ga si 'jig bā ga /bkra/ gdam ka'o/ /au dang dzas la bā tso/ bā tsaX/༈ji skad du/ ki pra pha rol la nyer bsgyur gyi ring po na hu la'o/ /zhes bshad pus na hu 'ching ba la'o/ /na hu kis 'jig u pa gong / nyer sgyur gyi ring po/ na hu la'o zhes pas pā ring po/ si na/ he'i dha 'o/ ༈ /hu dha/ dha ta/ si 'jig u bā na ta grub/ de ni lham gyi ming yang yin/ u ba sa sī pe na phya te/ nye bar phyin nas btod do / /zhes par yang 'gyur ro/ ༈ /yang kṛ ki pra yal/ sa rkyen byin re tra kyi ri/ /ri da du bsgyur byings gnyis brjod/ si byin ki ra gi rus si byung thog ma'i ha sa sogs ru sngon ma yal i u ra ba sogs kyis ki phyi ma ring —576—

po'o/ /ya las so zhes pas sa'i dbyangs a phyis/ sa dbyangs med/ kra gong ma tsu/ si dang rab sbyor mtha'i sa dbyi ru rnam bcad/ ka ṭa gong / ka ṭa tsi gīX/ rtsa lhas byas so/ /don ni ka ṭaX tsi ki r+ṣa ti/ zhes so/ ༈au dang dzas sogs la sa mi dbyi ste/ sa khyi au dang as la 'dren ka ṭa tsi kirjo/ ka ṭa tsi kir+shaX/ zhes so/ ༈sbyi sems pa la'o/ /ji skad du/ rnyi rnams kyi ki pra la slar yang dag par bskyur ba ring po nyid kyang ngo zhes 'byung bas/ sbyi la sogs pa'i byings la/ ki pu byung na saX pra sa ra ṇa 'byung la/ de yang thung ngu ma yin ring po ste/ sbyi kis de thams cad dbyi/ dha yi so sor phral/ saX pra sa ra ṇa spyi khyab la/ yu nyid i thung ngur bsgyur ba yin kyang / 'dir spra dang srog e gnyis po sdoms nas sī ring por bsgyur bas/ dha yī byung drangs/ su gong / si rnam bcad/ su dhīX/ rab tu sems pa'am/legs par sems pa'o/༈ khru she ni kra sa ko tso pa mā ne ka rle/ phrog la ṭa ka sa ka dag kyang ste dpe'i bya ba la'o/ /byings dri sha sogs la/ sarba sogs kyi sgra rtags sngon du bzhag na/ rkyen ṭa ka dang sa ka gang rung 'byung zhing / kyang zhes pa'i sgras ki pra kyang 'byung ngo / /de lta bu'i rkyen gsum po gang byin kyang 'dra ste/ don ni dpe nye bar mtsho ni pa ste/ gser ma mthong ba'i mi la dpe ni/ gser las gzhan pa ra gan lta bu ste/ gser ci 'dra zer/ ra gan 'dra bar mthong zhes pa lta bu'o/ /dri sha ṭa ka ces pa bzhag /sarba sogs kyi nang nas a n+ya gong / kra ṭā phyis a bzhag shra a la drangs/a sa bī de sarba sogs la u'o/ /ṭa ka sa ka ki pu ste rkyen 'di rnams pha —577—

rol du byung na/ sngon du bzhag pa'i sarba sogs kyi rtags mtha' ni ā ring po nyid du 'gyur ro/ /'dir a n+ya zhes pa'i n+ya ring por song / si rnam bcad/ a n+ya i ba dro khyi te/ gzhan dang 'dra bar ltos shig /ces pa'i don la/ a rgyu dra shaX ༈yang dro shas kra kra yal/ a n+ya gong / sarba sogs la u'o/ /zhes pas rgyu ring po/ tsha sha ṣa ra dza sogs/ shra lga ku ha sogs ṣa kra rkyen gyi sa ṣa kra ṣa k+ṣa si rnam bcad a rdzu dro k+ṣaX/ ༈a n+ya dro sha ki pra de yal rgyu ring / shra ka/ si phyis a rgyu dri kra/ ༈ta ta dang ldan pa'i dra sha las so/ /zhes pas dre sha ṭa kra kra dang ṭa yal a sarba sogs kyi nang nas ta tra gong / 'di la ta ta kyi dbyangs a thung dang / mthar brten tra dbyangs med sbrags nas ā ring por 'gro tra ā la drangs shra drangs si rnam bcad/ tā dri shaX/ des rigs 'gre/ ༈ta tra dra shas kra si zhes pa la kra yal/ shra kra/ sa lga a tra ā/ si rnam bcad tā drik+ṣaX/ ༈ta tra dṛ shra ki pu si zhes pa la ki pu 'jig a tra ā/ ri/ kra/ ha sa la si yal/ tā khrug/ zhes/ ba'o/ ༈sgrub tshul byings de kho na bzhin dri sha'i gong du usmad bzhag /usmad ni ma ta ces bar bsgyur/ sarba sogs kyi thog ma'i ā ste/ ma ta zhes pa/ mā zhes par 'gro ba khyad par ro/ /mā dra shaX/ mā drik+ṣaX/ tsakra /zhes so/ ༈rkyen ṭa ka zhes pa'i ṭa rjes 'brel ni zhwa pra bud med kyi rkyen sbyin du rung ba'i don te/ dra sha ṭa ka kra dang ṭā yal/ a bzhag /de la sha drangs ta tra gong zhes te/ tā rmi zhu la zhis byin pu thim a i la dbyi/ sha'i dbyangs a mi snang / sī la drangs/ si 'jig tā khru shī/ ༈de bzhin du/ ā smad ma ta ru bsgyur/ de mā ṭa ka zhib/ mā dra shī/ ༈a n+ya ring po ā/ ṭa kra zhi pu/ a rgyu dṛ shī/—578—

༈ki mi da moXki sho/ ki mu dang i dmu ni gī dang yī sha'o/ /ṭa ka sogs rkyen gsum po'i skabs 'dir/ byings dra sha'i gong du sarba sogs nang tshan rtags sam sgra ki mu yod na gī ring po dang / i dmu yod na yī sha ru bsgyur ro//ka i ba dra khyi ti/ gang dang 'dra bar mthong / zhes pa la 'di ltar sgrub/ ༈ki mu phrog ṭa ka /ki mu dang zhes pa'i mdo 'dis/ ki mu ni gī zhes par bsgyur/ gī phrog a drangs/ si rnam bcad/ gī khru shaX/ gī dro k+ṣaX/ gī dra ka tri shra ṭa ka i dmu gong / i dmu yī shra ru bsgyur/ sha yig khyad don gzhan 'dra/ a ya mi ba khru khyi te/ 'di dang 'dra bar mthong ngo / /zhes pa la/ yī dra shaX/ yī dro k+ṣaX/ yī dro kra zhes pa rnams gong bzhin/ sī sbyo zla ṭa ka dang zhi pu byin na gong bzhin te/ yī khru shī bā rta/ gtam 'di dang 'dra bar shes so/ /zhes pa'o/ /ji skad du/ bha ba tra sogs rnams la/ dra sha'i rnam par gnas pa'i don la ṭa kra la sogs pa'i thog ma'i ṭi ring po nyid do zhes 'byung bas/ khru sha ṭa ka/ a bta kyi ṭi ni/ a ta te/de ni ā ru bsgyur/ bha bā sha a la sbyar/ si rnam bcad bha 5khyu shaX/ bha bā dra k+ṣaX/bha bā dṛ kra/ bha bā ni bsdu shu te/ khyod dang 'dra bar shes so/༈ /ṇi ni ra tī te/ 'das pa la ṇi ni'o/ /byings gang la 'das pa'i dus kyi don dang / tshul khrims kyi don du ṇi ni zhes pa'i rkyen ster ro/ /ṇa ni 'phel ba'i don na'i i rjes 'brel rkyen dngos ni in zhes pa'o/ ༈de yang 'di ltar ya dzu ṇi ni zhes pa bzhag /i phyi ma dang ṇa yal/ ya thu in/ dang por 'phel/ ba ā te yu thu byung / drangs/ yā dzin asnitā| ma sngon du bzhag si in rnams kyi si la'o zhes pas ring / u pa dha'i rigs dzī ring por song si —579—

dbyi na ya nga dbyi/ me'i las kyis lha mchod do/ /asnosno ma yā dzī/ zhes mchod zin 'das pa'i dus so/ pra dzu ṇi ni in/ dang por 'phel/ drangs/ pra gong /si/ dzī ring si dang na 'jig /pra bru dzī/ rab tu sbong ba'o/ /tshul khrims kyi don no/ ༈bha dzu ṇi ni/ stu dzu in 'phel ba thob kyang 'dir yon to no/ /drangs bho dzin u'i gong si u pa dh+wa ring / si dang na yal/ u snaX bhak+ta ban/ zas dron mo zos so/ /zhes pa'i don la/ u mi bho dzī/༈ ki pra ba ni pra ḍāX/ ki pra dang ba ni pra dang ḍa rnams so/ /'das dus tshul khrims kyi don la/ rkyen kwa pra dang ba ni pa dang / ḍa zhes pa rnams 'jug ste/ki pu ni pi ta yin kyang thams cad dus gcig tu dbyi ba dgos chos yin/ ba ni pra ni pi tu gyi bya ba byed do/ ༈ /ha na kis 'jig bri tā gong / si/ u pa bhā ring /si dang na yal bṛ tā hā/ grub/ bṛ tā ha ta pulga/ lha min 'joms pa dang ldan pa'o ste brgya byin no/ ༈ /ṣān srog mched pa la'o/ /khu nya nya dbyi/ ba ni pra ster/pra dang i mi snang / khu ban pi ta la tu ka ste kra dang u yal/ tra lus/ khu ta ban/ṣa sa/ ta ba la drangs su twa na/ si/ u pa bhā ring si dang na yal su tā grub/ 'tsho ba rgyas pa'i don no/ /shukra ni ki ta yin pas yon tan mi 'byung ste/ so twa zhes par mi 'gro'o/ ༈dzan ḍa zhes bzhag /ḍa phyis a/ ni ta ṭi yal ba an med/dzu dbyangs med lus/ de rkyen gyi a la drangs/ sa ra/ si gong / si ri/ ḍa'i a dza la yod pa phyis nas aX la drangs/ sa ra si dzaX/ zhes te/ sa ra si dzā taX/mtsho las skyes pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ ga mu ḍa a drangs/ sarba gong / si rnam bcad/ sarba gaX/ sarba tra ga smo ti/ thams cad du 'gro'o/ ༈ /gi ḍa/ a ṭi yal/—580—

ga dbyangs med rkyen la drangs swā ma gong si rnam bcad/ swa ma ga ya ti/ snyan tshig 'don no zhes pa'i don te/ swā ma gaX/༈khyu snya ba tu/ khyi dang khyu ba tu'o/ /byings gang la 'das dus ston pa'i don la rkyen khyi dang khyi ba tu gnyis kyang 'byung ste/ 'das dus kyi dngos po'i bya byed la khyi dang / 'das dus kyi byed pa po'i don la khyu ba tu'o/ ༈ /byings kṛ la/rkyen khyi bzhag kra 'jig ta lus/ si rnam bcad kritaX/ de yang kṛ taXka ṭaX/rtsa lhas byed rgyu sngar yod pa'o/ ༈yang byings kṛ la rkyen khyi ba tu ster kra 'jig /u ni nus ster ba'i khyad don no/ /si krita bta si/ ba dang ta'i bar du nus mu dang u yal/ krita ban tra si/ u pa dh+wa ring po/ ma ning la si 'jigarab sbyor mtha'i tra yal/ kṛ ta bā na/ de la kṛ ta bān kra ṭaX rtswa lhas byas zin pa'o/ /yang ga mu khyi kra yal a nu dat+ta dbyi ba nyid do/ /zhes mu dang ud gong dra dbyi si ri/ ta'i srog yal ba da la drangs/ ā ga taX/ tshur shog ༈sta kra song sna ru bsgyur i ṭa ā phyis nas ṭa la drangs sbyi se a mu gong bzhin/ snyi taX/ 'dug shig༈ga khya shrī da karma kasnro ka rta rik+taX/ 'gro ba'i don dang las med pa dang byed po la lta'o/ /byings gang la 'gro ba'i don yod pa dang byed po'i don dang /byings las med pa la yang rkyen khyi 'jug pa yin no/ ༈aṭa 'gro ba la'o/ /yas khyi bzhag /byings rkyen bar du i ṭa aṭa i ta si byung / drangs/ rnam bcad/ i ṭi taX/ 'khor bar gyur to/ a ṭa ti/ zhes so/ ༈spre snya i ṭa za ru song / i mthong / ā yal/ drangs/ si sbi taX/ gnas pa'o/ /zhes so/ ༈ kham khyi i ṭa —581—

med/ sha mu rnams kyi ring po'o/ /zhes pas byings kyi dbyangs ring po ste/ shwa mu nga ro/ /si rnam bcad shāX taXgrub shuṭa n+taXlus 'gyur gyi khyad tsam yin/ shin+taX pru bhaX/zhi ba thob bo/ yā mya ti/ zhi bar byed ces pa'i don no/ ༈sgrub tshul de kho nas dmu snya ces pa la/ dwa n+taX/ dā mya ta/ dul bar byed do/༈lto bā se ṭa/ i ṭa bcas khyi la yang na'o/ /gong du bshad pa'i a ṭi taXdang / smi taXsogs dmigs gsal rnams ma yin pa'i i ṭa yang yod pa'i khyu byung na/ byings la yon tan byed mi byed gdam nga ste/ rkyen ki tra kyi ming can du byed na/ yon tan spangs pas rang gnas yin/ ki tra min la yon tan no/ ༈byu tra i ṭa khyu zhes bzhag kra dang ṭa song / nyer sgyur pra gong ki tra du bsams na yon tan med/ pra byu ti taX/ ki ta min du bsams na yon tan te/ pra khyo ti taX/pra dro ta te sma/ rab tu gsal bar 'dug go /byu ta sprasaX/ snang ba thob pa'o/ ༈ /bad khyi i ṭa sa spra sa ra ṇa byas pas ba yig u yig tu bsgyur/ u du i tra si byung gong bzhin/ u ti taX/ u da yaX pru rdza/ smra ba'i skabs byung ngo / /zhes pa'o/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ rud i ṭa khyi zhes pa la/ ru di taX/ yang na/ro di taX/ rod naX pra bhaX/ ༈mu lta i ṭa khyi/ zhes pa la mo ṣi taX/ yang na mu ṣi taX/mu rtsi te sma/ rkun po 'dug go /zhes pa'i don no/ ༈ /gra hu e ṭa khyi bzhagagra hu rnams kyi i ṭa la'o/ /zhes pa i ṭa'i yī ring po'o/ /ki tra la slar yang dag par bsgyur te/ gra kṛ ru 'gro/ niX min la mi 'gro /kṛ hi taX/ gra hi ta:/ don ni gro rgya te sma/ bzung bar gyur to/ ༈ /nud byed du 'jug pa la'o/ /nud i ṭa khyi/no de ta:/ nu di taX/ gong bzhin no/ /nu du ste sma/ byed du bcug pa'o/ ༈bid —582—

i ṭa khyi/ be di taX/ bi r+ya te sma/ rig par byed pa'o/ /ki taX ki ta la'o//byings u yig mtha' can dang / ṛ yig mtha' can dang shrī zhes pa'i byings las pha rol rkyen ki tra kyi ming can khyi lta bu byung na/ i ṭa ā ga ma'i rkyen mi ster te/ ṛ mtha'i dper brjod/ prita khyi si zhes pa la/ prit+taX/ zhes par 'gro bas rnam 'gyur g.yin med/ ༈u mtha'i dper brjod ni/ bhā khyu zhes pa la si byin/bha taXzhes pa kho na'o/ ༈ yī la shik+ta si bzhag shwe taX/ zhes pa kho na'o/༈bṛ t+yaX pra staXsgribs par gyur te/ bha ba ti/ byung bar gyur to/ khyu ya te sma/'byor bar gyur to/ /de dag ni lta'i rkyen gyi bya ba ste/ kra ni rnam pa kun du dbyi'o/༈ /yī dī di taX/ utu dang zhi ta i ta nyid do/ /uta ces pa ā ring po'i ming yin/ zhi ta ces pa'ang yī ring po'i ming yin/ i tra rting ma ni sngar yod phyis pa'i yul gyi ming ngo / /des na uta kyi mtha' i ta du gyur pa ste phyis pa dang /uta kyi mtha' i tra kyi ming can te phyis pa la ni i ṭa mi 'jug go /3 shī tāX ta ka brta mā ne nye ba/ nya dang i i tra la ta ka te 'ju ga bzhin pa la yang ngo / /byings gang la nya rjes 'brel yal ba dang / i phyis pa la ta ku zhes pa'i rkyen 'jug ste/ i ṭa med pa'o/ /da sta phya no da lga da las ta'i na te da yang ngo / /byings kyi mtha'i dra yig gi pha rol du rkyen ki ta yin pa'i ta yig byung na ta yig de na yig tu 'gyur la/da yig rang nyid kyang na yig tu 'gyur ro/ ༈ /de yang nyi mi dā snum pa'am 'phrod pa la'o/ /nyi ma dā/ nyi rjes 'brel/ da yi dbyangs ā brjod don/ mid lus/—583—

mid ta kra/ kra rjes 'brel da las ta'i na te zhes pas/ byings kyi mtha'i dra yig gi pha rol rkyen ta ka zhes pa'i ta yig dbyangs bcas na yig srog can du 'gyur ro/ /mid na zhes so/ /da yang ngo zhes pas byings mtha'i dra yig dbyangs med mid zhes pa'i dra rang nyid kyang na dbyangs bral du 'gyur ro/ /min byung / drangs/mi sno si da/ na'i a yal/ drangs/ mir+ghaṃ grub/ bsres pa'am sbags pa'i don te/ mi ni ma snoX tai le na brta te/ zas la til mar 'dres par blugs so/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈nyi nyi dā lus gsher ba la'o/ /nyi dang ā yal/ ṣi dra ta ka i ṭa med/ tan dra na/ sri/ si rnam bcad/ pra gong / pra srinaX/ rdul nag gis gsher ba'o/ /ā yā se na pra sī bya ti/ rang las byung bas rab tu gsher ro/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈ /nyi gi khya dwa phyi mar 'thag pa la'o/ /nyi dang ā phyis/ khrid ta ka ba theg i ṭa med ta na/ du na si rnam bcad/ yinaX/ k+ṣi du ti/ phye mar 'thag go /༈ a do dza ghuXki ti/ ad dza snyi ki ta lu'o/ /ad ces pa'i byings ni pha rol du ki tra yin pa'i rkyen byung na/ dza gha zhes par kun nas bsgyur te/ de yang ad ta ka kra song / ad ces pa dza gha ru song / dza gha ta byung / gha ga ru 'grota tha'i dha zhes pas ta dha ru 'gyur/ dzag dha byung / drangs/ si da sngar bzhin/dzam+bhaX/ bza' bya thob bo/ /zhes pa la/ a da naX bru bhaX/ 'on kyang dzaghaX/ sha'i bza' ba la bye brag tu 'jug go༈ raX/ ra las so/ byings kyi mtha' gdod ma'am rnam 'gyur gyi re pha yin na yang / pha rol kyi rkyen gyi ta yig na yig tu 'gyur te/ de yang byings mtha' rang dgos kyi byings mtha' rkyen gyi re pha'i mtha' tsam la ma yin —584—

no/ /kri nya 'tshe ba la'o/ /nya yal/ kṛ ta ka bzhag re ta da 'o zhes pas/ kra da/ drangs/ ki ru/ i ur ba ha sa la zhes pas re pha'i gong gi yī ring po/ ta na/ ṣa ra ṛ sogs ṇa/ chu la ku ba sogs/ bi sngon si da/ gong bzhin/ bi kiṇiX/ rab tu bcom mo/ /bi ki r+ya te/ ༈ snya rnam par bskyod pa la'o/ /krita kra da thung ngu sogs sngar dang 'dra/ bi kiṇiX rnam par myos so/ ༈ /dzhai khu rnyi khu lang tsho bcom pa la'o/ ༈ /spyon ṣa yal/ dzo k+ta/ ṛ ri/ i ring ta na/ na ṇa/ si da/ dzī ya te sma/ rgas so dang 'gyur song dang rnyings pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /de la sauX/ ༈ṣ+ka khyi gong ltar sgrubs sauX/ dhī klo 'e/ rnyings so/ /dhī r+ṇaX sha rī raX/lus rgas so/༈ /swā byo di taX/ lha sogs dang otra i ta la'o/ /pū nya gcod pa la'o/ /zhes sogs kyi byings dang / o ta ces pa o yig go /i ta te o de 'dra/ phyis pa'i byings la yang / ha yig ni na yig tu 'gyur zhing / byings la i thung yod na yī ring por yang bgyur ro/ ༈ /lha k+ta/ ta na/ si rnam bcad/ lha naXgrub/ pū ya te sma/ gcod par byed pa nyid do/ ༈ /lha sogs zhes pa'i sogs khongs dper brjod ni/ khyi zad pa la'o/ /khyi khyi zhes pa bzhag /ji skad du/ yang na khyi la ring po ste/ nges par rtogs pa la na'o/ /zhes 'byung ba byings lta gcig bu yin yang zad pa'i don dang nges par rtogs pa gnyis su 'gro bas/ ༈nges par rtogs pa'i don du sgrub na/ snyi'i i thung yī ring du 'gyur/rkyen gyi ta yig na yig go /khrin ṣa ra ṛ sogs ṇa/ si da pho ṇaX/ don ni spyi ya te sma te nges pa rnyed pa'o/ /zad pa'i don du byed na/ khri tra/ si rnam bcad/ 585—

khri taX/ gzhan rnam 'gyur med/ ༈khri ka ta/ mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge ā ring por 'gro /slu ta na si rnam bcad/ slu naX/ slu ya ti sma/ mi dga' bar gnas so/༈ /de bzhin du/ gli khyi/ glu na/ glu ya te sma/ don snga ma dang 'dra/ ༈o hwa ka btang ba la'o/ /o dang kra yal/ otra phyis pa'i dper brjod de/ o yig byings mthar yod mi dgos so/ /des na thog ma'i khyad don o yig phyis pa nyid o i ta yin no/ /hā snya he'i dbyangs ā ring nyid yī ring du 'gyur/ ta na/ si rnam bcad hi naX/ hi ya te sma/ nyams pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ dwa k+ta ā yī sa ta na/ si/dī naXgrub/ di ya te sma/ spyin par gnas so/ /ā yī ru 'gro ba ni/ za rnams kyi zhi'o zhes pa'i gzhus las so/ ༈ /o byā yi rgan pa la'o/ /o dang i phyis byā bī/byā ya pri'o/ /byu yu zhes pa'i byings bī zhes par bsgyur ba ste/ ta'i rkyen pha rol du byung na'o/ /byā ya khyi/ bī zhes par bsgyur/ ta na si rnam bcad bī naX/rgan lo/ /rtsub lo/ /do da sti/ dwa'i twa 'o/ /byings dā ni/ ki ta rkyen khyi lta bu la cwa ces bar bsgyur ro/ /dwa k+ta/ kra 'jig dā zhes pa dad da ta drangs si dat+taX/ dī ya te sma/ sbyin pa gda'o/ ༈dā lti btu/ ka dang u yal/ dwa ta bta byung / da dad/ da sna/ si/ ba dang tra'i bar du nus ā ga ma/ dad ta ban tā si zhes byung / u pa bhā ring / bā si 'jig rab sbyor mtha' tra dbyi/ dat+ta bā na grub/ da dā tisma/ sbyin pa 'dug go༈ /dū hu nye bar gdung ba la'o/ /du khyi ta na/ si/ dū naXgrub/ tsha bas gdungs so/༈ /swa rwa sto bā/ dbyangs las ta yang na'o/ /dā zhes pa'i byings ni/ pha —586—

rol rkyen khyi byung la byings rang gi thog mar ming tshig gzhan dbyangs mtha' byung na/ ta dbyangs med du 'gyur ba'am/ yang na sngar bzhin dad du bsgyur ro/ ༈ /dwa k+ta nyer sgyur sa pra gong / de'i tshe dbyangs mtha' thog mar byung / dā dbyangs bcas tra dbyangs bral du bsgyur/ rkyen gyi tra yig na ru mi 'gro'o/ /pra ta/ ta si/ prat+taX/ yang na prad ta si pra dat+taX/ ༈yang pra'i dod du a ba bzhag na/ si da/ gzhan 'dra/ a bat+taX a ba dat+taX/ ches sbyin pa nyid do/ ༈ /ya dzu lha mchod pa la'o/ /ya dza khyi/ ya dz+ra rnams kyi ya ba ra rnams so zhes/sa spra sa ra ṇa byed pas ya i ru song i/ dzu tsha sha ṣa ra dza sogs hro lga ta ni ṣa mthong bas ṭa/ si/ da/ i niX/ ༈khyi ba tu ster na'ang gong bzhin thams cad te/is ṭa ban/ ta/ si/ u pa dh+wa ring / si dang tā yal/ i gi bān/ 'dod pa'i lha mchod do/ ༈ khub pu sa bon dang thags skyed pa la'o/ khu dbyi'o/ /da khyi/ ba u sa spra sa ra ṇa byed/ drangs/ si da/ ustaX/ grub/ u bya te sma/ sa bon las myu gu skyes so/ yang na thags btags so/ ༈ /ba ha thob pa la'o/ /ba hu snya/ ba sa spra sa ra ṇa byas/ u/ ha he'i rte'o zhes pas/ ha bha ta tha'i dha 'o/ /rkyen dha dha lha ru song / khyu la lha dbyi ste ring po'o/ /zhes pas u ring por song / lha dbyangs bral mi snang / ྅ khyuX/ mū rnyo3n ḍū hā saX guX/ khyu mchog 'theng po la zhon pa'o/༈he nya 'bod par byed pa la'o/ /nya rjes 'brel he khyu bzhag hu be ta byung /sa spras ra ṇa ra byas/ mū ring por song / rgyu mtshan pa tsam la u thung yin kyang /srog e yod pas rgyu de las ring po'o/ /nyer sgyur ri sngon/ si rnam bcad/ ā hu ya te sma/ mgron du bos so zhes pa la/ ā hu taX/ ༈bye nya g.yogs pa —587—

la'o/ /bye khyi ba e ta byung / saX pra sa ra ṇa sa/ ye/ yī ru bsgyur rgyu mtshan/ ya rang nyid i thung 'gyur dgos na'ang / srog e ya bsgyur ba'i nus pas yī ring po'o/ /gong du ha la rnam 'gyur med/ be la sa spra sa ra ṇa byed pa ltar/ 'dir thog ma'i yi ge bral/ rnam 'gyur med/ ye sa spros ra ṇa byed pa'o/ /nyer sgyur da gong / drangs/ si rnam bcad/ yang na si da saX bī ya te sma/sa sdi ta/ sa sgri taX/ yang dag par g.yogs pa'o/ /yang na mang pos mchod do/༈ /yang byings bad khyi kra yal/ ba dbyangs bcas u i ṭa ster/ u du i ta drangs/ si da/ da shas la a phyis/ drangs/ u di taX/ ༈bsngo k+ta/ ba u/ tsa yi ku'o/ /tsu ka ru song / drangs/ si ri/ uk+taX/ u di taX dang / uk+taX don gciga.u du te sma/ smra ba nyid do/༈ba si khri dho riṭa/ bas dang khri dha dag la i ṭa 'o/ /byings bas dang spu dha la rkyen khyu pha rol la i ṭa ster ro/ /bas k+ṣa i ṭa/ sa spra sa ra ṇa/ us i ta/si ri/ uṣ+ṭha te sma/ u ṣi taX/ gnas chos shig ces pa'o/ ༈khyu dha bkres pa la'o/ /khri dha khyi i ṭa khri dha i ta/ si/ khyu dhi taX/༈gha sā deXṇaX gas sogs la khri'o/ /byings lhas sogs la khyi byung na/byings mtha'i sa ṣa yig tu 'gyur ro/ /lha slo za ba la'o/ /le rjes 'brel/ gas khyi/ sa lga ta ṭa si rnam bcad/ grwa giX/ zas la spyod do/ ༈ /tred srung ba la'o/ /dra rjes 'brel/ tri khyi bzhag /tru ṇa rgyu bā ni bā twa rnye/ bhā ṇa sogs la ni pā ta yang na'o/ /ji skad du/ ta yig na yig tshig phrad do/ /zhes kyang bshad pas tre dra la sogs pa la klu'i rkyen —588—

gyi skabs 'dir srung ba'i don la sogs pa don gyi khyad par sna tshogs pa yin kyang lti'i ta yig na yig tu bsgyur ba'i ni pā da'i sgrub pa byed do/ /'on kyang mtha' gcig tu ni ma yin te/ yang na/ ta nyid du gnas so/ /ta na ru bsgyur bar ma zad/ tri ni t+yā ring por bsgyur ro/ i ā ru bsgyur ba tri kho na la yin gyi gzhan la ma yin no/ ༈ des na tra i ta tan/ na ṇa/ i ā/ si rnam bcad nywa ṇaX/ yang tre ta si/ tri t+yā ru bsgyur ba las gzhan mi dgos/ tru taX/ ༈sogs khongs dper brjod ṇ+ḍi3/ kra yal tan de ṇa/ si/ hi ṇaX/ ta rang gnas hi taX/ngo tsha ro/ /zhes so/ ༈ghā khyi/ tan/ de ṇa/ si/ ghā ṇaX/ ghā taX/ snom byed de sna'o/༈ /bi du khyi ta na dra yang na/ si/ bi snoX/ yang na ta rang gnas/ dra ta/ bstiXrig pa'o/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ nud khyi na/ da na si/ nunaX/ yang na/ ta rang gnas/ da ta/ nut+taX/ byed 'jug go'am gyis shig go ༈bā 'gro ba dang dri dag la yang ngo / /bāk+ta ta na/ ni ru gong / si rnam bcad/ ni bī ṇaX/ yang na ta mi 'gyur/ ni rwa taX/ kun spangs sam/ myang 'das so/༈ /sa smra rlung pe khyuXka ro ti bhā ṣa ṇi su ṭa/ sa mu ba ri u ba rnams las kṛ la rgyan gyi don du su ṭa'o/ /mdze se byed dang gzhan na las khyad 'phags kyi yon tan brjod pa'i don du/ kri'i byings la thog mar saX dang pa ri dang u pa zhes pa nyer sgyur gsum gang rung sbyar na su ṭa ā ga ma ster te/ de yang byings kyi thog mar ro/ ༈ /kṛ khyi su ṭa ā ga ma byings kyi gong du bzhag ṭa dang u yal/ sa dbyangs med phar drangs/ da gong / si rnam bcad/ saX sla taX/ saX sla te sma/ legs byas sam legs sbyar ro/ ༈ /pa ri sbyar na/ pa ri u ya te sma/—589—

yongs su byed pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don la/ pa ri u taX/ u ba sbyar na/ u pa khyu ya te/ nye bar sbyor bar byed ces pa'i don la/ u ba sgro taX/ ༈bha be lha nya/ dngos po la lha nya'o/ /dngos po'i don du spo'i byings la gha nya'i rkyen ster te nya rjes 'brel lo/ /kṛ lha nya gha yang khyad don no/ /sus gong / sa spo a/ ri gong / ṛ 'phel ba uru/ si/ saX sa ka uru a si/ rim pas drangs rnams bcad saX sku raX/ 'du byed ces pa'o/ /de yang saX khyu ya te/ shin du byed pa'o/ ༈ /gzhan de dang 'dra ba las/ sdoskyu med/ a laX sngon du bzhag /a laX kṛ ya te/ mdzes bar byed do/ /zhes pa'i don la/ a laX kā raX/ rgyan no/༈phan gha/ dza ne rdzuXstsosno/ /dza na dzā ru bsgyur/ si/ dzā taX/ dza te sma/ skyesaso/ /zhes pa'o/༈ /pa tse baX/ pa tsu la ba'o/ /pa tsu'i byings la ba rkyen te/ khyi ba ru bsgyur pa yin no/ /pa tsu khyi /kra yal/ ta ba ru bsgyur/ tsu'i ku'o zhes pas tsu ka drangs si/ pa kwaX/ btsos pa'o/ ༈ /pa kwa sgrub tshul de ltar byas nas/ sla yang bta rkyen byin/ si nus ā ga ma 'jog ste/ ba dang tra'i bar du'o/ /bkwa ba na tra si/ u pa dh+wa ring po/ si 'jig rab sbyor la tra yal/ bka bān/ ༈hwa lto skams pa la'o/༈ khu ṣeXkaX/ hwa skyu la ka'i/ /byings shu khri'i pha rol du rkyen snya byung na ta ni ka zhes par 'gyur ro/ khri yil khyi ta ka/ ṣa sa drangs/ si shu bya te sma/ skams pa'o/ /zhes pa la shu skaX/ spu zad byed pa'o/ /nā k+ta ka ru song mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge u'o / / /zhes pas khyi byung /—590—

spu de rmaX/ k+ṣa las ma'o/ /nywa sogs kyi byings kyi pha rol rkyen khyi ni ma rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /smye ya te sma/ /zad byed do zad byed kyi nad lta bu'o/ /don de la nywa maX/ ༈swā yi dang o bya yi rgan po la'o/ /swā yaXkhyiX/ spyi ni lha'o/ /byings khyi ni rkyen khyu mthong na khyi ru 'gyur ro/ ༈ /snya khyi sdi ru bsgyur/ si/ spyi taX/༈a byu ya khyi/ o dbyi byā ya zhes pa bī ru song bī taX/ rgan po'o/༈kwa su kā no ṇa be bta/ kwa su dang ka ṇa dag ṇa pa be dang 'dra'o/ /byings la kra su'i rkyen byung na 'das dus lkog gyur gyi rkyen ṇa pu sogs/ pa ra smi dang 'dra ba'i cho ga dang / kaṇi rkyen byung na/ lkog gyur gyi e sogs ut+pa ne'i bya ba dang 'dra'o zhes pa'i don no/ ༈ /bhi di ru gnyis su 'byed pa la'o/ /ri mi snang / snyed kwa su kā ni yon tan dgag pa dang / u ni nus gyi cho ga 'jug ba'i don yin dbyi/ bhi dra bas byung / ṇa pra mtshungs pa'i don gnyis brjod yin pas/nyid nyid thog ma'i ha sa sogs dra snga ma yal/ bhi bi ru song / si dang nus/ bi bhi da ba nas si zhes byung / u pa khyu ring si dang sa 'jig dra drangs bi bhi snyen/grub bo/ /bi bhe te ti/ 'joms par byed ba'am bsed par byed pa'o/ ༈kri kwa su ka dang u thim/ kṛ bas gnyis brjod kṛ kra ru bsgyur/ ka tsa/ si/ num/ u pa khyu ring / tsa kṛ bā nas si/ si dang sa dbyi tsa spo bān/ byed pa po'o/ /tsa kā ra dang don gcig go ༈kṛ kā ṇa kra yon tan spangs pa'i don/ kṛ un gnyis brjod ṛ dang po a thung de tsa ṛ phyi ma ru ru song / tsakra ru ā na si ru dang kra ā la drangs/ na ṇa si rnam bcad/ 'dzo ṇaX/ ༈ /han kwa su/ kra dang u yal/ gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa sogs/ ha dzha de dza ha phyi ma'i dbyangs phyis sna khya ru song /—591—

si nus/ na dang ba'i bar du i ṭa/ u pa dh+wa ring / dza lhan i bānas si zhes pa byung / na gha i la drangs si su yal/ dza ghi bān/ zhes grub/ dza ghā na/ 'tshe ldan no/ ༈ kha tri shā no ti pra te bta kri yā lha mu/ sha ༷ dang shā na dag ti pu te dang 'dra ste bya ba la'o/ /bya ba zhes pa bya ba'i tshig ste/ ga mya ma na zhes byings dang rkyen 'du bar rung ba'o/ /de la rkyen chu byin na pa ra smi'i tib dang sgrub tshul 'dra la shwan byin na/ ut+pa ne te dang sgrub tshul 'dra'o/ ༈ /ba tsu sha phro sha yal ṛ nus gyi bya ba'i don no/ /ri a ta si nus ri an ta si/ drangs/ si dang tra 'jig pa pa tsa na/ zhes pa grub po/ /pa tsan a sti ba 'ag thung ngu mtha'i da ṇa na rnams pha rol dbyangs mthong na gnyis su 'gyur bas/ a thung gi mtha'i na yig pha rol a yig mthong bas/ na nyis 'gyur du song ba a sti'i a la drangs/ pa tsan+da sti/ tshos nas sdod cig ces so/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ da glo bzhagad na ru bsgyur lugs/ pa tsan dang 'dra/ pha rol du tiṣ+ṭha ti bzhag bar du sa kra rkyen byin/ akra song / sa dbyangs bral gnas/ pa ṭha nas/ tiṣ+ṭha ti/ zhes pa byung / na nga ro sa ti la drangs pa ṭhaX rjo ti/ klog nas 'dug cig ༈gi sha tri i ā ya si nus ga ā yu un ta si/ si tra yal/ so sor drangs/ gā yun grub/ ru ti dang sbyar/ gā ya ṅga ts+tsha ti/ smos la song zhig༈mu gā ne3 taX/ a tra las ā na la mu ka'o/ /byings a mtha' can gyi pha rol rkyen ā na byung na bar du mukra ā ga ma ster ro/ /pa tsa shwan/ sha song / pa tsa un 'dir pa tsa'i tsa dbyangs ldan no/ /byings rkyen bar du mu ka kra dang u song /pa da un mu drangs si rnam bcad pa tsa mā naX/ 'tshed pa po'o/ /pa tsa ti/ ༈de —592—

bzhin du/ pi pa shwan zhes pa mu ka pi pa mā naX pi pa ti/ 'thung ba po'o/ /yadza shwan/ mu ka/ yadza munaX ya dza te/ mchod sbyin byed mkhan no/ /ya dza mā na sto ti/ mchod spyin pos bstod do/ ༈ /ma nu a pa bo khyo ne/ ma nu shā na bzhug 'di rkyen ā na yin yang byings a mtha' min bas mu ka mi ster/ u pra drangs/ si rnam bcad/ ma nā naX/ grub/ ma rgya te/ gus pa lo/༈ /ā se rā na yī/ us la ā na'i zhi'o/ /byings us rkyen ā na byung na ā na yī ru 'gyur ro/ /us gnas pa la'o/ /us un si/ ā na yī na ru bsgyur/ si rnam bcad ā snyinaX/ ā ste/ gnas par gyis shig༈bā di'i po shaX tuX/ a tra la sha tu te zhi pu la yang na'o/ /a ta mtha' la rkyen sha tu ster ba ni rtag tu yin la/ de'i steng du bud med kyi yī pu ster na nus ā ga ma ster mi ster gdam nga'o/ ༈tud sha tu/ sha dang u yal/ tud a ta drangs si yal tu dad/ yang na tu gan/ gdung ba po'o/ ༈ /zhi pra ster na/ tud/ a ta/tu/ dan/ zhis/ si/ dbyangs mthar nus/ tud na ta yī si byung na nga ro ta yī la bud med la si dbyi/ tu dan+ti/ ༈nus spangs na tud a ta zhi pra si drangs/ si yal tu da dī/ zhes so/ ༈ /tu dan+ti au/ tu da khyo/ ༈tu da skyi dzas/ dzu dbyi/ da/ tu dan+t+raX/ ༈zhwa pra la nus med na/ tu da rkyo/ tu da tuX/ ༈yī pu med na si gong du song /spyod tra au bzhag /au yī/ tu da tī/ ༈spyod tra/ dzas/ dzas shas shi/ ste/ tu da ti/ zhes pa'o/ ༈rud sha tu rbad a ta/ bar du nus/ mthar yī da si bzhagarud a na tra yī si byung / na nga ro drangs/ si dbyi ru daX tī/ grub/ sdi ru da tī brta te/ bud med du bar byed bzhin pa zhes so/—593—

༈ /a bya yo rwa ni tuX/ ༈a ta la da kyi a'i rtag tu'o/ /'dir mdo 'di ltar sgrubs te/ a bi zhes pa ab kyi'o/ /a os/ a la drug pa'i os sbyar/a'i zhes pa'i don no/ /bi dang sbyar/ bya ru song / 'di a er song / e da/bya a la drangs/ yu o la drangs/ sa rnam bcad/ a bya yoX ri gyi a'i zhes pa'o/ /de rjes uta ces a yig gi don dang / ni tuX zhes pa ni rtag tu zhes so/ /ā ta la ngi yod kyang tshig phrad kyis zhig pa'o/ /des na uta las zhes bya'o/ /nā mi'i pha rol rnam cad ru dbyangs med du song ba de ā la drangs/ tra na de ni la drangs pa'o/ /de ltar ā mtha' can gyi pha rol zhes pa ni/ da bi ka ra ṇa'i rkyen dang sbrel ba'i/ a yig gi mtha'i pha rol du rkyen sha tu byung na nus ā ga ma rtag tu 'byung ste/ i yig dang zhwab kyang pha rol du sbyor zhes bya ste/ 'on kyang re zhig rdzis las gzhan pa'i i yig ngos 'dzin rgyu med do/ ༈ /dh+wa la da yon tan ab ste bha ba sngar bzhin sgrubs/ bha ba sha tu bzhag /ba'i dbyangs da kyi a de yal/ sha tu a tra du song ba'i a la drangs zhwas si ba dang tra'i bar du nus/ bha ban tra sī si/ na nga ro/ tra sī la drangs/ si 'jig bha ban+ti/ ༈des mtshon pa/ pa tsa dang pa ṭha dang ha sa la de bzhin du sgrubs pas/ pa tsaX tī dang pa ṭhaX tī/ ha sa khyi/ ༈dī bya dang nywa sgri la a pu med/ di bu rtsed mo dang / shis dga' ba'i byings la sngar bshad ltar ya rkyen byung ba yin/ de dag zhis si nus rnams byin pas/ dī bya rnyi/ 'a rtsiX tī/ grub bo/ ji skad du/ gnyis brjod pa rnams kyi dzak+ṣa sogs la yang sha tu rtag par te nus dgag pa'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ dā dang ya dza k+ṣa sogs kyang yin pa'i byings gnyis brjod can la/ sha tu rtag par —594—

'jug kyang nus med ces pa ste/ sha tu rtag par 'jug ces pa'i don 'chad tshul gcig la/ byidas de dag ming du sgrub tshad rkyen sha tu med du mi rung ba'i go ba ma yin mod/ sha tu rkyen nam sbyor kyang 'dra/ nus mi 'byung zhes pa'i go don no/ /des dus nges med du 'jug par 'brel ba la yang rtag par ming 'dogs pa'ang yod/ don gzhan gnyis sogs du ma la thun mong du 'jug pa la yang rtag pa'i sgra yod pa shes par bya'o/ /dper na lo gcig la 'jigs pa zhig dus lan gcig gam 'ga' re las mi 'byung yang dus nges pa med na/ rtag tu zon dgos zer ba dang / mi che ge mo dus ston gnyis ka la 'ong ba la/ che ge mo de rtag par 'ong zer ba lta bu'o/ /yang bshad lugs gcig la 'dir sha tu rkyen mang du 'jug pa yod pa la nu mu dgag pa'i don te/ yang na rtag par zhes pa nu mu la sbyar te/ rtag par ྅ṭā dgag pa'o zhes bton na rig pa mi shes pa la go bde'o/ ༈ /dwa sha tu a ta du song / gnyis brjod/ dang po thung ngu / a mthong bas dwa'i ā yal/ drangs/ si yal/ dad tra au yī/ da da tī/ dzas i/ da da ti/ ༈ dzak+ṣa gad mo la'o/ /dzak+ṣa a ta a ya la drangs/ si mi snang / dza k+ta ta/ au la dzak+ṣa tī/dzas la nus byung na/ dza k+tan+ti/ nu mu med na dzak+ṣa ti/ ༈rdzu gro sha tu/ ṛ yon tan dzug ru a tu/ drangs/ si yal/ dza ga ra tra/ yang na ṛ ru/ dzā gra ta/ ku lā ni dzag rte/ rigs can mel tshe byed do/༈ /da ri drwa sha tu/ da ri drwa'i ā dbyi'o/ /zhes bshad pas/ da ri dra a ta drangs si yal/ da ri dra ta/ tsa ka sri ṛ rjes 'brel/ tsa kas a tra drangs/ si —595—

yal tsa kā sa ta/ 'od can no/ ༈ thus a tra drangs/ si mi snang / shā sa ta/ a nu shā sa ti/ chad pas bcad do/ /zhes pa'o/༈ /bi dwa de rbu ba suX/ bid la nges par ba su'o/ /bid kyi byings la rkyen sha tri'i gnas su ba su ster ro/ /de la rgya skad bā zhes yang na ba la 'jug pa mang yang / 'di mi zad pa yin pas res 'ga' yang na ba bkag pa'i nges pa la yang 'jug res 'ga' gnyis ka ma yin pa'i tshig rgyan nam tshig gi kha skongs tsam yang yod pa las/ 'di'i 'grel bshad la las nges par 'chad/ la las gdam khar 'chad do/ /'grel par sha tri'i yul la ba su rkyen du 'gyur ro zhes pa'i don yang kha cig khrig tri'i yul te gnas su 'chad cing / bid la yang na rkyen lo ste ba yang yod/ lgo'i tshab tu ba su ster ba'ang yod ces 'chad/ nges par 'dod pa 'ga' zhig yul gyi don sngar byung zhig pa'i shul te lo phyis nas ba su ster zer/ la la lo ba su ru bsgyur ba yin yang zer ro/ ༈ /bid ba su u brjod don bas/ si/ nus/ u pa bhā ring po'o/ /bid bā nas si byung / si dang sa yal/da bā la drangs bi dwan/ rig pa can te ma/khas pa'o/ ༈ /yang na bar 'dod na/ ba su bshad zin/ bid sha ༷ ri dang sha myi snang / a ta lus/ si/ nu mu/ u paṅgā ring po med/ g.yin 'dra/ bi dan zhes so/ ༈ /yang ji skad du/ a tra bha ba ta dang ta ta bha ba ta kyi sgra dag mchod pa'i don la ni pā da'o/ /zhes 'byung pa a ta bha ba ta si rnam bcad/ bhaṭa mi grwa/ rnam bcad u de o/ 'di rkyen sogs gang yang med/ ba la nga ro baX tshig phrad do/ /a ta bha brnyo bhaṭa mi shā/ 'dir yod pa ni rje bo gsal pa'o/ zhes so/ /'di don la bhaṭa ni rje zhes bya mod/ gtso bo yin tshad —596—
